# ==============================
# вњ… DAILY QUEST SYSTEM
# ==============================

DAILY_QUEST_ID_KILL_MONSTERS = "kill_25_monsters"
DAILY_QUEST_TARGET_KILLS = 25
DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_ITEM_ID = 201  # рџ”ґ РњР°Р»Рµ Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ Р·РґРѕСЂРѕРІвЂ™СЏ
DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_QUANTITY = 3


def get_daily_today_str():
    from datetime import date
    return date.today().isoformat()


def init_daily_quest_system():
    """
    Р©РѕРґРµРЅРЅС– Р·Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ v1.

    РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅР° РІРµСЂСЃС–СЏ:
    - 1 Р·Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ РЅР° РґРµРЅСЊ
    - РІР±РёС‚Рё 25 РјРѕРЅСЃС‚СЂС–РІ
    - РЅР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґР°: РњР°Р»Рµ Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ Р·РґРѕСЂРѕРІвЂ™СЏ x3
    """

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_daily_quests (
        user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        quest_date TEXT,
        quest_id TEXT,
        progress INTEGER,
        target_count INTEGER,
        completed INTEGER,
        reward_claimed INTEGER
    )
    """)

    conn.commit()


def reset_daily_quest_if_needed(user_id):
    init_daily_quest_system()

    today = get_daily_today_str()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT quest_date
    FROM user_daily_quests
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO user_daily_quests (
            user_id,
            quest_date,
            quest_id,
            progress,
            target_count,
            completed,
            reward_claimed
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            user_id,
            today,
            DAILY_QUEST_ID_KILL_MONSTERS,
            0,
            DAILY_QUEST_TARGET_KILLS,
            0,
            0
        ))

        conn.commit()
        return

    quest_date = row[0] or ""

    if quest_date != today:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE user_daily_quests
        SET
            quest_date=?,
            quest_id=?,
            progress=0,
            target_count=?,
            completed=0,
            reward_claimed=0
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (
            today,
            DAILY_QUEST_ID_KILL_MONSTERS,
            DAILY_QUEST_TARGET_KILLS,
            user_id
        ))

        conn.commit()


def get_daily_quest_status(user_id):
    reset_daily_quest_if_needed(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        quest_date,
        quest_id,
        progress,
        target_count,
        completed,
        reward_claimed
    FROM user_daily_quests
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "exists": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р©РѕРґРµРЅРЅРµ Р·Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        }

    (
        quest_date,
        quest_id,
        progress,
        target_count,
        completed,
        reward_claimed
    ) = row

    return {
        "exists": True,
        "quest_date": quest_date,
        "quest_id": quest_id,
        "progress": progress or 0,
        "target_count": target_count or DAILY_QUEST_TARGET_KILLS,
        "completed": bool(completed),
        "reward_claimed": bool(reward_claimed),
        "reward_item_id": DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_ITEM_ID,
        "reward_quantity": DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_QUANTITY
    }


def process_daily_quest_progress_on_kill(user_id, mob=None):
    """
    Р’РёРєР»РёРєР°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ РїС–СЃР»СЏ РїРµСЂРµРјРѕРіРё РЅР°Рґ Р±СѓРґСЊ-СЏРєРёРј РјРѕРЅСЃС‚СЂРѕРј.

    Р’СЂР°С…РѕРІСѓСЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ:
    - Р·РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅС– РјРѕРЅСЃС‚СЂРё
    - РµР»С–С‚РЅС– РјРѕРЅСЃС‚СЂРё
    - Р±РѕСЃРё, РєРѕР»Рё РІРѕРЅРё Р±СѓРґСѓС‚СЊ СЂРµР°Р»С–Р·РѕРІР°РЅС–
    """

    reset_daily_quest_if_needed(user_id)

    status = get_daily_quest_status(user_id)

    if not status["exists"]:
        return {
            "updated": False,
            "completed": False,
            "message": None
        }

    if status["reward_claimed"]:
        return {
            "updated": False,
            "completed": False,
            "message": None
        }

    if status["completed"]:
        return {
            "updated": False,
            "completed": True,
            "message": None
        }

    progress = status["progress"]
    target_count = status["target_count"]

    new_progress = min(target_count, progress + 1)
    completed = 1 if new_progress >= target_count else 0

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE user_daily_quests
    SET progress=?,
        completed=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_progress,
        completed,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    if completed:
        return {
            "updated": True,
            "completed": True,
            "message": (
                "рџ“† Р©РѕРґРµРЅРЅРµ Р·Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ РІРёРєРѕРЅР°РЅРѕ!\n"
                "вњ… РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ: 25/25\n"
                "рџЏ›пёЏ РџРѕРІРµСЂРЅС–С‚СЊСЃСЏ РґРѕ Р Р°С‚СѓС€С– Р·Р° РЅР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґРѕСЋ."
            )
        }

    return {
        "updated": True,
        "completed": False,
        "message": f"рџ“† Р©РѕРґРµРЅРЅРµ Р·Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ: {new_progress}/{target_count}"
    }


def claim_daily_quest_reward(user_id):
    reset_daily_quest_if_needed(user_id)

    status = get_daily_quest_status(user_id)

    if not status["exists"]:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р©РѕРґРµРЅРЅРµ Р·Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        }

    if not status["completed"]:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                "вќЊ Р©РѕРґРµРЅРЅРµ Р·Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ С‰Рµ РЅРµ РІРёРєРѕРЅР°РЅРѕ.\n\n"
                f"рџ“€ РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ: {status['progress']}/{status['target_count']}"
            )
        }

    if status["reward_claimed"]:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вњ… РќР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґСѓ Р·Р° СЃСЊРѕРіРѕРґРЅС– РІР¶Рµ РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°РЅРѕ."
        }

    result = add_item(
        user_id=user_id,
        item_id=DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_ITEM_ID,
        quantity=DAILY_QUEST_REWARD_QUANTITY
    )

    added = result.get("added", 0)
    lost = result.get("lost", 0)
    name = result.get("name", "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")

    if added <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                "рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР° РїРµСЂРµРїРѕРІРЅРµРЅР°.\n\n"
                "Р—РІС–Р»СЊРЅРё РјС–СЃС†Рµ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂС– С‚Р° СЃРїСЂРѕР±СѓР№ Р·Р°Р±СЂР°С‚Рё РЅР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґСѓ С‰Рµ СЂР°Р·."
            )
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE user_daily_quests
    SET reward_claimed=1
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    conn.commit()

    message = (
        "рџЋЃ Р’Рё РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°Р»Рё РЅР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґСѓ Р·Р° С‰РѕРґРµРЅРЅРµ Р·Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ!\n\n"
        f"рџ“¦ {name} x{added}"
    )

    if lost > 0:
        message += f"\nвљ пёЏ РќРµ РІР»С–Р·Р»Рѕ РІ СЃСѓРјРєСѓ: x{lost}"

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": message
    }

def init_weapon_damage_system():
    """
    Р”РѕРґР°С” СЃР»СѓР¶Р±РѕРІС– РїРѕР»СЏ РґР»СЏ РјР°Р№Р±СѓС‚РЅСЊРѕРіРѕ Р·Р±РµСЂРµР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ damage РЅР° Р·Р±СЂРѕС—.

    РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅР° v1 РјРѕР¶Рµ СЂР°С…СѓРІР°С‚Рё damage РґРёРЅР°РјС–С‡РЅРѕ Р·:
    - item_level
    - rarity
    - weapon_hands
    - РЅР°Р·РІРё Р·Р±СЂРѕС—

    РђР»Рµ РїРѕР»СЏ Р·Р°Р»РёС€Р°С”РјРѕ РІ Р‘Р” РґР»СЏ РјР°Р№Р±СѓС‚РЅСЊРѕС— Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєРё.
    """

    migrations = [
        ("items", "weapon_min_damage", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "weapon_max_damage", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "weapon_min_magic_damage", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "weapon_max_magic_damage", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "weapon_attack_type", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.commit()


def is_weapon_name_magical(name):
    """
    РўРёРјС‡Р°СЃРѕРІР° Р»РѕРіС–РєР° РґРѕ РєР»Р°СЃС–РІ/С‚РёРїС–РІ Р·Р±СЂРѕС—.

    РџРѕСЃРѕС… = magical.
    Р’СЃРµ С–РЅС€Рµ = physical.
    """

    if not name:
        return False

    name_lower = name.lower()

    if "РїРѕСЃРѕС…" in name_lower:
        return True

    return False


def calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(item_level, rarity, weapon_hands=1):
    """
    Р‘Р°Р·РѕРІР° С„РѕСЂРјСѓР»Р° Weapon Damage v1.

    1H:
    min = level Г— 0.8 Г— rarity_multiplier
    max = level Г— 1.2 Г— rarity_multiplier

    2H:
    РґРѕРґР°С‚РєРѕРІРѕ Г—1.35
    """

    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    item_level = int(item_level or 1)
    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    rarity_multiplier = DYNAMIC_STAT_MULTIPLIERS.get(rarity, 1.0)

    hand_multiplier = 1.0

    if int(weapon_hands or 1) == 2:
        hand_multiplier = 1.35

    min_damage = int(round(item_level * 0.8 * rarity_multiplier * hand_multiplier))
    max_damage = int(round(item_level * 1.2 * rarity_multiplier * hand_multiplier))

    min_damage = max(1, min_damage)
    max_damage = max(min_damage, max_damage)

    return min_damage, max_damage


def get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id(inventory_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” damage РїСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЊ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°.

    РЇРєС‰Рѕ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ С” main_hand Р·Р±СЂРѕС”СЋ вЂ” РїРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” РЅСѓР»С–.
    """

    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        items.name,
        items.category,
        items.slot_key,
        items.weapon_hands,
        items.rarity,
        items.item_level,
        items.weapon_min_damage,
        items.weapon_max_damage,
        items.weapon_min_magic_damage,
        items.weapon_max_magic_damage,
        items.weapon_attack_type
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.id=?
    """, (inventory_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "is_weapon": False,
            "attack_type": "physical",
            "physical_min": 0,
            "physical_max": 0,
            "magic_min": 0,
            "magic_max": 0,
            "text": None
        }

    (
        name,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        rarity,
        item_level,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type
    ) = row

    if category != "equipment" or slot_key != "main_hand":
        return {
            "is_weapon": False,
            "attack_type": "physical",
            "physical_min": 0,
            "physical_max": 0,
            "magic_min": 0,
            "magic_max": 0,
            "text": None
        }

    is_magical = is_weapon_name_magical(name)

    attack_type = "magical" if is_magical else "physical"

    # РЇРєС‰Рѕ РІ РјР°Р№Р±СѓС‚РЅСЊРѕРјСѓ damage Р±СѓРґРµ Р·Р°РїРёСЃР°РЅРёР№ Сѓ Р‘Р” вЂ” РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС”РјРѕ Р№РѕРіРѕ.
    if is_magical:
        if weapon_min_magic_damage and weapon_max_magic_damage:
            min_dmg = weapon_min_magic_damage
            max_dmg = weapon_max_magic_damage
        else:
            min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
                item_level=item_level,
                rarity=rarity,
                weapon_hands=weapon_hands
            )

        return {
            "is_weapon": True,
            "attack_type": attack_type,
            "physical_min": 0,
            "physical_max": 0,
            "magic_min": min_dmg,
            "magic_max": max_dmg,
            "text": f"рџ”® РњР°Рі. С€РєРѕРґР°: {min_dmg}-{max_dmg}"
        }

    if weapon_min_damage and weapon_max_damage:
        min_dmg = weapon_min_damage
        max_dmg = weapon_max_damage
    else:
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

    return {
        "is_weapon": True,
        "attack_type": attack_type,
        "physical_min": min_dmg,
        "physical_max": max_dmg,
        "magic_min": 0,
        "magic_max": 0,
        "text": f"вљ”пёЏ РЁРєРѕРґР°: {min_dmg}-{max_dmg}"
    }


def get_player_attack_profile(user_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” РїРѕРІРЅРёР№ РїСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЊ Р°С‚Р°РєРё РіСЂР°РІС†СЏ РґР»СЏ Р±РѕСЋ.

    v1:
    physical:
        damage = random weapon damage + STR - DEF Г— 0.5

    magical:
        damage = random magic weapon damage + INT - DEF Г— 0.5
    """

    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return {
            "attack_type": "physical",
            "stat_attack": 0,
            "weapon_min_damage": 0,
            "weapon_max_damage": 0,
            "display_attack": 0,
            "weapon_text": "Р‘РµР· Р·Р±СЂРѕС—"
        }

    total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta, lvl = stats

    main_hand_id = get_equipped_slot(user_id, "main_hand")

    if not main_hand_id:
        return {
            "attack_type": "physical",
            "stat_attack": total_str,
            "weapon_min_damage": 0,
            "weapon_max_damage": 0,
            "display_attack": total_str,
            "weapon_text": "Р‘РµР· Р·Р±СЂРѕС—"
        }

    weapon_data = get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id(main_hand_id)

    if not weapon_data.get("is_weapon"):
        return {
            "attack_type": "physical",
            "stat_attack": total_str,
            "weapon_min_damage": 0,
            "weapon_max_damage": 0,
            "display_attack": total_str,
            "weapon_text": "Р‘РµР· Р·Р±СЂРѕС—"
        }

    attack_type = weapon_data["attack_type"]

    if attack_type == "magical":
        stat_attack = total_int
        weapon_min = weapon_data["magic_min"]
        weapon_max = weapon_data["magic_max"]
    else:
        stat_attack = total_str
        weapon_min = weapon_data["physical_min"]
        weapon_max = weapon_data["physical_max"]

    display_attack = stat_attack + weapon_max

    return {
        "attack_type": attack_type,
        "stat_attack": stat_attack,
        "weapon_min_damage": weapon_min,
        "weapon_max_damage": weapon_max,
        "display_attack": display_attack,
        "weapon_text": weapon_data.get("text")
    }


def get_inventory_weapon_damage_display(inventory_id):
    """
    Р”Р»СЏ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ.
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” С‚РµРєСЃС‚ damage Р·Р±СЂРѕС— Р°Р±Рѕ None.
    """

    weapon_data = get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

    if not weapon_data.get("is_weapon"):
        return None

    return weapon_data.get("text")

    - active contracts

    """

            """, (user_id,))

        cursor.execute("""

        return {

def add_stat_value(stats, stat_key, value):
    if stat_key == "str":
        stats["bonus_str"] += value
    elif stat_key == "dex":
        stats["bonus_dex"] += value
    elif stat_key == "int":
        stats["bonus_int"] += value
    elif stat_key == "wis":
        stats["bonus_wis"] += value
    elif stat_key == "sta":
        stats["bonus_sta"] += value


def get_random_main_hand_profile():
    return random.choice(list(MAIN_HAND_PROFILES.keys()))


def get_random_off_hand_profile():
    return random.choice(list(OFF_HAND_PROFILES.keys()))


def get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile=None):
    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        if item_profile in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
            return item_profile

        return get_random_main_hand_profile()

    if slot_key == "off_hand":
        if item_profile in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
            return item_profile

        return get_random_off_hand_profile()

    return ""


def get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands=1, item_profile=None):
    icon = DYNAMIC_RARITY_ICONS.get(rarity, "вљЄ")

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, MAIN_HAND_PROFILES["sword_1h"])
        return f"{icon} {profile['name']}"

    if slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, OFF_HAND_PROFILES["shield"])
        return f"{icon} {profile['name']}"

    return f"{icon} Р—Р±СЂРѕСЏ"


def generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(slot_key, item_level, rarity, weapon_hands=1, item_profile=None):
    stats = {
        "bonus_str": 0,
        "bonus_dex": 0,
        "bonus_int": 0,
        "bonus_wis": 0,
        "bonus_sta": 0,
        "pdef": 0,
        "mdef": 0
    }

    # ==============================
    # MAIN HAND
    # ==============================

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, MAIN_HAND_PROFILES["sword_1h"])

        main_stat = profile["main_stats"][0]
        base_multiplier = 1.00

        if profile["hands"] == 2:
            base_multiplier = 1.20

        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, base_multiplier)
        add_stat_value(stats, main_stat, value)

        extra_pool = profile["extra_stats"]

    # ==============================
    # OFF HAND
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile_key = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES.get(profile_key, OFF_HAND_PROFILES["shield"])

        if profile_key == "shield":
            stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.35)
            stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        elif profile_key == "talisman":
            stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.35)
            stats["bonus_wis"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.65)

        elif profile_key == "dagger":
            stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.95)
            stats["bonus_str"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)

        extra_pool = profile["extra_stats"]

    # ==============================
    # ARMOR SLOTS
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "helmet":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.40)

        bonus = random.choice(["sta", "wis", "dex"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)
        add_stat_value(stats, bonus, value)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "shoulders":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.00)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "chest":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.60)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "gloves":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.60)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["dex"])

    elif slot_key == "legs":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.20)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
        stats["bonus_sta"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["sta"])

    elif slot_key == "boots":
        stats["pdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        stats["bonus_dex"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["dex"])

    # ==============================
    # JEWELRY
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "necklace":
        stats["mdef"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.30)
        stats["bonus_wis"] = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["wis", "int"])

    elif slot_key == "ring":
        stat_choice = random.choice(["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.90)
        add_stat_value(stats, stat_choice, value)

        extra_pool = ARMOR_EXTRA_STATS_BY_SLOT.get(slot_key, ["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])

    else:
        extra_pool = ["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"]

    # ==============================
    # EXTRA BONUSES BY RARITY
    # ==============================

    if rarity in ["uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        bonus_count = 1
        min_bonus = 2

        if rarity == "rare":
            bonus_count = 2
            min_bonus = 3

        if rarity == "epic":
            bonus_count = 3
            min_bonus = 4

        for _ in range(bonus_count):
            bonus_type = random.choice(extra_pool)

            bonus_value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
            bonus_value = max(min_bonus, bonus_value)

            add_stat_value(stats, bonus_type, bonus_value)

    return stats


def calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(item_level, rarity, weapon_hands=1):
    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    item_level = int(item_level or 1)
    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    rarity_multiplier = DYNAMIC_STAT_MULTIPLIERS.get(rarity, 1.0)

    hand_multiplier = 1.0

    if int(weapon_hands or 1) == 2:
        hand_multiplier = 1.35

    min_damage = int(round(item_level * 0.8 * rarity_multiplier * hand_multiplier))
    max_damage = int(round(item_level * 1.2 * rarity_multiplier * hand_multiplier))

    min_damage = max(1, min_damage)
    max_damage = max(min_damage, max_damage)

    return min_damage, max_damage


def detect_weapon_profile_from_name(name):
    if not name:
        return ""

    lowered = name.lower()

    if "РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅРёР№ РїРѕСЃРѕС…" in lowered:
        return "staff_2h"

    if "Р¶РµР·Р»" in lowered or "РѕРґРЅРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅРёР№ РїРѕСЃРѕС…" in lowered:
        return "wand_1h"

    if "РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅРёР№ РјРµС‡" in lowered:
        return "sword_2h"

    if "Р»СѓРє" in lowered:
        return "bow_2h"

    if "Р°СЂР±Р°Р»РµС‚" in lowered:
        return "crossbow_2h"

    if "РјРµС‡" in lowered:
        return "sword_1h"

    if "С‰РёС‚" in lowered:
        return "shield"

    if "С‚Р°Р»С–СЃРјР°РЅ" in lowered:
        return "talisman"

    if "РєРёРЅРґР¶Р°Р»" in lowered:
        return "dagger"

    return ""


def is_weapon_profile_magical(profile_key):
    if profile_key in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
        return MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["attack_type"] == "magical"

    return False


def get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id(inventory_id):
    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        items.name,
        items.category,
        items.slot_key,
        items.weapon_hands,
        items.rarity,
        items.item_level,
        items.weapon_min_damage,
        items.weapon_max_damage,
        items.weapon_min_magic_damage,
        items.weapon_max_magic_damage,
        items.weapon_attack_type,
        items.item_subtype
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.id=?
    """, (inventory_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "is_weapon": False,
            "attack_type": "physical",
            "physical_min": 0,
            "physical_max": 0,
            "magic_min": 0,
            "magic_max": 0,
            "text": None
        }

    (
        name,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        rarity,
        item_level,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        item_subtype
    ) = row

    if category != "equipment" or slot_key != "main_hand":
        return {
            "is_weapon": False,
            "attack_type": "physical",
            "physical_min": 0,
            "physical_max": 0,
            "magic_min": 0,
            "magic_max": 0,
            "text": None
        }

    profile_key = item_subtype or detect_weapon_profile_from_name(name)

    if profile_key not in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
        profile_key = detect_weapon_profile_from_name(name)

    is_magical = is_weapon_profile_magical(profile_key)
    attack_type = "magical" if is_magical else "physical"

    if is_magical:
        if weapon_min_magic_damage and weapon_max_magic_damage:
            min_dmg = weapon_min_magic_damage
            max_dmg = weapon_max_magic_damage
        else:
            min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
                item_level=item_level,
                rarity=rarity,
                weapon_hands=weapon_hands
            )

        return {
            "is_weapon": True,
            "attack_type": attack_type,
            "physical_min": 0,
            "physical_max": 0,
            "magic_min": min_dmg,
            "magic_max": max_dmg,
            "text": f"рџ”® РњР°Рі. С€РєРѕРґР°: {min_dmg}-{max_dmg}"
        }

    if weapon_min_damage and weapon_max_damage:
        min_dmg = weapon_min_damage
        max_dmg = weapon_max_damage
    else:
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

    return {
        "is_weapon": True,
        "attack_type": attack_type,
        "physical_min": min_dmg,
        "physical_max": max_dmg,
        "magic_min": 0,
        "magic_max": 0,
        "text": f"вљ”пёЏ РЁРєРѕРґР°: {min_dmg}-{max_dmg}"
    }


def create_generated_equipment_item(user_id, item_level, rarity):
    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    item_level = int(item_level)
    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    if rarity not in ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        rarity = "common"

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "lost": 1,
            "message": "рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР° РїРµСЂРµРїРѕРІРЅРµРЅР°. Р•РєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ РЅРµ РІР»С–Р·Р»Рѕ."
        }

    slot_key = get_dynamic_slot_key()
    item_profile = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key)
    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "weapon"

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "offhand"

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1
        name = get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    rarity_name = DYNAMIC_RARITY_NAMES.get(rarity, "Р—РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅРёР№")
    name = f"{name} {item_level} СЂС–РІРЅСЏ"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type
    ))

    item_id = cursor.lastrowid

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    inventory_id = cursor.lastrowid

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "lost": 0,
        "name": name,
        "rarity": rarity,
        "rarity_name": rarity_name,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "message": f"{name}"
    }

def get_common_equipment_shop_suboffers(user_id, slot_key):
    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    price = get_common_equipment_price_for_slot(player_level, slot_key)

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        allowed_profiles = get_allowed_shop_main_hand_profiles(user_id)

        return [
            {
                "slot_key": slot_key,
                "profile_key": profile_key,
                "name": MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["name"],
                "hands": MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["hands"],
                "attack_type": MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["attack_type"],
                "item_level": player_level,
                "price": price
            }
            for profile_key in allowed_profiles
        ]

    if slot_key == "off_hand":
        allowed_profiles = get_allowed_shop_off_hand_profiles(user_id)

        return [
            {
                "slot_key": slot_key,
                "profile_key": profile_key,
                "name": OFF_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["name"],
                "hands": 1,
                "attack_type": OFF_HAND_PROFILES[profile_key]["attack_type"],
                "item_level": player_level,
                "price": price
            }
            for profile_key in allowed_profiles
        ]

    return []

def buy_common_equipment_from_trader(user_id, slot_key, item_profile=None):
    if slot_key not in SLOT_ORDER:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ СЃР»РѕС‚ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ."
        }

    if slot_key == "main_hand" and item_profile not in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ С‚РёРї Р·Р±СЂРѕС—."
        }

    if slot_key == "off_hand" and item_profile not in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ С‚РёРї РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РґР»СЏ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё."
        }

    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    price = get_common_equipment_price_for_slot(player_level, slot_key)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        }

    gold = row[0] or 0.0

    if gold < price:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°.\n\n"
                f"рџ’і РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ: {price:.2f} рџЄ™\n"
                f"рџ’° РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {gold:.2f} рџЄ™"
            )
        }

    result = create_generated_equipment_item_for_slot(
        user_id=user_id,
        item_level=player_level,
        rarity="common",
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    if not result.get("success"):
        return result

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold - ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (price, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"вњ… РљСѓРїР»РµРЅРѕ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ.\n\n"
            f"рџ“¦ {result['name']}\n"
            f"рџЏ· Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°: {player_level}\n"
            f"рџ’і РЎРїР»Р°С‡РµРЅРѕ: {price:.2f} рџЄ™"
        )
    }

def detect_weapon_profile_from_name(name):
    if not name:
        return ""

    lowered = name.lower()

    if "РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅРёР№ РїРѕСЃРѕС…" in lowered:
        return "staff_2h"

    if "Р¶РµР·Р»" in lowered or "РѕРґРЅРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅРёР№ РїРѕСЃРѕС…" in lowered:
        return "wand_1h"

    if "РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅРёР№ РјРµС‡" in lowered:
        return "sword_2h"

    if "РєРёРЅРґР¶Р°Р»" in lowered:
        return "dagger_1h"

    if "Р»СѓРє" in lowered:
        return "bow_2h"

    if "Р°СЂР±Р°Р»РµС‚" in lowered:
        return "crossbow_2h"

    if "РјРµС‡" in lowered:
        return "sword_1h"

    if "С‰РёС‚" in lowered:
        return "shield"

    if "С‚Р°Р»С–СЃРјР°РЅ" in lowered:
        return "talisman"

    return ""

def expand_bag_slots_to_40():
    """
    Р РѕР±РёС‚СЊ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІРёР№ СЂРѕР·РјС–СЂ СЃСѓРјРєРё 40 СЃР»РѕС‚С–РІ.
    Р”Р»СЏ С–СЃРЅСѓСЋС‡РёС… РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶С–РІ, Сѓ РєРѕРіРѕ РјРµРЅС€Рµ 40, РїС–РґРЅС–РјР°С” РґРѕ 40.
    """

    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET bag_slots=?
        WHERE bag_slots IS NULL OR bag_slots < ?
        """, (DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS, DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS))

        conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass

def create_user(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (
        user_id,

        max_hp,
        level,
        exp,
        gold,
        kills,
        bag_slots,
        current_location,
        str,
        dex,
        intelligence,
        wis,
        sta,
        equipped_weapon,
        equipped_armor
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        170,
        170,
        1,
        0,
        0.0,
        0,
        DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS,
        "start_path",
        10,
        10,
        10,
        10,
        10,
        None,
        None
    ))

    conn.commit()

    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)
    migrate_legacy_equipment_to_slots(user_id)
    expand_bag_slots_to_40()

# ==============================
# вњ… GOLD FORMAT HELPERS
# ==============================

GOLD_ICON = "рџ’°"
GOLD_NAME = "Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ"


def format_gold(amount):
    try:
        amount = float(amount)
    except Exception:
        amount = 0.0

    return f"{amount:.2f} {GOLD_ICON} {GOLD_NAME}"


# ==============================
# вњ… OVERRIDE: BUY ITEM FOR GOLD
# ==============================

def buy_item_for_gold(user_id, item_id, price, quantity=1):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ"
        }

    gold = row[0] or 0
    total_price = float(price) * quantity

    if gold < total_price:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°.\n"
                f"РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ: {format_gold(total_price)}\n"
                f"РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {format_gold(gold)}"
            )
        }

    add_result = add_item(user_id, item_id, quantity)

    added = add_result.get("added", 0)
    lost = add_result.get("lost", 0)
    name = add_result.get("name", "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")

    if added <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР° РїРµСЂРµРїРѕРІРЅРµРЅР°. РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РєСѓРїР»РµРЅРѕ."
        }

    actual_price = float(price) * added

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold - ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (actual_price, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    new_gold_row = cursor.fetchone()
    new_gold = new_gold_row[0] if new_gold_row else 0

    message = (
        f"вњ… РљСѓРїР»РµРЅРѕ: {name} x{added}\n"
        f"рџ’і Р’РёС‚СЂР°С‡РµРЅРѕ: {format_gold(actual_price)}\n"
        f"рџ’° Р—Р°Р»РёС€РёР»РѕСЃСЊ: {format_gold(new_gold)}"
    )

    if lost > 0:
        message += f"\nвљ пёЏ РќРµ РІР»С–Р·Р»Рѕ РІ СЃСѓРјРєСѓ: x{lost}"

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": message,
        "added": added,
        "lost": lost,
        "gold_left": new_gold
    }


# ==============================
# вњ… OVERRIDE: SELL EQUIPMENT TO TRADER
# ==============================

def sell_inventory_item_to_trader(user_id, inventory_id):
    if is_inventory_item_equipped(user_id, inventory_id):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                "вќЊ РќРµРјРѕР¶Р»РёРІРѕ РїСЂРѕРґР°С‚Рё РІРґСЏРіРЅРµРЅРёР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚.\n\n"
                "РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ Р·РЅС–РјРё Р№РѕРіРѕ Р· РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°."
            )
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        inventory.id,
        inventory.item_id,
        items.name,
        items.category,
        inventory.quantity,
        items.sell_price
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.id=? AND inventory.user_id=?
    """, (inventory_id, user_id))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂС–."
        }

    inv_id, item_id, name, category, quantity, sell_price = row

    quantity = quantity or 1
    sell_price = sell_price or 0

    if category != "equipment":
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р§РµСЂРµР· С†Рµ РјРµРЅСЋ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РїСЂРѕРґР°РІР°С‚Рё С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ."
        }

    if sell_price <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РјР°С” С†С–РЅРё РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ."
        }

    total_gold = round(quantity * sell_price, 2)

    cursor.execute("""
    DELETE FROM inventory
    WHERE id=? AND user_id=?
    """, (inventory_id, user_id))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold + ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (total_gold, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"рџ’° РЎРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°РЅРѕ С‚РѕСЂРіРѕРІС†СЋ.\n\n"
            f"рџ“¦ {name} x{quantity}\n"
            f"рџ’° РћС‚СЂРёРјР°РЅРѕ: {format_gold(total_gold)}"
        ),
        "gold_earned": total_gold
    }


# ==============================
# вњ… OVERRIDE: COMMON EQUIPMENT BUY
# ==============================

def buy_common_equipment_from_trader(user_id, slot_key, item_profile=None):
    if slot_key not in SLOT_ORDER:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ СЃР»РѕС‚ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ."
        }

    if slot_key == "main_hand" and item_profile not in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ С‚РёРї Р·Р±СЂРѕС—."
        }

    if slot_key == "off_hand" and item_profile not in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ С‚РёРї РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РґР»СЏ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё."
        }

    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    price = get_common_equipment_price_for_slot(player_level, slot_key)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        }

    gold = row[0] or 0.0

    if gold < price:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°.\n\n"
                f"рџ’і РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ: {format_gold(price)}\n"
                f"рџ’° РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {format_gold(gold)}"
            )
        }

    result = create_generated_equipment_item_for_slot(
        user_id=user_id,
        item_level=player_level,
        rarity="common",
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    if not result.get("success"):
        return result

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold - ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (price, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    new_gold_row = cursor.fetchone()
    new_gold = new_gold_row[0] if new_gold_row else 0

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"вњ… РљСѓРїР»РµРЅРѕ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ.\n\n"
            f"рџ“¦ {result['name']}\n"
            f"рџЏ· Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°: {player_level}\n"
            f"рџ’і РЎРїР»Р°С‡РµРЅРѕ: {format_gold(price)}\n"
            f"рџ’° Р—Р°Р»РёС€РёР»РѕСЃСЊ: {format_gold(new_gold)}"
        )
    }

# ==============================

def repair_equipped_item(user_id, inventory_id):
    if not is_inventory_item_equipped(user_id, inventory_id):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РІРґСЏРіРЅРµРЅРёР№."
        }

    item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)

    if not item:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        }

    (
        inv_id,
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        quantity,
        max_stack,
        durability,
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        sell_price
    ) = item

    if category != "equipment":
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ С” СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏРј."
        }

    if durability is None:
        durability = 100

    repair_cost = calculate_repair_cost(durability, rarity)

    if repair_cost <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": f"рџ› пёЏ {name} РІР¶Рµ РјР°С” РїРѕРІРЅСѓ РјС–С†РЅС–СЃС‚СЊ."
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        }

    gold = row[0] or 0.0

    if gold < repair_cost:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р° РґР»СЏ СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚Сѓ.\n\n"
                f"рџ“¦ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚: {name}\n"
                f"рџ’і РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ: {format_gold(repair_cost)}\n"
                f"рџ’° РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {format_gold(gold)}"
            )
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE inventory
    SET durability=100
    WHERE id=?
    """, (inventory_id,))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold - ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (repair_cost, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"вњ… РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РІС–РґСЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚РѕРІР°РЅРѕ.\n\n"
            f"рџ“¦ {name}\n"
            f"рџ› пёЏ РњС–С†РЅС–СЃС‚СЊ: {durability}/100 в†’ 100/100\n"
            f"рџ’і РЎРїР»Р°С‡РµРЅРѕ: {format_gold(repair_cost)}"
        ),
        "repair_cost": repair_cost
    }


# ==============================

# ==============================

def repair_all_equipped(user_id):
    equipped_items = get_equipped_items_for_repair(user_id)
    total_cost = get_total_repair_cost(user_id)

    if total_cost <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "рџ› пёЏ РЈСЃРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РІР¶Рµ РјР°С” РїРѕРІРЅСѓ РјС–С†РЅС–СЃС‚СЊ.",
            "total_cost": 0.0
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ.",
            "total_cost": total_cost
        }

    gold = row[0] or 0.0

    if gold < total_cost:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р° РґР»СЏ РїРѕРІРЅРѕРіРѕ СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚Сѓ.\n\n"
                f"рџ’і РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ: {format_gold(total_cost)}\n"
                f"рџ’° РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {format_gold(gold)}\n\n"
                f"в„№пёЏ РњРѕР¶РµС€ РІС–РґСЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚СѓРІР°С‚Рё РѕРєСЂРµРјС– СЂРµС‡С– РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ."
            ),
            "total_cost": total_cost
        }

    repaired_count = 0

    for item in equipped_items:
        inventory_id = item["inventory_id"]

        if not inventory_id:
            continue

        if item["repair_cost"] <= 0:
            continue

        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE inventory
        SET durability=100
        WHERE id=?
        """, (inventory_id,))

        repaired_count += 1

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold - ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (total_cost, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"вњ… РЎРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РІС–РґСЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚РѕРІР°РЅРѕ.\n"
            f"рџ› пёЏ Р’С–РґСЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚РѕРІР°РЅРѕ СЂРµС‡РµР№: {repaired_count}\n"
            f"рџ’і РЎРїР»Р°С‡РµРЅРѕ: {format_gold(total_cost)}"
        ),
        "total_cost": total_cost,
        "repaired_count": repaired_count
    }

# ==============================
# вњ… SHOP PREVIEW PURCHASE SYSTEM
# ==============================

def init_shop_preview_system():
    migrations = [
        ("items", "shop_preview_owner", "INTEGER DEFAULT NULL"),
        ("items", "shop_preview_price", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.commit()


def cleanup_shop_previews_for_user(user_id):
    init_shop_preview_system()

    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        DELETE FROM items
        WHERE shop_preview_owner=?
          AND id NOT IN (
              SELECT item_id FROM inventory
          )
        """, (user_id,))

        conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass


def create_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, slot_key, item_profile=None):
    """
    РЎС‚РІРѕСЂСЋС” preview-РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ Сѓ С‚Р°Р±Р»РёС†С– items, Р°Р»Рµ РќР• РґРѕРґР°С” Р№РѕРіРѕ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂ.

    Р¦Рµ РїРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ, С‰РѕР± РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ Р±Р°С‡РёРІ СЃР°РјРµ С‚РѕР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚, СЏРєРёР№ РєСѓРїРёС‚СЊ.
    """

    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()
    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()
    init_shop_preview_system()

    cleanup_shop_previews_for_user(user_id)

    if slot_key not in SLOT_ORDER:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ СЃР»РѕС‚ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ."
        }

    if slot_key == "main_hand" and item_profile not in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ С‚РёРї Р·Р±СЂРѕС—."
        }

    if slot_key == "off_hand" and item_profile not in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ С‚РёРї РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РґР»СЏ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё."
        }

    if slot_key in ["main_hand", "off_hand"]:
        if not is_shop_profile_allowed_for_user(user_id, slot_key, item_profile):
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ С‚РІРѕС”РјСѓ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ."
            }

    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    item_level = player_level
    rarity = "common"
    price = get_common_equipment_price_for_slot(item_level, slot_key)

    item_profile = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key, item_profile)

    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""
    armor_type = ""

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "weapon"

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]
        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]
        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands, item_profile)
        type_ = "offhand"

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1
        armor_type = get_shop_armor_type_for_user(user_id)
        name = get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    name = f"{name} {item_level} СЂС–РІРЅСЏ"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        stats = apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            armor_type=armor_type
        )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type,
        shop_preview_owner,
        shop_preview_price
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type,
        user_id,
        price
    ))

    item_id = cursor.lastrowid
    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "price": price,
        "name": name,
        "armor_type": armor_type,
        "item_subtype": item_profile
    }

def get_shop_preview_item(item_id, user_id):
    init_shop_preview_system()
    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        id,
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type,
        shop_preview_price
    FROM items
    WHERE id=?
      AND shop_preview_owner=?
    """, (item_id, user_id))

    return cursor.fetchone()

def cancel_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, item_id):
    init_shop_preview_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    DELETE FROM items
    WHERE id=?
      AND shop_preview_owner=?
      AND id NOT IN (
          SELECT item_id FROM inventory
      )
    """, (item_id, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": "вќЊ РљСѓРїС–РІР»СЋ СЃРєР°СЃРѕРІР°РЅРѕ."
    }


def confirm_common_equipment_shop_preview(user_id, item_id):
    init_shop_preview_system()

    preview = get_shop_preview_item(item_id, user_id)

    if not preview:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС–Р№ РїРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРґ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ Р°Р±Рѕ Р·Р°СЃС‚Р°СЂС–РІ."
        }

    price = preview[24] or 0
    name = preview[1]

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        }

    gold = row[0] or 0.0

    if gold < price:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°.\n\n"
                f"рџ’і РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ: {format_gold(price)}\n"
                f"рџ’° РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {format_gold(gold)}"
            )
        }

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР° РїРµСЂРµРїРѕРІРЅРµРЅР°. РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РєСѓРїР»РµРЅРѕ."
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold - ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (price, user_id))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE items
    SET shop_preview_owner=NULL,
        shop_preview_price=0
    WHERE id=?
    """, (item_id,))

    conn.commit()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    new_gold_row = cursor.fetchone()
    new_gold = new_gold_row[0] if new_gold_row else 0

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"вњ… РљСѓРїР»РµРЅРѕ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ.\n\n"
            f"рџ“¦ {name}\n"
            f"рџ’і РЎРїР»Р°С‡РµРЅРѕ: {format_gold(price)}\n"
            f"рџ’° Р—Р°Р»РёС€РёР»РѕСЃСЊ: {format_gold(new_gold)}"
        )
    }


def get_shop_preview_weapon_damage_text(item_id):
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        name,
        slot_key,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type
    FROM items
    WHERE id=?
    """, (item_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return None

    (
        name,
        slot_key,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type
    ) = row

    if slot_key != "main_hand":
        return None

    if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
        return f"рџ”® РњР°Рі. С€РєРѕРґР°: {weapon_min_magic_damage}-{weapon_max_magic_damage}"

    return f"вљ”пёЏ РЁРєРѕРґР°: {weapon_min_damage}-{weapon_max_damage}"

CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID = 301


def init_character_class_system():
    migrations = [
        ("users", "character_name", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "character_class", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "class_selected_at", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "class_change_available", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "mp", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "max_mp", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "last_regen_at", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.commit()

def get_character_name(user_id):
    init_character_class_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT character_name
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return ""

    return row[0] or ""


def get_character_class(user_id):
    init_character_class_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT character_class
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return ""

    return row[0] or ""


def get_character_class_display(user_id):
    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)

    if not class_key:
        return "РќРµ РѕР±СЂР°РЅРѕ"

    return CLASS_CONFIGS.get(class_key, {}).get("name", "РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ РєР»Р°СЃ")


def get_character_resource_type(user_id):
    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)

    if not class_key:
        return ""

    return CLASS_CONFIGS.get(class_key, {}).get("resource", "")


def normalize_character_name(name):
    name = (name or "").strip()

    while "  " in name:
        name = name.replace("  ", " ")

    return name


def validate_character_name(name):
    name = normalize_character_name(name)

    if len(name) < 2:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р†РјвЂ™СЏ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РјР°С” РјС–СЃС‚РёС‚Рё С‰РѕРЅР°Р№РјРµРЅС€Рµ 2 СЃРёРјРІРѕР»Рё."
        }

    if len(name) > 24:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р†РјвЂ™СЏ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ РјРѕР¶Рµ Р±СѓС‚Рё РґРѕРІС€РёРј Р·Р° 24 СЃРёРјРІРѕР»Рё."
        }

    forbidden = ["/", "\\", "<", ">", "{", "}", "[", "]", "|"]

    for symbol in forbidden:
        if symbol in name:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "вќЊ Р†РјвЂ™СЏ РјС–СЃС‚РёС‚СЊ РЅРµРґРѕР·РІРѕР»РµРЅС– СЃРёРјРІРѕР»Рё."
            }

    return {
        "success": True,
        "name": name
    }


def set_character_name(user_id, name):
    init_character_class_system()

    validation = validate_character_name(name)

    if not validation["success"]:
        return validation

    clean_name = validation["name"]

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET character_name=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (clean_name, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "name": clean_name,
        "message": f"вњ… Р†РјвЂ™СЏ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° Р·Р±РµСЂРµР¶РµРЅРѕ: {clean_name}"
    }


def set_character_class(user_id, class_key):
    init_character_class_system()

    if class_key not in CLASS_CONFIGS:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ РєР»Р°СЃ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°."
        }

    from datetime import datetime

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET character_class=?,
        class_selected_at=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        class_key,
        datetime.now().isoformat(),
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    refresh_user_mp(user_id)

    return {
        "success": True,
        "class_key": class_key,
        "class_name": CLASS_CONFIGS[class_key]["name"],
        "message": f"вњ… РљР»Р°СЃ РѕР±СЂР°РЅРѕ: {CLASS_CONFIGS[class_key]['name']}"
    }


def needs_character_name(user_id):
    return get_character_name(user_id) == ""


def needs_character_class(user_id):
    return get_character_class(user_id) == ""


def get_max_mp(user_id):
    """
    Р‘Р°Р·РѕРІР° С„РѕСЂРјСѓР»Р° MP.
    РџРѕРєРё РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Р°, С‰РѕР± РЅРµ Р»Р°РјР°С‚Рё Р±Р°Р»Р°РЅСЃ:

    max_mp = 50 + INT * 5 + WIS * 3

    РќР°РґР°Р»С– РјРѕР¶РЅР° Р±СѓРґРµ Р·РјС–РЅРёС‚Рё РїС–Рґ РєР»Р°СЃРё.
    """

    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return 0

    total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta, lvl = stats

    max_mp = 50 + (total_int * 5) + (total_wis * 3)

    return max(0, int(max_mp))


def refresh_user_mp(user_id):
    init_character_class_system()

    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
    resource_type = CLASS_CONFIGS.get(class_key, {}).get("resource", "")

    if resource_type != "mana":
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET mp=0,
            max_mp=0
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (user_id,))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "mp": 0,
            "max_mp": 0
        }

    max_mp = get_max_mp(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT mp
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()
    current_mp = row[0] if row else max_mp

    if current_mp is None:
        current_mp = max_mp

    if current_mp > max_mp:
        current_mp = max_mp

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET mp=?,
        max_mp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        current_mp,
        max_mp,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "mp": current_mp,
        "max_mp": max_mp
    }


def get_user_mp(user_id):
    refresh_user_mp(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT mp, max_mp
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "mp": 0,
            "max_mp": 0
        }

    mp, max_mp = row

    return {
        "mp": mp or 0,
        "max_mp": max_mp or 0
    }

    }

def get_physical_crit_chance_display(user_id):
    """
    РЁР°РЅСЃ С„С–Р·РёС‡РЅРѕРіРѕ РєСЂРёС‚Сѓ РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЋ.
    Р¤РѕСЂРјСѓР»Р° РІС–РґРїРѕРІС–РґР°С” Р»РѕРіС–С†С– combat_system:
    5 + ((DEX - 10) / level) * 0.5
    """

    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return 5.0

    total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta, level = stats

    if level <= 0:
        level = 1

    chance = 5 + ((total_dex - 10) / max(1, level)) * 0.5

    return max(1.0, min(35.0, chance))


def get_magical_crit_chance_display(user_id):
    """
    РЁР°РЅСЃ РјР°РіС–С‡РЅРѕРіРѕ РєСЂРёС‚Сѓ РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЋ.
    Р¤РѕСЂРјСѓР»Р° РІС–РґРїРѕРІС–РґР°С” Р»РѕРіС–С†С– combat_system:
    5 + ((WIS - 10) / level) * 0.5
    """

    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return 5.0

    total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta, level = stats

    if level <= 0:
        level = 1

    chance = 5 + ((total_wis - 10) / max(1, level)) * 0.5

    return max(1.0, min(35.0, chance))


def get_base_dodge_chance_display(user_id):
    """
    Р‘Р°Р·РѕРІРёР№ СѓС…РёР» РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЋ.

    РЈ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРјСѓ Р±РѕСЋ СѓС…РёР» Р·Р°Р»РµР¶РёС‚СЊ РІС–Рґ DEX РіСЂР°РІС†СЏ С– DEX РєРѕРЅРєСЂРµС‚РЅРѕРіРѕ РјРѕР±Р°.
    РўСѓС‚ РїРѕРєР°Р·СѓС”РјРѕ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІРµ Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРЅСЏ РґР»СЏ РґРѕРІС–РґРєРё.
    """

    return 5.0


def get_enemy_crit_chance_against_player(user_id):
    """
    РЁР°РЅСЃ РєСЂРёС‚Сѓ РІРѕСЂРѕРіР° РїРѕ РіСЂР°РІС†СЋ.
    Р¤РѕСЂРјСѓР»Р° РІС–РґРїРѕРІС–РґР°С” combat_system:
    max(0, 10 - STA // 25)
    """

    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return 10.0

    total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta, level = stats

    chance = max(0, 10 - (total_sta // 25))

    return float(chance)

def is_class_reset_sphere_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id):
    seed_class_reset_sphere_item()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        inventory.id,
        inventory.item_id,
        items.type,
        items.name
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.id=?
      AND inventory.user_id=?
    """, (inventory_id, user_id))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return False

    inv_id, item_id, type_, name = row

    return item_id == CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID or type_ == "class_reset"


def use_class_reset_sphere_from_inventory(user_id, inventory_id):
    """
    Р’РёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°РЅРЅСЏ рџ”® РЎС„РµСЂРё РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ С€Р»СЏС…Сѓ.

    Р•С„РµРєС‚:
    - РІРёС‚СЂР°С‡Р°С” 1 РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚;
    - РІС–РґРєСЂРёРІР°С” РїСЂР°РІРѕ РЅР° Р·РјС–РЅСѓ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ;
    - СЃР°Рј РІРёР±С–СЂ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ РІРёРєРѕРЅСѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ РІ handlers/start.py.
    """

    init_character_class_system()
    seed_class_reset_sphere_item()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        inventory.id,
        inventory.item_id,
        inventory.quantity,
        items.name,
        items.type
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.id=?
      AND inventory.user_id=?
    """, (inventory_id, user_id))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row or not row[0]:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂС–."
        }

    inv_id, item_id, quantity, name, type_ = row

    if item_id != CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID and type_ != "class_reset":
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р¦Рµ РЅРµ РЎС„РµСЂР° РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ С€Р»СЏС…Сѓ."
        }

    quantity = quantity or 1

    if quantity <= 1:
        cursor.execute("""
        DELETE FROM inventory
        WHERE id=?
          AND user_id=?
        """, (inventory_id, user_id))
    else:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE inventory
        SET quantity = quantity - 1
        WHERE id=?
          AND user_id=?
        """, (inventory_id, user_id))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET class_change_available=1
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            "рџ”® РЎС„РµСЂР° РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ С€Р»СЏС…Сѓ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°РЅР°.\n\n"
            "РўРё РјРѕР¶РµС€ РѕР±СЂР°С‚Рё РЅРѕРІРёР№ РєР»Р°СЃ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°."
        )
    }

# ==============================
# вњ… PASSIVE HP / MP REGEN
# ==============================

from datetime import datetime


def init_passive_regen_system():
    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        ALTER TABLE users
        ADD COLUMN last_regen_at TEXT DEFAULT ''
        """)
    except Exception:
        pass

    conn.commit()


def update_last_regen_timestamp(user_id):
    init_passive_regen_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET last_regen_at=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        datetime.utcnow().isoformat(),
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()


def process_passive_regeneration(user_id):
    """
    РџР°СЃРёРІРЅРµ РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РїРѕР·Р° Р±РѕС”Рј.

    Р—Р° РєРѕР¶РЅСѓ РїРѕРІРЅСѓ С…РІРёР»РёРЅСѓ:
    - +5% РІС–Рґ max HP
    - +5% РІС–Рґ max MP, СЏРєС‰Рѕ РєР»Р°СЃ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС” РјР°РЅСѓ

    Р’Р°Р¶Р»РёРІРѕ:
    - РЅРµ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС” РєРѕР»РѕРЅРєСѓ current_hp РЅР°РїСЂСЏРјСѓ;
    - Р±РµСЂРµ HP С‡РµСЂРµР· get_current_hp / get_max_hp;
    - Р·Р°РїРёСЃСѓС” HP С‡РµСЂРµР· set_current_hp.
    """

    init_passive_regen_system()
    init_character_class_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT last_regen_at
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        }

    last_regen_at = row[0]
    now = datetime.utcnow()

    if not last_regen_at:
        update_last_regen_timestamp(user_id)

        return {
            "success": True,
            "minutes": 0,
            "hp_restored": 0,
            "mp_restored": 0
        }

    try:
        previous = datetime.fromisoformat(last_regen_at)
    except Exception:
        update_last_regen_timestamp(user_id)

        return {
            "success": True,
            "minutes": 0,
            "hp_restored": 0,
            "mp_restored": 0
        }

    elapsed_seconds = int((now - previous).total_seconds())

    if elapsed_seconds < 60:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "minutes": 0,
            "hp_restored": 0,
            "mp_restored": 0
        }

    minutes = elapsed_seconds // 60

    # ==============================
    # HP REGEN
    # ==============================

    current_hp = get_current_hp(user_id)
    max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    hp_restored = 0

    if max_hp > 0:
        hp_regen_per_minute = max(
            1,
            int(round(max_hp * 0.05))
        )

        new_hp = min(
            max_hp,
            current_hp + (hp_regen_per_minute * minutes)
        )

        hp_restored = max(0, new_hp - current_hp)

        if hp_restored > 0:
            set_current_hp(user_id, new_hp)

    # ==============================
    # MP REGEN
    # ==============================

    mp_restored = 0

    profile_summary = get_character_profile_summary(user_id)

    if profile_summary.get("resource_type") == "mana":
        mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)

        current_mp = mp_data.get("mp", 0)
        max_mp = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)

        if max_mp > 0:
            mp_regen_per_minute = max(
                1,
                int(round(max_mp * 0.05))
            )

            new_mp = min(
                max_mp,
                current_mp + (mp_regen_per_minute * minutes)
            )

            mp_restored = max(0, new_mp - current_mp)

            if mp_restored > 0:
                cursor.execute("""
                UPDATE users
                SET mp=?
                WHERE user_id=?
                """, (
                    new_mp,
                    user_id
                ))

    # ==============================
    # UPDATE TIMER
    # ==============================

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET last_regen_at=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        now.isoformat(),
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "minutes": minutes,
        "hp_restored": hp_restored,
        "mp_restored": mp_restored
    }

# ==============================
# вњ… SAFE MP HELPERS / OVERRIDES
# ==============================

def refresh_user_mp(user_id):
    """
    РћРЅРѕРІР»СЋС” max_mp РґР»СЏ mana-РєР»Р°СЃС–РІ, Р°Р»Рµ РќР• РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»СЋС” РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅСѓ MP РґРѕ РјР°РєСЃРёРјСѓРјСѓ
    РїСЂРё Р·РјС–РЅС– РµРєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ.

    РџСЂР°РІРёР»Р°:
    - СЏРєС‰Рѕ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶ РЅРµ mana-РєР»Р°СЃ вЂ” mp/max_mp = 0;
    - СЏРєС‰Рѕ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё РІРїРµСЂС€Рµ СЃС‚Р°РІ mana-РєР»Р°СЃРѕРј вЂ” mp = max_mp;
    - СЏРєС‰Рѕ max_mp Р·Р±С–Р»СЊС€РёРІСЃСЏ С‡РµСЂРµР· РµРєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ вЂ” РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅР° mp РќР• Р·РјС–РЅСЋС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ;
    - СЏРєС‰Рѕ max_mp Р·РјРµРЅС€РёРІСЃСЏ вЂ” РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅР° mp РѕР±СЂС–Р·Р°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ РґРѕ РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ РјР°РєСЃРёРјСѓРјСѓ.
    """

    init_character_class_system()

    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
    resource_type = CLASS_CONFIGS.get(class_key, {}).get("resource", "")

    if resource_type != "mana":
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET mp=0,
            max_mp=0
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (user_id,))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "mp": 0,
            "max_mp": 0
        }

    new_max_mp = get_max_mp(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT mp, max_mp
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "mp": 0,
            "max_mp": 0
        }

    current_mp, old_max_mp = row

    current_mp = current_mp or 0
    old_max_mp = old_max_mp or 0

    # РџРµСЂС€Рµ РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°РЅРЅСЏ mana-РєР»Р°СЃСѓ
    if old_max_mp <= 0 and current_mp <= 0:
        current_mp = new_max_mp

    # РЇРєС‰Рѕ РјР°РєСЃРёРјСѓРј Р·РјРµРЅС€РёРІСЃСЏ вЂ” РѕР±СЂС–Р·Р°С‚Рё РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅСѓ РјР°РЅСѓ
    if current_mp > new_max_mp:
        current_mp = new_max_mp

    if current_mp < 0:
        current_mp = 0

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET mp=?,
        max_mp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        current_mp,
        new_max_mp,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "mp": current_mp,
        "max_mp": new_max_mp
    }


def get_user_mp(user_id):
    refresh_user_mp(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT mp, max_mp
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "mp": 0,
            "max_mp": 0
        }

    mp, max_mp = row

    return {
        "mp": mp or 0,
        "max_mp": max_mp or 0
    }


def set_user_mp(user_id, amount):
    """
    Р‘РµР·РїРµС‡РЅРёР№ Р·Р°РїРёСЃ MP.
    """

    mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)
    max_mp = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)

    try:
        amount = int(amount)
    except Exception:
        amount = 0

    if amount < 0:
        amount = 0

    if amount > max_mp:
        amount = max_mp

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET mp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        amount,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "mp": amount,
        "max_mp": max_mp
    }


def spend_user_mp(user_id, amount):
    """
    Р’РёС‚СЂР°С‚Р° MP РґР»СЏ РЅР°РІРёС‡РѕРє.
    """

    mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)

    current_mp = mp_data.get("mp", 0)
    max_mp = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)

    try:
        amount = int(amount)
    except Exception:
        amount = 0

    if amount <= 0:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "mp": current_mp,
            "max_mp": max_mp
        }

    if current_mp < amount:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ РјР°РЅРё.\n\n"
                f"рџ”µ РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ: {amount} MP\n"
                f"рџ”µ РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {current_mp}/{max_mp} MP"
            ),
            "mp": current_mp,
            "max_mp": max_mp
        }

    new_mp = current_mp - amount

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET mp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_mp,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "mp": new_mp,
        "max_mp": max_mp
    }

# вњ… RESTORE MP AFTER COMBAT

def restore_user_mp_to_full(user_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІРЅС–СЃС‚СЋ РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»СЋС” MP, СЏРєС‰Рѕ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС” РјР°РЅСѓ.

    Р”Р»СЏ РЅРµ-mana РєР»Р°СЃС–РІ РЅС–С‡РѕРіРѕ РЅРµ СЂРѕР±РёС‚СЊ.
    """

    init_character_class_system()

    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
    resource_type = CLASS_CONFIGS.get(class_key, {}).get("resource", "")

    if resource_type != "mana":
        return {
            "success": True,
            "restored": False,
            "mp": 0,
            "max_mp": 0
        }

    mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)
    max_mp = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET mp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        max_mp,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "restored": True,
        "mp": max_mp,
        "max_mp": max_mp
    }
