def init_class_equipment_restrictions_system():
    """
    Р”РѕРґР°С” СЃР»СѓР¶Р±РѕРІРµ РїРѕР»Рµ armor_type РґР»СЏ РєР»Р°СЃРѕРІРёС… РѕР±РјРµР¶РµРЅСЊ Р±СЂРѕРЅС–.

    weapon_family РѕРєСЂРµРјРѕ РќР• РґРѕРґР°С”РјРѕ.
    РЈ РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅС–Р№ СЃРёСЃС‚РµРјС– СЂРѕР»СЊ weapon_family РІРёРєРѕРЅСѓС” items.item_subtype.
    """

    migrations = [
        ("items", "armor_type", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.commit()


def normalize_equipment_restriction_value(value):
    if value is None:
        return ""

    return str(value).strip()


def is_armor_slot(slot_key):
    return slot_key in ARMOR_SLOTS


def get_armor_type_label(armor_type):
    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)
    return ARMOR_TYPE_LABELS.get(armor_type, armor_type or "РЈРЅС–РІРµСЂСЃР°Р»СЊРЅРёР№")


def get_item_subtype_label(item_subtype):
    item_subtype = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(item_subtype)
    return ITEM_SUBTYPE_LABELS.get(item_subtype, item_subtype or "РЈРЅС–РІРµСЂСЃР°Р»СЊРЅРёР№")


def get_class_display_name_by_key(class_key):
    try:
        config = CLASS_CONFIGS.get(class_key, {})
        return config.get("name", class_key or "РќРµ РѕР±СЂР°РЅРѕ")
    except Exception:
        return class_key or "РќРµ РѕР±СЂР°РЅРѕ"


def get_allowed_armor_type_for_class(class_key):
    return ARMOR_ALLOWED_BY_CLASS.get(class_key, "")


def get_allowed_main_hand_subtypes_for_class(class_key):
    return MAIN_HAND_ALLOWED_BY_CLASS.get(class_key, [])


def get_allowed_off_hand_subtypes_for_class(class_key):
    return OFF_HAND_ALLOWED_BY_CLASS.get(class_key, [])


def format_allowed_armor_for_class(class_key):
    armor_type = get_allowed_armor_type_for_class(class_key)

    if not armor_type:
        return "РЅРµРјР°С”"

    return get_armor_type_label(armor_type)


def format_allowed_main_hand_for_class(class_key):
    allowed = get_allowed_main_hand_subtypes_for_class(class_key)

    if not allowed:
        return "РЅРµРјР°С”"

    return ", ".join(get_item_subtype_label(value) for value in allowed)


def format_allowed_off_hand_for_class(class_key):
    allowed = get_allowed_off_hand_subtypes_for_class(class_key)

    if not allowed:
        return "РЅРµРјР°С” РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚С–РІ РґР»СЏ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё"

    return ", ".join(get_item_subtype_label(value) for value in allowed)


def get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” РєР»Р°СЃРёС„С–РєР°С†С–СЋ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РґР»СЏ РїРµСЂРµРІС–СЂРєРё РєР»Р°СЃРѕРІРёС… РѕР±РјРµР¶РµРЅСЊ.

    Р’РёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС”:
    - items.armor_type РґР»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅС–;
    - items.item_subtype РґР»СЏ Р·Р±СЂРѕС— / off-hand.
    """

    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()
    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        inventory.id,
        inventory.item_id,
        items.name,
        items.type,
        items.rarity,
        items.category,
        items.slot_key,
        items.weapon_hands,
        inventory.quantity,
        inventory.durability,
        items.armor_type,
        items.item_subtype,
        items.weapon_attack_type
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.id=?
    """, (inventory_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return None

    (
        inv_id,
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        quantity,
        durability,
        armor_type,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_attack_type
    ) = row

    return {
        "inventory_id": inv_id,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "name": name,
        "type": type_,
        "rarity": rarity,
        "category": category,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "weapon_hands": int(weapon_hands or 1),
        "quantity": quantity,
        "durability": durability,
        "armor_type": normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type),
        "item_subtype": normalize_equipment_restriction_value(item_subtype),
        "weapon_attack_type": normalize_equipment_restriction_value(weapon_attack_type)
    }


def check_armor_compatibility_for_class(class_key, item_info):
    slot_key = item_info.get("slot_key", "")

    if not is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(
        item_info.get("armor_type", "")
    )

    # РЎС‚Р°СЂС– РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Рё Р±РµР· armor_type Р·Р°Р»РёС€Р°СЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ СѓРЅС–РІРµСЂСЃР°Р»СЊРЅРёРјРё.
    if not armor_type:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    allowed_armor_type = get_allowed_armor_type_for_class(class_key)

    if armor_type == allowed_armor_type:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    class_name = get_class_display_name_by_key(class_key)
    allowed_label = get_armor_type_label(allowed_armor_type)
    item_label = get_armor_type_label(armor_type)

    return {
        "success": False,
        "message": (
            f"вќЊ Р¦РµР№ С‚РёРї Р±СЂРѕРЅС– РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ С‚РІРѕС”РјСѓ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ.\n\n"
            f"РўРІС–Р№ РєР»Р°СЃ: {class_name}\n"
            f"Р”РѕР·РІРѕР»РµРЅР° Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ: {allowed_label}\n"
            f"РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚: {item_label}"
        )
    }


def check_main_hand_compatibility_for_class(class_key, item_info):
    slot_key = item_info.get("slot_key", "")

    if slot_key != "main_hand":
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    item_subtype = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(
        item_info.get("item_subtype", "")
    )

    # РЎС‚Р°СЂС– РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Рё Р±РµР· item_subtype Р·Р°Р»РёС€Р°СЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ СѓРЅС–РІРµСЂСЃР°Р»СЊРЅРёРјРё.
    if not item_subtype:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    allowed = get_allowed_main_hand_subtypes_for_class(class_key)

    if item_subtype in allowed:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    class_name = get_class_display_name_by_key(class_key)
    allowed_text = format_allowed_main_hand_for_class(class_key)
    item_label = get_item_subtype_label(item_subtype)

    return {
        "success": False,
        "message": (
            f"вќЊ Р¦СЋ Р·Р±СЂРѕСЋ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶Рµ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓРІР°С‚Рё С‚РІС–Р№ РєР»Р°СЃ.\n\n"
            f"РўРІС–Р№ РєР»Р°СЃ: {class_name}\n"
            f"Р”РѕР·РІРѕР»РµРЅР° Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ: {allowed_text}\n"
            f"РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚: {item_label}"
        )
    }

def check_two_handed_conflict_for_equip(user_id, item_info):
    """
    РџРµСЂРµРІС–СЂСЏС” С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё РІРёРїР°РґРѕРє:
    - РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ С…РѕС‡Рµ РІРґСЏРіРЅСѓС‚Рё off_hand;
    - Р°Р»Рµ main_hand СѓР¶Рµ Р·Р°Р№РЅСЏС‚РёР№ РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅРѕСЋ Р·Р±СЂРѕС”СЋ.

    Р’РёРїР°РґРѕРє, РєРѕР»Рё РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ РІРґСЏРіР°С” РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅСѓ Р·Р±СЂРѕСЋ С– С‚СЂРµР±Р° Р·РЅСЏС‚Рё off_hand,
    РѕР±СЂРѕР±Р»СЏС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ Сѓ СЃС‚Р°СЂС–Р№ equip-Р»РѕРіС–С†С– РѕРєСЂРµРјРѕ.
    """

    slot_key = item_info.get("slot_key", "")

    if slot_key != "off_hand":
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    main_hand_item = get_main_hand_item(user_id)

    if not main_hand_item:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    try:
        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            slot_key,
            weapon_hands,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = main_hand_item
    except Exception:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    if int(weapon_hands or 1) == 2:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"вќЊ РќРµРјРѕР¶Р»РёРІРѕ РІРґСЏРіРЅСѓС‚Рё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ Сѓ РґСЂСѓРіСѓ СЂСѓРєСѓ.\n\n"
                f"РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ РІР¶Рµ РІРґСЏРіРЅРµРЅР° РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР° Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ:\n"
                f"{name}"
            )
        }

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": ""
    }


def can_equip_item_by_class(user_id, item_info):
    """
    Р¦РµРЅС‚СЂР°Р»СЊРЅР° РїРµСЂРµРІС–СЂРєР° РєР»Р°СЃРѕРІРѕС— СЃСѓРјС–СЃРЅРѕСЃС‚С–.

    item_info вЂ” dict Р· get_item_classification_by_inventory_id().
    """

    if not item_info:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        }

    if item_info.get("category") != "equipment":
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)

    if not class_key:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё РєР»Р°СЃ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°."
        }

    armor_result = check_armor_compatibility_for_class(class_key, item_info)

    if not armor_result["success"]:
        return armor_result

    main_hand_result = check_main_hand_compatibility_for_class(class_key, item_info)

    if not main_hand_result["success"]:
        return main_hand_result

    off_hand_result = check_off_hand_compatibility_for_class(class_key, item_info)

    if not off_hand_result["success"]:
        return off_hand_result

    two_handed_result = check_two_handed_conflict_for_equip(user_id, item_info)

    if not two_handed_result["success"]:
        return two_handed_result

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": ""
    }


def can_equip_inventory_item_by_class(user_id, inventory_id):
    """
    Р—СЂСѓС‡РЅРёР№ wrapper РґР»СЏ РїРµСЂРµРІС–СЂРєРё С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂРЅРѕРіРѕ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°.
    """

    item_info = get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

    return can_equip_item_by_class(user_id, item_info)


def is_inventory_item_class_compatible(user_id, inventory_id):
    """
    Boolean helper РґР»СЏ РјР°Р№Р±СѓС‚РЅС–С… С„С–Р»СЊС‚СЂС–РІ / auto-unequip.
    """

    result = can_equip_inventory_item_by_class(user_id, inventory_id)
    return bool(result.get("success"))

def get_shop_armor_type_for_user(user_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” armor_type РґР»СЏ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІРѕРіРѕ РјР°РіР°Р·РёРЅСѓ Р·Р° РєР»Р°СЃРѕРј РіСЂР°РІС†СЏ.
    """

    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)

    return get_allowed_armor_type_for_class(class_key)


def pick_weighted_stat(weighted_stats, exclude_stat=None):
    """
    Р’РёР±РёСЂР°С” С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєСѓ Р·Р° РІР°РіР°РјРё.

    РџСЂРёРєР»Р°Рґ:
    [
        ("int", 40),
        ("wis", 40),
        ("sta", 20)
    ]
    """

    filtered = []

    for stat_key, weight in weighted_stats:
        if exclude_stat is not None and stat_key == exclude_stat:
            continue

        filtered.append((stat_key, weight))

    if not filtered:
        filtered = weighted_stats

    if not filtered:
        return ""

    total_weight = sum(weight for _, weight in filtered)

    if total_weight <= 0:
        return filtered[0][0]

    roll = random.randint(1, total_weight)
    current = 0

    for stat_key, weight in filtered:
        current += weight

        if roll <= current:
            return stat_key

    return filtered[-1][0]


def add_primary_stat_to_stats(stats, stat_key, value):
    """
    Р”РѕРґР°С” РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅСѓ С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєСѓ РІ stats.
    """

    value = int(value or 0)

    if value <= 0:
        return

    if stat_key == "str":
        stats["bonus_str"] += value

    elif stat_key == "dex":
        stats["bonus_dex"] += value

    elif stat_key == "int":
        stats["bonus_int"] += value

    elif stat_key == "wis":
        stats["bonus_wis"] += value

    elif stat_key == "sta":
        stats["bonus_sta"] += value


def get_existing_primary_stat_budget(stats):
    """
    Р Р°С…СѓС” РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРёР№ Р±СЋРґР¶РµС‚ РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅРёС… С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРє,
    СЏРєРёР№ СѓР¶Рµ Р·РіРµРЅРµСЂСѓРІР°РІ СЃР»РѕС‚.

    РќР°РїСЂРёРєР»Р°Рґ:
    chest 8 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ common РјРѕР¶Рµ РјР°С‚Рё:
    bonus_sta = 4

    РўРѕРґС– budget = 4.
    РќР° РѕСЃРЅРѕРІС– С†СЊРѕРіРѕ budget СЃС‚РІРѕСЂСЋСЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё РїС–Рґ armor_type.
    """

    return (
        int(stats.get("bonus_str", 0) or 0)
        + int(stats.get("bonus_dex", 0) or 0)
        + int(stats.get("bonus_int", 0) or 0)
        + int(stats.get("bonus_wis", 0) or 0)
        + int(stats.get("bonus_sta", 0) or 0)
    )


def clear_primary_stat_bonuses(stats):
    """
    РћС‡РёС‰Р°С” СЃС‚Р°СЂС– slot-based С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё.

    Р¦Рµ РїРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ, С‰РѕР±:
    - С‚РєР°РЅРёРЅР° РЅРµ РґР°РІР°Р»Р° РІРёРїР°РґРєРѕРІСѓ РЎРїСЂРёС‚РЅС–СЃС‚СЊ;
    - Р»Р°С‚Рё РЅРµ РґР°РІР°Р»Рё Р†РЅС‚РµР»РµРєС‚;
    - С€РєС–СЂР° РЅРµ РґР°РІР°Р»Р° РњСѓРґСЂС–СЃС‚СЊ С‚РѕС‰Рѕ.
    """

    stats["bonus_str"] = 0
    stats["bonus_dex"] = 0
    stats["bonus_int"] = 0
    stats["bonus_wis"] = 0
    stats["bonus_sta"] = 0


def apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats(stats, armor_type):
    """
    РџРµСЂРµСЂРѕР·РїРѕРґС–Р»СЏС” РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅС– С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё Р±СЂРѕРЅС– Р·Р°Р»РµР¶РЅРѕ РІС–Рґ armor_type.

    Р›РѕРіС–РєР°:
    - Р±РµСЂРµРјРѕ СЃС‚Р°СЂРёР№ stat budget, СЏРєРёР№ Р·Р°Р»РµР¶Р°РІ РІС–Рґ СЃР»РѕС‚Сѓ;
    - РѕС‡РёС‰Р°С”РјРѕ СЃС‚Р°СЂС– С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё;
    - РІРёР±РёСЂР°С”РјРѕ primary stat Р·Р° РІР°РіР°РјРё armor_type;
    - РІРёР±РёСЂР°С”РјРѕ secondary stat Р·Р° РІР°РіР°РјРё armor_type;
    - РґРѕРґР°С”РјРѕ С†С– С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё РЅР°Р·Р°Рґ.

    РќР°РїСЂСЏРјРѕРє:
    cloth   -> INT / WIS / STA
    leather -> DEX / STR / STA
    chain   -> STR / STA / СЂС–РґРєРѕ DEX
    plate   -> STA / STR
    """

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)

    if not armor_type:
        return stats

    profile = ARMOR_PRIMARY_STAT_PROFILES.get(armor_type)

    if not profile:
        return stats

    existing_budget = get_existing_primary_stat_budget(stats)

    if existing_budget <= 0:
        return stats

    clear_primary_stat_bonuses(stats)

    main_multiplier = float(profile.get("main_multiplier", 1.0))
    secondary_multiplier = float(profile.get("secondary_multiplier", 0.5))

    primary_value = int(round(existing_budget * main_multiplier))
    secondary_value = int(round(existing_budget * secondary_multiplier))

    primary_value = max(1, primary_value)

    if existing_budget >= 2:
        secondary_value = max(1, secondary_value)
    else:
        secondary_value = 0

    primary_stat = pick_weighted_stat(
        profile.get("primary_weights", []),
        exclude_stat=None
    )

    secondary_stat = None

    if secondary_value > 0:
        secondary_stat = pick_weighted_stat(
            profile.get("secondary_weights", []),
            exclude_stat=primary_stat
        )

    add_primary_stat_to_stats(
        stats=stats,
        stat_key=primary_stat,
        value=primary_value
    )

    if secondary_stat:
        add_primary_stat_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            stat_key=secondary_stat,
            value=secondary_value
        )

    return stats

    # СЃРёР»Р° С– РІРёС‚СЂРёРІР°Р»С–СЃС‚СЊ.
    "chain": {
        "primary_weights": [
            ("str", 55),
            ("sta", 40),
            ("dex", 5)
        ],
        "secondary_weights": [
            ("sta", 55),
            ("str", 40),
            ("dex", 5)
        ],
        "main_multiplier": 1.00,
        "secondary_multiplier": 0.50
    },

    # Р›Р°С‚Рё РґР»СЏ Р»РёС†Р°СЂСЏ:
    # РІРёС‚СЂРёРІР°Р»С–СЃС‚СЊ РіРѕР»РѕРІРЅР°, СЃРёР»Р° РґСЂСѓРіР°.
    "plate": {
        "primary_weights": [
            ("sta", 65),
            ("str", 35)
        ],
        "secondary_weights": [
            ("str", 70),
            ("sta", 30)
        ],
        "main_multiplier": 1.25,
        "secondary_multiplier": 0.50
    }
}


def pick_weighted_stat(weighted_stats, exclude_stat=None):
    """
    Р’РёР±РёСЂР°С” С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєСѓ Р·Р° РІР°РіР°РјРё.
    """

    filtered = []

    for stat_key, weight in weighted_stats:
        if exclude_stat is not None and stat_key == exclude_stat:
            continue

        filtered.append((stat_key, weight))

    if not filtered:
        filtered = weighted_stats

    if not filtered:
        return ""

    total_weight = sum(weight for _, weight in filtered)

    if total_weight <= 0:
        return filtered[0][0]

    roll = random.randint(1, total_weight)
    current = 0

    for stat_key, weight in filtered:
        current += weight

        if roll <= current:
            return stat_key

    return filtered[-1][0]


def add_primary_stat_to_stats(stats, stat_key, value):
    """
    Р”РѕРґР°С” РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅСѓ С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєСѓ Сѓ stats.
    """

    value = int(value or 0)

    if value <= 0:
        return

    if stat_key == "str":
        stats["bonus_str"] += value

    elif stat_key == "dex":
        stats["bonus_dex"] += value

    elif stat_key == "int":
        stats["bonus_int"] += value

    elif stat_key == "wis":
        stats["bonus_wis"] += value

    elif stat_key == "sta":
        stats["bonus_sta"] += value


def get_existing_primary_stat_budget(stats):
    """
    Р Р°С…СѓС” РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРёР№ Р±СЋРґР¶РµС‚ РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅРёС… С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРє.
    РќР°РїСЂРёРєР»Р°Рґ chest 8 common РґР°С” bonus_sta = 4, РѕС‚Р¶Рµ budget = 4.
    """

    return (
        int(stats.get("bonus_str", 0) or 0)
        + int(stats.get("bonus_dex", 0) or 0)
        + int(stats.get("bonus_int", 0) or 0)
        + int(stats.get("bonus_wis", 0) or 0)
        + int(stats.get("bonus_sta", 0) or 0)
    )


def clear_primary_stat_bonuses(stats):
    """
    РћС‡РёС‰Р°С” СЃС‚Р°СЂС– slot-based С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё.
    """

    stats["bonus_str"] = 0
    stats["bonus_dex"] = 0
    stats["bonus_int"] = 0
    stats["bonus_wis"] = 0
    stats["bonus_sta"] = 0


def apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats(stats, armor_type):
    """
    РџРµСЂРµСЂРѕР·РїРѕРґС–Р»СЏС” РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅС– С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё Р±СЂРѕРЅС– Р·Р°Р»РµР¶РЅРѕ РІС–Рґ armor_type.

    cloth   -> INT / WIS / STA
    leather -> DEX / STR / STA
    chain   -> STR / STA / СЂС–РґРєРѕ DEX
    plate   -> STA / STR
    """

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)

    if not armor_type:
        return stats

    profile = ARMOR_PRIMARY_STAT_PROFILES.get(armor_type)

    if not profile:
        return stats

    existing_budget = get_existing_primary_stat_budget(stats)

    if existing_budget <= 0:
        return stats

    clear_primary_stat_bonuses(stats)

    main_multiplier = float(profile.get("main_multiplier", 1.0))
    secondary_multiplier = float(profile.get("secondary_multiplier", 0.5))

    primary_value = int(round(existing_budget * main_multiplier))
    secondary_value = int(round(existing_budget * secondary_multiplier))

    primary_value = max(1, primary_value)

    if existing_budget >= 2:
        secondary_value = max(1, secondary_value)
    else:
        secondary_value = 0

    primary_stat = pick_weighted_stat(
        profile.get("primary_weights", []),
        exclude_stat=None
    )

    secondary_stat = None

    if secondary_value > 0:
        secondary_stat = pick_weighted_stat(
            profile.get("secondary_weights", []),
            exclude_stat=primary_stat
        )

    add_primary_stat_to_stats(
        stats=stats,
        stat_key=primary_stat,
        value=primary_value
    )

    if secondary_stat:
        add_primary_stat_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            stat_key=secondary_stat,
            value=secondary_value
        )

    return stats

def apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(stats, armor_type):
    """
    Р¦РµРЅС‚СЂР°Р»СЊРЅР° С„СѓРЅРєС†С–СЏ РїСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЋ Р±СЂРѕРЅС–.

    Р РѕР±РёС‚СЊ 2 СЂРµС‡С–:
    1. РџРµСЂРµСЂРѕР·РїРѕРґС–Р»СЏС” PDEF/MDEF Р·Р°Р»РµР¶РЅРѕ РІС–Рґ armor_type.
    2. РџРµСЂРµСЂРѕР·РїРѕРґС–Р»СЏС” РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅС– С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё Р·Р°Р»РµР¶РЅРѕ РІС–Рґ armor_type.
    """

    armor_type = normalize_equipment_restriction_value(armor_type)

    if not armor_type:
        return stats

    # ==============================
    # 1. PDEF / MDEF redistribution
    # ==============================

    defense_profile = ARMOR_DEFENSE_DISTRIBUTION_PROFILES.get(armor_type)

    if defense_profile:
        base_pdef = int(stats.get("pdef", 0) or 0)
        base_mdef = int(stats.get("mdef", 0) or 0)
        base_total = base_pdef + base_mdef

        if base_total > 0:
            total_multiplier = float(defense_profile.get("total_multiplier", 1.0))
            pdef_share = float(defense_profile.get("pdef_share", 0.5))
            mdef_share = float(defense_profile.get("mdef_share", 0.5))

            total_defense = int(round(base_total * total_multiplier))

            if total_defense < 2:
                total_defense = 2

            new_pdef = int(round(total_defense * pdef_share))
            new_mdef = int(round(total_defense * mdef_share))

            new_pdef = max(1, new_pdef)
            new_mdef = max(1, new_mdef)

            # Р“Р°СЂР°РЅС‚С–СЏ: С‚РєР°РЅРёРЅР° Р·Р°РІР¶РґРё РјР°С” MDEF > PDEF.
            if armor_type == "cloth" and new_mdef <= new_pdef:
                total = max(2, new_pdef + new_mdef)
                new_mdef = max(1, int(round(total * 0.70)))
                new_pdef = max(1, total - new_mdef)

                if new_mdef <= new_pdef:
                    new_mdef = new_pdef + 1

            # Р“Р°СЂР°РЅС‚С–СЏ: Р»Р°С‚Рё Р·Р°РІР¶РґРё РјР°СЋС‚СЊ PDEF > MDEF.
            if armor_type == "plate" and new_pdef <= new_mdef:
                total = max(2, new_pdef + new_mdef)
                new_pdef = max(1, int(round(total * 0.88)))
                new_mdef = max(1, total - new_pdef)

                if new_pdef <= new_mdef:
                    new_pdef = new_mdef + 1

            stats["pdef"] = new_pdef
            stats["mdef"] = new_mdef

    # ==============================
    # 2. Primary stats redistribution
    # ==============================

    stats = apply_armor_type_primary_stat_profile_to_stats(
        stats=stats,
        armor_type=armor_type
    )

    return stats


def get_allowed_shop_main_hand_profiles(user_id):
    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
    allowed = get_allowed_main_hand_subtypes_for_class(class_key)

    return [
        profile_key
        for profile_key in allowed
        if profile_key in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES
    ]


def get_allowed_shop_off_hand_profiles(user_id):
    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
    allowed = get_allowed_off_hand_subtypes_for_class(class_key)

    return [
        profile_key
        for profile_key in allowed
        if profile_key in OFF_HAND_PROFILES
    ]


def is_shop_profile_allowed_for_user(user_id, slot_key, item_profile):
    """
    Р”РѕРґР°С‚РєРѕРІРёР№ Р·Р°С…РёСЃС‚ РІС–Рґ СЂСѓС‡РЅРѕРіРѕ callback.
    РќР°РІС–С‚СЊ СЏРєС‰Рѕ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ РЅР°С‚РёСЃРЅРµ СЃС‚Р°СЂСѓ/РїС–РґСЂРѕР±Р»РµРЅСѓ РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ, РјР°РіР°Р·РёРЅ РЅРµ РјР°С” РїСЂРѕРґР°С‚Рё
    РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚, СЏРєРёР№ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ.
    """

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        return item_profile in get_allowed_shop_main_hand_profiles(user_id)

    if slot_key == "off_hand":
        return item_profile in get_allowed_shop_off_hand_profiles(user_id)

    return True

# вњ… OVERRIDE: EQUIP ITEM WITH CLASS RESTRICTIONS
# ==============================

def equip_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id):
    item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)

    if not item:
        return "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ"

    (
        inv_id,
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        quantity,
        max_stack,
        durability,
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        sell_price
    ) = item

    if category != "equipment":
        return "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РѕРґСЏРіС‚Рё"

    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    required_level = get_item_required_level_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

    if player_level < required_level:
        return (
            f"рџ”’ РўРё С‰Рµ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РµС€ РѕРґСЏРіС‚Рё С†РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚.\n\n"
            f"рџ“¦ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚: {name}\n"
            f"рџЏ· РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРёР№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ: {required_level}\n"
            f"рџ‘¤ РўРІС–Р№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ: {player_level}"
        )

    if not slot_key:
        return "вќЊ Р”Р»СЏ С†СЊРѕРіРѕ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РЅРµ РІРєР°Р·Р°РЅРѕ СЃР»РѕС‚"

    if slot_key not in EQUIPMENT_SLOTS:
        return "вќЊ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ СЃР»РѕС‚ РµРєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ"

    # ==============================
    # вњ… CLASS EQUIPMENT RESTRICTION CHECK
    # ==============================

    class_check = can_equip_inventory_item_by_class(
        user_id=user_id,
        inventory_id=inventory_id
    )

    if not class_check.get("success"):
        return class_check.get(
            "message",
            "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ С‚РІРѕС”РјСѓ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ."
        )

    # ==============================
    # вњ… TWO-HANDED / OFF-HAND RULE
    # ==============================

    if slot_key == "off_hand" and is_main_hand_two_handed(user_id):
        return "вќЊ РќРµРјРѕР¶Р»РёРІРѕ: РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР° Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ Р±Р»РѕРєСѓС” РґСЂСѓРіСѓ СЂСѓРєСѓ"

    if slot_key == "main_hand" and int(weapon_hands or 1) == 2:
        old_offhand_id = get_equipped_slot(user_id, "off_hand")

        if old_offhand_id:
            unequip_slot(user_id, "off_hand")

    set_equipped_slot(user_id, slot_key, inventory_id)

    return f"вњ… РћРґСЏРіРЅСѓС‚Рѕ: {name}"

# ==============================
# вњ… AUTO UNEQUIP INCOMPATIBLE ITEMS AFTER CLASS CHANGE
# ==============================

def unequip_incompatible_items_after_class_change(user_id):
    """
    РџС–СЃР»СЏ Р·РјС–РЅРё РєР»Р°СЃСѓ Р°РІС‚РѕРјР°С‚РёС‡РЅРѕ Р·РЅС–РјР°С” СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ,
    СЏРєРµ Р±С–Р»СЊС€Рµ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РЅРѕРІРѕРјСѓ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ.

    РџРµСЂРµРІС–СЂСЏС”:
    - armor_type РґР»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅС–;
    - item_subtype РґР»СЏ main_hand;
    - item_subtype РґР»СЏ off_hand;
    - РїСЂР°РІРёР»Рѕ РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅРѕС— Р·Р±СЂРѕС— РґР»СЏ off_hand.

    РЎС‚Р°СЂС– РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Рё Р±РµР· armor_type / item_subtype Р·Р°Р»РёС€Р°СЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ СѓРЅС–РІРµСЂСЃР°Р»СЊРЅРёРјРё.
    """

    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)
    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()
    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    removed_items = []

    equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)

    for slot_key in SLOT_ORDER:
        inventory_id = equipped_slots.get(slot_key)

        if not inventory_id:
            continue

        item_info = get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

        if not item_info:
            continue

        compatibility = can_equip_item_by_class(
            user_id=user_id,
            item_info=item_info
        )

        if compatibility.get("success"):
            continue

        item_name = item_info.get("name", "РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")

        unequip_slot(user_id, slot_key)

        removed_items.append({
            "inventory_id": inventory_id,
            "slot_key": slot_key,
            "name": item_name,
            "reason": compatibility.get("message", "")
        })

    return {
        "success": True,
        "removed_items": removed_items,
        "removed_count": len(removed_items)
    }


def build_class_change_unequip_text(unequip_result):
    """
    Р¤РѕСЂРјСѓС” РєРѕРјРїР°РєС‚РЅРµ РїРѕРІС–РґРѕРјР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РїС–СЃР»СЏ Р·РјС–РЅРё РєР»Р°СЃСѓ.

    РџСЂРёРєР»Р°Рґ:
    вљ пёЏ РќРµСЃСѓРјС–СЃРЅРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ Р·РЅСЏС‚Рѕ:
    вЂў РљРёРЅРґР¶Р°Р» 5 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ вЂ” Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ
    вЂў РћР±Р»Р°РґСѓРЅРѕРє [РЁРєС–СЂР°] 5 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ вЂ” Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ

    РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Рё РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚Рѕ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂ.
    """

    def compact_reason(reason):
        reason = reason or ""

        if "С‚РёРї Р±СЂРѕРЅС–" in reason or "Р±СЂРѕРЅС– РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ" in reason:
            return "Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if "С†СЋ Р·Р±СЂРѕСЋ" in reason or "Р·Р±СЂРѕСЋ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶Рµ" in reason:
            return "Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if "РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё" in reason or "РґСЂСѓРіСѓ СЂСѓРєСѓ" in reason:
            return "РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РґР»СЏ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if "РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР° Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ" in reason:
            return "РєРѕРЅС„Р»С–РєС‚ С–Р· РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅРѕСЋ Р·Р±СЂРѕС”СЋ"

        if "РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё РєР»Р°СЃ" in reason:
            return "РєР»Р°СЃ РЅРµ РѕР±СЂР°РЅРѕ"

        return "РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РЅРѕРІРѕРјСѓ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

    def display_removed_item_name(item):
        name = item.get("name", "РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")
        inventory_id = item.get("inventory_id")

        if not inventory_id:
            return name

        try:
            classification = get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

            if not classification:
                return name

            slot_key = classification.get("slot_key", "")
            armor_type = classification.get("armor_type", "")

            # Р”Р»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅС– РґРѕРґР°С”РјРѕ С‚РёРї Сѓ РґСѓР¶РєР°С…, СЏРєС‰Рѕ Р№РѕРіРѕ С‰Рµ РЅРµРјР°С” РІ РЅР°Р·РІС–.
            if is_armor_slot(slot_key) and armor_type:
                armor_label = get_armor_type_label(armor_type)

                if armor_label and f"[{armor_label}]" not in name:
                    marker = " СЂС–РІРЅСЏ"

                    if marker in name:
                        index = name.rfind(marker)
                        before_level = name[:index]
                        after_level = name[index:]
                        parts = before_level.rsplit(" ", 1)

                        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit():
                            return f"{parts[0]} [{armor_label}] {parts[1]}{after_level}"

                    return f"{name} [{armor_label}]"

        except Exception:
            pass

        return name

    if not unequip_result:
        return ""

    removed_items = unequip_result.get("removed_items", [])

    if not removed_items:
        return "\n\nвњ… РЈСЃРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ СЃСѓРјС–СЃРЅРµ Р· РЅРѕРІРёРј РєР»Р°СЃРѕРј."

    text = "\n\nвљ пёЏ РќРµСЃСѓРјС–СЃРЅРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ Р·РЅСЏС‚Рѕ:\n"

    for item in removed_items:
        item_name = display_removed_item_name(item)
        reason = compact_reason(item.get("reason", ""))

        text += f"вЂў {item_name} вЂ” {reason}\n"

    text += "\nРџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Рё РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚Рѕ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂ."

    return text

# вњ… OVERRIDE: DYNAMIC LOOT WITH ARMOR_TYPE / ITEM_SUBTYPE

def get_random_loot_armor_type():
    """
    Р’РёРїР°РґРєРѕРІРёР№ С‚РёРї Р±СЂРѕРЅС– РґР»СЏ РґСЂРѕРїСѓ Р· РјРѕР±С–РІ.

    РџРѕРєРё РќР• class-aware:
    - РјРѕР¶Рµ РІРїР°СЃС‚Рё С‚РєР°РЅРёРЅР°
    - РјРѕР¶Рµ РІРїР°СЃС‚Рё С€РєС–СЂР°
    - РјРѕР¶Рµ РІРїР°СЃС‚Рё РєРѕР»СЊС‡СѓРіР°
    - РјРѕР¶СѓС‚СЊ РІРїР°СЃС‚Рё Р»Р°С‚Рё
    """

    return random.choice([
        "cloth",
        "leather",
        "chain",
        "plate"
    ])


def create_generated_equipment_item(user_id, item_level, rarity):
    """
    Р”РёРЅР°РјС–С‡РЅРёР№ РґСЂРѕРї РµРєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ Р· РјРѕР±С–РІ.

    Р’Р°Р¶Р»РёРІРѕ:
    - РґР»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅС– РґРѕРґР°С” armor_type;
    - РґР»СЏ main_hand/off_hand РґРѕРґР°С” item_subtype;
    - РґР»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅС– Р·Р°СЃС‚РѕСЃРѕРІСѓС” PDEF/MDEF РїСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЊ armor_type;
    - РїРѕРєРё РґСЂРѕРї РќР• РїС–РґР»Р°С€С‚РѕРІСѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ РїС–Рґ РєР»Р°СЃ РіСЂР°РІС†СЏ;
    - РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РјРѕР¶Рµ Р±СѓС‚Рё РЅРµСЃСѓРјС–СЃРЅРёР№ С–Р· РєР»Р°СЃРѕРј, С– С†Рµ РЅРѕСЂРјР°Р»СЊРЅРѕ РґР»СЏ РІРёРїР°РґРєРѕРІРѕРіРѕ Р»СѓС‚Сѓ.
    """

    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()
    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()

    item_level = int(item_level)
    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    if rarity not in ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        rarity = "common"

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "lost": 1,
            "message": "рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР° РїРµСЂРµРїРѕРІРЅРµРЅР°. Р•РєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ РЅРµ РІР»С–Р·Р»Рѕ."
        }

    slot_key = get_dynamic_slot_key()
    item_profile = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key)

    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""
    armor_type = ""

    # ==============================
    # MAIN HAND
    # ==============================

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]

        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]

        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(
            slot_key=slot_key,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
            item_profile=item_profile
        )

        type_ = "weapon"

    # ==============================
    # OFF HAND
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]

        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]

        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(
            slot_key=slot_key,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
            item_profile=item_profile
        )

        type_ = "offhand"

    # ==============================
    # ARMOR / ACCESSORIES
    # ==============================

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1

        if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
            armor_type = get_random_loot_armor_type()

        name = get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    rarity_name = DYNAMIC_RARITY_NAMES.get(rarity, "Р—РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅРёР№")
    name = f"{name} {item_level} СЂС–РІРЅСЏ"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        stats = apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            armor_type=armor_type
        )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    ))

    item_id = cursor.lastrowid

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    inventory_id = cursor.lastrowid

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "lost": 0,
        "name": name,
        "rarity": rarity,
        "rarity_name": rarity_name,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "armor_type": armor_type,
        "item_subtype": item_profile,
        "message": f"{name}"
    }

# ==============================
# вњ… DEV EQUIPMENT GENERATION HELPERS
# ==============================

def normalize_dev_rarity(rarity):
    rarity = (rarity or "common").strip().lower()

    aliases = {
        "white": "common",
        "Р±С–Р»РёР№": "common",
        "bilyi": "common",

        "green": "uncommon",
        "Р·РµР»РµРЅРёР№": "uncommon",
        "zelenyi": "uncommon",

        "blue": "rare",
        "СЃРёРЅС–Р№": "rare",
        "synii": "rare",

        "purple": "epic",
        "С„С–РѕР»РµС‚РѕРІРёР№": "epic",
        "fioletovyi": "epic",
    }

    rarity = aliases.get(rarity, rarity)

    if rarity not in ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        rarity = "common"

    return rarity

# вњ… OVERRIDE: CLASS-AWARE DYNAMIC LOOT
# ==============================

def get_random_loot_armor_type():
    """
    Р’РёРїР°РґРєРѕРІРёР№ armor_type РґР»СЏ РїРѕРІРЅС–СЃС‚СЋ РІРёРїР°РґРєРѕРІРѕРіРѕ РґСЂРѕРїСѓ.
    """

    return random.choice([
        "cloth",
        "leather",
        "chain",
        "plate"
    ])


def get_random_class_aware_equipment_choice(user_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” slot_key, item_profile, armor_type РґР»СЏ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РїС–Рґ РєР»Р°СЃ.

    Р›РѕРіС–РєР°:
    - Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РїС–Рґ РєР»Р°СЃ;
    - main_hand РїС–Рґ РєР»Р°СЃ;
    - off_hand РїС–Рґ РєР»Р°СЃ, СЏРєС‰Рѕ РєР»Р°СЃ РјР°С” РґРѕР·РІРѕР»РµРЅРёР№ off_hand.
    """

    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)

    allowed_armor_type = get_allowed_armor_type_for_class(class_key)
    allowed_main_hand = get_allowed_main_hand_subtypes_for_class(class_key)
    allowed_off_hand = get_allowed_off_hand_subtypes_for_class(class_key)

    has_off_hand = len(allowed_off_hand) > 0

    roll = random.random()

    # РЇРєС‰Рѕ РєР»Р°СЃ РјР°С” off-hand:
    # 60% Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ, 25% main hand, 15% off hand.
    if has_off_hand:
        if roll < 0.60:
            return {
                "slot_key": random.choice(ARMOR_SLOTS),
                "item_profile": "",
                "armor_type": allowed_armor_type
            }

        if roll < 0.85:
            return {
                "slot_key": "main_hand",
                "item_profile": random.choice(allowed_main_hand),
                "armor_type": ""
            }

        return {
            "slot_key": "off_hand",
            "item_profile": random.choice(allowed_off_hand),
            "armor_type": ""
        }

    # РЇРєС‰Рѕ РєР»Р°СЃ РќР• РјР°С” off-hand:
    # 65% Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ, 35% main hand.
    if roll < 0.65:
        return {
            "slot_key": random.choice(ARMOR_SLOTS),
            "item_profile": "",
            "armor_type": allowed_armor_type
        }

    return {
        "slot_key": "main_hand",
        "item_profile": random.choice(allowed_main_hand),
        "armor_type": ""
    }


def get_random_unrestricted_equipment_choice():
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” slot_key, item_profile, armor_type РґР»СЏ РїРѕРІРЅС–СЃС‚СЋ РІРёРїР°РґРєРѕРІРѕРіРѕ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°.
    """

    slot_key = get_dynamic_slot_key()
    item_profile = get_profile_for_generated_item(slot_key)
    armor_type = ""

    if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        armor_type = get_random_loot_armor_type()
        item_profile = ""

    return {
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_profile": item_profile,
        "armor_type": armor_type
    }


def create_generated_equipment_item(
    user_id,
    item_level,
    rarity,
    class_aware_chance=0.0
):
    """
    Р”РёРЅР°РјС–С‡РЅРёР№ РґСЂРѕРї РµРєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ Р· РјРѕР±С–РІ.

    class_aware_chance:
    - 0.0 = РїРѕРІРЅС–СЃС‚СЋ РІРёРїР°РґРєРѕРІРёР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚;
    - 0.5 = 50% С€Р°РЅСЃ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РїС–Рґ РєР»Р°СЃ;
    - 0.7 = 70% С€Р°РЅСЃ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РїС–Рґ РєР»Р°СЃ.

    Р”Р»СЏ class-aware РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°:
    - Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РѕС‚СЂРёРјСѓС” armor_type РєР»Р°СЃСѓ;
    - Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ РѕС‚СЂРёРјСѓС” item_subtype, РґРѕР·РІРѕР»РµРЅРёР№ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ;
    - off-hand РѕС‚СЂРёРјСѓС” item_subtype, РґРѕР·РІРѕР»РµРЅРёР№ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ.

    Р”Р»СЏ random РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°:
    - Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РѕС‚СЂРёРјСѓС” РІРёРїР°РґРєРѕРІРёР№ armor_type;
    - Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ/off-hand РѕС‚СЂРёРјСѓС” РІРёРїР°РґРєРѕРІРёР№ item_subtype.
    """

    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()
    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()

    item_level = int(item_level)
    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    if rarity not in ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        rarity = "common"

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "lost": 1,
            "message": "рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР° РїРµСЂРµРїРѕРІРЅРµРЅР°. Р•РєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ РЅРµ РІР»С–Р·Р»Рѕ."
        }

    try:
        class_aware_chance = float(class_aware_chance or 0.0)
    except Exception:
        class_aware_chance = 0.0

    class_aware_chance = max(0.0, min(1.0, class_aware_chance))

    is_class_aware = random.random() <= class_aware_chance

    if is_class_aware:
        choice = get_random_class_aware_equipment_choice(user_id)
    else:
        choice = get_random_unrestricted_equipment_choice()

    slot_key = choice["slot_key"]
    item_profile = choice.get("item_profile", "")
    armor_type = choice.get("armor_type", "")

    weapon_hands = 1
    weapon_attack_type = ""

    # ==============================
    # MAIN HAND
    # ==============================

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        if item_profile not in MAIN_HAND_PROFILES:
            item_profile = get_random_main_hand_profile()

        profile = MAIN_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]

        weapon_hands = profile["hands"]
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]

        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(
            slot_key=slot_key,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
            item_profile=item_profile
        )

        type_ = "weapon"

    # ==============================
    # OFF HAND
    # ==============================

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        if item_profile not in OFF_HAND_PROFILES:
            item_profile = get_random_off_hand_profile()

        profile = OFF_HAND_PROFILES[item_profile]

        weapon_hands = 1
        weapon_attack_type = profile["attack_type"]

        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(
            slot_key=slot_key,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
            item_profile=item_profile
        )

        type_ = "offhand"

    # ==============================
    # ARMOR / ACCESSORIES
    # ==============================

    else:
        item_profile = ""
        weapon_hands = 1

        if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
            if not armor_type:
                armor_type = get_random_loot_armor_type()
        else:
            armor_type = ""

        name = get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    rarity_name = DYNAMIC_RARITY_NAMES.get(rarity, "Р—РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅРёР№")
    name = f"{name} {item_level} СЂС–РІРЅСЏ"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands,
        item_profile=item_profile
    )

    if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        stats = apply_armor_type_defense_profile_to_stats(
            stats=stats,
            armor_type=armor_type
        )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    weapon_min_damage = 0
    weapon_max_damage = 0
    weapon_min_magic_damage = 0
    weapon_max_magic_damage = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        min_dmg, max_dmg = calculate_weapon_damage_by_values(
            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity,
            weapon_hands=weapon_hands
        )

        if weapon_attack_type == "magical":
            weapon_min_magic_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_magic_damage = max_dmg
        else:
            weapon_min_damage = min_dmg
            weapon_max_damage = max_dmg

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated,
        item_subtype,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1,
        item_profile,
        weapon_min_damage,
        weapon_max_damage,
        weapon_min_magic_damage,
        weapon_max_magic_damage,
        weapon_attack_type,
        armor_type
    ))

    item_id = cursor.lastrowid

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    inventory_id = cursor.lastrowid

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "lost": 0,
        "name": name,
        "rarity": rarity,
        "rarity_name": rarity_name,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "armor_type": armor_type,
        "item_subtype": item_profile,
        "class_aware": is_class_aware,
        "message": f"{name}"
    }

def init_energy_system():
    """
    Р†РЅС–С†С–Р°Р»С–Р·СѓС” СЃРёСЃС‚РµРјСѓ РІС‚РѕРјРё.

    РџСЂР°РІРёР»СЊРЅР° Р»РѕРіС–РєР°:
    - energy = 0 РѕР·РЅР°С‡Р°С” РіРµСЂРѕР№ РІС–РґРїРѕС‡РёРІ С– РјРѕР¶Рµ РїРѕР»СЋРІР°С‚Рё;
    - ENERGY_MAX = 40 РѕР·РЅР°С‡Р°С” РіРµСЂРѕР№ РїРѕРІРЅС–СЃС‚СЋ РІС‚РѕРјР»РµРЅРёР№;
    - РЅРѕРІРёР№ РіРµСЂРѕР№ РјР°С” СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚СѓРІР°С‚Рё Р· energy = 0/40;
    - РЅРµРєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅС– СЃС‚Р°СЂС– Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРЅСЏ energy > ENERGY_MAX С‚СЂРµР±Р° РІРёРїСЂР°РІР»СЏС‚Рё.
    """

    migrations = [
        ("users", "energy", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "last_energy_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "energy_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    # NULL Р°Р±Рѕ РІС–РґвЂ™С”РјРЅР° РІС‚РѕРјР° вЂ” С†Рµ РЅРµРєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅРѕ, СЃС‚Р°РІРёРјРѕ 0.
    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET energy = 0
    WHERE energy IS NULL OR energy < 0
    """)

    # Р’С‚РѕРјР° Р±С–Р»СЊС€Р° Р·Р° РјР°РєСЃРёРјСѓРј вЂ” С†Рµ Р±Р°Рі СЃС‚Р°СЂРѕС— Р»РѕРіС–РєРё.
    # РЎС‚Р°РІРёРјРѕ 0, Р±Рѕ РЅРѕРІРёР№/Р±РёС‚РёР№ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶ РЅРµ РјР°С” Р±СѓС‚Рё Р·Р°Р±Р»РѕРєРѕРІР°РЅРёР№.
    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET energy = 0
    WHERE energy > ?
    """, (ENERGY_MAX,))

    # РЇРєС‰Рѕ РіРµСЂРѕР№ РІР¶Рµ РЅРµ РІС‚РѕРјР»РµРЅРёР№, РїРѕРІС–РґРѕРјР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РїСЂРѕ РїРѕРІРЅРµ РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РЅРµ РїРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ.
    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET energy_full_notified = 1
    WHERE energy <= 0
    """)

    conn.commit()


def create_user(user_id):
    """
    Р¤С–РЅР°Р»СЊРЅР° РІРµСЂСЃС–СЏ СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРµРЅРЅСЏ РєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚СѓРІР°С‡Р°.

    Р’Р°Р¶Р»РёРІРѕ:
    РЅРѕРІРёР№ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶ РјР°С” СЃС‚РІРѕСЂСЋРІР°С‚РёСЃСЏ Р· РІС‚РѕРјРѕСЋ 0/40.
    """

    from datetime import datetime

    init_energy_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (
        user_id,
        hp,
        max_hp,
        level,
        exp,
        gold,
        kills,
        bag_slots,
        current_location,
        str,
        dex,
        intelligence,
        wis,
        sta,
        equipped_weapon,
        equipped_armor,
        energy,
        last_energy_update,
        energy_full_notified
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        170,
        170,
        1,
        0,
        0.0,
        0,
        DEFAULT_BAG_SLOTS,
        "start_path",
        10,
        10,
        10,
        10,
        10,
        None,
        None,
        0,
        datetime.now().isoformat(),
        1
    ))

    conn.commit()

    # РЇРєС‰Рѕ РєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚СѓРІР°С‡ СѓР¶Рµ С–СЃРЅСѓРІР°РІ, Р°Р»Рµ РјР°РІ Р±РёС‚Сѓ РІС‚РѕРјСѓ > 40,
    # РІРёРїСЂР°РІР»СЏС”РјРѕ РѕРєСЂРµРјРѕ.
    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET energy = 0,
        last_energy_update = ?,
        energy_full_notified = 1
    WHERE user_id = ?
      AND (energy IS NULL OR energy < 0 OR energy > ?)
    """, (
        datetime.now().isoformat(),
        user_id,
        ENERGY_MAX
    ))

    conn.commit()

    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)
    migrate_legacy_equipment_to_slots(user_id)
    expand_bag_slots_to_40()

def normalize_character_name_for_unique(name):
    """
    РќРѕСЂРјР°Р»С–Р·Р°С†С–СЏ С–РјРµРЅС– РґР»СЏ РїРµСЂРµРІС–СЂРєРё СѓРЅС–РєР°Р»СЊРЅРѕСЃС‚С–.

    Р’Р°Р¶Р»РёРІРѕ:
    - РїСЂРёР±РёСЂР°С”РјРѕ Р·Р°Р№РІС– РїСЂРѕР±С–Р»Рё РЅР° РєСЂР°СЏС…;
    - СЃС‚РёСЃРєР°С”РјРѕ Р±Р°РіР°С‚Рѕ РїСЂРѕР±С–Р»С–РІ СѓСЃРµСЂРµРґРёРЅС– РґРѕ РѕРґРЅРѕРіРѕ;
    - РїРѕСЂС–РІРЅСЋС”РјРѕ С‡РµСЂРµР· casefold(), С‰РѕР± СЂРµРіС–СЃС‚СЂ РЅРµ РјР°РІ Р·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРЅСЏ.
    """

    name = normalize_character_name(name)
    name = " ".join(name.split())

    return name.casefold()


def is_character_name_taken(name, exclude_user_id=None):
    """
    РџРµСЂРµРІС–СЂСЏС”, С‡Рё Р·Р°Р№РЅСЏС‚Рµ С–РјвЂ™СЏ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° С–РЅС€РёРј РєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚СѓРІР°С‡РµРј.

    exclude_user_id РїРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РµРЅ РЅР° РјР°Р№Р±СѓС‚РЅС”, СЏРєС‰Рѕ Р±СѓРґРµ РїРµСЂРµР№РјРµРЅСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ:
    РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРёР№ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ РЅРµ РјР°С” РєРѕРЅС„Р»С–РєС‚СѓРІР°С‚Рё СЃР°Рј С–Р· СЃРѕР±РѕСЋ.
    """

    init_character_class_system()

    target_name = normalize_character_name_for_unique(name)

    if not target_name:
        return False

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT user_id, character_name
    FROM users
    WHERE character_name IS NOT NULL
      AND character_name != ''
    """)

    rows = cursor.fetchall()

    for row in rows:
        existing_user_id, existing_name = row

        if exclude_user_id is not None:
            try:
                if int(existing_user_id) == int(exclude_user_id):
                    continue
            except Exception:
                pass

        existing_normalized = normalize_character_name_for_unique(existing_name)

        if existing_normalized == target_name:
            return True

    return False


def set_character_name(user_id, name):
    """
    Р¤С–РЅР°Р»СЊРЅР° РІРµСЂСЃС–СЏ РІСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ С–РјРµРЅС– РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°.

    Р”РѕРґР°С” РїРµСЂРµРІС–СЂРєСѓ СѓРЅС–РєР°Р»СЊРЅРѕСЃС‚С– С–РјРµРЅС–.
    """

    init_character_class_system()

    name = normalize_character_name(name)

    validation = validate_character_name(name)

    if not validation["success"]:
        return validation

    if is_character_name_taken(name, exclude_user_id=user_id):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                "вќЊ Р¦Рµ С–РјвЂ™СЏ РІР¶Рµ Р·Р°Р№РЅСЏС‚Рµ С–РЅС€РёРј РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶РµРј.\n\n"
                "Р’РІРµРґРё С–РЅС€Рµ С–РјвЂ™СЏ."
            )
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET character_name=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (name, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": f"вњ… Р†РјвЂ™СЏ РіРµСЂРѕСЏ Р·Р±РµСЂРµР¶РµРЅРѕ: {name}"
    }

# вњ… OVERRIDE 5.9.5 FINAL: AUTO UNEQUIP WITH READY DISPLAY NAMES
# ==============================

def unequip_incompatible_items_after_class_change(user_id):
    """
    Р¤С–РЅР°Р»СЊРЅР° РІРµСЂСЃС–СЏ auto-unequip РїС–СЃР»СЏ Р·РјС–РЅРё РєР»Р°СЃСѓ.

    Р’Р°Р¶Р»РёРІРѕ:
    removed_items.name РѕРґСЂР°Р·Сѓ РјС–СЃС‚РёС‚СЊ:
    - РєСЂР°СЃРёРІСѓ РЅР°Р·РІСѓ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°;
    - armor_type Сѓ РґСѓР¶РєР°С… РґР»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅС–;
    - РєРѕРјРїР°РєС‚РЅСѓ РїСЂРёС‡РёРЅСѓ.

    Р¦Рµ Р·СЂРѕР±Р»РµРЅРѕ СЃРїРµС†С–Р°Р»СЊРЅРѕ, С‰РѕР± РЅР°РІС–С‚СЊ СЃС‚Р°СЂР° С„СѓРЅРєС†С–СЏ build_class_change_unequip_text()
    РїРѕРєР°Р·СѓРІР°Р»Р° РїСЂР°РІРёР»СЊРЅРёР№ С‚РµРєСЃС‚.
    """

    def add_armor_type_to_name(name, inventory_id):
        if not inventory_id:
            return name

        try:
            classification = get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

            if not classification:
                return name

            slot_key = classification.get("slot_key", "")
            armor_type = classification.get("armor_type", "")

            if not is_armor_slot(slot_key):
                return name

            if not armor_type:
                return name

            armor_label = get_armor_type_label(armor_type)

            if not armor_label:
                return name

            if f"[{armor_label}]" in name:
                return name

            marker = " СЂС–РІРЅСЏ"

            if marker in name:
                index = name.rfind(marker)
                before_level = name[:index]
                after_level = name[index:]

                parts = before_level.rsplit(" ", 1)

                if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit():
                    return f"{parts[0]} [{armor_label}] {parts[1]}{after_level}"

            return f"{name} [{armor_label}]"

        except Exception:
            return name

    def infer_compact_reason(item_info, compatibility_message=""):
        reason = compatibility_message or ""
        reason_lower = reason.lower()

        if "С‚РёРї Р±СЂРѕРЅС–" in reason_lower or "Р±СЂРѕРЅ" in reason_lower:
            return "Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if "С†СЋ Р·Р±СЂРѕСЋ" in reason_lower or "Р·Р±СЂРѕСЋ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶Рµ" in reason_lower or "Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ" in reason_lower:
            return "Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if "РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё" in reason_lower or "РґСЂСѓРіСѓ СЂСѓРєСѓ" in reason_lower:
            return "РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РґР»СЏ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if "РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР° Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ" in reason_lower:
            return "РєРѕРЅС„Р»С–РєС‚ С–Р· РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅРѕСЋ Р·Р±СЂРѕС”СЋ"

        slot_key = item_info.get("slot_key", "")

        if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
            return "Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if slot_key == "main_hand":
            return "Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if slot_key == "off_hand":
            return "РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РґР»СЏ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        return "РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РЅРѕРІРѕРјСѓ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)
    init_class_equipment_restrictions_system()
    init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    init_weapon_damage_system()

    removed_items = []

    equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)

    for slot_key in SLOT_ORDER:
        inventory_id = equipped_slots.get(slot_key)

        if not inventory_id:
            continue

        item_info = get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

        if not item_info:
            continue

        compatibility = can_equip_item_by_class(
            user_id=user_id,
            item_info=item_info
        )

        if compatibility.get("success"):
            continue

        raw_name = item_info.get("name", "РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")

        display_name = add_armor_type_to_name(
            name=raw_name,
            inventory_id=inventory_id
        )

        compact_reason = infer_compact_reason(
            item_info=item_info,
            compatibility_message=compatibility.get("message", "")
        )

        ready_name = f"{display_name} вЂ” {compact_reason}"

        unequip_slot(user_id, slot_key)

        removed_items.append({
            "inventory_id": inventory_id,
            "slot_key": slot_key,
            "name": ready_name,
            "reason": compact_reason
        })

    return {
        "success": True,
        "removed_items": removed_items,
        "removed_count": len(removed_items)
    }

def set_current_hp(user_id, hp):
    """
    Р‘РµР·РїРµС‡РЅРѕ РІСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕРІР»СЋС” РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРµ HP РіСЂР°РІС†СЏ.

    Р’Р°Р¶Р»РёРІРѕ:
    РїС–СЃР»СЏ Р±СѓРґСЊ-СЏРєРѕС— СЂСѓС‡РЅРѕС— Р·РјС–РЅРё HP РѕРЅРѕРІР»СЋС”РјРѕ last_hp_regen_update,
    С‰РѕР± РїР°СЃРёРІРЅР° СЂРµРіРµРЅРµСЂР°С†С–СЏ РЅРµ "РЅР°Р·РґРѕРіР°РЅСЏР»Р°" С‡Р°СЃ Р±РѕСЋ РѕРґСЂР°Р·Сѓ РїС–СЃР»СЏ Р±РѕСЋ.

    Р¦Рµ РїРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ РґР»СЏ РїСЂР°РІРёР»:
    - РїС–Рґ С‡Р°СЃ Р±РѕСЋ РїР°СЃРёРІРЅРёР№ СЂРµРіРµРЅ РЅРµ РЅР°РєРѕРїРёС‡СѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ;
    - РїС–СЃР»СЏ СЃРјРµСЂС‚С– РіРµСЂРѕР№ Р»РёС€Р°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ Р· 1 HP;
    - РїС–СЃР»СЏ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРЅСЏ Р±РѕСЋ С‚Р°Р№РјРµСЂ РїР°СЃРёРІРЅРѕС— СЂРµРіРµРЅРµСЂР°С†С–С— СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚СѓС” Р·Р°РЅРѕРІРѕ.
    """

    from datetime import datetime

    init_hp_regen_system()

    max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    try:
        hp = int(hp)
    except Exception:
        hp = max_hp

    if max_hp <= 0:
        max_hp = 1

    hp = max(0, min(max_hp, hp))

    hp_full_notified = 1 if hp >= max_hp else 0

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET hp=?,
        last_hp_regen_update=?,
        hp_full_notified=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        hp,
        datetime.now().isoformat(),
        hp_full_notified,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return hp

REFINE_STONE_ITEM_ID = 401
SUCCESS_RUNE_ITEM_ID = 402


def init_refine_system():
    """Р†РЅС–С†С–Р°Р»С–Р·СѓС” Р‘Р” РґР»СЏ СЃРёСЃС‚РµРјРё Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєРё."""
    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        ALTER TABLE inventory
        ADD COLUMN refine_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0
        """)
        conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass
    seed_refine_items()


def _get_table_columns(table_name):
    cursor.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table_name})")
    return [row[1] for row in cursor.fetchall()]


def _insert_item_dynamic(values_by_column):
    columns = _get_table_columns("items")
    insert_columns = []
    insert_values = []
    for column in columns:
        if column in values_by_column:
            insert_columns.append(column)
            insert_values.append(values_by_column[column])
    placeholders = ", ".join(["?"] * len(insert_columns))
    columns_sql = ", ".join(insert_columns)
    cursor.execute(f"""
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO items ({columns_sql})
    VALUES ({placeholders})
    """, insert_values)


def seed_refine_items():
    common_values = {
        "slot_key": "", "weapon_hands": 1, "max_stack": 999, "bonus_str": 0,
        "bonus_dex": 0, "bonus_int": 0, "bonus_wis": 0, "bonus_sta": 0,
        "pdef": 0, "mdef": 0, "item_level": 1, "is_generated": 0,
        "item_subtype": "", "armor_type": "", "weapon_min_damage": 0,
        "weapon_max_damage": 0, "weapon_min_magic_damage": 0,
        "weapon_max_magic_damage": 0, "weapon_attack_type": "",
        "shop_preview_owner": None, "shop_preview_price": 0,
    }
    stone_values = dict(common_values)
    stone_values.update({"id": REFINE_STONE_ITEM_ID, "name": "рџЄЁ РљР°РјС–РЅСЊ РџРѕСЃРёР»РµРЅРЅСЏ", "type": "refine_stone", "rarity": "common", "category": "material", "sell_price": 1.0})
    rune_values = dict(common_values)
    rune_values.update({"id": SUCCESS_RUNE_ITEM_ID, "name": "рџ’Ћ Р СѓРЅР° РЈСЃРїС–С…Сѓ", "type": "success_rune", "rarity": "rare", "category": "material", "sell_price": 5.0})
    _insert_item_dynamic(stone_values)
    _insert_item_dynamic(rune_values)
    conn.commit()


def get_inventory_item_refine_info(inventory_id):
    init_refine_system()
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT inventory.id, inventory.user_id, inventory.item_id, inventory.quantity,
           inventory.durability, inventory.refine_level, items.name, items.type,
           items.rarity, items.category, items.slot_key, items.weapon_hands,
           items.item_level, items.item_subtype, items.armor_type,
           items.weapon_min_damage, items.weapon_max_damage,
           items.weapon_min_magic_damage, items.weapon_max_magic_damage,
           items.weapon_attack_type
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.id=?
    """, (inventory_id,))
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    if not row:
        return None
    return {
        "inventory_id": row[0], "user_id": row[1], "item_id": row[2],
        "quantity": row[3], "durability": row[4], "refine_level": row[5],
        "name": row[6], "type": row[7], "rarity": row[8], "category": row[9],
        "slot_key": row[10], "weapon_hands": row[11], "item_level": row[12],
        "item_subtype": row[13], "armor_type": row[14],
        "weapon_min_damage": row[15], "weapon_max_damage": row[16],
        "weapon_min_magic_damage": row[17], "weapon_max_magic_damage": row[18],
        "weapon_attack_type": row[19],
    }


def get_inventory_refine_level(inventory_id):
    init_refine_system()
    cursor.execute("SELECT refine_level FROM inventory WHERE id=?", (inventory_id,))
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    if not row:
        return 0
    try:
        return int(row[0] or 0)
    except Exception:
        return 0


def set_inventory_refine_level(inventory_id, refine_level):
    init_refine_system()
    try:
        refine_level = int(refine_level)
    except Exception:
        refine_level = 0
    refine_level = max(0, refine_level)
    cursor.execute("UPDATE inventory SET refine_level=? WHERE id=?", (refine_level, inventory_id))
    conn.commit()
    return refine_level


def count_user_item(user_id, item_id):
    cursor.execute("SELECT COALESCE(SUM(quantity), 0) FROM inventory WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=?", (user_id, item_id))
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    try:
        return int((row[0] if row else 0) or 0)
    except Exception:
        return 0


def consume_user_item_by_item_id(user_id, item_id, quantity=1):
    try:
        quantity = int(quantity)
    except Exception:
        quantity = 1
    if quantity <= 0:
        return True
    if count_user_item(user_id, item_id) < quantity:
        return False
    remaining = quantity
    cursor.execute("SELECT id, quantity FROM inventory WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=? ORDER BY id ASC", (user_id, item_id))
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    for inventory_id, stack_quantity in rows:
        if remaining <= 0:
            break
        stack_quantity = int(stack_quantity or 0)
        take = min(stack_quantity, remaining)
        new_quantity = stack_quantity - take
        if new_quantity <= 0:
            cursor.execute("DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=?", (inventory_id,))
        else:
            cursor.execute("UPDATE inventory SET quantity=? WHERE id=?", (new_quantity, inventory_id))
        remaining -= take
    conn.commit()
    return remaining <= 0


def get_refine_resource_counts(user_id):
    return {"stone": count_user_item(user_id, REFINE_STONE_ITEM_ID), "success_rune": count_user_item(user_id, SUCCESS_RUNE_ITEM_ID)}

try:
    _base_get_max_hp_before_refine_v1 = get_max_hp
except Exception:
    _base_get_max_hp_before_refine_v1 = None

    _base_get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id_before_refine_v1 = get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id
except Exception:

def get_refine_total_armor_hp_bonus_percent(user_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” СЃСѓРјР°СЂРЅРёР№ HP% Р±РѕРЅСѓСЃ РІС–Рґ Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РµРЅРѕС— Р±СЂРѕРЅС–.

    Р—Р° РўР—:
    - Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ С‚РѕС‡РёС‚СЊСЃСЏ РґРѕ +6;
    - Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ Р·Р±С–Р»СЊС€СѓС” С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё РјР°РєСЃРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅРёР№ HP;
    - PDEF/MDEF С– С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё РЅРµ Р·РјС–РЅСЋСЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ.
    """

    from systems.refine_system import get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent

    init_refine_system()
    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)

    armor_slots = {
        "helmet",
        "shoulders",
        "chest",
        "gloves",
        "legs",
        "boots",
    }

    equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)
    total_bonus = 0.0

    for slot_key, inventory_id in equipped_slots.items():
        if slot_key not in armor_slots:
            continue

        if not inventory_id:
            continue

        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT
            inventory.refine_level,
            items.rarity
        FROM inventory
        JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
        WHERE inventory.id=? AND inventory.user_id=?
        """, (inventory_id, user_id))

        row = cursor.fetchone()

        if not row:
            continue

        refine_level, rarity = row

        try:
            refine_level = int(refine_level or 0)
        except Exception:
            refine_level = 0

        if refine_level <= 0:
            continue

        total_bonus += float(
            get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent(
                refine_level=refine_level,
                rarity=rarity
            )
        )

    return round(total_bonus, 2)


def get_max_hp(user_id):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE:
    max HP Р· СѓСЂР°С…СѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏРј refine Р±СЂРѕРЅС–.

    Р¤РѕСЂРјСѓР»Р° Р·Р° РўР—:
    Final HP = Base HP Г— (1 + Total_HP_Bonus / 100)

    Р’Р°Р¶Р»РёРІРѕ:
    Base HP СЂР°С…СѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ СЃС‚Р°СЂРѕСЋ С„СѓРЅРєС†С–С”СЋ get_max_hp().
    Refine Р±СЂРѕРЅС– РЅРµ Р·РјС–РЅСЋС” STA/PDEF/MDEF, Р° РґРѕРґР°С” С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё HP%.
    """

    if _base_get_max_hp_before_refine_v1 is None:
        return 1

    base_hp = int(_base_get_max_hp_before_refine_v1(user_id) or 1)

    if base_hp <= 0:
        base_hp = 1

    total_bonus = get_refine_total_armor_hp_bonus_percent(user_id)

    if total_bonus <= 0:
        return base_hp

    final_hp = int(round(base_hp * (1 + total_bonus / 100)))

    return max(1, final_hp)


def _apply_refine_multiplier_to_damage_dict(damage_data, refine_level):
    """
    РџС–РґС‚СЂРёРјСѓС” СЂС–Р·РЅС– РјРѕР¶Р»РёРІС– С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚Рё dict Р· damage-РїРѕР»СЏРјРё.
    """

    from systems.refine_system import apply_weapon_refine_to_damage

    if not isinstance(damage_data, dict):
        return damage_data

    result = dict(damage_data)

    damage_pairs = [
        ("weapon_min_damage", "weapon_max_damage"),
        ("min_damage", "max_damage"),
        ("physical_min_damage", "physical_max_damage"),
        ("weapon_min_magic_damage", "weapon_max_magic_damage"),
        ("min_magic_damage", "max_magic_damage"),
        ("magic_min_damage", "magic_max_damage"),
    ]

    for min_key, max_key in damage_pairs:
        if min_key in result and max_key in result:
            min_damage = int(result.get(min_key, 0) or 0)
            max_damage = int(result.get(max_key, 0) or 0)

            if min_damage > 0 or max_damage > 0:
                refined_min, refined_max = apply_weapon_refine_to_damage(
                    min_damage=min_damage,
                    max_damage=max_damage,
                    refine_level=refine_level
                )

                result[min_key] = refined_min
                result[max_key] = refined_max

    result["refine_level"] = refine_level
    result["refine_applied"] = True

    return result


def _apply_refine_multiplier_to_damage_sequence(damage_data, refine_level):
    """
    РћР±РµСЂРµР¶РЅР° РїС–РґС‚СЂРёРјРєР° tuple/list С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚С–РІ:
    - (min, max)
    - (min_phys, max_phys, min_magic, max_magic)
    """

    from systems.refine_system import apply_weapon_refine_to_damage

    if not isinstance(damage_data, (tuple, list)):
        return damage_data

    values = list(damage_data)

    if len(values) >= 2:
        min_damage = int(values[0] or 0)
        max_damage = int(values[1] or 0)

        if min_damage > 0 or max_damage > 0:
            values[0], values[1] = apply_weapon_refine_to_damage(
                min_damage=min_damage,
                max_damage=max_damage,
                refine_level=refine_level
            )

    if len(values) >= 4:
        min_magic = int(values[2] or 0)
        max_magic = int(values[3] or 0)

        if min_magic > 0 or max_magic > 0:
            values[2], values[3] = apply_weapon_refine_to_damage(
                min_damage=min_magic,
                max_damage=max_magic,
                refine_level=refine_level
            )

    if isinstance(damage_data, tuple):
        return tuple(values)

    return values


def get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id(inventory_id):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE:
    weapon damage Р· СѓСЂР°С…СѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏРј refine_level.

    Р—Р° РўР—:
    Final Min Damage = Base Min Damage Г— Refine Multiplier
    Final Max Damage = Base Max Damage Г— Refine Multiplier
    """

    if _base_get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id_before_refine_v1 is None:
        return None

    base_result = _base_get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id_before_refine_v1(inventory_id)

    try:
        refine_level = get_inventory_refine_level(inventory_id)
    except Exception:
        refine_level = 0

    try:
        refine_level = int(refine_level or 0)
    except Exception:
        refine_level = 0

    if refine_level <= 0:
        return base_result

    if isinstance(base_result, dict):
        return _apply_refine_multiplier_to_damage_dict(base_result, refine_level)

    if isinstance(base_result, (tuple, list)):
        return _apply_refine_multiplier_to_damage_sequence(base_result, refine_level)

    return base_result


def get_refine_effects_summary_for_user(user_id):
    """
    Р”С–Р°РіРЅРѕСЃС‚РёС‡РЅРёР№ helper РґР»СЏ С‚РµСЃС‚С–РІ.
    """

    return {
        "armor_hp_bonus_percent": get_refine_total_armor_hp_bonus_percent(user_id),
        "max_hp": get_max_hp(user_id),
    }

def _build_refined_weapon_damage_text(damage_data):
    attack_type = damage_data.get("attack_type", "")

    physical_min = int(damage_data.get("physical_min", 0) or 0)
    physical_max = int(damage_data.get("physical_max", 0) or 0)
    magic_min = int(damage_data.get("magic_min", 0) or 0)
    magic_max = int(damage_data.get("magic_max", 0) or 0)

    if attack_type == "magical" or magic_min > 0 or magic_max > 0:
        return f"рџ”® РњР°Рі. С€РєРѕРґР°: {magic_min}-{magic_max}"

    if attack_type == "physical" or physical_min > 0 or physical_max > 0:
        return f"вљ”пёЏ Р¤С–Р·. С€РєРѕРґР°: {physical_min}-{physical_max}"

    return damage_data.get("text", "")


def _apply_refine_to_weapon_damage_result_v2(base_result, refine_level):
    from systems.refine_system import apply_weapon_refine_to_damage

    try:
        refine_level = int(refine_level or 0)
    except Exception:
        refine_level = 0

    if refine_level <= 0:
        return base_result

    if isinstance(base_result, dict):
        result = dict(base_result)

        key_pairs = [
            ("physical_min", "physical_max"),
            ("magic_min", "magic_max"),
            ("weapon_min_damage", "weapon_max_damage"),
            ("weapon_min_magic_damage", "weapon_max_magic_damage"),
            ("min_damage", "max_damage"),
            ("min_magic_damage", "max_magic_damage"),
        ]

        for min_key, max_key in key_pairs:
            if min_key not in result or max_key not in result:
                continue

            min_damage = int(result.get(min_key, 0) or 0)
            max_damage = int(result.get(max_key, 0) or 0)

            if min_damage <= 0 and max_damage <= 0:
                continue

            refined_min, refined_max = apply_weapon_refine_to_damage(
                min_damage=min_damage,
                max_damage=max_damage,
                refine_level=refine_level,
            )

            result[min_key] = refined_min
            result[max_key] = refined_max

        result["refine_level"] = refine_level
        result["refine_applied"] = True
        result["text"] = _build_refined_weapon_damage_text(result)

        return result

    if isinstance(base_result, (tuple, list)):
        values = list(base_result)

        if len(values) >= 2:
            min_damage = int(values[0] or 0)
            max_damage = int(values[1] or 0)

            if min_damage > 0 or max_damage > 0:
                values[0], values[1] = apply_weapon_refine_to_damage(
                    min_damage=min_damage,
                    max_damage=max_damage,
                    refine_level=refine_level,
                )

        if len(values) >= 4:
            min_magic = int(values[2] or 0)
            max_magic = int(values[3] or 0)

            if min_magic > 0 or max_magic > 0:
                values[2], values[3] = apply_weapon_refine_to_damage(
                    min_damage=min_magic,
                    max_damage=max_magic,
                    refine_level=refine_level,
                )

        if isinstance(base_result, tuple):
            return tuple(values)

        return values

    return base_result


def get_weapon_damage_by_inventory_id(inventory_id):
    """
    FINAL HOTFIX OVERRIDE:
    weapon damage Р· СѓСЂР°С…СѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏРј refine_level РґР»СЏ Р°РєС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРіРѕ С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚Сѓ dict:
    - physical_min / physical_max
    - magic_min / magic_max
    """

    if _base_get_weapon_damage_for_refine_hotfix_v1 is None:
        return None

    base_result = _base_get_weapon_damage_for_refine_hotfix_v1(inventory_id)

    try:
        refine_level = get_inventory_refine_level(inventory_id)
    except Exception:
        refine_level = 0

    return _apply_refine_to_weapon_damage_result_v2(
        base_result=base_result,
        refine_level=refine_level,
    )
