def strip_refine_suffix_from_name(name):
    """
    РџСЂРёР±РёСЂР°С” СЃС‚Р°СЂРёР№ refine suffix, С‰РѕР± РЅРµ РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°С‚Рё РґСѓР±Р»СЋРІР°РЅРЅСЏ:
    РќР°Р·РІР° [+3] [+4]
    """

    name = name or ""
    return _refine_display_re.sub(r"\s\[\+\d+\]$", "", name).strip()


def format_refined_item_name(name, refine_level):
    """
    Р”РѕРґР°С” suffix [+N] РґРѕ РЅР°Р·РІРё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°.
    РЇРєС‰Рѕ refine_level <= 0 вЂ” РїРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” РЅР°Р·РІСѓ Р±РµР· suffix.
    """

    name = strip_refine_suffix_from_name(name)

    try:
        refine_level = int(refine_level or 0)
    except Exception:
        refine_level = 0

    if refine_level <= 0:
        return name

    return f"{name} [+{refine_level}]"


def get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, name=None):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” РЅР°Р·РІСѓ inventory-РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° Р· [+N].
    """

    try:
        refine_level = get_inventory_refine_level(inventory_id)
    except Exception:
        refine_level = 0

    if name is None:
        try:
            cursor.execute("""
            SELECT items.name
            FROM inventory
            JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
            WHERE inventory.id=?
            """, (inventory_id,))
            row = cursor.fetchone()
            name = row[0] if row else "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚"
        except Exception:
            name = "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚"

    return format_refined_item_name(name, refine_level)


def get_inventory_refine_display_line(inventory_id):
    """
    РўРµРєСЃС‚РѕРІРёР№ СЂСЏРґРѕРє РґР»СЏ РґРµС‚Р°Р»РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°.
    РџРѕРєРё РЅРµ РІСЃС– handlers Р№РѕРіРѕ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓСЋС‚СЊ, Р°Р»Рµ helper РіРѕС‚РѕРІРёР№ РґР»СЏ UI.
    """

    try:
        refine_level = get_inventory_refine_level(inventory_id)
    except Exception:
        refine_level = 0

    try:
        refine_level = int(refine_level or 0)
    except Exception:
        refine_level = 0

    if refine_level <= 0:
        return ""

    return f"вњЁ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР°: +{refine_level}\n"


def _replace_tuple_name_by_refine(row, inventory_id_index, name_index):
    if row is None:
        return row

    try:
        values = list(row)
        inventory_id = values[inventory_id_index]
        name = values[name_index]
        values[name_index] = get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, name)

        if isinstance(row, tuple):
            return tuple(values)

        return values

    except Exception:
        return row


def _replace_dict_name_by_refine(item):
    if not isinstance(item, dict):
        return item

    inventory_id = item.get("inventory_id") or item.get("id")

    if not inventory_id:
        return item

    if "name" not in item:
        return item

    result = dict(item)
    result["name"] = get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, result.get("name"))
    return result

    РћС‡С–РєСѓРІР°РЅРёР№ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІРёР№ С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚ row:

REFINE_MATERIAL_MAX_STACK = 999


def ensure_refine_material_stack_sizes():
    """
    Р“Р°СЂР°РЅС‚СѓС”, С‰Рѕ РјР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»Рё Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєРё СЃС‚Р°РєР°СЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ РґРѕ 999.
    Р‘РµР·РїРµС‡РЅРѕ РІРёРєР»РёРєР°С‚Рё Р±Р°РіР°С‚Рѕ СЂР°Р·С–РІ.
    """

    try:
        init_refine_system()
    except Exception:
        pass

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE items
    SET max_stack=?
    WHERE id IN (401, 402)
    """, (
        REFINE_MATERIAL_MAX_STACK,
    ))

    conn.commit()


def get_refine_material_stack_debug():
    """
    DEV/helper: РїРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅС– max_stack РґР»СЏ РјР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»С–РІ Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєРё.
    """

    ensure_refine_material_stack_sizes()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT id, name, max_stack
    FROM items
    WHERE id IN (401, 402)
    ORDER BY id
    """)

    return cursor.fetchall()


# РђРІС‚РѕРјР°С‚РёС‡РЅРѕ С„С–РєСЃРёРјРѕ max_stack РїСЂРё С–РјРїРѕСЂС‚С– db.py.

def get_user_guild_profile_line(user_id):
    """
    Р СЏРґРѕРє РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЋ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°.

    Р¤РѕСЂРјР°С‚:
    рџЏ° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ: рџЌ’ [Р’Р’Рџ]

    РЇРєС‰Рѕ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ РЅРµ РјР°С” РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—:
    рџЏ° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ: РЅРµРјР°С”
    """

    try:
        guild = get_user_guild(user_id)
    except Exception:
        guild = None

    if not guild:
        return "рџЏ° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ: РЅРµРјР°С”\n"

    try:
        icon = guild["icon"] or "рџЏ°"
        tag = guild["tag"] or "???"
    except Exception:
        try:
            icon = guild[3] or "рџЏ°"
            tag = guild[3] or "???"
        except Exception:
            icon = "рџЏ°"
            tag = "???"

    return f"рџЏ° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ: {icon} [{tag}]\n"

# вњ… GUILD CONTRACT REWARD CLAIM HOOK V1

# 7.0.9a
# РўРѕС‡РЅРёР№ hook РґР»СЏ РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРѕС— СЃРёСЃС‚РµРјРё РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚С–РІ Сѓ db.py.
# РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚ Р·РґР°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ С‡РµСЂРµР· claim_contract_reward(user_id), С‚РѕРјСѓ Guild EXP/Resource
# С‚СЂРµР±Р° РЅР°СЂР°С…РѕРІСѓРІР°С‚Рё СЃР°РјРµ РїС–СЃР»СЏ СѓСЃРїС–С€РЅРѕС— Р·РґР°С‡С– РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Сѓ.
#
# РќР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґР° РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—:
# - +50 Guild EXP
# - +3 Guild Resource
# - +1 guild contract

try:
    _base_claim_contract_reward_before_guild_reward_v1 = claim_contract_reward
except Exception:
    _base_claim_contract_reward_before_guild_reward_v1 = None


def _guild_contract_reward_result_success_v1(result):
    if not result:
        return False

    if isinstance(result, dict):
        if result.get("success") is False:
            return False

        message = str(result.get("message", ""))

        if "рџЋЃ РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚ Р·РґР°РЅРѕ" in message:
            return True

        if "РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚ Р·РґР°РЅРѕ" in message:
            return True

        return False

    return False


def _guild_contract_reward_append_message_v1(result, guild_result):
    try:
        guild_text = get_guild_activity_reward_text(guild_result)
    except Exception:
        guild_text = None

    if not guild_text:
        return result

    if isinstance(result, dict):
        message = str(result.get("message", ""))
        if guild_text not in message:
            result = dict(result)
            result["message"] = message.rstrip() + "\n" + guild_text
        return result

    return result


def claim_contract_reward(user_id):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE:
    Р—РґР°С‡Р° РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Сѓ + Guild reward.
    """

    if _base_claim_contract_reward_before_guild_reward_v1 is None:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р¤СѓРЅРєС†С–СЏ Р·РґР°С‡С– РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Сѓ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅР°."
        }

    # Р—Р±РµСЂС–РіР°С”РјРѕ active_contract Р”Рћ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІРѕС— Р·РґР°С‡С–, Р±Рѕ Р±Р°Р·РѕРІР° С„СѓРЅРєС†С–СЏ РїС–СЃР»СЏ РЅР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґРё
    # РІРёРґР°Р»СЏС” РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚ С–Р· user_active_contracts.
    try:
        active_contract_before_claim = get_active_contract(user_id)
    except Exception:
        active_contract_before_claim = None

    result = _base_claim_contract_reward_before_guild_reward_v1(user_id)

    if not _guild_contract_reward_result_success_v1(result):
        return result

    # Р—Р°С…РёСЃС‚ РІС–Рґ РІРёРїР°РґРєРѕРІРѕРіРѕ РЅР°СЂР°С…СѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ, СЏРєС‰Рѕ РґРѕ Р·РґР°С‡С– РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Сѓ РЅРµ Р±СѓР»Рѕ Р°Р±Рѕ РІС–РЅ РЅРµ completed.
    if not active_contract_before_claim:
        return result

    try:
        if not active_contract_before_claim.get("completed"):
            return result
        if active_contract_before_claim.get("reward_claimed"):
            return result
    except Exception:
        return result

    try:
        contract_name = active_contract_before_claim.get("target_mob_name") or "РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚"
        guild_result = award_guild_contract_completion(user_id, contract=contract_name)
        result = _guild_contract_reward_append_message_v1(result, guild_result)
    except Exception as error:
        print(f"вљ пёЏ Guild contract reward hook failed: {error}")

    return result

# 7.0.9c
# Р‘Р°Р»Р°РЅСЃ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚С–РІ:
# Р±СѓР»Рѕ: 10 РІР±РёРІСЃС‚РІ

# - СЃС‚Р°СЂС– Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅС– РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё Р· target_kills > 5 Р°РІС‚РѕРјР°С‚РёС‡РЅРѕ СЃС‚РёСЃРєР°СЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ РґРѕ 5;
# - СЏРєС‰Рѕ Сѓ СЃС‚Р°СЂРѕРјСѓ Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅРѕРјСѓ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚С– РІР¶Рµ current_kills >= 5, РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚ СЃС‚Р°С” completed.

CONTRACT_TARGET_KILLS = 5


def migrate_active_contracts_target_kills_to_5():
    init_contract_system()

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE user_active_contracts
    SET target_kills=5
    WHERE target_kills > 5
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE user_active_contracts
    SET completed=1,
        current_kills=5
    WHERE target_kills=5
      AND current_kills >= 5
      AND reward_claimed=0
    """)

    conn.commit()

    return True


try:
    migrate_active_contracts_target_kills_to_5()
except Exception as _contract_target_kills_5_error:
    print(f"вљ пёЏ Contract target kills migration failed: {_contract_target_kills_5_error}")

# ==============================
# вњ… ROM 9.0.2c HP REGEN DYNAMIC MAX FIX V1
# ==============================

# Fix reason:
# After refined armor changes max HP dynamically, stored users.max_hp can become stale.
# Legacy passive regen can then reset last_hp_regen_update while hp < dynamic max_hp,
# so HP may stay like 365/380 and not regenerate as expected.

try:
    _legacy_process_passive_regeneration_before_hp_dynamic_max_fix_v1 = process_passive_regeneration
except NameError:
    _legacy_process_passive_regeneration_before_hp_dynamic_max_fix_v1 = None


def _hp_regen_parse_dt_v1(value):
    from datetime import datetime

    if not value:
        return None

    text = str(value).strip()

    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace("Z", ""))
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace("T", " ").split(".")[0])
    except Exception:
        return None


def _hp_regen_user_columns_v1():
    try:
        cursor.execute("PRAGMA table_info(users)")
        return {row[1] for row in cursor.fetchall()}
    except Exception:
        return set()


def _hp_regen_get_config_v1():
    minutes = globals().get("HP_REGEN_MINUTES", 1)
    percent = globals().get("HP_REGEN_PERCENT", 0.10)

    try:
        minutes = int(minutes)
    except Exception:
        minutes = 1

    try:
        percent = float(percent)
    except Exception:
        percent = 0.10

    if minutes <= 0:
        minutes = 1

    if percent <= 0:
        percent = 0.10

    return minutes, percent


def process_passive_regeneration(user_id):
    """
    Dynamic-max-HP-safe passive regeneration.

    Rules:
    - max HP is always recalculated through get_max_hp(user_id);
    - users.max_hp is synchronized through sync_user_max_hp() if available;
    - if max HP increased because of refined armor, HP is not healed immediately;
    - passive regen then heals toward the new dynamic max HP;
    - last_hp_regen_update is NOT reset when hp < max_hp and no regen tick passed.
    """

    from datetime import datetime

    now = datetime.now()
    now_iso = now.isoformat()

    try:
        # Sync stale users.max_hp with dynamic equipment/refine HP.
        if "sync_user_max_hp" in globals():
            sync_user_max_hp(user_id, heal_to_full=False)
    except Exception:
        pass

    columns = _hp_regen_user_columns_v1()

    select_cols = ["hp"]
    if "max_hp" in columns:
        select_cols.append("max_hp")
    if "last_hp_regen_update" in columns:
        select_cols.append("last_hp_regen_update")
    if "mp" in columns:
        select_cols.append("mp")
    if "max_mp" in columns:
        select_cols.append("max_mp")

    try:
        cursor.execute(
            f"SELECT {', '.join(select_cols)} FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
            (user_id,)
        )
        row = cursor.fetchone()
    except Exception:
        row = None

    if not row:
        # Fallback to legacy if DB shape is unexpected.
        if _legacy_process_passive_regeneration_before_hp_dynamic_max_fix_v1:
            return _legacy_process_passive_regeneration_before_hp_dynamic_max_fix_v1(user_id)
        return {"success": False, "minutes": 0, "hp_restored": 0, "mp_restored": 0}

    def row_get(key, index, default=None):
        try:
            return row[key]
        except Exception:
            pass
        try:
            return row[index]
        except Exception:
            return default

    idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(select_cols)}

    try:
        dynamic_max_hp = int(get_max_hp(user_id) or 1)
    except Exception:
        dynamic_max_hp = int(row_get("max_hp", idx.get("max_hp", 0), 1) or 1)

    current_hp = int(row_get("hp", idx.get("hp", 0), dynamic_max_hp) or 0)

    last_value = None
    if "last_hp_regen_update" in idx:
        last_value = row_get("last_hp_regen_update", idx["last_hp_regen_update"], None)

    last_dt = _hp_regen_parse_dt_v1(last_value)

    # Initialize timestamp only if absent. Do not heal instantly.
    if last_dt is None:
        if "last_hp_regen_update" in columns:
            try:
                cursor.execute(
                    "UPDATE users SET max_hp=?, last_hp_regen_update=? WHERE user_id=?",
                    (dynamic_max_hp, now_iso, user_id)
                )
                conn.commit()
            except Exception:
                pass

        return {"success": True, "minutes": 0, "hp_restored": 0, "mp_restored": 0}

    elapsed_seconds = (now - last_dt).total_seconds()

    if elapsed_seconds < 0:
        elapsed_seconds = 0
        last_dt = now

    elapsed_minutes = int(elapsed_seconds // 60)
    regen_minutes, regen_percent = _hp_regen_get_config_v1()
    ticks = elapsed_minutes // regen_minutes

    hp_restored = 0
    mp_restored = 0
    new_hp = current_hp

    # Only heal if player is below dynamic max HP and a regen tick actually passed.
    if current_hp < dynamic_max_hp and ticks > 0:
        heal_per_tick = max(1, int(round(dynamic_max_hp * regen_percent)))
        hp_restored = min(dynamic_max_hp - current_hp, heal_per_tick * ticks)
        new_hp = min(dynamic_max_hp, current_hp + hp_restored)

        try:
            if "max_hp" in columns and "last_hp_regen_update" in columns:
                cursor.execute(
                    "UPDATE users SET hp=?, max_hp=?, last_hp_regen_update=? WHERE user_id=?",
                    (new_hp, dynamic_max_hp, now_iso, user_id)
                )
            elif "max_hp" in columns:
                cursor.execute(
                    "UPDATE users SET hp=?, max_hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                    (new_hp, dynamic_max_hp, user_id)
                )
            else:
                cursor.execute(
                    "UPDATE users SET hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                    (new_hp, user_id)
                )
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            pass

    elif current_hp >= dynamic_max_hp:
        # Full or overhealed: keep DB consistent and reset timer to now.
        clamped_hp = min(current_hp, dynamic_max_hp)
        try:
            if "max_hp" in columns and "last_hp_regen_update" in columns:
                cursor.execute(
                    "UPDATE users SET hp=?, max_hp=?, last_hp_regen_update=? WHERE user_id=?",
                    (clamped_hp, dynamic_max_hp, now_iso, user_id)
                )
            elif "max_hp" in columns:
                cursor.execute(
                    "UPDATE users SET hp=?, max_hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                    (clamped_hp, dynamic_max_hp, user_id)
                )
            else:
                cursor.execute(
                    "UPDATE users SET hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                    (clamped_hp, user_id)
                )
            conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            pass

        new_hp = clamped_hp

    else:
        # Below max but no tick yet: only ensure stored max_hp is correct.
        try:
            if "max_hp" in columns:
                cursor.execute(
                    "UPDATE users SET max_hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                    (dynamic_max_hp, user_id)
                )
                conn.commit()
        except Exception:
            pass

    return {
        "success": True,
        "minutes": elapsed_minutes,
        "hp_restored": hp_restored,
        "mp_restored": mp_restored,
        "hp": new_hp,
        "max_hp": dynamic_max_hp,
    }

## Recommended next steps

1. Do **not** mass-delete old `db.py` implementations yet. Most 9.0 systems are compatibility facades that still call legacy implementations.
2. Convert each system from legacy delegation to real implementation one domain at a time.
3. After a system no longer calls `_legacy_*`, remove the corresponding old `db.py` implementations and keep only facade wrappers.
4. Run checks after each cleanup:

```powershell
python -m py_compile .\db.py
python tools/check_imports.py
python tools/smoke_test_rom_core.py
python tools/db_cleanup_readiness.py
```

␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀ ␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀Ј␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀c␀d␀‰␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀␀E␀I␀␀ def build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob):
    """
    Р‘СѓРґСѓС” inline РєР»Р°РІС–Р°С‚СѓСЂСѓ РґР»СЏ Р±РѕСЋ Р· РѕСЃРЅРѕРІРЅРёРјРё РѕРїС†С–СЏРјРё С‚Р° РЅР°РІРёС‡РєР°РјРё.
    РќР°РІРёС‡РєРё РѕС‚СЂРёРјСѓСЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ РЅР°РїСЂСЏРјСѓ Р· РєР»Р°СЃСѓ РіСЂР°РІС†СЏ.
    """
    from handlers.combat import get_player_class_skills, get_skill_cooldown
    
    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
    
    # РћСЃРЅРѕРІРЅС– РєРЅРѕРїРєРё
    kb.add(
        types.InlineKeyboardButton("вљ”пёЏ РђС‚Р°РєСѓРІР°С‚Рё", callback_data="combat_attack"),
        types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ§Є Р—С–Р»Р»СЏ", callback_data="combat_potion"),
        types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџЏѓ Р’С‚РµРєС‚Рё", callback_data="combat_flee")
    )
    
    # РќР°РІРёС‡РєРё РіСЂР°РІС†СЏ (СЏРєС‰Рѕ РІРѕРЅРё С”)
    try:
        skills = get_player_class_skills(user_id)
        if skills:
            for skill in skills:
                cooldown = get_skill_cooldown(mob, skill["key"])
                
                if cooldown > 0:
                    # РќР°РІРёС‡РєР° РІ РїРµСЂРµР·Р°СЂСЏРґС†С–
                    kb.add(
                        types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                            f"рџ”’ {skill['name']} ({cooldown}С‡)",
                            callback_data=f"skill_locked:{skill['key']}"
                        )
                    )
                else:
                    # РќР°РІРёС‡РєР° РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅР°
                    kb.add(
                        types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                            f"вњЁ {skill['name']}",
                            callback_data=f"combat_use_skill:{skill['key']}"
                        )
                    )
    except Exception:
        pass
    
    return kb

# вњ… TELEGRAM POLLING TIMEOUT RESILIENCE V3
import time as _rom_polling_time

try:
    import requests as _rom_polling_requests
except Exception:
    _rom_polling_requests = None

try:
    from telebot import apihelper as _rom_polling_apihelper
except Exception:
    _rom_polling_apihelper = None

if _rom_polling_apihelper is not None:
    try:
        _rom_polling_apihelper.READ_TIMEOUT = 60
        _rom_polling_apihelper.CONNECT_TIMEOUT = 15
    except Exception:
        pass


def run_bot_polling_resilient(bot):
    """
    Keeps Telegram polling alive after temporary network timeouts.
    """
    while True:
        try:
            run_bot_polling_resilient(bot)
        except Exception as error:
            error_name = type(error).__name__
            error_text = str(error)

            is_timeout = False
            is_connection = False

            if _rom_polling_requests is not None:
                try:
                    is_timeout = isinstance(error, _rom_polling_requests.exceptions.ReadTimeout)
                    is_connection = isinstance(error, _rom_polling_requests.exceptions.ConnectionError)
                except Exception:
                    pass

            if is_timeout or "Read timed out" in error_text or "ReadTimeout" in error_name:
                print(f"вљ пёЏ Telegram polling read timeout, restarting polling in 5s: {error}")
                _rom_polling_time.sleep(5)
                continue

            if is_connection or "Connection" in error_name or "connection" in error_text.lower():
                print(f"вљ пёЏ Telegram polling connection error, restarting polling in 10s: {error}")
                _rom_polling_time.sleep(10)
                continue

            print(f"вљ пёЏ Telegram polling unexpected error, restarting polling in 10s: {error}")
            _rom_polling_time.sleep(10)

import sqlite3
import random

# ==============================
# 🔌 ПІДКЛЮЧЕННЯ ДО БАЗИ
# ==============================

conn = sqlite3.connect("game.db", check_same_thread=False)
cursor = conn.cursor()


# ==============================
# ✅ EQUIPMENT CONFIG
# ==============================

EQUIPMENT_SLOTS = {
    "main_hand": "🗡️ Зброя",
    "off_hand": "🛡️ Друга рука",
    "helmet": "🪖 Голова",
    "shoulders": "🦾 Плечі",
    "chest": "🥋 Тіло",
    "gloves": "🧤 Руки",
    "legs": "👖 Ноги",

RARITY_REPAIR_MULTIPLIERS = {
    "common": 1.0,
    "uncommon": 2.5,
    "rare": 7.0,
    "epic": 18.0
}


# ==============================
# ✅ DB INIT
# ==============================

def init_db():
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS users (
        user_id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,

        hp INTEGER,
        max_hp INTEGER,
        level INTEGER,
        exp INTEGER,
        gold REAL,
        kills INTEGER,
        bag_slots INTEGER,
        current_location TEXT,

        str INTEGER,
        dex INTEGER,
        intelligence INTEGER,
        wis INTEGER,
        sta INTEGER,

        equipped_weapon INTEGER,
        equipped_armor INTEGER
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS inventory (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        user_id INTEGER,
        item_id INTEGER,
        quantity INTEGER,
        durability INTEGER
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS items (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
        name TEXT,
        type TEXT,
        rarity TEXT,
        category TEXT,

        slot_key TEXT,
        weapon_hands INTEGER,

        max_stack INTEGER,
        sell_price REAL,

        bonus_str INTEGER,
        bonus_dex INTEGER,
        bonus_int INTEGER,
        bonus_wis INTEGER,
        bonus_sta INTEGER,

        pdef INTEGER,
        mdef INTEGER
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS equipment_slots (
        user_id INTEGER,
        slot_key TEXT,
        inventory_id INTEGER,
        PRIMARY KEY (user_id, slot_key)
    )
    """)

    migrations = [
        ("users", "gold", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "kills", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "bag_slots", "INTEGER DEFAULT 20"),
        ("users", "current_location", "TEXT DEFAULT 'start_path'"),

        ("inventory", "quantity", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("inventory", "durability", "INTEGER DEFAULT NULL"),

        ("items", "category", "TEXT DEFAULT 'equipment'"),
        ("items", "slot_key", "TEXT DEFAULT NULL"),
        ("items", "weapon_hands", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "max_stack", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "sell_price", "REAL DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "bonus_sta", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "pdef", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "mdef", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("items", "item_level", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "is_generated", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),

        ("users", "daily_contracts_completed", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "daily_contract_date", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),

        ("users", "energy", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "last_energy_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "energy_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),

        ("users", "last_hp_regen_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "hp_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("users", "daily_hunts", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "daily_hunts_date", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET gold = 0 WHERE gold IS NULL")
    cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET kills = 0 WHERE kills IS NULL")
    cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET bag_slots = 20 WHERE bag_slots IS NULL")

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET current_location = 'start_path'
    WHERE current_location IS NULL OR current_location = ''
    """)

    cursor.execute("UPDATE inventory SET quantity = 1 WHERE quantity IS NULL")

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE inventory
    SET durability = 100
    WHERE durability IS NULL
      AND item_id IN (
          SELECT id FROM items WHERE category = 'equipment'
      )
    """)

    conn.commit()

def create_user(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT OR IGNORE INTO users (
        user_id,
        hp,
        max_hp,
        level,
        exp,
        gold,
        kills,
        bag_slots,
        current_location,
        str,
        dex,
        intelligence,
        wis,
        sta,
        equipped_weapon,
        equipped_armor
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        170,
        170,
        1,
        0,
        0.0,
        0,
        20,
        "start_path",
        10,
        10,
        10,
        10,
        10,
        None,
        None
    ))

    conn.commit()

    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)
    migrate_legacy_equipment_to_slots(user_id)


# ==============================
# ✅ EQUIPMENT SLOTS CORE
# ==============================

def ensure_equipment_slots(user_id):
    for slot_key in SLOT_ORDER:
        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT OR IGNORE INTO equipment_slots (
            user_id,
            slot_key,
            inventory_id
        )
        VALUES (?, ?, NULL)
        """, (user_id, slot_key))

    conn.commit()


def migrate_legacy_equipment_to_slots(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT equipped_weapon, equipped_armor
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return

    equipped_weapon, equipped_armor = row

    if equipped_weapon:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE equipment_slots
        SET inventory_id=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND slot_key='main_hand'
        """, (equipped_weapon, user_id))

    if equipped_armor:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE equipment_slots
        SET inventory_id=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND slot_key='chest'
        """, (equipped_armor, user_id))

    conn.commit()


def get_equipped_slot(user_id, slot_key):
    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT inventory_id
    FROM equipment_slots
    WHERE user_id=? AND slot_key=?
    """, (user_id, slot_key))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return None

    return row[0]


def set_equipped_slot(user_id, slot_key, inventory_id):
    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE equipment_slots
    SET inventory_id=?
    WHERE user_id=? AND slot_key=?
    """, (inventory_id, user_id, slot_key))

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET equipped_weapon=?
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (inventory_id, user_id))

    if slot_key == "chest":
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET equipped_armor=?
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (inventory_id, user_id))

    conn.commit()


def unequip_slot(user_id, slot_key):
    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE equipment_slots
    SET inventory_id=NULL
    WHERE user_id=? AND slot_key=?
    """, (user_id, slot_key))

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET equipped_weapon=NULL
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (user_id,))

    if slot_key == "chest":
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET equipped_armor=NULL
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (user_id,))

    conn.commit()


def get_all_equipped_slots(user_id):
    ensure_equipment_slots(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT slot_key, inventory_id
    FROM equipment_slots
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    result = {}

    for slot_key, inventory_id in rows:
        result[slot_key] = inventory_id

    for slot_key in SLOT_ORDER:
        result.setdefault(slot_key, None)

    return result


def get_all_equipped_items(user_id):
    equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)
    result = []

    for slot_key in SLOT_ORDER:
        inventory_id = equipped_slots.get(slot_key)

        item = None

        if inventory_id:
            item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)

        result.append({
            "slot_key": slot_key,
            "slot_name": EQUIPMENT_SLOTS[slot_key],
            "inventory_id": inventory_id,
            "item": item
        })

    return result


def get_equipped_inventory_ids(user_id):
    main_hand = get_equipped_slot(user_id, "main_hand")
    chest = get_equipped_slot(user_id, "chest")
    return main_hand, chest


def is_inventory_item_equipped(user_id, inventory_id):
    equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)
    return inventory_id in equipped_slots.values()


def find_equipped_slot_by_inventory_id(user_id, inventory_id):
    equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)

    for slot_key, equipped_inventory_id in equipped_slots.items():
        if equipped_inventory_id == inventory_id:
            return slot_key

    return None

def get_bag_capacity(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT bag_slots
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row or row[0] is None:
        return 20

    return row[0]


def get_inventory_used_slots(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT COUNT(*)
    FROM inventory
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return 0

    return row[0]


# ==============================
# ✅ ADD ITEM WITH STACKING
# ==============================

def add_item(user_id, item_id, quantity=1):
    item = get_item_full(item_id)

    if not item:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "added": 0,
            "lost": quantity,
            "message": "❌ Предмет не знайдено"
        }

    (
        _,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef
    ) = item

    max_stack = max_stack or 1
    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    added = 0
    lost = 0

    if max_stack <= 1:
        for _ in range(quantity):
            used = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

            if used >= capacity:
                lost += 1
                continue

            durability = 100 if category == "equipment" else None

            cursor.execute("""
            INSERT INTO inventory (user_id, item_id, quantity, durability)
            VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
            """, (user_id, item_id, 1, durability))

            added += 1

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": added > 0,
            "added": added,
            "lost": lost,
            "name": name,
            "used_slots": get_inventory_used_slots(user_id),
            "capacity": capacity
        }

    remaining = quantity

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT id, quantity
    FROM inventory
    WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=? AND quantity < ?
    ORDER BY id ASC
    """, (user_id, item_id, max_stack))

    stacks = cursor.fetchall()

    for inv_id, current_qty in stacks:
        if remaining <= 0:
            break

        current_qty = current_qty or 0
        space = max_stack - current_qty
        to_add = min(space, remaining)

        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE inventory
        SET quantity = quantity + ?
        WHERE id=?
        """, (to_add, inv_id))

        remaining -= to_add
        added += to_add

    while remaining > 0:
        used = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

        if used >= capacity:
            lost += remaining
            remaining = 0
            break

        to_add = min(max_stack, remaining)

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO inventory (user_id, item_id, quantity, durability)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (user_id, item_id, to_add, None))

        remaining -= to_add
        added += to_add

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": added > 0,
        "added": added,
        "lost": lost,
        "name": name,
        "used_slots": get_inventory_used_slots(user_id),
        "capacity": capacity
    }

def get_inventory_entry(user_id, inventory_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        inventory.id,
        inventory.item_id,
        items.name,
        items.type,
        items.category,
        inventory.quantity
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.id=? AND inventory.user_id=?
    """, (inventory_id, user_id))

    return cursor.fetchone()


def consume_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id, quantity=1):
    entry = get_inventory_entry(user_id, inventory_id)

    if not entry:
        return False

    inv_id, item_id, name, type_, category, current_quantity = entry

    if current_quantity is None:
        current_quantity = 1

    if current_quantity < quantity:
        return False

    new_quantity = current_quantity - quantity

    if new_quantity <= 0:
        cursor.execute("""
        DELETE FROM inventory
        WHERE id=? AND user_id=?
        """, (inventory_id, user_id))
    else:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE inventory
        SET quantity=?
        WHERE id=? AND user_id=?
        """, (new_quantity, inventory_id, user_id))

    conn.commit()
    return True


def find_first_item_stack_by_type(user_id, item_type):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT inventory.id
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.user_id=?
      AND items.type=?
      AND inventory.quantity > 0
    ORDER BY inventory.id ASC
    LIMIT 1
    """, (user_id, item_type))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return None

    return row[0]

    cursor.execute("""

def get_item_required_level_by_inventory_id(inventory_id):
    try:
        init_dynamic_equipment_system()
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT items.item_level
        FROM inventory
        JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
        WHERE inventory.id=?
        """, (inventory_id,))

        row = cursor.fetchone()

        if not row:
            return 1

        return row[0] or 1

    except Exception:
        return 1


# ==============================
# ✅ EQUIPMENT
# ==============================

def get_main_hand_item(user_id):
    main_hand_id = get_equipped_slot(user_id, "main_hand")

    if not main_hand_id:
        return None

    return get_item_by_inventory_id_full(main_hand_id)


def is_main_hand_two_handed(user_id):
    item = get_main_hand_item(user_id)

    if not item:
        return False

    weapon_hands = item[7]

    return weapon_hands == 2


def equip_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id):
    item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)

    if not item:
        return "❌ Предмет не знайдено"

    (
        inv_id,
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        quantity,
        max_stack,
        durability,
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        sell_price
    ) = item

    if category != "equipment":
        return "❌ Цей предмет не можна одягти"

    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    required_level = get_item_required_level_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

    if player_level < required_level:
        return (
            f"🔒 Ти ще не можеш одягти цей предмет.\n\n"
            f"📦 Предмет: {name}\n"
            f"🏷 Потрібний рівень: {required_level}\n"
            f"👤 Твій рівень: {player_level}"
        )

        if not slot_key:
            return "❌ Для цього предмета не вказано слот"

        if slot_key not in EQUIPMENT_SLOTS:
            return "❌ Невідомий слот екіпірування"

        # ==============================
        # ✅ CLASS EQUIPMENT RESTRICTION CHECK
        # ==============================

        class_check = can_equip_inventory_item_by_class(
            user_id=user_id,
            inventory_id=inventory_id
        )

        if not class_check.get("success"):
            return class_check.get(
                "message",
                "❌ Цей предмет не підходить твоєму класу."
            )

        if slot_key == "off_hand" and is_main_hand_two_handed(user_id):
            return "❌ Неможливо: дворучна зброя блокує другу руку"

    if slot_key == "main_hand" and weapon_hands == 2:
        unequip_slot(user_id, "off_hand")

    set_equipped_slot(user_id, slot_key, inventory_id)

    return f"✅ Одягнуто: {name}"


def unequip_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id):
    slot_key = find_equipped_slot_by_inventory_id(user_id, inventory_id)

    if not slot_key:
        return "❌ Цей предмет не вдягнений"

    unequip_slot(user_id, slot_key)

    return f"✅ Знято зі слота: {EQUIPMENT_SLOTS.get(slot_key, slot_key)}"


def equip_item(user_id, item_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT id
    FROM inventory
    WHERE user_id=? AND item_id=?
    ORDER BY id ASC
    LIMIT 1
    """, (user_id, item_id))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return "❌ Такого предмета немає в інвентарі"

    return equip_inventory_item(user_id, row[0])


# ==============================
# ✅ BONUSES
# ==============================

def get_item_bonuses(user_id):
    equipped_items = get_all_equipped_items(user_id)

    total_str = 0
    total_dex = 0
    total_int = 0
    total_wis = 0
    total_sta = 0

    for equipped in equipped_items:
        item = equipped["item"]

        if not item:
            continue

        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            slot_key,
            weapon_hands,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = item

        if durability is not None and durability <= 0:
            continue

        total_str += b_str or 0
        total_dex += b_dex or 0
        total_int += b_int or 0
        total_wis += b_wis or 0
        total_sta += b_sta or 0

    return total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta


def get_equipped_item_defenses(user_id):

    total_pdef = 0

    for equipped in equipped_items:

        if not item:

        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            slot_key,
            weapon_hands,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = item

        if durability is not None and durability <= 0:
            continue

        total_pdef += pdef or 0
        total_mdef += mdef or 0

    return total_pdef, total_mdef

def get_player_stats(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        str,
        dex,
        intelligence,
        wis,
        sta,
        level
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return None

    base_str, base_dex, base_int, base_wis, base_sta, lvl = row

    item_str, item_dex, item_int, item_wis, item_sta = get_item_bonuses(user_id)

    return (
        base_str + item_str,
        base_dex + item_dex,
        base_int + item_int,
        base_wis + item_wis,
        base_sta + item_sta,
        lvl
    )

    1: 10,
    2: 12,
    3: 15,
    4: 18,
    5: 25,
    6: 30,
    7: 35,
    8: 45,
    9: 60,

    24: 340,
    25: 380,
    26: 420,
    27: 460,
    28: 520,
    29: 600,
    30: 600
}


CONDITIONAL_MOBS_TO_NEXT_BY_LEVEL = {
    1: 50,
    2: 150,
    3: 300,
    4: 500,
    5: 1200,
    6: 1800,
    7: 2500,
    8: 3500,
    9: 4500,
    10: 5000,
    11: 5500,
    12: 6000,
    13: 6000,
    14: 6000,
    15: 7000,
    16: 7000,
    17: 7000,
    18: 8000,
    19: 8000,
    20: 8500,
    21: 8500,
    22: 9500,
    23: 9500,
    24: 9500,
    25: 10500,
    26: 10500,
    27: 10500,
    28: 12000,
    29: 12000,
    30: 14000
}


CONTRACT_MOBS_EQUIVALENT = 20


def get_base_exp_for_level(level):
    level = int(level)

    if level in BASE_EXP_BY_LEVEL:
        return BASE_EXP_BY_LEVEL[level]

    if level > 30:
        return int(BASE_EXP_BY_LEVEL[30] * (1.12 ** (level - 30)))

    return BASE_EXP_BY_LEVEL[1]


def get_contract_exp_for_level(level):
    return get_base_exp_for_level(level) * CONTRACT_MOBS_EQUIVALENT


def get_exp_to_next_level(level):
    level = int(level)
    base_exp = get_base_exp_for_level(level)

    if level in CONDITIONAL_MOBS_TO_NEXT_BY_LEVEL:
        mobs_required = CONDITIONAL_MOBS_TO_NEXT_BY_LEVEL[level]
        return int(base_exp * mobs_required)

    mobs_required = int(CONDITIONAL_MOBS_TO_NEXT_BY_LEVEL[30] * (1.10 ** (level - 30)))
    return int(base_exp * mobs_required)


def add_exp(user_id, amount):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT level, exp
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return None

    level, exp = row
    exp += int(amount)

    level_ups = 0

    while exp >= get_exp_to_next_level(level):
        exp -= get_exp_to_next_level(level)
        level += 1
        level_ups += 1

        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET
            str = str + 1,
            dex = dex + 1,
            intelligence = intelligence + 1,
            wis = wis + 1,
            sta = sta + 1
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (user_id,))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET level=?, exp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (level, exp, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET max_hp=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (max_hp, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "level": level,
        "exp": exp,
        "exp_to_next": get_exp_to_next_level(level),
        "level_ups": level_ups
    }


def add_gold(user_id, amount):
    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold + ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (float(amount), user_id))

    conn.commit()


def add_kill(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET kills = kills + 1
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    conn.commit()


def get_wallet(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return 0.0

    return row[0]


def get_user_progress(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT level, exp, gold, kills, daily_hunts
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return None

    level, exp, gold, kills, daily_hunts = row

    return {
        "level": level,
        "exp": exp,
        "exp_to_next": get_exp_to_next_level(level),
        "gold": gold,
        "kills": kills,
        "daily_hunts": daily_hunts or 0
    }


# ==============================
# ✅ SELL TRASH
# ==============================

def sell_all_trash(user_id):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT
        inventory.id,
        items.name,
        inventory.quantity,
        items.sell_price
    FROM inventory
    JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
    WHERE inventory.user_id=?
      AND items.category='trash'
    """, (user_id,))

    rows = cursor.fetchall()

    if not rows:
        return {
            "sold_items_count": 0,
            "gold_earned": 0.0,
            "freed_slots": 0,
            "details": []
        }

    total_gold = 0.0
    freed_slots = 0
    details = []

    for inv_id, name, quantity, sell_price in rows:
        quantity = quantity or 1
        sell_price = sell_price or 0

        earned = quantity * sell_price
        total_gold += earned
        freed_slots += 1

        details.append(f"{name} x{quantity} = {earned:.2f} золота")

        cursor.execute("""
        DELETE FROM inventory
        WHERE id=?
        """, (inv_id,))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold + ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (total_gold, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "sold_items_count": len(rows),
        "gold_earned": total_gold,
        "freed_slots": freed_slots,
        "details": details
    }


# ==============================
# ✅ BUY ITEM FOR GOLD
# ==============================

def buy_item_for_gold(user_id, item_id, price, quantity=1):
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Персонажа не знайдено"
        }

    gold = row[0] or 0
    total_price = float(price) * quantity

    if gold < total_price:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"❌ Недостатньо золота.\n"
                f"Потрібно: {total_price:.2f}\n"
                f"У тебе: {gold:.2f}"
            )
        }

    add_result = add_item(user_id, item_id, quantity)

    added = add_result.get("added", 0)
    lost = add_result.get("lost", 0)
    name = add_result.get("name", "Предмет")

    if added <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "🎒 Сумка переповнена. Предмет не куплено."
        }

    actual_price = float(price) * added

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold - ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (actual_price, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    new_gold_row = cursor.fetchone()
    new_gold = new_gold_row[0] if new_gold_row else 0

    message = (
        f"✅ Куплено: {name} x{added}\n"
        f"🪙 Витрачено: {actual_price:.2f}\n"
        f"🪙 Залишилось золота: {new_gold:.2f}"
    )

    if lost > 0:
        message += f"\n⚠️ Не влізло в сумку: x{lost}"

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": message,
        "added": added,
        "lost": lost,
        "gold_left": new_gold
    }


# ==============================
# ✅ BLACKSMITH / REPAIR SYSTEM
# ==============================

def get_rarity_repair_multiplier(rarity):
    return RARITY_REPAIR_MULTIPLIERS.get(rarity, 1.0)


def calculate_repair_cost(durability, rarity):
    if durability is None:
        durability = 100

    durability = max(0, min(100, durability))

    if durability >= 100:
        return 0.0

    multiplier = get_rarity_repair_multiplier(rarity)

    return round((100 - durability) * multiplier * 0.05, 2)


def get_equipped_items_for_repair(user_id):
    equipped_items = get_all_equipped_items(user_id)
    result = []

    for equipped in equipped_items:
        slot_key = equipped["slot_key"]
        slot_name = equipped["slot_name"]
        inventory_id = equipped["inventory_id"]
        item = equipped["item"]

        if not inventory_id:
            result.append({
                "slot": slot_name,
                "slot_key": slot_key,
                "inventory_id": None,
                "name": "Порожньо",
                "rarity": None,
                "durability": None,
                "repair_cost": 0.0,
                "is_broken": False
            })
            continue

        if not item:
            result.append({
                "slot": slot_name,
                "slot_key": slot_key,
                "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                "name": "Предмет не знайдено",
                "rarity": None,
                "durability": None,
                "repair_cost": 0.0,
                "is_broken": False
            })
            continue

        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            item_slot_key,
            weapon_hands,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = item

        if durability is None:
            durability = 100

        repair_cost = calculate_repair_cost(durability, rarity)

        result.append({
            "slot": slot_name,
            "slot_key": slot_key,
            "inventory_id": inv_id,
            "name": name,
            "rarity": rarity,
            "durability": durability,
            "repair_cost": repair_cost,
            "is_broken": durability <= 0
        })

    return result


def get_total_repair_cost(user_id):
    equipped_items = get_equipped_items_for_repair(user_id)
    total = 0.0

    for item in equipped_items:
        total += item["repair_cost"]

    return round(total, 2)


def repair_equipped_item(user_id, inventory_id):
    if not is_inventory_item_equipped(user_id, inventory_id):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Цей предмет не вдягнений."
        }

    item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)

    if not item:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Предмет не знайдено."
        }

    (
        inv_id,
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        quantity,
        max_stack,
        durability,
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        sell_price
    ) = item

    if category != "equipment":
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Цей предмет не є спорядженням."
        }

    if durability is None:
        durability = 100

    repair_cost = calculate_repair_cost(durability, rarity)

    if repair_cost <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": f"🛠️ {name} вже має повну міцність."
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Персонажа не знайдено."
        }

    gold = row[0] or 0.0

    if gold < repair_cost:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"❌ Недостатньо золота для ремонту.\n\n"
                f"📦 Предмет: {name}\n"
                f"💳 Потрібно: {repair_cost:.2f} 🪙\n"
                f"💰 У тебе: {gold:.2f} 🪙"
            )
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE inventory
    SET durability=100
    WHERE id=?
    """, (inventory_id,))

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold - ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (repair_cost, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"✅ Предмет відремонтовано.\n\n"
            f"📦 {name}\n"
            f"🛠️ Міцність: {durability}/100 → 100/100\n"
            f"💳 Сплачено: {repair_cost:.2f} 🪙"
        ),
        "repair_cost": repair_cost
    }


def repair_all_equipped(user_id):
    equipped_items = get_equipped_items_for_repair(user_id)
    total_cost = get_total_repair_cost(user_id)

    if total_cost <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "🛠️ Усе спорядження вже має повну міцність.",
            "total_cost": 0.0
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT gold
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,))

    row = cursor.fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "❌ Персонажа не знайдено.",
            "total_cost": total_cost
        }

    gold = row[0] or 0.0

    if gold < total_cost:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"❌ Недостатньо золота для повного ремонту.\n\n"
                f"💳 Потрібно: {total_cost:.2f} 🪙\n"
                f"💰 У тебе: {gold:.2f} 🪙\n\n"
                f"ℹ️ Можеш відремонтувати окремі речі нижче."
            ),
            "total_cost": total_cost
        }

    repaired_count = 0

    for item in equipped_items:
        inventory_id = item["inventory_id"]

        if not inventory_id:
            continue

        if item["repair_cost"] <= 0:
            continue

        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE inventory
        SET durability=100
        WHERE id=?
        """, (inventory_id,))

        repaired_count += 1

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET gold = gold - ?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (total_cost, user_id))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"✅ Спорядження відремонтовано.\n"
            f"🛠️ Відремонтовано речей: {repaired_count}\n"
            f"💳 Сплачено: {total_cost:.2f} 🪙"
        ),
        "total_cost": total_cost,
        "repaired_count": repaired_count
    }


def damage_equipped_items_on_death(user_id, amount=5):
    equipped_items = get_all_equipped_items(user_id)
    damaged = []

    for equipped in equipped_items:
        inventory_id = equipped["inventory_id"]
        item = equipped["item"]

        if not inventory_id or not item:
            continue

        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            slot_key,
            weapon_hands,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = item

        if durability is None:
            durability = 100

        new_durability = max(0, durability - amount)

        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE inventory
        SET durability=?
        WHERE id=?
        """, (new_durability, inventory_id))

        damaged.append({
            "name": name,
            "old": durability,
            "new": new_durability,
            "broken": new_durability <= 0
        })

    conn.commit()

    return damaged


# ==============================
# ✅ NATURAL DURABILITY WEAR ON VICTORY
# ==============================

def apply_random_durability_wear_on_victory(user_id, chance_percent=25):
    roll = random.randint(1, 100)

    if roll > chance_percent:
        return {
            "triggered": False,
            "message": None
        }

    equipped_items = get_all_equipped_items(user_id)
    candidates = []

    for equipped in equipped_items:
        inventory_id = equipped["inventory_id"]
        item = equipped["item"]
        slot_name = equipped["slot_name"]

        if not inventory_id or not item:
            continue

        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            slot_key,
            weapon_hands,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = item

        if category != "equipment":
            continue

        if durability is None:
            durability = 100

        if durability <= 1:
            continue

        candidates.append({
            "inventory_id": inventory_id,
            "slot_name": slot_name,
            "name": name,
            "old_durability": durability
        })

    if not candidates:
        return {
            "triggered": False,
            "message": None
        }

    selected = random.choice(candidates)

    old_durability = selected["old_durability"]
    new_durability = max(1, old_durability - 1)

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE inventory
    SET durability=?
    WHERE id=?
    """, (new_durability, selected["inventory_id"]))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "triggered": True,
        "slot_name": selected["slot_name"],
        "name": selected["name"],
        "old_durability": old_durability,
        "new_durability": new_durability,
        "message": (
            f"🧱 Знос спорядження:\n"
            f"• {selected['slot_name']}: {selected['name']} "
            f"{old_durability} → {new_durability}/100"
        )
    }


# ==============================
# ✅ COMBAT STATS
# ==============================

def get_attack(user_id):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return 0

    total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta, lvl = stats

    return total_str


def get_magic_attack(user_id):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return 0

    total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta, lvl = stats

    return total_int


def get_max_hp(user_id):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return 100

    total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta, lvl = stats

    return 100 + (lvl * 20) + (total_sta * 5)


def get_physical_defense(user_id):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return 0

    total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta, lvl = stats
    item_pdef, item_mdef = get_equipped_item_defenses(user_id)

    return int(item_pdef + (total_sta * 0.2))


def get_magic_defense(user_id):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return 0

    total_str, total_dex, total_int, total_wis, total_sta, lvl = stats
    item_pdef, item_mdef = get_equipped_item_defenses(user_id)

    return int(item_mdef + (total_wis * 1))


def get_defense(user_id):
    return get_physical_defense(user_id)

def init_dynamic_equipment_system():
    migrations = [
        ("items", "item_level", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
        ("items", "is_generated", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            cursor.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.commit()


def get_dynamic_slot_key():
    return random.choice(SLOT_ORDER)


def get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, base=1.0):
    multiplier = DYNAMIC_STAT_MULTIPLIERS.get(rarity, 1.0)
    value = int(round(item_level * base * multiplier))

    return max(1, value)


def get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity):
    multiplier = DYNAMIC_SELL_MULTIPLIERS.get(rarity, 0.30)

    return round(max(0.10, item_level * multiplier), 2)


def get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands):
    icon = DYNAMIC_RARITY_ICONS.get(rarity, "⚪")

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        variants_1h = [
            "Одноручний меч",
            "Одноручний посох"
        ]

        variants_2h = [
            "Дворучний меч",
            "Дворучний посох",
            "Лук",
            "Арбалет"
        ]

        if weapon_hands == 2:
            base_name = random.choice(variants_2h)
        else:
            base_name = random.choice(variants_1h)

        return f"{icon} {base_name}"

    if slot_key == "off_hand":
        variants = [
            "Щит",
            "Магічний талісман",
            "Кинджал для другої руки"
        ]

        return f"{icon} {random.choice(variants)}"

    return f"{icon} Зброя"


def get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity):
    icon = DYNAMIC_RARITY_ICONS.get(rarity, "⚪")
    base_name = DYNAMIC_SLOT_NAMES.get(slot_key, "Річ")

    return f"{icon} {base_name}"


def generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(slot_key, item_level, rarity, weapon_hands=1):
    b_str = 0
    b_dex = 0
    b_int = 0
    b_wis = 0
    b_sta = 0
    pdef = 0
    mdef = 0

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        if random.random() < 0.55:
            b_str = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.00)

            if weapon_hands == 2:
                b_str = int(round(b_str * 1.35))
        else:
            b_int = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.00)

            if weapon_hands == 2:
                b_int = int(round(b_int * 1.35))

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        choice = random.choice(["shield", "talisman", "dagger"])

        if choice == "shield":
            pdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.30)
            b_sta = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)

        elif choice == "talisman":
            mdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.30)
            b_wis = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

        else:
            b_dex = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.90)

    elif slot_key == "helmet":
        pdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)
        mdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.40)

        bonus = random.choice(["sta", "wis", "dex"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)

        if bonus == "sta":
            b_sta += value
        elif bonus == "wis":
            b_wis += value
        else:
            b_dex += value

    elif slot_key == "shoulders":
        pdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.00)
        mdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.25)

    elif slot_key == "chest":
        pdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.60)
        mdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.35)
        b_sta = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)

    elif slot_key == "gloves":
        pdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.55)
        mdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        b_dex = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.60)

    elif slot_key == "legs":
        pdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.20)
        mdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
        b_sta = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)

    elif slot_key == "boots":
        pdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.45)
        mdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.20)
        b_dex = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

    elif slot_key == "necklace":
        mdef = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 1.30)
        b_wis = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.80)

    elif slot_key == "ring":
        stat_choice = random.choice(["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])
        value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.90)

        if stat_choice == "str":
            b_str = value
        elif stat_choice == "dex":
            b_dex = value
        elif stat_choice == "int":
            b_int = value
        elif stat_choice == "wis":
            b_wis = value
        elif stat_choice == "sta":
            b_sta = value

    if rarity in ["uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        bonus_count = 1
        min_bonus = 2

        if rarity == "rare":
            bonus_count = 2
            min_bonus = 3

        if rarity == "epic":
            bonus_count = 3
            min_bonus = 4

        for _ in range(bonus_count):
            bonus_type = random.choice(["str", "dex", "int", "wis", "sta"])

            bonus_value = get_dynamic_stat_value(item_level, rarity, 0.30)
            bonus_value = max(min_bonus, bonus_value)

            if bonus_type == "str":
                b_str += bonus_value
            elif bonus_type == "dex":
                b_dex += bonus_value
            elif bonus_type == "int":
                b_int += bonus_value
            elif bonus_type == "wis":
                b_wis += bonus_value
            elif bonus_type == "sta":
                b_sta += bonus_value

    return {
        "bonus_str": b_str,
        "bonus_dex": b_dex,
        "bonus_int": b_int,
        "bonus_wis": b_wis,
        "bonus_sta": b_sta,
        "pdef": pdef,
        "mdef": mdef
    }


def create_generated_equipment_item(user_id, item_level, rarity):
    init_dynamic_equipment_system()

    item_level = int(item_level)
    item_level = max(1, item_level)

    if rarity not in ["common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
        rarity = "common"

    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)

    if used_slots >= capacity:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "lost": 1,
            "message": "🎒 Сумка переповнена. Екіпірування не влізло."
        }

    slot_key = get_dynamic_slot_key()
    weapon_hands = 1

    if slot_key == "main_hand":
        weapon_hands = 2 if random.random() < 0.45 else 1
        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands)
        type_ = "weapon"

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        name = get_dynamic_weapon_name(slot_key, rarity, weapon_hands)
        type_ = "offhand"

    else:
        name = get_dynamic_armor_name(slot_key, rarity)
        type_ = slot_key

    rarity_name = DYNAMIC_RARITY_NAMES.get(rarity, "Звичайний")
    name = f"{name} {item_level} рівня"

    stats = generate_dynamic_equipment_stats(
        slot_key=slot_key,
        item_level=item_level,
        rarity=rarity,
        weapon_hands=weapon_hands
    )

    sell_price = get_dynamic_sell_price(item_level, rarity)

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO items (
        name,
        type,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        max_stack,
        sell_price,
        bonus_str,
        bonus_dex,
        bonus_int,
        bonus_wis,
        bonus_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        item_level,
        is_generated
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        "equipment",
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        1,
        sell_price,
        stats["bonus_str"],
        stats["bonus_dex"],
        stats["bonus_int"],
        stats["bonus_wis"],
        stats["bonus_sta"],
        stats["pdef"],
        stats["mdef"],
        item_level,
        1
    ))

    item_id = cursor.lastrowid

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO inventory (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        quantity,
        durability
    )
    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        user_id,
        item_id,
        1,
        100
    ))

    inventory_id = cursor.lastrowid

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "lost": 0,
        "name": name,
        "rarity": rarity,
        "rarity_name": rarity_name,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_id": item_id,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "message": f"{name}"
    }
