    )


def _auction_register_buy_lot_handlers_v1(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == AUCTION_BUY_BUTTON)
    def auction_buy_start_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
        AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = {
            "step": "list",
            "page": 0,
        }
        text, kb = build_auction_buy_list_text(user_id, page=0)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_BUY_STATE)
    def auction_buy_state_router_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_BUY_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_house_text(user_id),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        if step == "list":
            page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)

            if text == AUCTION_NEXT_LOTS_BUTTON:
                page += 1
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_buy_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            if text == AUCTION_PREV_LOTS_BUTTON:
                page = max(0, page - 1)
                state["page"] = page
                AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state
                list_text, kb = build_auction_buy_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            lot_id = _auction_parse_lot_id_from_button(text)
            if not lot_id:
                list_text, kb = build_auction_buy_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            from db import build_auction_lot_public_details

            details = build_auction_lot_public_details(lot_id, viewer_user_id=user_id)
            if not details.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    details.get("message", "вљ пёЏ Р›РѕС‚ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёР№."),
                    reply_markup=auction_buy_lots_kb(user_id, page=page)[0],
                )
                return

            state["step"] = "view"
            state["lot_id"] = lot_id
            AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                details["text"],
                reply_markup=auction_lot_view_kb(),
            )
            return

        if step == "view":
            lot_id = state.get("lot_id")

            if text == AUCTION_LOT_BACK_BUTTON:
                state["step"] = "list"
                AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state
                page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)
                list_text, kb = build_auction_buy_list_text(user_id, page=page)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_BUY_BUTTON:
                from db import build_auction_lot_public_details
                details = build_auction_lot_public_details(lot_id, viewer_user_id=user_id)
                if not details.get("success"):
                    clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
                    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, details.get("message", "вљ пёЏ Р›РѕС‚ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёР№."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                    return
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, details["text"], reply_markup=auction_lot_view_kb())
                return

            from db import build_auction_lot_public_details
            details = build_auction_lot_public_details(lot_id, viewer_user_id=user_id)
            if not details.get("success"):
                clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, details.get("message", "вљ пёЏ Р›РѕС‚ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёР№."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                return

            state["step"] = "confirm"
            AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_auction_buy_confirm_text(details["text"]),
                reply_markup=auction_lot_view_kb(),
            )
            return

        if step == "confirm":
            lot_id = state.get("lot_id")

            if text in [AUCTION_CANCEL_BUY_BUTTON, AUCTION_LOT_BACK_BUTTON]:
                state["step"] = "view"
                AUCTION_BUY_STATE[user_id] = state
                from db import build_auction_lot_public_details
                details = build_auction_lot_public_details(lot_id, viewer_user_id=user_id)
                if details.get("success"):
                    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, details["text"], reply_markup=auction_lot_view_kb())
                else:
                    clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
                    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, details.get("message", "вљ пёЏ Р›РѕС‚ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёР№."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                return

            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_BUY_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґСЊС‚Рµ РїРѕРєСѓРїРєСѓ Р°Р±Рѕ РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅС–С‚СЊСЃСЏ РЅР°Р·Р°Рґ.", reply_markup=auction_lot_view_kb())
                return

            from db import buy_auction_lot

            result = buy_auction_lot(buyer_user_id=user_id, lot_id=lot_id)
            clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)

            if not result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(
                    message.chat.id,
                    result.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РєСѓРїРёС‚Рё Р»РѕС‚."),
                    reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
                )
                return

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "вњ… РџРѕРєСѓРїРєСѓ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРѕ!\n\n"
                    f"рџ“¦ {result.get('item_name')}\n"
                    f"рџ’° РЎРїР»Р°С‡РµРЅРѕ: {result.get('price')} Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°\n\n"
                    "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РґРѕРґР°РЅРѕ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂ."
                ),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        clear_auction_buy_state(user_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "в„№пёЏ РЎС‚Р°РЅ РїРѕРєСѓРїРєРё СЃРєРёРЅСѓС‚Рѕ.", reply_markup=auction_house_kb())

    _auction_base_register_handlers_before_buy_lot_v1 = None

    AUCTION_EQUIPMENT_CATEGORY_BUTTON: "equipment",
    globals().get("AUCTION_STACK_CATEGORY_POTION_BUTTON", "рџ§Є Р—С–Р»Р»СЏ РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ"): "potion",
    globals().get("AUCTION_STACK_CATEGORY_MATERIAL_BUTTON", "рџЄЁ РњР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»Рё"): "material",

def _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id):
    AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE.pop(user_id, None)

    for state_name in ["AUCTION_SELL_STATE", "AUCTION_SELL_STATE_V2"]:
        try:
            globals().get(state_name, {}).pop(user_id, None)
        except Exception:
            pass


def _auction_clear_all_buy_states_v1(user_id):
    try:
        AUCTION_BUY_STATE.pop(user_id, None)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _auction_inline_truncate(text, limit=58):
    text = str(text or "")
    if len(text) <= limit:
        return text
    return text[:limit - 3] + "..."

    kb.add(AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON)
    return kb

def auction_sell_items_inline_kb_v1(user_id, category, page=0):
    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    offset = page * AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE

    if category == "equipment":
        from db import get_user_sellable_equipment_for_auction
        items = get_user_sellable_equipment_for_auction(
            user_id=user_id,
            limit=AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE + 1,
            offset=offset,
        )
    else:
        from db import get_user_sellable_stack_items_for_auction
        items = get_user_sellable_stack_items_for_auction(
            user_id=user_id,
            category=category,
            limit=AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE + 1,
            offset=offset,
        )

    visible_items = items[:AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE]
    has_next = len(items) > AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    for item in visible_items:
        if category == "equipment":
            durability = ""
            if item.get("durability_current") is not None:
                durability = f" [{item.get('durability_current')}/{item.get('durability_max')}]"
            label = f"рџ“¦ {item['name']}{durability}"
        else:
            label = f"рџ“¦ {item['name']} x{item['quantity']}"

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            _auction_inline_truncate(label),
            callback_data=f"ah_sell_item:{category}:{item['inventory_id']}:{page}"
        ))

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_sell_page:{category}:{page - 1}"))
    if has_next:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_sell_page:{category}:{page + 1}"))
    if nav:
        kb.row(*nav)

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј", callback_data="ah_menu"))
    return kb, visible_items, has_next


def build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=0):
    titles = {
        "equipment": "вљ”пёЏ Р’РёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ",
        "potion": "рџ§Є Р’РёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ",
        "material": "рџЄЁ Р’РёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РјР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»С–РІ",
    }

    kb, items, has_next = auction_sell_items_inline_kb_v1(user_id, category, page=page)
    text = f"{titles.get(category, 'вћ• Р’РёСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚Рё С‚РѕРІР°СЂ')}\n\nРЎС‚РѕСЂС–РЅРєР°: {int(page) + 1}\n\n"

    if not items:
        text += "РќРµРјР°С” РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёС… РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚С–РІ Сѓ С†С–Р№ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ."
    else:
        text += "РћР±РµСЂС–С‚СЊ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ inline-РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕСЋ РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ."

    return text, kb


def _auction_register_sell_inline_handlers_v1(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == AUCTION_SELL_BUTTON)
    def auction_sell_start_inline_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
        AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = {
            "step": "category",
        }
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_sell_start_text_inline_v1(),
            reply_markup=auction_sell_inline_category_kb_v1(),
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE)
    def auction_sell_inline_state_message_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_auction_house_text(user_id), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            return

        if text == AUCTION_CANCEL_BUTTON:
            _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ Р’РёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ С‚РѕРІР°СЂСѓ СЃРєР°СЃРѕРІР°РЅРѕ.", reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            return

        if step == "category":
            if text not in AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_CATEGORY_BUTTONS:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "РћР±РµСЂС–С‚СЊ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–СЋ РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕСЋ РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ.", reply_markup=auction_sell_inline_category_kb_v1())
                return

            category = AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_CATEGORY_BUTTONS[text]
            state.update({"step": "item_inline", "category": category, "page": 0})
            AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = state
            list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=0)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

        if step == "quantity":
            category = state.get("category")
            inventory_id = state.get("inventory_id")

            try:
                quantity = int(text)
            except Exception:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ Р’РІРµРґС–С‚СЊ РєС–Р»СЊРєС–СЃС‚СЊ С‡РёСЃР»РѕРј.")
                return

            from db import validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction
            validation = validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction(
                user_id=user_id,
                inventory_id=inventory_id,
                category=category,
                quantity=quantity,
            )

            if not validation.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, validation.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµРєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅР° РєС–Р»СЊРєС–СЃС‚СЊ."))
                return

            state.update({
                "step": "price",
                "quantity": quantity,
                "snapshot": validation["snapshot"],
            })
            AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = state
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_auction_stack_price_prompt_v2(validation["snapshot"], quantity), reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove())
            return

        if step == "price":
            from db import validate_auction_price
            price_result = validate_auction_price(text)
            if not price_result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, price_result.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµРєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅР° С†С–РЅР°.") + "\n\nРЎРїСЂРѕР±СѓР№С‚Рµ С‰Рµ СЂР°Р· Р°Р±Рѕ РЅР°РїРёС€С–С‚СЊ вќЊ РЎРєР°СЃСѓРІР°С‚Рё.", reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
                return

            state["step"] = "confirm"
            state["price"] = price_result["price"]
            AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = state

            if state.get("category") == "equipment":
                confirm_text = build_auction_sell_confirm_text(state["snapshot"], price_result["price"])
            else:
                confirm_text = build_auction_stack_confirm_text_v2(state["snapshot"], state.get("quantity", 1), price_result["price"])

            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, confirm_text, reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
            return

        if step == "confirm":
            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_LIST_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґС–С‚СЊ РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ Р°Р±Рѕ СЃРєР°СЃСѓР№С‚Рµ РґС–СЋ.", reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
                return

            category = state.get("category")

            if category == "equipment":
                from db import create_equipment_auction_lot
                result = create_equipment_auction_lot(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                    price=state.get("price"),
                )
            else:
                from db import create_stack_auction_lot
                result = create_stack_auction_lot(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                    category=category,
                    quantity=state.get("quantity"),
                    price=state.get("price"),
                )

            _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)

            if not result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРёС‚Рё Р»РѕС‚."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                return

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "вњ… Р›РѕС‚ РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРѕ РЅР° РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶!\n\n"
                    f"рџ“¦ {result.get('item_name')}\n"
                    f"рџ’° Р¦С–РЅР°: {result.get('price')} Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°\n"
                    "вЏі РўРµСЂРјС–РЅ: 7 РґРЅС–РІ\n\n"
                    "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РїРµСЂРµРЅРµСЃРµРЅРѕ Р· С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ РґРѕ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРѕРіРѕ Р”РѕРјСѓ."
                ),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "в„№пёЏ РЎС‚Р°РЅ РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ С‚РѕРІР°СЂСѓ СЃРєРёРЅСѓС‚Рѕ.", reply_markup=auction_house_kb())

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "ah_menu")
    def auction_inline_menu_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
        _auction_clear_all_buy_states_v1(user_id)
        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass
        bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, build_auction_house_text(user_id), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_sell_page:"))
    def auction_sell_inline_page_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        category = parts[1]
        page = int(parts[2])
        state = AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        state.update({"step": "item_inline", "category": category, "page": page})
        AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = state
        text, kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=page)
        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
            bot.edit_message_text(text, chat_id=call.message.chat.id, message_id=call.message.message_id, reply_markup=kb)
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_sell_item:"))
    def auction_sell_inline_item_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        category = parts[1]
        inventory_id = int(parts[2])
        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0

        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if category == "equipment":
            from db import validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment
            validation = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)
            if not validation.get("success"):
                text, kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=page)
                bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, validation.get("message", "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚Рё."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)
                return

            snapshot = validation["snapshot"]
            AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = {
                "step": "price",
                "category": category,
                "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                "snapshot": snapshot,
                "quantity": 1,
                "page": page,
            }
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, build_auction_sell_price_prompt(snapshot), reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove())
            return

        from db import get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction
        snapshot_result = get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id)
        if not snapshot_result.get("success"):
            text, kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=page)
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, snapshot_result.get("message", "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

        snapshot = snapshot_result["snapshot"]
        AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_STATE[user_id] = {
            "step": "quantity",
            "category": category,
            "inventory_id": inventory_id,
            "snapshot": snapshot,
            "page": page,
        }
        bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, build_auction_stack_quantity_prompt_v2(snapshot, category), reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove())

def auction_buy_lots_inline_kb_v1(user_id, page=0):
    from db import get_public_auction_lots_for_buyer

    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    offset = page * AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE
    lots = get_public_auction_lots_for_buyer(
        user_id=user_id,
        limit=AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE + 1,
        offset=offset,
        sort="new",
    )

    visible_lots = lots[:AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE]
    has_next = len(lots) > AUCTION_INLINE_PAGE_SIZE

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    for lot in visible_lots:
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)
        qty = f" x{quantity}" if quantity > 1 and f"x{quantity}" not in lot["item_name"] else ""
        label = f"рџ›’ {lot['item_name']}{qty} вЂ” {lot['price']} рџ’°"
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            _auction_inline_truncate(label),
            callback_data=f"ah_buy_lot:{lot['id']}:{page}"
        ))

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_buy_page:{page - 1}"))
    if has_next:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_buy_page:{page + 1}"))
    if nav:
        kb.row(*nav)

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј", callback_data="ah_menu"))
    return kb, visible_lots, has_next


def build_auction_buy_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, page=0):
    kb, lots, has_next = auction_buy_lots_inline_kb_v1(user_id, page=page)
    text = f"рџ›’ РљСѓРїРёС‚Рё\n\nРЎС‚РѕСЂС–РЅРєР°: {int(page) + 1}\n\n"

    if not lots:
        text += "РђРєС‚РёРІРЅРёС… Р»РѕС‚С–РІ РІС–Рґ С–РЅС€РёС… РіСЂР°РІС†С–РІ РїРѕРєРё РЅРµРјР°С”."
    else:
        text += (
            "РћР±РµСЂС–С‚СЊ Р»РѕС‚ inline-РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕСЋ РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ.\n\n"
            "РџСЂРѕРґР°РІРµС†СЊ РїСЂРёС…РѕРІР°РЅРёР№."
        )

    return text, kb

AUCTION_SELL_REVIEW_STATE = {}


def _auction_clear_sell_review_state_v1(user_id):
    AUCTION_SELL_REVIEW_STATE.pop(user_id, None)
    try:
        _auction_clear_all_sell_states_v1(user_id)
    except Exception:
        pass


def auction_sell_review_kb_v1(category, inventory_id, page=0):
    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    if category == "equipment":
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ’° Р’РІРµСЃС‚Рё С†С–РЅСѓ", callback_data=f"ahsrp:{category}:{inventory_id}:{page}"))
    else:
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”ў Р’РєР°Р·Р°С‚Рё РєС–Р»СЊРєС–СЃС‚СЊ", callback_data=f"ahsrq:{category}:{inventory_id}:{page}"))

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”™ Р”Рѕ СЃРїРёСЃРєСѓ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚С–РІ", callback_data=f"ah_sell_page:{category}:{page}"))
    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("вќЊ РЎРєР°СЃСѓРІР°С‚Рё", callback_data="ah_menu"))
    return kb


def _auction_send_sell_review_v1(bot, chat_id, user_id, inventory_id, category, page=0, edit_message=None):
    from db import build_auction_sell_item_review_text

    review = build_auction_sell_item_review_text(user_id=user_id, inventory_id=inventory_id, category=category)
    if not review.get("success"):
        text, kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=page)
        bot.send_message(chat_id, review.get("message", "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚Рё."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
        bot.send_message(chat_id, text, reply_markup=kb)
        return

    AUCTION_SELL_REVIEW_STATE[user_id] = {
        "step": "review",
        "category": category,
        "inventory_id": inventory_id,
        "snapshot": review.get("snapshot"),
        "page": page,
    }

    kb = auction_sell_review_kb_v1(category, inventory_id, page=page)

    if edit_message is not None:
        try:
            bot.edit_message_text(review["text"], chat_id=chat_id, message_id=edit_message.message_id, reply_markup=kb)
            return
        except Exception:
            pass

    bot.send_message(chat_id, review["text"], reply_markup=kb)


def _auction_register_sell_review_before_price_handlers_v1(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == AUCTION_SELL_BUTTON)
    def auction_sell_start_review_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        _auction_clear_sell_review_state_v1(user_id)
        AUCTION_SELL_REVIEW_STATE[user_id] = {"step": "category"}
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_sell_start_text_inline_v1(),
            reply_markup=auction_sell_inline_category_kb_v1(),
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_SELL_REVIEW_STATE)
    def auction_sell_review_message_router_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = message.text or ""
        state = AUCTION_SELL_REVIEW_STATE.get(user_id) or {}
        step = state.get("step")

        if text == AUCTION_BACK_TO_MENU_BUTTON:
            _auction_clear_sell_review_state_v1(user_id)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_auction_house_text(user_id), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            return

        if text == AUCTION_CANCEL_BUTTON:
            _auction_clear_sell_review_state_v1(user_id)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ Р’РёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ С‚РѕРІР°СЂСѓ СЃРєР°СЃРѕРІР°РЅРѕ.", reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            return

        if step == "category":
            if text not in AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_CATEGORY_BUTTONS:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "РћР±РµСЂС–С‚СЊ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–СЋ РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕСЋ РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ.", reply_markup=auction_sell_inline_category_kb_v1())
                return

            category = AUCTION_SELL_INLINE_CATEGORY_BUTTONS[text]
            state.update({"step": "item_inline", "category": category, "page": 0})
            AUCTION_SELL_REVIEW_STATE[user_id] = state
            list_text, kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=0)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, list_text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

        if step == "quantity":
            category = state.get("category")
            inventory_id = state.get("inventory_id")

            try:
                quantity = int(text)
            except Exception:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ Р’РІРµРґС–С‚СЊ РєС–Р»СЊРєС–СЃС‚СЊ С‡РёСЃР»РѕРј.")
                return

            from db import validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction
            validation = validate_inventory_stack_item_for_auction(
                user_id=user_id,
                inventory_id=inventory_id,
                category=category,
                quantity=quantity,
            )

            if not validation.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, validation.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµРєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅР° РєС–Р»СЊРєС–СЃС‚СЊ."))
                return

            state.update({
                "step": "price",
                "quantity": quantity,
                "snapshot": validation["snapshot"],
            })
            AUCTION_SELL_REVIEW_STATE[user_id] = state
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_auction_stack_price_prompt_v2(validation["snapshot"], quantity), reply_markup=types.ReplyKeyboardRemove())
            return

        if step == "price":
            from db import validate_auction_price
            price_result = validate_auction_price(text)
            if not price_result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, price_result.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµРєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅР° С†С–РЅР°.") + "\n\nРЎРїСЂРѕР±СѓР№С‚Рµ С‰Рµ СЂР°Р· Р°Р±Рѕ РЅР°РїРёС€С–С‚СЊ вќЊ РЎРєР°СЃСѓРІР°С‚Рё.", reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
                return

            state["step"] = "confirm"
            state["price"] = price_result["price"]
            AUCTION_SELL_REVIEW_STATE[user_id] = state

            if state.get("category") == "equipment":
                confirm_text = build_auction_sell_confirm_text(state["snapshot"], price_result["price"])
            else:
                confirm_text = build_auction_stack_confirm_text_v2(state["snapshot"], state.get("quantity", 1), price_result["price"])

            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, confirm_text, reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
            return

        if step == "confirm":
            if text != AUCTION_CONFIRM_LIST_BUTTON:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґС–С‚СЊ РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ Р°Р±Рѕ СЃРєР°СЃСѓР№С‚Рµ РґС–СЋ.", reply_markup=auction_sell_confirm_kb())
                return

            category = state.get("category")

            if category == "equipment":
                from db import create_equipment_auction_lot
                result = create_equipment_auction_lot(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                    price=state.get("price"),
                )
            else:
                from db import create_stack_auction_lot
                result = create_stack_auction_lot(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=state.get("inventory_id"),
                    category=category,
                    quantity=state.get("quantity"),
                    price=state.get("price"),
                )

            _auction_clear_sell_review_state_v1(user_id)

            if not result.get("success"):
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРёС‚Рё Р»РѕС‚."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
                return

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "вњ… Р›РѕС‚ РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРѕ РЅР° РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶!\n\n"
                    f"рџ“¦ {result.get('item_name')}\n"
                    f"рџ’° Р¦С–РЅР°: {result.get('price')} Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°\n"
                    "вЏі РўРµСЂРјС–РЅ: 7 РґРЅС–РІ\n\n"
                    "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РїРµСЂРµРЅРµСЃРµРЅРѕ Р· С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ РґРѕ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРѕРіРѕ Р”РѕРјСѓ."
                ),
                reply_markup=auction_house_kb(),
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "РћР±РµСЂС–С‚СЊ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ Р·С– СЃРїРёСЃРєСѓ Р°Р±Рѕ РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅС–С‚СЊСЃСЏ РґРѕ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРѕРіРѕ Р”РѕРјСѓ.")

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_sell_item:"))
    def auction_sell_review_item_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

AUCTION_MY_LOTS_PAGE_SIZE = 8


def auction_my_lots_inline_kb_v1(user_id, page=0):
    from db import get_user_auction_lots

    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    offset = page * AUCTION_MY_LOTS_PAGE_SIZE
    lots = get_user_auction_lots(
        user_id=user_id,
        status="ACTIVE",
        limit=AUCTION_MY_LOTS_PAGE_SIZE + 1,
        offset=offset,
    )

    visible_lots = lots[:AUCTION_MY_LOTS_PAGE_SIZE]
    has_next = len(lots) > AUCTION_MY_LOTS_PAGE_SIZE

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    for lot in visible_lots:
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)
        qty = f" x{quantity}" if quantity > 1 and f"x{quantity}" not in lot["item_name"] else ""
        label = f"рџ“¦ {lot['item_name']}{qty} вЂ” {lot['price']} рџ’°"
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            _auction_inline_truncate(label),
            callback_data=f"ah_my_lot:{lot['id']}:{page}"
        ))

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_my_page:{page - 1}"))
    if has_next:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_my_page:{page + 1}"))
    if nav:

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј", callback_data="ah_menu"))
    return kb, visible_lots, has_next

def auction_completed_sales_inline_kb_v1(user_id, page=0):

    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    offset = page * AUCTION_COMPLETED_SALES_PAGE_SIZE
    lots = get_user_unclaimed_auction_sales(
        user_id=user_id,
        limit=AUCTION_COMPLETED_SALES_PAGE_SIZE + 1,
        offset=offset,
    )

    visible_lots = lots[:AUCTION_COMPLETED_SALES_PAGE_SIZE]
    has_next = len(lots) > AUCTION_COMPLETED_SALES_PAGE_SIZE

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    for lot in visible_lots:
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)
        qty = f" x{quantity}" if quantity > 1 and f"x{quantity}" not in lot["item_name"] else ""
        label = f"рџ’° {lot['item_name']}{qty} вЂ” {lot['price']} Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°"
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            _auction_inline_truncate(label),
            callback_data=f"ah_sale_lot:{lot['id']}:{page}"
        ))

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_sale_page:{page - 1}"))

        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_sale_page:{page + 1}"))
    if nav:
        kb.row(*nav)

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј", callback_data="ah_menu"))
    return kb, visible_lots, has_next

def _auction_register_completed_sales_handlers_v1(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == AUCTION_SOLD_BUTTON)
    def auction_completed_sales_start_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text, kb = build_auction_completed_sales_text_v1(user_id, page=0)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_sale_page:"))
    def auction_completed_sales_page_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        page = int(call.data.split(":")[1])
        text, kb = build_auction_completed_sales_text_v1(user_id, page=page)
        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
            bot.edit_message_text(text, chat_id=call.message.chat.id, message_id=call.message.message_id, reply_markup=kb)
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_sale_lot:"))
    def auction_completed_sale_view_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        lot_id = int(parts[1])
        page = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0

        from db import build_user_unclaimed_auction_sale_details
        details = build_user_unclaimed_auction_sale_details(user_id=user_id, lot_id=lot_id)

        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if not details.get("success"):
            text, kb = build_auction_completed_sales_text_v1(user_id, page=page)
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, details.get("message", "вќЊ РџСЂРѕРґР°Р¶ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёР№."), reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)
            return

        try:
            bot.edit_message_text(details["text"], chat_id=call.message.chat.id, message_id=call.message.message_id, reply_markup=auction_completed_sale_view_kb_v1(lot_id, page=page))
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, details["text"], reply_markup=auction_completed_sale_view_kb_v1(lot_id, page=page))

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_sale_claim_confirm:"))

    kb.row(*sort_buttons[2:4])

        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)
        qty = f" x{quantity}" if quantity > 1 and f"x{quantity}" not in lot["item_name"] else ""
        label = f"рџ“¦ {lot['item_name']}{qty} вЂ” {lot['price']} рџ’°"

            _auction_inline_truncate(label),

        ))

    nav = []

        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_buy2_page:{category}:{sort_key}:{page - 1}"))

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј", callback_data="ah_menu"))

def _auction_clear_runtime_states_v1(user_id):
    """
    Best-effort cleanup for Auction House UI states.
    This prevents old sell/buy state routers from swallowing navigation buttons.
    """

    possible_state_names = [
        "AUCTION_SELL_STATE",
        "AUCTION_BUY_STATE",
        "AUCTION_MY_LOTS_STATE",
        "AUCTION_UNCLAIMED_STATE",
        "AUCTION_COMPLETED_SALES_STATE",
        "AUCTION_SEARCH_STATE",
        "AUCTION_HISTORY_STATE",
    ]

    for state_name in possible_state_names:
        state_obj = globals().get(state_name)
        if not state_obj:
            continue

        try:
            if isinstance(state_obj, dict):
                state_obj.pop(user_id, None)
            elif isinstance(state_obj, set):
                state_obj.discard(user_id)
        except Exception:
            pass


def _auction_main_menu_text_v1(user_id=None):
    """
    Returns Auction House main menu text without relying on a specific older helper name.
    """

    try:
        if "build_auction_house_text" in globals():
            if user_id is not None:
                try:
                    return build_auction_house_text(user_id)
                except TypeError:
                    return build_auction_house_text()
            return build_auction_house_text()
    except Exception:
        pass

    return (
        "рџЏ›пёЏ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј\n\n"
        "РўСѓС‚ РіСЂР°РІС†С– РјРѕР¶СѓС‚СЊ РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»СЏС‚Рё С‚РѕРІР°СЂРё РЅР° РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶, РєСѓРїСѓРІР°С‚Рё Р»РѕС‚Рё С–РЅС€РёС… РіСЂР°РІС†С–РІ "
        "С‚Р° Р·Р°Р±РёСЂР°С‚Рё Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ Р·Р° Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅС– РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶С–.\n\n"
        "Р”РѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅС– РґС–С—:\n"
        "вЂў рџ›’ РљСѓРїРёС‚Рё\n"
        "вЂў вћ• Р’РёСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚Рё С‚РѕРІР°СЂ\n"
        "вЂў рџ“¦ РњРѕС— Р»РѕС‚Рё\n"
        "вЂў рџ“¬ РќРµР·Р°Р±СЂР°РЅС– РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Рё\n"

def _auction_register_back_to_menu_callback_v1(bot):

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "ah_menu")
    def auction_back_to_menu_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        _auction_clear_runtime_states_v1(user_id)

        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        # Main Auction House menu uses ReplyKeyboardMarkup, so send a fresh message.
        # Telegram edit_message_text cannot attach ReplyKeyboardMarkup.
        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            _auction_main_menu_text_v1(user_id),
            reply_markup=auction_house_kb()
        )

def auction_buy_lots_inline_kb_v1(user_id, category="all", sort_key="new", page=0):
    """
    Override: СЃРїРёСЃРѕРє Р»РѕС‚С–РІ Р»РёС€Р°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ inline, Р°Р»Рµ Р±РµР· inline-РєРЅРѕРїРєРё рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј.
    РџРѕРІРµСЂРЅРµРЅРЅСЏ РІ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ Р”С–Рј РјР°С” Р±СѓС‚Рё С‡РµСЂРµР· Р·РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅСѓ ReplyKeyboard-РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ РІРЅРёР·Сѓ.
    """

    from db import get_auction_lots_for_buy_filtered

    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    offset = page * AUCTION_BUY_PAGE_SIZE
    lots = get_auction_lots_for_buy_filtered(
        buyer_user_id=user_id,
        category=category,
        sort_key=sort_key,
        limit=AUCTION_BUY_PAGE_SIZE + 1,
        offset=offset,
    )

    visible_lots = lots[:AUCTION_BUY_PAGE_SIZE]
    has_next = len(lots) > AUCTION_BUY_PAGE_SIZE

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    # РЎРѕСЂС‚СѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ Р»РёС€Р°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ inline.
    sort_buttons = auction_buy_sort_inline_row_v1(category, sort_key)
    kb.row(*sort_buttons[:2])
    kb.row(*sort_buttons[2:4])
    kb.row(*sort_buttons[4:])

    for lot in visible_lots:
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)
        qty = f" x{quantity}" if quantity > 1 and f"x{quantity}" not in lot["item_name"] else ""
        label = f"рџ“¦ {lot['item_name']}{qty} вЂ” {lot['price']} рџ’°"
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            _auction_inline_truncate(label),
            callback_data=f"ah_buy2_lot:{lot['id']}:{category}:{sort_key}:{page}"
        ))

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_buy2_page:{category}:{sort_key}:{page - 1}"))
    if has_next:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_buy2_page:{category}:{sort_key}:{page + 1}"))
    if nav:
        kb.row(*nav)

    # РЈ СЃРїРёСЃРєСѓ РїРѕРєСѓРїРєРё Р»РёС€Р°С”РјРѕ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅРµРЅРЅСЏ РґРѕ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–Р№.
    # РќР°Р·Р°Рґ Сѓ РіРѕР»РѕРІРЅРµ РјРµРЅСЋ вЂ” Р·РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅРѕСЋ РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕСЋ рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј.
    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”™ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С—", callback_data="ah_buy2_categories"))
    return kb, visible_lots, has_next

def _auction_register_buy_category_keyboard_cleanup_v1(bot):

    def auction_buy_category_selected_clean_keyboard_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        category = AUCTION_BUY_CATEGORY_BY_BUTTON_V1.get(message.text, "all")

        page = 0

            category=category,

            user_id,

        )

        if not lots:
            text += "\n\nР›РѕС‚С–РІ Сѓ С†С–Р№ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— РїРѕРєРё РЅРµРјР°С”."

        # Р° РїРѕС‚С–Рј РЅР°РґСЃРёР»Р°С”РјРѕ СЃРїРёСЃРѕРє Р· inline-РєРЅРѕРїРєР°РјРё.

def _auction_sanitize_sell_inline_kb_v1(kb):
    """
    РџСЂРёР±РёСЂР°С” inline-РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј Р·С– СЃРїРёСЃРєС–РІ РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ С‚РѕРІР°СЂСѓ
    С– РґРѕРґР°С” inline-РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ рџ”™ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ.
    """

    try:
        new_keyboard = []
        for row in getattr(kb, "keyboard", []) or []:
            new_row = []
            for button in row:
                text = getattr(button, "text", "") or ""
                callback_data = getattr(button, "callback_data", "") or ""

                if callback_data == "ah_menu":
                    continue
                if "РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј" in text:
                    continue

                new_row.append(button)

            if new_row:
                new_keyboard.append(new_row)

        kb.keyboard = new_keyboard
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”™ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ", callback_data=AUCTION_SELL_BACK_TO_CATEGORIES_CALLBACK_V1))
    except Exception:
        pass

    return kb


def _auction_call_equipment_sell_list_v1(user_id, page=0):
    """РџСЂРѕР±СѓС” РІРёРєР»РёРєР°С‚Рё РЅР°СЏРІРЅРёР№ helper СЃРїРёСЃРєСѓ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ."""

    fn = globals().get("build_auction_sell_item_list_text")
    if not fn:
        return None

    try:
        return fn(user_id, page=page)
    except TypeError:
        try:
            return fn(user_id=user_id, page=page)
        except TypeError:
            try:
                return fn(user_id)
            except Exception:
                return None
    except Exception:
        raise


def _auction_try_stack_sell_list_v1(user_id, category, page=0):
    """РџСЂРѕР±СѓС” Р·РЅР°Р№С‚Рё С– РІРёРєР»РёРєР°С‚Рё helper СЃРїРёСЃРєСѓ СЃС‚РµРєРѕРІРёС… РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚С–РІ."""

    candidate_names = [
        "build_auction_sell_stack_item_list_text",
        "build_auction_sell_stack_items_text",
        "build_auction_sell_stack_list_text",
        "build_auction_sell_stack_items_list_text",
        "build_auction_sell_potion_material_list_text",
    ]

    for name in candidate_names:
        fn = globals().get(name)
        if not fn:
            continue

        call_patterns = [
            lambda: fn(user_id=user_id, category=category, page=page),
            lambda: fn(user_id, category, page=page),
            lambda: fn(user_id, category, page),
            lambda: fn(user_id=user_id, item_category=category, page=page),
            lambda: fn(user_id, item_category=category, page=page),
        ]

        for call_fn in call_patterns:
            try:
                return call_fn()
            except TypeError:
                continue
            except Exception:
                raise

    return None


def _auction_send_sell_category_listing_v1(bot, message, category):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    page = 0

    # РџРµСЂРµРјРёРєР°С”РјРѕ РЅРёР¶РЅСЋ ReplyKeyboard РЅР° РѕРґРЅСѓ РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅРµРЅРЅСЏ.
    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        "рџ“‚ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–СЋ РІС–РґРєСЂРёС‚Рѕ. Р”Р»СЏ РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅРµРЅРЅСЏ РґРѕ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–Р№ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°Р№ inline-РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ В«рџ”™ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏВ» РїС–Рґ СЃРїРёСЃРєРѕРј.",
        reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1()
    )

    if category == "equipment":
        result = _auction_call_equipment_sell_list_v1(user_id, page=page)
        if result:
            text, inline_kb = result
            inline_kb = _auction_sanitize_sell_inline_kb_v1(inline_kb)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=inline_kb)
            return

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "вљ пёЏ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РІС–РґРєСЂРёС‚Рё СЃРїРёСЃРѕРє СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ.",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1()
        )
        return

    stack_category = "potion" if category == "potion" else "material"
    result = _auction_try_stack_sell_list_v1(user_id, stack_category, page=page)

    if result:
        text, inline_kb = result
        inline_kb = _auction_sanitize_sell_inline_kb_v1(inline_kb)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=inline_kb)
        return

    # РЇРєС‰Рѕ helper РјР°С” С–РЅС€Сѓ РЅР°Р·РІСѓ, РєСЂР°С‰Рµ РїРѕРєР°Р·Р°С‚Рё Р·СЂРѕР·СѓРјС–Р»РёР№ С‚РµРєСЃС‚, Р° РЅРµ РјРѕРІС‡Р°С‚Рё.
    label = "Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ" if category == "potion" else "РјР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»С–РІ"
    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        f"вљ пёЏ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РІС–РґРєСЂРёС‚Рё СЃРїРёСЃРѕРє {label} РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ. РЇРєС‰Рѕ С†Рµ РїРѕРІС‚РѕСЂРёС‚СЊСЃСЏ вЂ” СЃРєРёРЅСЊ handlers/auction_house.py, СЏ РїС–РґРєР»СЋС‡Сѓ С‚РѕС‡РЅРёР№ helper.",
        reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_back_kb_v1()
    )

def _auction_sanitize_sell_inline_keyboard_v2_safe(kb):
    """
    Р’РёРґР°Р»СЏС” inline рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј С– РґРѕРґР°С” inline рџ”™ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ.
    """

    try:
        new_keyboard = []
        for row in getattr(kb, "keyboard", []) or []:
            new_row = []
            for button in row:
                text = getattr(button, "text", "") or ""
                callback_data = getattr(button, "callback_data", "") or ""

                if callback_data == "ah_menu":
                    continue
                if "РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј" in text:
                    continue
                if callback_data == AUCTION_SELL_BACK_TO_CATEGORIES_CALLBACK_V2:
                    continue

                new_row.append(button)

            if new_row:
                new_keyboard.append(new_row)

        kb.keyboard = new_keyboard
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”™ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ", callback_data=AUCTION_SELL_BACK_TO_CATEGORIES_CALLBACK_V2))
    except Exception:
        pass

    return kb

    - РґРѕРґР°С”РјРѕ inline рџ”™ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ.

def _auction_open_sell_inline_category_v2_safe(bot, message, category):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    page = 0

    # РЎРїРµСЂС€Сѓ РїСЂРёР±РёСЂР°С”РјРѕ РЅРёР¶РЅС– РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— С– Р·Р°Р»РёС€Р°С”РјРѕ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё Р·РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅСѓ РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ РЅР°Р·Р°Рґ.
    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        "рџ“‚ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–СЋ РІС–РґРєСЂРёС‚Рѕ. Р”Р»СЏ РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅРµРЅРЅСЏ РґРѕ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–Р№ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°Р№ inline-РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ В«рџ”™ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏВ» РїС–Рґ СЃРїРёСЃРєРѕРј.",
        reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_reply_back_kb_v2_safe()
    )

    try:
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_sell_inline_list_text_v1(user_id, category, page=page)
        inline_kb = _auction_sanitize_sell_inline_keyboard_v2_safe(inline_kb)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=inline_kb)
    except Exception as error:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            f"вљ пёЏ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РІС–РґРєСЂРёС‚Рё СЃРїРёСЃРѕРє С‚РѕРІР°СЂС–РІ С†С–С”С— РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С—: {error}",
            reply_markup=auction_sell_listing_reply_back_kb_v2_safe()
        )


def _auction_register_sell_category_keyboard_cleanup_v2_safe(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "вћ• Р’РёСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚Рё С‚РѕРІР°СЂ")
    def auction_sell_start_categories_v2_safe(message):
        # РџСЂРё РІС…РѕРґС– Сѓ РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РїРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С”РјРѕ РЅРёР¶РЅС– РєРЅРѕРїРєРё РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–Р№.
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_sell_category_text_v2_safe(),
            reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb_v2_safe()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text in AUCTION_SELL_CATEGORY_BY_BUTTON_V2)
    def auction_sell_category_selected_v2_safe(message):
        category = AUCTION_SELL_CATEGORY_BY_BUTTON_V2.get(message.text, "equipment")
        _auction_open_sell_inline_category_v2_safe(bot, message, category)

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == AUCTION_SELL_BACK_TO_CATEGORIES_CALLBACK_V2)
    def auction_sell_back_to_categories_v2_safe(call):
        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_auction_sell_category_text_v2_safe(),
            reply_markup=auction_sell_category_kb_v2_safe()
        )

def auction_search_sort_inline_buttons_v1(sort_key):
    buttons = []
    for key, label in AUCTION_BUY_SORT_LABELS_V1.items():
        prefix = "вњ… " if key == sort_key else ""
        buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(prefix + label, callback_data=f"ah_search_page:{key}:0"))
    return buttons


def auction_search_results_inline_kb_v1(user_id, query, sort_key="new", page=0):
    from db import get_auction_lots_for_buy_search

    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    offset = page * AUCTION_SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE_V1
    lots = get_auction_lots_for_buy_search(
        buyer_user_id=user_id,
        search_text=query,
        sort_key=sort_key,
        limit=AUCTION_SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE_V1 + 1,
        offset=offset,
    )

    visible_lots = lots[:AUCTION_SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE_V1]
    has_next = len(lots) > AUCTION_SEARCH_PAGE_SIZE_V1

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    sort_buttons = auction_search_sort_inline_buttons_v1(sort_key)
    kb.row(*sort_buttons[:2])
    kb.row(*sort_buttons[2:4])
    kb.row(*sort_buttons[4:])

    for lot in visible_lots:
        quantity = int(lot["quantity"] or 1)
        qty = f" x{quantity}" if quantity > 1 and f"x{quantity}" not in lot["item_name"] else ""
        label = f"рџ“¦ {lot['item_name']}{qty} вЂ” {lot['price']} рџ’°"
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            _auction_inline_truncate(label),
            callback_data=f"ah_search_lot:{lot['id']}:{sort_key}:{page}"
        ))

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_search_page:{sort_key}:{page - 1}"))
    if has_next:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_search_page:{sort_key}:{page + 1}"))
    if nav:
        kb.row(*nav)

    # РќР°Р·Р°Рґ РґРѕ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–Р№ СЂРѕР±РёРјРѕ С‡РµСЂРµР· inline, Р±Рѕ С†Рµ РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅРµРЅРЅСЏ СЃР°РјРµ РґРѕ buy-category screen.
    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("рџ”™ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С—", callback_data="ah_buy2_categories"))
    return kb, visible_lots, has_next


def build_auction_search_results_text_v1(query, sort_key="new", page=0):
    sort_label = AUCTION_BUY_SORT_LABELS_V1.get(sort_key, AUCTION_BUY_SORT_LABELS_V1["new"])
    return (
        "рџ”Ќ Р РµР·СѓР»СЊС‚Р°С‚Рё РїРѕС€СѓРєСѓ\n\n"
        f"Р—Р°РїРёС‚: {query}\n"
        f"в†•пёЏ РЎРѕСЂС‚СѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ: {sort_label}\n"
        f"рџ“„ РЎС‚РѕСЂС–РЅРєР°: {int(page) + 1}\n\n"
        "РћР±РµСЂС–С‚СЊ Р»РѕС‚ inline-РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕСЋ РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ."
    )

def _auction_get_search_query_v1(user_id):
    state = AUCTION_SEARCH_STATE_V1.get(user_id) or {}
    return state.get("query", "")


def _auction_show_search_results_v1(bot, chat_id, user_id, sort_key="new", page=0, edit_message=None):
    query = _auction_get_search_query_v1(user_id)
    text = build_auction_search_results_text_v1(query, sort_key=sort_key, page=page)
    kb, lots, has_next = auction_search_results_inline_kb_v1(user_id, query, sort_key=sort_key, page=page)

    if not lots:
        text += "\n\nРќС–С‡РѕРіРѕ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ. РЎРїСЂРѕР±СѓР№С‚Рµ С–РЅС€РёР№ Р·Р°РїРёС‚."

    if edit_message is not None:
        try:
            bot.edit_message_text(text, chat_id=chat_id, message_id=edit_message.message_id, reply_markup=kb)
            return
        except Exception:
            pass

    bot.send_message(chat_id, text, reply_markup=kb)


def _auction_register_buy_search_handlers_v1(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == AUCTION_SEARCH_BUTTON_V1)
    def auction_search_start_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        AUCTION_SEARCH_STATE_V1[user_id] = {"step": "query"}
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_search_prompt_text_v1(),
            reply_markup=auction_search_reply_kb_v1()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ”Ќ РќРѕРІРёР№ РїРѕС€СѓРє")
    def auction_search_new_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        AUCTION_SEARCH_STATE_V1[user_id] = {"step": "query"}
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_search_prompt_text_v1(),
            reply_markup=auction_search_reply_kb_v1()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ”™ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С—")
    def auction_search_back_to_categories_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        AUCTION_SEARCH_STATE_V1.pop(user_id, None)
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_buy_category_text_v1(),
            reply_markup=auction_buy_category_kb_v1()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_SEARCH_STATE_V1)
    def auction_search_query_router_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = (message.text or "").strip()

        if text == "рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј":
            AUCTION_SEARCH_STATE_V1.pop(user_id, None)
            try:
                if "_auction_main_menu_text_v2" in globals():
                    menu_text = _auction_main_menu_text_v2(user_id)
                else:
                    menu_text = build_auction_house_text(user_id)
            except Exception:
                menu_text = build_auction_house_text(user_id)

            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, menu_text, reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            return

        if len(text) < 2:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ Р’РІРµРґС–С‚СЊ РјС–РЅС–РјСѓРј 2 СЃРёРјРІРѕР»Рё РґР»СЏ РїРѕС€СѓРєСѓ.", reply_markup=auction_search_reply_kb_v1())
            return

        from db import normalize_auction_search_query
        query = normalize_auction_search_query(text)

        AUCTION_SEARCH_STATE_V1[user_id] = {
            "step": "results",
            "query": query,
            "sort_key": "new",
            "page": 0,
        }

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "рџ”Ќ РџРѕС€СѓРє РІРёРєРѕРЅР°РЅРѕ.",
            reply_markup=auction_search_results_reply_kb_v1()
        )
        _auction_show_search_results_v1(bot, message.chat.id, user_id, sort_key="new", page=0)

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_search_page:"))
    def auction_search_page_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        sort_key = parts[1]
        page = int(parts[2])

        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if not _auction_get_search_query_v1(user_id):
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, build_auction_search_prompt_text_v1(), reply_markup=auction_search_reply_kb_v1())
            return

        AUCTION_SEARCH_STATE_V1[user_id]["sort_key"] = sort_key
        AUCTION_SEARCH_STATE_V1[user_id]["page"] = page
        _auction_show_search_results_v1(bot, call.message.chat.id, user_id, sort_key=sort_key, page=page, edit_message=call.message)

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_search_lot:"))
    def auction_search_lot_view_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        lot_id = int(parts[1])
        sort_key = parts[2]
        page = int(parts[3])

        from db import build_auction_buy_lot_details_v2
        details = build_auction_buy_lot_details_v2(buyer_user_id=user_id, lot_id=lot_id)

        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if not details.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, details.get("message", "вќЊ Р›РѕС‚ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёР№."), reply_markup=auction_search_results_reply_kb_v1())
            return

        try:
            bot.edit_message_text(details["text"], chat_id=call.message.chat.id, message_id=call.message.message_id, reply_markup=auction_search_lot_view_kb_v1(lot_id, sort_key, page))
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, details["text"], reply_markup=auction_search_lot_view_kb_v1(lot_id, sort_key, page))

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_search_confirm:"))
    def auction_search_confirm_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        lot_id = int(parts[1])
        sort_key = parts[2]
        page = int(parts[3])

        from db import build_auction_buy_lot_details_v2
        details = build_auction_buy_lot_details_v2(buyer_user_id=user_id, lot_id=lot_id)

        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        if not details.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, details.get("message", "вќЊ Р›РѕС‚ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёР№."), reply_markup=auction_search_results_reply_kb_v1())
            return

        text = (
            "вљ пёЏ РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РїРѕРєСѓРїРєРё\n\n"
            f"{details['text']}\n\n"
            "РџС–СЃР»СЏ РїС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ Р±СѓРґРµ СЃРїРёСЃР°РЅРѕ, Р° РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РґРѕРґР°РЅРѕ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂ."
        )

        try:
            bot.edit_message_text(text, chat_id=call.message.chat.id, message_id=call.message.message_id, reply_markup=auction_search_confirm_kb_v1(lot_id, sort_key, page))
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=auction_search_confirm_kb_v1(lot_id, sort_key, page))

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_search_do:"))
    def auction_search_do_callback_v1(call):

        parts = call.data.split(":")

        sort_key = parts[2]

        from db import buy_auction_lot_v2
        result = buy_auction_lot_v2(buyer_user_id=user_id, lot_id=lot_id)

def auction_history_inline_kb_v1(mode="all", page=0, has_next=False):
    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    row = []
    for key, label in AUCTION_HISTORY_MODE_LABELS_V1.items():
        prefix = "вњ… " if key == mode else ""
        row.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(prefix + label, callback_data=f"ah_hist:{key}:0"))
    kb.row(*row)

    nav = []
    if int(page) > 0:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_hist:{mode}:{int(page) - 1}"))
    if has_next:
        nav.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton("вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС–", callback_data=f"ah_hist:{mode}:{int(page) + 1}"))
    if nav:
        kb.row(*nav)

    return kb


def _auction_history_row_to_line_v1(row, viewer_user_id, index):
    from db import format_auction_history_date

    seller_id = int(row["seller_user_id"] or 0)
    buyer_id = int(row["buyer_user_id"] or 0)

    if buyer_id == int(viewer_user_id):
        action = "рџ›’ РљСѓРїР»РµРЅРѕ"
    elif seller_id == int(viewer_user_id):
        action = "рџ’° РџСЂРѕРґР°РЅРѕ"
    else:
        action = "рџ“¦ РЈРіРѕРґР°"

    sold_date = row["sold_at"] if "sold_at" in row.keys() else row["created_at"]
    date_text = format_auction_history_date(sold_date, with_time=True)

    quantity = int(row["quantity"] or 1)
    qty = f" x{quantity}" if quantity > 1 and f"x{quantity}" not in row["item_name"] else ""

    return (
        f"{index}. {action}: {row['item_name']}{qty}\n"
        f"   рџ’° {row['price']} Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р° | рџ•’ {date_text}"
    )


def build_auction_history_text_v1(user_id, mode="all", page=0):
    from db import get_user_auction_history

    page = max(0, int(page or 0))
    offset = page * AUCTION_HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE_V1
    rows = get_user_auction_history(user_id, mode=mode, limit=AUCTION_HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE_V1 + 1, offset=offset)

    visible = rows[:AUCTION_HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE_V1]
    has_next = len(rows) > AUCTION_HISTORY_PAGE_SIZE_V1
    mode_label = AUCTION_HISTORY_MODE_LABELS_V1.get(mode, AUCTION_HISTORY_MODE_LABELS_V1["all"])

    text = (
        "рџ“њ Р†СЃС‚РѕСЂС–СЏ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРѕРіРѕ Р”РѕРјСѓ\n\n"
        f"Р РѕР·РґС–Р»: {mode_label}\n"
        f"РЎС‚РѕСЂС–РЅРєР°: {page + 1}\n\n"
    )

    if not visible:
        text += "Р—Р°РїРёСЃС–РІ РїРѕРєРё РЅРµРјР°С”."
    else:
        lines = []
        for idx, row in enumerate(visible, start=offset + 1):
            lines.append(_auction_history_row_to_line_v1(row, user_id, idx))
        text += "\n".join(lines)

    return text, auction_history_inline_kb_v1(mode=mode, page=page, has_next=has_next)


def build_auction_market_price_prompt_v1():
    return (
        "рџ“€ Р РёРЅРєРѕРІС– С†С–РЅРё\n\n"
        "Р’РІРµРґС–С‚СЊ С‡Р°СЃС‚РёРЅСѓ РЅР°Р·РІРё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°, С‰РѕР± РїРѕРґРёРІРёС‚РёСЃСЏ С–СЃС‚РѕСЂС–СЋ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶С–РІ.\n\n"

        "вЂў РѕР±Р»Р°РґСѓРЅРѕРє\n"

        "вЂў Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ\n\n"
        "РњС–РЅС–РјСѓРј: 2 СЃРёРјРІРѕР»Рё."
    )


def build_auction_market_price_search_text_v1(query):
    from db import search_auction_market_price_stats, format_auction_history_date

    rows = search_auction_market_price_stats(query, limit=10)

    text = (
        "рџ“€ Р РёРЅРєРѕРІС– С†С–РЅРё\n\n"
        f"Р—Р°РїРёС‚: {query}\n\n"
    )

    if not rows:
        text += "РџСЂРѕРґР°Р¶С–РІ Р·Р° С†РёРј Р·Р°РїРёС‚РѕРј С‰Рµ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        return text

    lines = []
    for idx, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        try:
            avg_price = float(row["avg_price"] or 0)
            min_price = float(row["min_price"] or 0)
            max_price = float(row["max_price"] or 0)
        except Exception:
            avg_price = min_price = max_price = 0.0

        last_sale = format_auction_history_date(row["last_sale_at"], with_time=True)

        lines.append(
            f"{idx}. {row['item_name']}\n"
            f"   РџСЂРѕРґР°Р¶С–РІ: {row['sales_count']} | РЎРµСЂРµРґРЅСЏ: {avg_price:.2f} рџ’°\n"
            f"   РњС–РЅ: {min_price:.2f} рџ’° | РњР°РєСЃ: {max_price:.2f} рџ’°\n"
            f"   РћСЃС‚Р°РЅРЅС–Р№ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶: {last_sale}"
        )

    text += "\n\n".join(lines)
    return text


def build_auction_lot_market_price_text_v1(lot_id):
    from db import get_auction_lot_market_price_stats, format_auction_history_date

    result = get_auction_lot_market_price_stats(lot_id)

    if not result.get("success"):
        return result.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°С‚Рё С–СЃС‚РѕСЂС–СЋ С†С–РЅ.")

    item_name = result.get("item_name", "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")

    text = (
        "рџ“€ Р РёРЅРєРѕРІС– С†С–РЅРё\n\n"
        f"рџ“¦ {item_name}\n\n"
    )

    if int(result.get("count", 0) or 0) <= 0:
        text += result.get("message", "Р†СЃС‚РѕСЂС–С— РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶С–РІ С‰Рµ РЅРµРјР°С”.")
        return text

    text += (
        f"РџСЂРѕРґР°Р¶С–РІ РІСЂР°С…РѕРІР°РЅРѕ: {result['count']}\n"
        f"РћСЃС‚Р°РЅРЅСЏ С†С–РЅР°: {float(result['last_price']):.2f} рџ’°\n"
        f"РЎРµСЂРµРґРЅСЏ С†С–РЅР°: {float(result['avg_price']):.2f} рџ’°\n"
        f"РњС–РЅС–РјР°Р»СЊРЅР° С†С–РЅР°: {float(result['min_price']):.2f} рџ’°\n"
        f"РњР°РєСЃРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅР° С†С–РЅР°: {float(result['max_price']):.2f} рџ’°\n\n"
        "РћСЃС‚Р°РЅРЅС– РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶С–:\n"
    )

    for row in result.get("rows", [])[:5]:
        date_text = format_auction_history_date(row["history_date"], with_time=True)
        text += f"вЂў {row['price']} рџ’° вЂ” {date_text}\n"

    return text.rstrip()

def _auction_register_history_market_prices_handlers_v1(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == AUCTION_HISTORY_BUTTON)
    def auction_history_start_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_history_text_v1(user_id, mode="all", page=0)
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "рџ“њ Р РѕР·РґС–Р» В«Р†СЃС‚РѕСЂС–СЏВ» РІС–РґРєСЂРёС‚Рѕ.",
            reply_markup=auction_history_reply_kb_v1()
        )
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=inline_kb)

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_hist:"))
    def auction_history_page_callback_v1(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        mode = parts[1]
        page = int(parts[2])
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_history_text_v1(user_id, mode=mode, page=page)

        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        try:
            bot.edit_message_text(text, chat_id=call.message.chat.id, message_id=call.message.message_id, reply_markup=inline_kb)
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=inline_kb)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ“€ Р РёРЅРєРѕРІС– С†С–РЅРё")
    def auction_market_price_search_start_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        AUCTION_MARKET_PRICE_SEARCH_STATE_V1[user_id] = True
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_market_price_prompt_v1(),
            reply_markup=auction_market_price_search_kb_v1()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ”™ Р†СЃС‚РѕСЂС–СЏ")
    def auction_market_price_back_history_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        AUCTION_MARKET_PRICE_SEARCH_STATE_V1.pop(user_id, None)
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_history_text_v1(user_id, mode="all", page=0)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=inline_kb)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in AUCTION_MARKET_PRICE_SEARCH_STATE_V1)
    def auction_market_price_search_query_v1(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        text = (message.text or "").strip()

        if text == "рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј":
            AUCTION_MARKET_PRICE_SEARCH_STATE_V1.pop(user_id, None)
            try:
                if "_auction_main_menu_text_v2" in globals():
                    menu_text = _auction_main_menu_text_v2(user_id)
                else:
                    menu_text = build_auction_house_text(user_id)
            except Exception:
                menu_text = build_auction_house_text(user_id)
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, menu_text, reply_markup=auction_house_kb())
            return

        if len(text) < 2:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ Р’РІРµРґС–С‚СЊ РјС–РЅС–РјСѓРј 2 СЃРёРјРІРѕР»Рё.", reply_markup=auction_market_price_search_kb_v1())
            return

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_auction_market_price_search_text_v1(text),
            reply_markup=auction_market_price_search_kb_v1()
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("ah_price_lot:"))
    def auction_lot_price_history_callback_v1(call):
        lot_id = int(call.data.split(":")[1])

        try:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        except Exception:
            pass

        text = build_auction_lot_market_price_text_v1(lot_id)
        bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=auction_price_back_kb_v1())

# Р’РёРїСЂР°РІР»РµРЅРЅСЏ UX Сѓ СЂРѕР·РґС–Р»С– С–СЃС‚РѕСЂС–С—:
# РїС–СЃР»СЏ РЅР°С‚РёСЃРєР°РЅРЅСЏ Р·РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅРѕС— РєРЅРѕРїРєРё "рџ”™ Р†СЃС‚РѕСЂС–СЏ" Р· РјРµРЅСЋ СЂРёРЅРєРѕРІРёС… С†С–РЅ
# РЅРёР¶РЅСЏ ReplyKeyboard РјР°С” РїРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С‚РёСЃСЏ РґРѕ РєР»Р°РІС–Р°С‚СѓСЂРё С–СЃС‚РѕСЂС–С—:
#   рџ“€ Р РёРЅРєРѕРІС– С†С–РЅРё
#   рџ”™ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРёР№ РґС–Рј
# Р° РЅРµ Р·Р°Р»РёС€Р°С‚Рё РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ "рџ”™ Р†СЃС‚РѕСЂС–СЏ".


def _auction_open_history_screen_v1(bot, chat_id, user_id, mode="all", page=0):
    """Р’С–РґРєСЂРёРІР°С” С–СЃС‚РѕСЂС–СЋ С– РіР°СЂР°РЅС‚РѕРІР°РЅРѕ РїРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” РїСЂР°РІРёР»СЊРЅСѓ РЅРёР¶РЅСЋ РєР»Р°РІС–Р°С‚СѓСЂСѓ."""

    try:
        AUCTION_MARKET_PRICE_SEARCH_STATE_V1.pop(user_id, None)
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        text, inline_kb = build_auction_history_text_v1(user_id, mode=mode, page=page)
    except Exception:
        text = "рџ“њ Р†СЃС‚РѕСЂС–СЏ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРѕРіРѕ Р”РѕРјСѓ\n\nР—Р°РїРёСЃС–РІ РїРѕРєРё РЅРµРјР°С”."
        inline_kb = None

    # РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РјС–РЅСЏС”РјРѕ РЅРёР¶РЅСЋ РєР»Р°РІС–Р°С‚СѓСЂСѓ РЅР° РєР»Р°РІС–Р°С‚СѓСЂСѓ СЂРѕР·РґС–Р»Сѓ С–СЃС‚РѕСЂС–С—.
    try:
        bot.send_message(
            chat_id,
            "рџ“њ Р РѕР·РґС–Р» В«Р†СЃС‚РѕСЂС–СЏВ» РІС–РґРєСЂРёС‚Рѕ.",
            reply_markup=auction_history_reply_kb_v1()
        )
    except Exception:

def _auction_list_short_v1(values, limit=10):
    values = list(values or [])
    if not values:
        return "РЅРµРјР°С”"

    shown = values[:limit]
    text = ", ".join(str(x) for x in shown)
    if len(values) > limit:
        text += f" ... +{len(values) - limit}"
    return text


def build_auction_diagnostics_text_v1(report):
    counts = report.get("status_counts", {}) if isinstance(report, dict) else {}
    active_by_seller = report.get("active_lots_by_seller", []) if isinstance(report, dict) else []

    top_sellers = []
    for row in active_by_seller[:5]:
        top_sellers.append(f"{row.get('seller_user_id')}: {row.get('active_count')}")

    if not top_sellers:
        top_sellers_text = "РЅРµРјР°С”"
    else:
        top_sellers_text = "\n".join(f"вЂў {x}" for x in top_sellers)

    return (
        "рџ§Є Auction diagnostics\n\n"
        f"РўР°Р±Р»РёС†С– OK: {'С‚Р°Рє' if report.get('tables_ok') else 'РЅС–'}\n"
        f"Р’СЃСЊРѕРіРѕ Р»РѕС‚С–РІ: {report.get('total_lots', 0)}\n\n"
        "РЎС‚Р°С‚СѓСЃРё:\n"
        f"вЂў ACTIVE: {counts.get('ACTIVE', 0)}\n"
        f"вЂў SOLD_UNCLAIMED: {counts.get('SOLD_UNCLAIMED', 0)}\n"
        f"вЂў SOLD_CLAIMED: {counts.get('SOLD_CLAIMED', 0)}\n"
        f"вЂў EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED: {counts.get('EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED', 0)}\n"
        f"вЂў EXPIRED_CLAIMED: {counts.get('EXPIRED_CLAIMED', 0)}\n"
        f"вЂў DELETED: {counts.get('DELETED', 0)}\n\n"
        "РџРѕС‚РµРЅС†С–Р№РЅС– РїСЂРѕР±Р»РµРјРё:\n"
        f"вЂў РќРµРєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅР° С†С–РЅР°: {_auction_list_short_v1(report.get('bad_price_lots'))}\n"
        f"вЂў РќРµРјР°С” snapshot: {_auction_list_short_v1(report.get('missing_snapshot_lots'))}\n"
        f"вЂў ACTIVE Р±РµР· expires_at: {_auction_list_short_v1(report.get('active_missing_expires_at'))}\n"
        f"вЂў Unclaimed Р±РµР· delete_after: {_auction_list_short_v1(report.get('unclaimed_missing_delete_after'))}\n"
        f"вЂў SOLD_UNCLAIMED Р±РµР· buyer: {_auction_list_short_v1(report.get('sold_unclaimed_without_buyer'))}\n\n"
        "РђРєС‚РёРІРЅС– Р»РѕС‚Рё Р·Р° РїСЂРѕРґР°РІС†СЏРјРё TOP-5:\n"

# Р”РѕРґР°С‚РєРѕРІРѕ РјРѕР¶РЅР° Р·Р°РґР°С‚Рё Р·РјС–РЅРЅСѓ СЃРµСЂРµРґРѕРІРёС‰Р°:
# AUCTION_ADMIN_IDS=243129101,123456789
# Р°Р±Рѕ ADMIN_USER_IDS=243129101,123456789


def _auction_get_admin_ids_v1():
    import os

    raw = (
        os.getenv("AUCTION_ADMIN_IDS")
        or os.getenv("ADMIN_USER_IDS")
        or "243129101"
    )

    result = set()

    for part in str(raw).replace(";", ",").split(","):
        part = part.strip()
        if not part:
            continue
        try:
            result.add(int(part))
        except Exception:
            pass

    return result


def _auction_is_admin_v1(user_id):
    return int(user_id) in _auction_get_admin_ids_v1()


def _auction_admin_denied_text_v1():

        "Р¦Рµ С‚РµС…РЅС–С‡РЅР° РєРѕРјР°РЅРґР° РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРѕРіРѕ Р”РѕРјСѓ."
    )

from keyboards import blacksmith_kb
from handlers.city import build_blacksmith_repair_text


REPAIR_BUTTON_TEXTS = {
    "рџ› пёЏ Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚",
    "рџ›  Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚",
    "рџ”§ Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚",
    "Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚",
}


def _normalize_text_kb_result(result, fallback_kb=None):
    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        if len(result) >= 2:
            return result[0], result[1]
        if len(result) == 1:
            return result[0], fallback_kb

    return result, fallback_kb


def register_blacksmith_repair_hotfix_handlers(bot):
    """
    Hotfix РґР»СЏ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё рџ› пёЏ Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚.

    Р РµС”СЃС‚СЂСѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ Р”Рћ city handlers, С‰РѕР± РєРЅРѕРїРєСѓ РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµС…РѕРїР»СЋРІР°Р»Рё С–РЅС€С– С€РёСЂРѕРєС– РѕР±СЂРѕР±РЅРёРєРё.
    """

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: bool(message.text) and message.text.strip() in REPAIR_BUTTON_TEXTS)
    def blacksmith_repair_hotfix(message):
        result = build_blacksmith_repair_text(message.from_user.id)
        text, kb = _normalize_text_kb_result(result, blacksmith_kb())

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

def _blacksmith_get_repair_item_name_v2(inventory_id):
    try:
        item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)
    except Exception:
        item = None

    if not item:
        return f"РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ #{inventory_id}"

    name = None

    try:
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            name = item.get("name") or item.get("item_name")
        else:
            # РўРёРїРѕРІРёР№ С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚ Сѓ РїСЂРѕС”РєС‚С–: (inv_id, item_id, name, ...)
            name = item[2]
    except Exception:
        name = None

    if not name:
        return f"РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ #{inventory_id}"

    try:
        if "get_inventory_refined_display_name" in globals():
            return get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, name)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return name
