# ==============================
# вњ… ROM 9.0.8b BLACKSMITH REPAIR CALLBACK FIX V1
# ==============================

# Why this exists:
# Old repair buttons used callback_data repair_prompt_one_v3_* / repair_prompt_all_v3.
# Old handlers for those callbacks were registered earlier and performed instant repair.
# This patch changes newly generated repair menu buttons to unique confirmation callbacks:
#   repair_prompt_one_v3_<inventory_id>
#   repair_prompt_all_v3
# so old instant handlers no longer receive button clicks.

try:
    _blacksmith_base_build_blacksmith_repair_text_before_confirm_v3 = build_blacksmith_repair_text
except NameError:
    _blacksmith_base_build_blacksmith_repair_text_before_confirm_v3 = None


def _blacksmith_rewrite_repair_callbacks_v3(kb):
    """Rewrite inline keyboard callback_data from instant repair to confirmation prompt callbacks."""

    try:
        keyboard = getattr(kb, "keyboard", None)
        if not keyboard:
            return kb

        for row in keyboard:
            for button in row:
                data = getattr(button, "callback_data", None)

                if data == "repair_prompt_all_v3":
                    button.callback_data = "repair_prompt_all_v3"
                    continue

                if isinstance(data, str) and data.startswith("repair_prompt_one_v3_"):
                    try:
                        inventory_id = int(data.split("_")[2])
                    except Exception:
                        continue
                    button.callback_data = f"repair_prompt_one_v3_{inventory_id}"
    except Exception:
        pass

    return kb


def build_blacksmith_repair_text(user_id):
    """Wrapper over original repair menu builder: only changes callback_data, not text/prices."""

    if not _blacksmith_base_build_blacksmith_repair_text_before_confirm_v3:
        return "рџ› пёЏ Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ", blacksmith_kb()

    result = _blacksmith_base_build_blacksmith_repair_text_before_confirm_v3(user_id)

    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        if len(result) >= 2:
            text, kb = result[0], result[1]
            return text, _blacksmith_rewrite_repair_callbacks_v3(kb)
        if len(result) == 1:
            return result[0], None

    return result


def _blacksmith_repair_confirm_kb_v3(confirm_callback, cancel_callback="repair_cancel_v3"):
    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)
    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("вњ… РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґРёС‚Рё СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚", callback_data=confirm_callback))
    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton("вќЊ РЎРєР°СЃСѓРІР°С‚Рё", callback_data=cancel_callback))
    return kb


def _blacksmith_safe_answer_callback_v3(bot, call, text=None):
    try:
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, text or "")
    except Exception:
        pass


def _blacksmith_normalize_text_kb_v3(result, fallback_kb=None):
    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        if len(result) >= 2:
            return result[0], result[1]
        if len(result) == 1:
            return result[0], fallback_kb
    return result, fallback_kb


def _blacksmith_show_repair_menu_v3(bot, chat_id, user_id):
    result = build_blacksmith_repair_text(user_id)
    text, kb = _blacksmith_normalize_text_kb_v3(result, blacksmith_kb())
    bot.send_message(chat_id, text, reply_markup=kb)


def _blacksmith_get_repair_item_name_v3(inventory_id):
    try:
        item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)
    except Exception:
        item = None

    if not item:
        return f"РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ #{inventory_id}"

    name = None

    try:
        if isinstance(item, dict):
            name = item.get("name") or item.get("item_name")
        else:
            name = item[2]
    except Exception:
        name = None

    if not name:
        return f"РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ #{inventory_id}"

    try:
        if "get_inventory_refined_display_name" in globals():
            return get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, name)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return name


def _blacksmith_result_message_v3(result, fallback="вњ… Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚ РІРёРєРѕРЅР°РЅРѕ."):
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        return result.get("message", fallback)
    return str(result or fallback)

from telebot.types import InlineKeyboardMarkup, InlineKeyboardButton


def _safe_answer(bot, call):
    try:
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _get_item_name(inventory_id):
    try:
        from db import get_item_by_inventory_id_full
        item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)

        if isinstance(item, dict):
            return item.get("name") or item.get("item_name") or f"РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ #{inventory_id}"

        if item:
            return str(item)

    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        from db import get_item_by_inventory_id
        item = get_item_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

        if isinstance(item, dict):
            return item.get("name") or item.get("item_name") or f"РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ #{inventory_id}"

        if item:
            return str(item)

    except Exception:
        pass

    return f"РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ #{inventory_id}"


def _result_message(result, default_text):
    if isinstance(result, dict):
        if result.get("message"):
            return result["message"]

        if result.get("success"):
            return default_text

        return result.get("error") or result.get("reason") or "вќЊ Р”С–СЋ РЅРµ РІРёРєРѕРЅР°РЅРѕ."

    if isinstance(result, str):
        return result

    return default_text


def _confirm_one_kb(inventory_id):
    kb = InlineKeyboardMarkup()
    kb.add(
        InlineKeyboardButton(
            "вњ… РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґРёС‚Рё СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚",
            callback_data=f"brc_confirm_one_{inventory_id}"
        )
    )
    kb.add(
        InlineKeyboardButton(
            "вќЊ РЎРєР°СЃСѓРІР°С‚Рё",
            callback_data="brc_cancel"
        )
    )
    return kb


def _confirm_all_kb():
    kb = InlineKeyboardMarkup()
    kb.add(
        InlineKeyboardButton(
            "вњ… РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґРёС‚Рё СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚ РІСЃСЊРѕРіРѕ",

    )
    return kb


def register_blacksmith_repair_confirmation_handlers(bot):
    """
    Register repair confirmation handlers before old instant repair handlers.

    Expected prompt callbacks:
    - repair_prompt_one_v3_<inventory_id>
    - brc_prompt_one_<inventory_id>
    - repair_prompt_all_v3
    - brc_prompt_all
    """

    @bot.callback_query_handler(
        func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("repair_prompt_one_v3_")
        or call.data.startswith("brc_prompt_one_")
    )
    def blacksmith_repair_prompt_one(call):
        _safe_answer(bot, call)

        user_id = call.from_user.id
        data = call.data or ""

        try:
            inventory_id = int(data.rsplit("_", 1)[1])
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РІРёР·РЅР°С‡РёС‚Рё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РґР»СЏ СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚Сѓ."
            )
            return

        item_name = _get_item_name(inventory_id)

        text = (
            "рџ› пёЏ РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚Сѓ\n\n"
            f"рџ“¦ {item_name}\n\n"
            "Р’Рё СЃРїСЂР°РІРґС– С…РѕС‡РµС‚Рµ РІС–РґСЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚СѓРІР°С‚Рё С†РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚?\n\n"
            "РџС–СЃР»СЏ РїС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ Р±СѓРґРµ СЃРїРёСЃР°РЅРѕ Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ Р·Р° СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚."
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=_confirm_one_kb(inventory_id)
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(
        func=lambda call: call.data in ("repair_prompt_all_v3", "brc_prompt_all")
    )
    def blacksmith_repair_prompt_all(call):
        _safe_answer(bot, call)

# вњ… ROM 9.0.8e BLACKSMITH REPAIR CONFIRM ITEM NAME FIX V1
# ==============================

# Fix reason:
# Confirmation message displayed the whole tuple from get_item_by_inventory_id_full(), e.g.
# [116, 413, 'вљЄпёЏ Р СѓРєР°РІРёС†С– 8 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ', ...]
# instead of only the item name.

try:
    _blacksmith_confirm_base_get_item_name_before_tuple_fix_v1 = _get_item_name
except NameError:
    _blacksmith_confirm_base_get_item_name_before_tuple_fix_v1 = None


def _get_item_name(inventory_id):
    """Return clean item name for blacksmith repair confirmation."""

    item = None

    try:
        from db import get_item_by_inventory_id_full
        item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)
    except Exception:
        item = None

    name = None

    if isinstance(item, dict):
        name = (
            item.get("name")
            or item.get("item_name")
            or item.get("raw_name")
        )
    elif isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
        # Common tuple format in this project:
        # (inventory_id, item_id, name, type, rarity, category, slot_key, ...)
        try:
            if len(item) > 2 and isinstance(item[2], str):
                name = item[2]
        except Exception:
            name = None

    if not name:
        try:
            from db import get_item_by_inventory_id
            item = get_item_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

            if isinstance(item, dict):
                name = item.get("name") or item.get("item_name") or item.get("raw_name")
            elif isinstance(item, (list, tuple)):
                # Usually (inventory_id, item_id, name, ...), but keep safe fallbacks.
                for index in [2, 1, 0]:
                    try:
                        if index < len(item) and isinstance(item[index], str):
                            name = item[index]
                            break
                    except Exception:
                        pass
            elif isinstance(item, str):
                name = item
        except Exception:
            pass

    if not name:
        name = f"РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ #{inventory_id}"

    try:
        from db import get_inventory_refined_display_name
        return get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, name)
    except Exception:
        return name

def _brc_show_repair_menu_after_action_v1(bot, chat_id, user_id):
    try:
        from handlers.city import build_blacksmith_repair_text
        from keyboards import blacksmith_kb

        result = build_blacksmith_repair_text(user_id)

        if isinstance(result, tuple):
            text = result[0]
            kb = result[1] if len(result) > 1 else blacksmith_kb()
        else:
            text = result
            kb = blacksmith_kb()

        bot.send_message(chat_id, text, reply_markup=kb)
    except Exception as error:
        try:
            bot.send_message(chat_id, f"вљ пёЏ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РѕРЅРѕРІРёС‚Рё СЃРїРёСЃРѕРє СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚Сѓ: {error}")
        except Exception:
            pass

def get_nearby_mobs_for_level(player_level, location_id):
    mobs = get_mobs_for_location(location_id)
    available = []

    for mob in mobs:
        mob_level = int(mob.get("level", 1))
        min_player_level = int(mob.get("min_player_level", 1))

        if min_player_level <= player_level and player_level - 1 <= mob_level <= player_level + 1:
            available.append(mob)

    if not available:
        for mob in mobs:
            if int(mob.get("min_player_level", 1)) <= player_level:
                available.append(mob)

    return available


def build_contracts_short_status(user_id):
    status = get_contract_status(user_id)

    if not status["exists"]:
        return "рџ“њ РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё: РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРѕ\n"

    if not status["unlocked"]:
        return "рџ“њ РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё: рџ”’ Р· 5 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ\n"

    completed = status["completed_today"]
    daily_limit = status["daily_limit"]
    active = status["active_contract"]

    text = f"рџ“њ РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё: {completed}/{daily_limit}\n"

    if active:
        if active.get("completed"):
            text += (
                f"вњ… РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚ РІРёРєРѕРЅР°РЅРѕ: "
                f"{active['target_mob_name']} "
                f"{active['current_kills']}/{active['target_kills']} вЂ” Р·РґР°С‚Рё РІ Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–С—\n"
            )
        else:
            text += (
                f"рџ“Њ РђРєС‚РёРІРЅРёР№ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚: "
                f"{active['target_mob_name']} "
                f"{active['current_kills']}/{active['target_kills']}\n"
            )

    return text


def build_main_menu_text(user_id):
    process_passive_regeneration(user_id)
    location_id = get_current_location(user_id)
    location = LOCATIONS.get(location_id, LOCATIONS["start_path"])

    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if stats:
        _, _, _, _, _, lvl = stats
    else:
        lvl = 1

    current_hp = get_current_hp(user_id)
    max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    energy_data = get_user_energy(user_id)
    energy = energy_data["energy"]
    max_energy = energy_data["max_energy"]

    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)
    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)

    contracts_text = build_contracts_short_status(user_id)

    nearby_mobs = get_nearby_mobs_for_level(lvl, location_id)

    mobs_text = ""

    if nearby_mobs:
        for mob in nearby_mobs:
            attack_icon = "вљ”пёЏ" if mob.get("attack_type") == "physical" else "рџ”®"

            mobs_text += (
                f"вЂў {attack_icon} {mob['name']} вЂ” "
                f"СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ {mob['level']}\n"
            )
    else:
        mobs_text = "вЂў РќР°РІРєРѕР»Рѕ РїРѕРєРё С‚РёС…Рѕ...\n"

    text = (
        f"рџЏ•пёЏ РўР°Р±С–СЂ РјР°РЅРґСЂС–РІРЅРёРєС–РІ\n\n"

        f"РџС–Рґ РЅРѕРіР°РјРё РІРѕР»РѕРіР° Р·РµРјР»СЏ, РїРѕСЂСѓС‡ РїРѕС‚СЂС–СЃРєСѓС” Р±Р°РіР°С‚С‚СЏ, "
        f"Р° Р·Р° РјРµР¶Р°РјРё С‚Р°Р±РѕСЂСѓ РІР¶Рµ С‡СѓС‚Рё СЂСѓС… РґРёРєРёС… Р·РІС–СЂС–РІ. "
        f"РўСѓС‚ С€СѓРєР°С‡С– РїСЂРёРіРѕРґ РіРѕС‚СѓСЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ РґРѕ РЅР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРѕРіРѕ РїРѕР»СЋРІР°РЅРЅСЏ.\n\n"

        f"рџ‘¤ РўРІС–Р№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ: {lvl}\n"

        f"рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР°: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n"
        f"{contracts_text}\n"

        f"рџ‘Ђ РџРѕР±Р»РёР·Сѓ С‚РІРѕРіРѕ СЂС–РІРЅСЏ РјРѕР¶РЅР° Р·СѓСЃС‚СЂС–С‚Рё:\n"

        f"рџ—єпёЏ РњР°РїР° вЂ” РїРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРЅСѓС‚Рё РЅР°РїСЂСЏРјРєРё С‚Р° РјС–СЃС‚Рѕ\n"
        f"рџ‘¤ РџСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЊ вЂ” РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶, С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂ С– СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ\n"

def build_alchemist_catalog(user_id):
    gold = get_wallet(user_id)

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    text = (
        f"рџ§Є РђР»С…С–РјС–Рє\n\n"
        f"рџ’° РўРІРѕС” Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ: {format_gold(gold)}\n\n"
        f"РђР»С…С–РјС–Рє РїСЂРѕРґР°С” Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ РґР»СЏ РІРёР¶РёРІР°РЅРЅСЏ РІ Р±РѕСЋ.\n\n"
        f"РђСЃРѕСЂС‚РёРјРµРЅС‚:\n\n"
    )

    for item_id in ALCHEMIST_SHOP:
        potion = POTIONS[item_id]

        if potion["type"] == "hp":
            effect = f"+{potion['restore']} HP"
        else:
            effect = f"+{potion['restore']} MP"

        text += (
            f"{potion['name']}\n"
            f"Р•С„РµРєС‚: {effect}\n"
            f"Р¦С–РЅР°: {format_gold(potion['buy_price'])}\n"
            f"РЎС‚Р°Рє: {potion['max_stack']}\n\n"
        )

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text=f"РљСѓРїРёС‚Рё: {potion['name']} вЂ” {format_gold(potion['buy_price'])}",
            callback_data=f"buy_potion_{item_id}"
        ))

    text += (
        f"вљ пёЏ РњР°РЅР° С‰Рµ РЅРµ СЂРµР°Р»С–Р·РѕРІР°РЅР°, С‚РѕРјСѓ СЃРёРЅС– Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РєСѓРїРёС‚Рё РЅР° РјР°Р№Р±СѓС‚РЅС”, "
        f"Р°Р»Рµ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°С‚Рё РїРѕРєРё РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР°."
    )

    return text, kb

def build_blacksmith_repair_text(user_id):
    equipped_items = get_equipped_items_for_repair(user_id)
    total_cost = get_total_repair_cost(user_id)
    gold = get_wallet(user_id)

    text = (
        f"вљ’пёЏ РљРћР’РђР›Р¬: Р Р•РњРћРќРў РўРђ РљРЈР—РќРЇ\n\n"
        f"рџ’° РўРІРѕС” Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ: {format_gold(gold)}\n\n"
        f"рџ“¦ РЎС‚Р°РЅ С‚РІРѕРіРѕ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ:\n\n"
    )

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    damaged_count = 0

    for item in equipped_items:
        slot = item["slot"]
        name = item["name"]
        durability = item["durability"]
        repair_cost = item["repair_cost"]
        is_broken = item["is_broken"]
        inventory_id = item["inventory_id"]

        if inventory_id is None:
            text += f"{slot}: РїРѕСЂРѕР¶РЅСЊРѕ\n\n"
            continue

        broken_text = " вљ пёЏ [Р—Р›РђРњРђРќРћ]" if is_broken else ""

        text += (
            f"{slot}: {name}\n"
            f"рџ› пёЏ РњС–С†РЅС–СЃС‚СЊ: {durability}/100{broken_text}\n"
            f"рџ’° Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚: {format_gold(repair_cost)}\n\n"
        )

        if repair_cost > 0:
            damaged_count += 1

            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text=f"рџ› пёЏ Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚: {name} вЂ” {format_gold(repair_cost)}",
                callback_data=f"repair_prompt_one_v3_{inventory_id}"
            ))

    text += (
        f"рџ’і Р Р°Р·РѕРј Р·Р° РїРѕРІРЅРёР№ СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚: {format_gold(total_cost)}\n"
        f"рџ’° РўРІРѕС” Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ: {format_gold(gold)}\n\n"
    )

    if damaged_count <= 0:

def format_shop_preview_bonuses(b_str, b_dex, b_int, b_wis, b_sta, pdef, mdef):
    bonuses = []

    if b_str:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ’Є РЎРёР»Р° +{b_str}")
    if b_dex:
        bonuses.append(f"рџЋЇ РЎРїСЂРёС‚РЅС–СЃС‚СЊ +{b_dex}")
    if b_int:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ”® Р†РЅС‚РµР»РµРєС‚ +{b_int}")
    if b_wis:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ¦‰ РњСѓРґСЂС–СЃС‚СЊ +{b_wis}")
    if b_sta:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ›Ў Р’РёС‚СЂРёРІР°Р»С–СЃС‚СЊ +{b_sta}")
    if pdef:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ›Ў Р¤С–Р·. Р·Р°С…РёСЃС‚ +{pdef}")
    if mdef:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ”® РњР°Рі. Р·Р°С…РёСЃС‚ +{mdef}")

    return bonuses



def build_shop_preview_display_name(name, slot_key, armor_type):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” РєСЂР°СЃРёРІСѓ РЅР°Р·РІСѓ preview-РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°.

    Р”Р»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅС– РґРѕРґР°С” С‚РёРї Сѓ РґСѓР¶РєР°С…:
    Р§РѕР±РѕС‚Рё 5 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ -> Р§РѕР±РѕС‚Рё [РўРєР°РЅРёРЅР°] 5 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ

    Р”Р»СЏ Р·Р±СЂРѕС— / off-hand С‚РёРї Сѓ РґСѓР¶РєР°С… РЅРµ РґРѕРґР°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ,
    Р±Рѕ РЅР°Р·РІР° РІР¶Рµ Р·Р°Р·РІРёС‡Р°Р№ РјС–СЃС‚РёС‚СЊ СЃР°Рј С‚РёРї:
    Р–РµР·Р» 5 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ
    РљРёРЅРґР¶Р°Р» 5 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ
    Р©РёС‚ 5 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ
    """

    if not is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        return name

    if not armor_type:
        return name

    armor_label = get_armor_type_label(armor_type)

    if not armor_label:
        return name

    if f"[{armor_label}]" in name:
        return name

    marker = " СЂС–РІРЅСЏ"

    if marker in name:
        index = name.rfind(marker)
        before_level = name[:index]
        after_level = name[index:]
        parts = before_level.rsplit(" ", 1)

        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit():
            return f"{parts[0]} [{armor_label}] {parts[1]}{after_level}"

    return f"{name} [{armor_label}]"

def build_sell_equipment_list_text(user_id, page=0):
    items = get_sellable_equipment_items(user_id)
    gold = get_wallet(user_id)

    if not items:
        text = (
            f"рџ§° РџСЂРѕРґР°Р¶ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ\n\n"
            f"рџ’° РўРІРѕС” Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ: {format_gold(gold)}\n\n"
            f"РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ РЅРµРјР°С” РЅРµРІРґСЏРіРЅРµРЅРѕРіРѕ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ.\n\n"
            f"в„№пёЏ Р’РґСЏРіРЅРµРЅС– СЂРµС‡С– РЅРµ РїРѕРєР°Р·СѓСЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ Сѓ С†СЊРѕРјСѓ СЃРїРёСЃРєСѓ."
        )

        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="в¬…пёЏ Р”Рѕ С‚РѕСЂРіРѕРІРѕРіРѕ СЂСЏРґСѓ",
            callback_data="back_to_trade_district"
        ))

        return text, kb

    total_items = len(items)
    total_pages = max(1, (total_items + SELL_EQUIPMENT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE - 1) // SELL_EQUIPMENT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE)

    if page < 0:
        page = 0

    if page >= total_pages:
        page = total_pages - 1

    start = page * SELL_EQUIPMENT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE
    end = start + SELL_EQUIPMENT_ITEMS_PER_PAGE
    page_items = items[start:end]

    text = (
        f"рџ§° РџСЂРѕРґР°Р¶ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ\n\n"
        f"рџ’° РўРІРѕС” Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ: {format_gold(gold)}\n\n"
        f"РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРµС†СЊ РіРѕС‚РѕРІРёР№ РєСѓРїРёС‚Рё РЅРµРІРґСЏРіРЅРµРЅС– СЂРµС‡С– Р· С‚РІРѕРіРѕ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ.\n"
        f"Р’РґСЏРіРЅРµРЅРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°РІР°С‚Рё РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР°.\n\n"
        f"рџ“„ РЎС‚РѕСЂС–РЅРєР°: {page + 1}/{total_pages}\n\n"
        f"РћР±РµСЂС–С‚СЊ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚:"
    )

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    for item in page_items:
        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            slot_key,
            weapon_hands,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = item

        quantity = quantity or 1
        sell_price = sell_price or 0
        total_price = round(quantity * sell_price, 2)

        durability_text = ""

        if durability is not None:
            durability_text = f" [{durability}/100]"

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text=f"{name}{durability_text} вЂ” {format_gold(total_price)}",
            callback_data=f"sell_eq_confirm:{inv_id}:{page}"
        ))

    nav_buttons = []

    if page > 0:
        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="в¬…пёЏ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ",
            callback_data=f"sell_eq_page:{page - 1}"
        ))

    if page < total_pages - 1:
        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="вћЎпёЏ Р”Р°Р»С–",
            callback_data=f"sell_eq_page:{page + 1}"
        ))

    if nav_buttons:
        kb.add(*nav_buttons)

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="в¬…пёЏ Р”Рѕ С‚РѕСЂРіРѕРІРѕРіРѕ СЂСЏРґСѓ",
        callback_data="back_to_trade_district"
    ))

    return text, kb

        durability,
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        sell_price
    ) = item

    quantity = quantity or 1
    sell_price = sell_price or 0
    total_price = round(quantity * sell_price, 2)

    text = (
        f"рџ’° РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ\n\n"
        f"РўРё С‚РѕС‡РЅРѕ С…РѕС‡РµС€ РїСЂРѕРґР°С‚Рё С†РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ С‚РѕСЂРіРѕРІС†СЋ?\n\n"
        f"рџ“¦ {name} x{quantity}\n"
        f"рџ’° Р¦С–РЅР°: {format_gold(total_price)}\n"
    )

    if durability is not None:
        text += f"рџ› пёЏ РњС–С†РЅС–СЃС‚СЊ: {durability}/100\n"

    text += "\nвљ пёЏ РџС–СЃР»СЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ Р·РЅРёРєРЅРµ Р· С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ."

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text=f"вњ… РџСЂРѕРґР°С‚Рё Р·Р° {format_gold(total_price)}",
        callback_data=f"sell_eq_do:{inventory_id}:{page}"
    ))

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="вќЊ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ",
        callback_data=f"sell_eq_page:{page}"
    ))

    return text, kb

# show_blacksmith() Сѓ С†СЊРѕРјСѓ РїСЂРѕС”РєС‚С– РѕС‡С–РєСѓС”:
#   text, kb = build_blacksmith_text(user_id)
# РўРѕРјСѓ build_blacksmith_text() РјР°С” РїРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С‚Рё СЃР°РјРµ tuple: (text, blacksmith_kb()).


def build_blacksmith_text(user_id):
    gold = get_wallet(user_id)

    text = (
        "вљ’пёЏ РљРѕРІР°Р»СЊ\n\n"
        "Р‘С–Р»СЏ СЂРѕР·РїРµС‡РµРЅРѕРіРѕ РіРѕСЂРЅР° РїСЂР°С†СЋС” РґРѕСЃРІС–РґС‡РµРЅРёР№ РєРѕРІР°Р»СЊ. "
        "Р’С–РЅ РјРѕР¶Рµ РїРѕР»Р°РіРѕРґРёС‚Рё С‚РІРѕС” СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ Р°Р±Рѕ РїРѕСЃРёР»РёС‚Рё Р№РѕРіРѕ Р·Р° РґРѕРїРѕРјРѕРіРѕСЋ РєР°РјРµРЅС–РІ Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєРё.\n\n"
        "Р”РѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅС– РґС–С—:\n"
        "вЂў рџ› пёЏ Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ\n"
        "вЂў вњЁ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР° СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ\n\n"
        f"рџ’° РўРІРѕС” Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ: {gold:.2f} рџ’°"
    )

    return text, blacksmith_kb()


def _normalize_text_kb_result(result, fallback_kb=None):
    """
    Р”РѕРїРѕРјС–Р¶РЅР° С„СѓРЅРєС†С–СЏ РґР»СЏ СЃС‚Р°СЂРёС… build_* С„СѓРЅРєС†С–Р№:
    - СЏРєС‰Рѕ С„СѓРЅРєС†С–СЏ РїРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” (text, kb), Р·Р°Р»РёС€Р°С”РјРѕ СЏРє С”;
    - СЏРєС‰Рѕ РїРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё text, РґРѕРґР°С”РјРѕ fallback_kb.
    """

    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        if len(result) >= 2:
            return result[0], result[1]
        if len(result) == 1:
            return result[0], fallback_kb

    return result, fallback_kb


def register_blacksmith_repair_button_v2(bot):
    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ› пёЏ Р РµРјРѕРЅС‚")
    def blacksmith_repair_button_v2(message):
        result = build_blacksmith_repair_text(message.from_user.id)
        text, kb = _normalize_text_kb_result(result, blacksmith_kb())

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

def _city_find_sellable_name_index(row):
    """
    РќР°РјР°РіР°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ Р·РЅР°Р№С‚Рё С–РЅРґРµРєСЃ РЅР°Р·РІРё Сѓ tuple/list sellable item.
    Р С–Р·РЅС– РІРµСЂСЃС–С— db.py РјРѕР¶СѓС‚СЊ РїРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С‚Рё СЂС–Р·РЅРёР№ С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚.
    """

    if not isinstance(row, (tuple, list)):
        return None

    # РќР°Р№С‡Р°СЃС‚С–С€С– С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚Рё:
    # (inventory_id, name, ...)
    # (inventory_id, item_id, name, ...)
    preferred_indexes = [1, 2]

    for index in preferred_indexes:
        if index < len(row) and isinstance(row[index], str):
            value = row[index]
            if value and value not in ["equipment", "weapon", "armor", "common", "uncommon", "rare", "epic"]:
                return index

    # Fallback: РїРµСЂС€РёР№ СЂСЏРґРѕРє, СЃС…РѕР¶РёР№ РЅР° РЅР°Р·РІСѓ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°.
    for index, value in enumerate(row):
        if not isinstance(value, str):
            continue

        if " СЂС–РІРЅСЏ" in value:
            return index

        if any(marker in value for marker in ["вљЄ", "рџџў", "рџ”µ", "рџџЈ", "РџРѕСЃРѕС…", "РњРµС‡", "РљРёРЅРґР¶Р°Р»", "РћР±Р»Р°РґСѓРЅРѕРє", "РЁРѕР»РѕРј", "РџРѕРЅРѕР¶С–", "Р СѓРєР°РІРёС†С–", "Р§РѕР±РѕС‚Рё"]):
            return index

    return None


def _city_refine_display_for_row(row):
    """
    Р”РѕРґР°С” [+N] Сѓ РЅР°Р·РІСѓ row, РЅРµ Р·РјС–РЅСЋСЋС‡Рё СЃС‚СЂСѓРєС‚СѓСЂСѓ row.
    """

    try:
        if isinstance(row, dict):
            inventory_id = row.get("inventory_id") or row.get("id")
            name = row.get("name")

            if not inventory_id or not name:
                return row

            updated = dict(row)
            updated["name"] = get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, name)
            return updated

        if isinstance(row, (tuple, list)):
            if not row:
                return row

            inventory_id = row[0]
            name_index = _city_find_sellable_name_index(row)

            if name_index is None:
                return row

            values = list(row)
            values[name_index] = get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, values[name_index])

            if isinstance(row, tuple):
                return tuple(values)

            return values

    except Exception:
        return row

    return row


def get_sellable_equipment_items(user_id):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE:
    РЎРїРёСЃРѕРє РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ Р· РЅР°Р·РІР°РјРё [+N].
    """

    if _base_city_get_sellable_equipment_items_before_refine_display_v1 is None:
        return []

    rows = _base_city_get_sellable_equipment_items_before_refine_display_v1(user_id)

    if not rows:
        return rows

    return [_city_refine_display_for_row(row) for row in rows]


def get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE:
    РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ С‚Р° С–РЅС€С– city-РґРµС‚Р°Р»С– РїРѕРєР°Р·СѓСЋС‚СЊ РЅР°Р·РІСѓ Р· [+N].
    """

    if _base_city_get_item_by_inventory_id_full_before_refine_display_v1 is None:
        return None

    row = _base_city_get_item_by_inventory_id_full_before_refine_display_v1(inventory_id)

    if not row:
        return row

    try:
        if isinstance(row, dict):
            if "name" in row:
                updated = dict(row)
                updated["name"] = get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, updated.get("name"))
                return updated
            return row

        if isinstance(row, (tuple, list)):
            values = list(row)

            # Р”Р»СЏ get_item_by_inventory_id_full Сѓ РїСЂРѕС”РєС‚С– Р·Р°Р·РІРёС‡Р°Р№:
            # inventory.id, inventory.item_id, items.name, ...
            if len(values) > 2 and isinstance(values[2], str):
                values[2] = get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, values[2])
            else:
                name_index = _city_find_sellable_name_index(values)
                if name_index is not None:
                    values[name_index] = get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, values[name_index])

            if isinstance(row, tuple):
                return tuple(values)

            return values

    except Exception:
        return row

    return row

def _city_get_refined_name_v2(inventory_id, name):

        from db import get_inventory_refined_display_name
        return get_inventory_refined_display_name(inventory_id, name)
    except Exception:

def _city_string_looks_like_item_name_v2(value):
    if not isinstance(value, str):
        return False

    if not value:
        return False

    # РќР°Р·РІРё СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РјР°Р№Р¶Рµ Р·Р°РІР¶РґРё РјР°СЋС‚СЊ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ Р°Р±Рѕ rarity emoji.
    if " СЂС–РІРЅСЏ" in value:
        return True

    item_markers = [
        "вљЄ", "рџџў", "рџ”µ", "рџџЈ",
        "РџРѕСЃРѕС…", "Р–РµР·Р»", "РњРµС‡", "РљРёРЅРґР¶Р°Р»", "Р›СѓРє", "РђСЂР±Р°Р»РµС‚", "Р©РёС‚",
        "РћР±Р»Р°РґСѓРЅРѕРє", "РЁРѕР»РѕРј", "РџРѕРЅРѕР¶С–", "Р СѓРєР°РІРёС†С–", "Р§РѕР±РѕС‚Рё", "РљР°РїС‚СѓСЂ", "РљР°РїРµР»СЋС…",
        "РђРјСѓР»РµС‚", "РљС–Р»СЊС†Рµ", "РўР°Р»С–СЃРјР°РЅ"
    ]

    return any(marker in value for marker in item_markers)


def _city_refine_display_for_sell_row_v2(row):
    try:
        if isinstance(row, dict):
            inventory_id = row.get("inventory_id") or row.get("id")

            if not inventory_id:
                return row

            updated = dict(row)

            for key in ["name", "item_name", "display_name", "label"]:
                if key in updated and isinstance(updated[key], str):
                    updated[key] = _city_get_refined_name_v2(inventory_id, updated[key])

            return updated

        if isinstance(row, (tuple, list)):
            if not row:
                return row

            inventory_id = row[0]
            values = list(row)
            changed = False

            # РњС–РЅСЏС”РјРѕ РІСЃС– РїРѕР»СЏ, СЏРєС– СЃС…РѕР¶С– РЅР° РЅР°Р·РІСѓ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°.
            # Р¦Рµ Р±РµР·РїРµС‡РЅС–С€Рµ РґР»СЏ СЂС–Р·РЅРёС… С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚С–РІ get_sellable_equipment_items().
            for index, value in enumerate(values):
                if _city_string_looks_like_item_name_v2(value):
                    values[index] = _city_get_refined_name_v2(inventory_id, value)
                    changed = True

            if not changed:
                # Fallback РґР»СЏ РЅР°Р№С‡Р°СЃС‚С–С€РёС… С„РѕСЂРјР°С‚С–РІ:
                # (inventory_id, name, ...)
                # (inventory_id, item_id, name, ...)
                for index in [1, 2]:
                    if index < len(values) and isinstance(values[index], str):
                        values[index] = _city_get_refined_name_v2(inventory_id, values[index])
                        changed = True
                        break

            if isinstance(row, tuple):
                return tuple(values)

            return values

    except Exception:
        return row

    return row


def get_sellable_equipment_items(user_id):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE V2:

def get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE V2:
    РџС–РґС‚РІРµСЂРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ РїРѕРєР°Р·СѓС” РЅР°Р·РІСѓ Р· [+N].
    """

    if _base_city_get_item_by_inventory_id_full_before_refine_display_v2 is None:
        return None

    row = _base_city_get_item_by_inventory_id_full_before_refine_display_v2(inventory_id)

    if not row:
        return row

    try:
        if isinstance(row, dict):
            updated = dict(row)
            for key in ["name", "item_name", "display_name", "label"]:
                if key in updated and isinstance(updated[key], str):
                    updated[key] = _city_get_refined_name_v2(inventory_id, updated[key])

            for index, value in enumerate(values):
                if _city_string_looks_like_item_name_v2(value):
                    values[index] = _city_get_refined_name_v2(inventory_id, value)

            if isinstance(row, tuple):
                return tuple(values)

            return values

    except Exception:
        return row

    return row

def init_class_combat_resource(user_id, mob):
    profile_summary = get_character_profile_summary(user_id)
    resource_type = profile_summary.get("resource_type", "")
    class_key = profile_summary.get("class_key", "")

    mob["player_resource_type"] = resource_type
    mob["player_class_key"] = class_key

    if resource_type == "rage":
        mob["player_rage"] = 0
        mob["player_max_rage"] = 100

    elif resource_type in ["combat_energy", "combat_energy_combo"]:
        mob["player_combat_energy"] = 100
        mob["player_max_combat_energy"] = 100

        if resource_type == "combat_energy_combo":
            mob["player_combo_points"] = 0
            mob["player_max_combo_points"] = 3

    elif resource_type == "mana":
        mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)

        mob["player_mp"] = mp_data.get("mp", 0)
        mob["player_max_mp"] = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)


def get_class_resource_line(mob):
    resource_type = mob.get("player_resource_type", "")

    if resource_type == "rage":
        rage = mob.get("player_rage", 0)
        max_rage = mob.get("player_max_rage", 100)

        return f"рџ”ґ Р›СЋС‚С–СЃС‚СЊ: {rage}/{max_rage}\n"

    if resource_type == "combat_energy":
        energy = mob.get("player_combat_energy", 100)
        max_energy = mob.get("player_max_combat_energy", 100)

        return f"рџџЎ Р•РЅРµСЂРіС–СЏ: {energy}/{max_energy}\n"

    if resource_type == "combat_energy_combo":
        energy = mob.get("player_combat_energy", 100)
        max_energy = mob.get("player_max_combat_energy", 100)
        combo = mob.get("player_combo_points", 0)
        max_combo = mob.get("player_max_combo_points", 3)

        return (
            f"рџџЎ Р•РЅРµСЂРіС–СЏ: {energy}/{max_energy}\n"
            f"вљ”пёЏ РљРѕРјР±Рѕ: {combo}/{max_combo}\n"
        )

    if resource_type == "mana":
        mp = mob.get("player_mp", 0)
        max_mp = mob.get("player_max_mp", 0)

        return f"рџ”µ РњР°РЅР°: {mp}/{max_mp}\n"

    return ""


def regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob):
    resource_type = mob.get("player_resource_type", "")

    if resource_type not in ["combat_energy", "combat_energy_combo"]:
        return ""

    current_energy = mob.get("player_combat_energy", 100)
    max_energy = mob.get("player_max_combat_energy", 100)

    old_energy = current_energy
    current_energy = min(max_energy, current_energy + 20)

    mob["player_combat_energy"] = current_energy

    if current_energy > old_energy:
        return f"рџџЎ Р•РЅРµСЂРіС–СЏ РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»РµРЅР°: {old_energy} в†’ {current_energy}/{max_energy}\n"

    return ""


def add_rage_for_player_attack(mob):
    if mob.get("player_resource_type") != "rage":
        return ""

    old_rage = mob.get("player_rage", 0)
    max_rage = mob.get("player_max_rage", 100)

    new_rage = min(max_rage, old_rage + 15)
    mob["player_rage"] = new_rage

    if new_rage > old_rage:
        return f"рџ”ґ Р›СЋС‚С–СЃС‚СЊ: +{new_rage - old_rage} ({new_rage}/{max_rage})\n"

    return ""


def add_rage_for_damage_taken(mob, damage):
    if mob.get("player_resource_type") != "rage":
        return ""

    if damage <= 0:
        return ""

    old_rage = mob.get("player_rage", 0)
    max_rage = mob.get("player_max_rage", 100)

    new_rage = min(max_rage, old_rage + 10)
    mob["player_rage"] = new_rage

    if new_rage > old_rage:
        return f"рџ”ґ Р›СЋС‚С–СЃС‚СЊ Р·Р° РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°РЅСѓ С€РєРѕРґСѓ: +{new_rage - old_rage} ({new_rage}/{max_rage})\n"

    return ""

def add_rogue_combo_point(mob, amount=1):
    if mob.get("player_resource_type") != "combat_energy_combo":
        return ""

    old_combo = mob.get("player_combo_points", 0)
    max_combo = mob.get("player_max_combo_points", 3)

    new_combo = min(max_combo, old_combo + amount)
    mob["player_combo_points"] = new_combo

    if new_combo > old_combo:
        return f"вљ”пёЏ РљРѕРјР±Рѕ: +{new_combo - old_combo} ({new_combo}/{max_combo})\n"

    return ""


def consume_rogue_combo_points(mob):
    if mob.get("player_resource_type") != "combat_energy_combo":
        return 0

    combo = mob.get("player_combo_points", 0)
    mob["player_combo_points"] = 0

    return combo

def init_combat_effects(mob):
    if "enemy_effects" not in mob:
        mob["enemy_effects"] = {}

    if "player_effects" not in mob:
        mob["player_effects"] = {}


def add_enemy_effect(mob, key, effect):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    effect["key"] = key
    mob["enemy_effects"][key] = effect


def add_player_effect(mob, key, effect):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    effect["key"] = key
    mob["player_effects"][key] = effect


def remove_enemy_effect(mob, key):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    if key in mob["enemy_effects"]:
        del mob["enemy_effects"][key]


def remove_player_effect(mob, key):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    if key in mob["player_effects"]:
        del mob["player_effects"][key]


def get_enemy_effects_text(mob):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    if not mob["enemy_effects"]:
        return ""

    text = "рџ“Њ Р•С„РµРєС‚Рё РЅР° РІРѕСЂРѕРіСѓ:\n"

    for key, effect in mob["enemy_effects"].items():
        name = effect.get("name", key)
        turns = effect.get("turns", 0)

        text += f"вЂў {name} вЂ” {turns} С…РѕРґ.\n"

    return text


def get_player_effects_text(mob):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    if not mob["player_effects"]:
        return ""

    text = "рџ“Њ Р•С„РµРєС‚Рё РЅР° С‚РѕР±С–:\n"

    for key, effect in mob["player_effects"].items():
        name = effect.get("name", key)
        turns = effect.get("turns", 0)

        if effect.get("type") == "shield":
            absorb_left = effect.get("absorb_left", 0)
            text += f"вЂў {name} вЂ” {turns} С…РѕРґ., С‰РёС‚ {absorb_left}\n"
        else:
            text += f"вЂў {name} вЂ” {turns} С…РѕРґ.\n"

    return text


def get_effective_mob_def(mob, attack_type):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    if attack_type == "magical":
        base_def = mob.get("mdef", mob.get("def", 0))
        flat_key = "mdef_flat"
        percent_key = "mdef_percent"
    else:
        base_def = mob.get("pdef", mob.get("def", 0))
        flat_key = "pdef_flat"
        percent_key = "pdef_percent"

    effective_def = float(base_def)

    for effect in mob["enemy_effects"].values():
        modifiers = effect.get("modifiers", {})

        if flat_key in modifiers:
            effective_def += float(modifiers.get(flat_key, 0))

        if percent_key in modifiers:
            percent = float(modifiers.get(percent_key, 0))
            effective_def *= (1 + percent / 100)

    if effective_def < 0:
        effective_def = 0

    return int(round(effective_def))


def get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    pdef = float(get_physical_defense(user_id))
    mdef = float(get_magic_defense(user_id))

    for effect in mob["player_effects"].values():
        modifiers = effect.get("modifiers", {})

        if "pdef_flat" in modifiers:
            pdef += float(modifiers.get("pdef_flat", 0))

        if "mdef_flat" in modifiers:
            mdef += float(modifiers.get("mdef_flat", 0))

        if "pdef_percent" in modifiers:
            pdef *= (1 + float(modifiers.get("pdef_percent", 0)) / 100)

        if "mdef_percent" in modifiers:
            mdef *= (1 + float(modifiers.get("mdef_percent", 0)) / 100)

    if pdef < 0:
        pdef = 0

    if mdef < 0:
        mdef = 0

    return int(round(pdef)), int(round(mdef))


def process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    # РЎРєС–Р»СЊРєРё HoT РІРёР»С–РєСѓРІР°РІ СЃР°РјРµ РЅР° СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚С– РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРѕРіРѕ С…РѕРґСѓ.
    # РЇРєС‰Рѕ С†РµР№ СЃР°РјРёР№ С…С–Рґ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РёС‚СЊСЃСЏ РїРµСЂРµРјРѕРіРѕСЋ, process_victory() РІС–РґРєРѕС‡СѓС” С†РµР№ С‚РёРє.
    mob["_turn_start_hot_heal_applied"] = 0

    if not mob["player_effects"]:
        return ""

    text = ""
    effects_to_remove = []

    if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
        current_hp = int(mob["player_hp"])
        max_hp = int(mob["player_max_hp"])
    else:
        current_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
        max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
        mob["player_hp"] = current_hp
        mob["player_max_hp"] = max_hp

        # Р‘С–Р№ РїРѕС‡Р°РІСЃСЏ: РїР°СЃРёРІРЅР° СЂРµРіРµРЅРµСЂР°С†С–СЏ HP РЅРµ РјР°С” РЅР°РєРѕРїРёС‡СѓРІР°С‚РёСЃСЊ РїС–Рґ С‡Р°СЃ Р±РѕСЋ.
        # set_current_hp() С‚Р°РєРѕР¶ РѕРЅРѕРІР»СЋС” last_hp_regen_update.
        set_current_hp(user_id, current_hp)

    initial_hp = current_hp
    total_hot_healed = 0

    for key, effect in list(mob["player_effects"].items()):
        effect_type = effect.get("type", "")
        turns = int(effect.get("turns", 0))

        if effect_type == "hot":
            heal = int(effect.get("heal", 0))

            if heal > 0 and current_hp < max_hp:
                prev_hp = current_hp
                current_hp = min(max_hp, current_hp + heal)
                healed = current_hp - prev_hp

                if healed > 0:
                    total_hot_healed += healed
                    text += f"рџЊї {effect.get('name', 'Р›С–РєСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ')}: +{healed} HP\n"

        turns -= 1
        effect["turns"] = turns

        if turns <= 0:
            effects_to_remove.append(key)

    if current_hp != initial_hp:
        set_current_hp(user_id, current_hp)
        mob["player_hp"] = current_hp

    mob["_turn_start_hot_heal_applied"] = total_hot_healed

    for key in effects_to_remove:
        name = mob["player_effects"].get(key, {}).get("name", key)
        remove_player_effect(mob, key)
        text += f"вЊ› Р•С„РµРєС‚ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РёРІСЃСЏ: {name}\n"

    return text

def process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    if not mob["enemy_effects"]:
        return {
            "text": "",
            "damage": 0
        }

    text = ""
    total_damage = 0
    effects_to_remove = []

    for key, effect in list(mob["enemy_effects"].items()):
        effect_type = effect.get("type", "")
        turns = int(effect.get("turns", 0))

        if effect_type == "dot":
            damage = int(effect.get("damage", 0))

            if damage > 0:
                mob["hp"] -= damage
                total_damage += damage
                text += f"{effect.get('icon', 'рџ”Ґ')} {effect.get('name', 'Р•С„РµРєС‚')}: РІРѕСЂРѕРі РѕС‚СЂРёРјСѓС” {damage} С€РєРѕРґРё.\n"

        turns -= 1
        effect["turns"] = turns

        if turns <= 0:
            effects_to_remove.append(key)

    for key in effects_to_remove:
        name = mob["enemy_effects"].get(key, {}).get("name", key)
        remove_enemy_effect(mob, key)
        text += f"вЊ› Р•С„РµРєС‚ РЅР° РІРѕСЂРѕРіСѓ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РёРІСЃСЏ: {name}\n"

    return {
        "text": text,
        "damage": total_damage
    }


def apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, damage):
    init_combat_effects(mob)

    if damage <= 0:
        return damage, ""

    text = ""
    remaining_damage = damage

    for key, effect in list(mob["player_effects"].items()):
        if effect.get("type") != "shield":
            continue

        absorb_left = int(effect.get("absorb_left", 0))

        if absorb_left <= 0:
            continue

        absorbed = min(absorb_left, remaining_damage)
        remaining_damage -= absorbed
        absorb_left -= absorbed

        effect["absorb_left"] = absorb_left

        text += f"рџ§± {effect.get('name', 'Р©РёС‚')} РїРѕРіР»РёРЅСѓРІ {absorbed} С€РєРѕРґРё.\n"

        if absorb_left <= 0:
            name = effect.get("name", "Р©РёС‚")
            remove_player_effect(mob, key)
            text += f"рџ’Ґ {name} Р·СЂСѓР№РЅРѕРІР°РЅРѕ.\n"

        if remaining_damage <= 0:
            remaining_damage = 0
            break

    return remaining_damage, text


# ==============================
# вњ… SKILL COOLDOWN HELPERS
# ==============================

def init_skill_cooldowns(mob):
    if "skill_cooldowns" not in mob:
        mob["skill_cooldowns"] = {}


def get_skill_cooldown(mob, skill_key):
    init_skill_cooldowns(mob)

    return int(mob["skill_cooldowns"].get(skill_key, 0) or 0)


def set_skill_cooldown(mob, skill_key, cooldown_turns):
    init_skill_cooldowns(mob)

    cooldown_turns = int(cooldown_turns or 0)

    if cooldown_turns <= 0:
        mob["skill_cooldowns"].pop(skill_key, None)
        return ""

    mob["skill_cooldowns"][skill_key] = cooldown_turns

    return f"вЏі РќР°РІРёС‡РєР° РїС–С€Р»Р° РЅР° РїРµСЂРµР·Р°СЂСЏРґРєСѓ: {cooldown_turns} С…РѕРґ.\n"


def tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob):
    init_skill_cooldowns(mob)

    if not mob["skill_cooldowns"]:
        return ""

    expired = []

    for skill_key in list(mob["skill_cooldowns"].keys()):
        old_value = int(mob["skill_cooldowns"].get(skill_key, 0) or 0)
        new_value = max(0, old_value - 1)

        if new_value <= 0:
            expired.append(skill_key)
            del mob["skill_cooldowns"][skill_key]
        else:
            mob["skill_cooldowns"][skill_key] = new_value

    text = ""

    if expired:
        text += "вњ… Р”РµСЏРєС– РЅР°РІРёС‡РєРё Р·РЅРѕРІСѓ РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅС–.\n"

    return text


def validate_skill_cooldown(mob, skill):
    skill_key = skill["key"]
    cooldown = get_skill_cooldown(mob, skill_key)

    if cooldown > 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": (
                f"вЏі РќР°РІРёС‡РєР° С‰Рµ РїРµСЂРµР·Р°СЂСЏРґР¶Р°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ.\n\n"
                f"{skill['name']}\n"
                f"Р—Р°Р»РёС€РёР»РѕСЃСЊ: {cooldown} С…РѕРґ."
            )
        }

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": ""
    }

def get_player_class_skills(user_id):
    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)

    if not class_key:
        return []

    return CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])


def get_player_class_skill(user_id):
    skills = get_player_class_skills(user_id)

    if not skills:
        return None

    return skills[0]


def get_player_skill_by_key(user_id, skill_key):
    skills = get_player_class_skills(user_id)

    for skill in skills:
        if skill["key"] == skill_key:
            return skill

    return None


def build_skill_menu_text(user_id, mob):
    skills = get_player_class_skills(user_id)
    class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)

    if not skills:
        return (
            "вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєРё\n\n"
            "вќЊ Р”Р»СЏ С‚РІРѕРіРѕ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ С‰Рµ РЅРµРјР°С” РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёС… РЅР°РІРёС‡РѕРє."
        ), None

    text = "вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєРё\n\n"
    text += f"{class_resource_text}\n"

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    for skill in skills:
        cooldown = get_skill_cooldown(mob, skill["key"])

        text += (
            f"{skill['name']}\n"
            f"{skill['description']}\n"
            f"Р’Р°СЂС‚С–СЃС‚СЊ: {skill.get('cost', 0)}"
        )

        if skill["cost_type"] == "rage":
            text += " Р›СЋС‚С–\n"
        elif skill["cost_type"] == "rage_all_min":
            text += f" Р›СЋС‚С–, РјС–РЅС–РјСѓРј {skill.get('min_cost', 30)}\n"
        elif skill["cost_type"] == "combat_energy":
            text += " Р•РЅРµСЂРіС–С—\n"
        elif skill["cost_type"] == "combat_energy_combo":
            text += f" Р•РЅРµСЂРіС–С— + РјС–РЅС–РјСѓРј {skill.get('min_combo', 1)} РєРѕРјР±Рѕ\n"
        elif skill["cost_type"] == "mana":
            text += " MP\n"
        else:
            text += "\n"

        if skill.get("cooldown", 0) > 0:
            text += f"РџРµСЂРµР·Р°СЂСЏРґРєР°: {skill['cooldown']} С…РѕРґ.\n"

        if cooldown > 0:
            text += f"вЏі РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅР° РїРµСЂРµР·Р°СЂСЏРґРєР°: {cooldown} С…РѕРґ.\n\n"
            button_text = f"рџ”’ {skill['name']} вЂ” {cooldown} С…РѕРґ."
            callback_data = f"skill_locked:{skill['key']}"
        else:
            text += "вњ… РќР°РІРёС‡РєР° РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅР°.\n\n"
            button_text = skill["name"]
            callback_data = f"use_skill:{skill['key']}"

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text=button_text,
            callback_data=callback_data
        ))

    enemy_effects_text = get_enemy_effects_text(mob)
    player_effects_text = get_player_effects_text(mob)

    if enemy_effects_text or player_effects_text:
        text += "\n"
        text += enemy_effects_text
        text += player_effects_text

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="в¬…пёЏ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ РґРѕ Р±РѕСЋ",
        callback_data="combat_back"
    ))

    return text, kb


def validate_and_pay_skill_cost(user_id, mob, skill):
    cost_type = skill["cost_type"]
    cost = int(skill.get("cost", 0))

    mob["last_skill_spent_rage"] = 0
    mob["last_skill_spent_combo"] = 0

    if cost_type == "rage":
        current_rage = mob.get("player_rage", 0)

        if current_rage < cost:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": (
                    f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ Р›СЋС‚С–.\n\n"
                    f"рџ”ґ РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ: {cost}\n"
                    f"рџ”ґ РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {current_rage}/{mob.get('player_max_rage', 100)}"
                )
            }

        mob["player_rage"] = max(0, current_rage - cost)

        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    if cost_type == "rage_all_min":
        current_rage = mob.get("player_rage", 0)
        min_cost = int(skill.get("min_cost", 30))

        if current_rage < min_cost:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": (
                    f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ Р›СЋС‚С–.\n\n"
                    f"рџ”ґ РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ РјС–РЅС–РјСѓРј: {min_cost}\n"
                    f"рџ”ґ РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {current_rage}/{mob.get('player_max_rage', 100)}"
                )
            }

        mob["last_skill_spent_rage"] = current_rage
        mob["player_rage"] = 0

        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    if cost_type == "combat_energy":
        current_energy = mob.get("player_combat_energy", 0)

        if current_energy < cost:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": (
                    f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ Р•РЅРµСЂРіС–С—.\n\n"
                    f"рџџЎ РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ: {cost}\n"
                    f"рџџЎ РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {current_energy}/{mob.get('player_max_combat_energy', 100)}"
                )
            }

        mob["player_combat_energy"] = max(0, current_energy - cost)

        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    if cost_type == "combat_energy_combo":
        current_energy = mob.get("player_combat_energy", 0)
        current_combo = mob.get("player_combo_points", 0)
        min_combo = int(skill.get("min_combo", 1))

        if current_energy < cost:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": (
                    f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ Р•РЅРµСЂРіС–С—.\n\n"
                    f"рџџЎ РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ: {cost}\n"
                    f"рџџЎ РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {current_energy}/{mob.get('player_max_combat_energy', 100)}"
                )
            }

        if current_combo < min_combo:
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": (
                    f"вќЊ РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ РєРѕРјР±Рѕ-РѕС‡РѕРє.\n\n"
                    f"вљ”пёЏ РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ РјС–РЅС–РјСѓРј: {min_combo}\n"
                    f"вљ”пёЏ РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ: {current_combo}/{mob.get('player_max_combo_points', 3)}"
                )
            }

        mob["player_combat_energy"] = max(0, current_energy - cost)
        mob["last_skill_spent_combo"] = consume_rogue_combo_points(mob)

        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    if cost_type == "mana":
        spend_result = spend_user_mp(user_id, cost)

        if not spend_result["success"]:
            return spend_result

        mob["player_mp"] = spend_result["mp"]
        mob["player_max_mp"] = spend_result["max_mp"]

        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": ""
        }

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": ""
    }


def apply_extra_rage_from_skill(mob, skill):
    extra_rage = int(skill.get("extra_rage", 0))

    if extra_rage <= 0:
        return ""

    if mob.get("player_resource_type") != "rage":
        return ""

    old_rage = mob.get("player_rage", 0)
    max_rage = mob.get("player_max_rage", 100)

    new_rage = min(max_rage, old_rage + extra_rage)
    mob["player_rage"] = new_rage

    if new_rage > old_rage:
        return f"рџ”ґ Р”РѕРґР°С‚РєРѕРІР° Р›СЋС‚С–СЃС‚СЊ РІС–Рґ РЅР°РІРёС‡РєРё: +{new_rage - old_rage} ({new_rage}/{max_rage})\n"

    return ""


def roll_skill_stun(mob, skill):
    stun_chance = int(skill.get("stun_chance", 0))

    if stun_chance <= 0:
        return ""

    import random

    roll = random.randint(1, 100)

    if roll <= stun_chance:
        mob["stunned_turns"] = 1
        return f"рџ’« {mob['name']} РѕРіР»СѓС€РµРЅРёР№ РЅР° 1 С…С–Рґ!\n"

    return ""


def apply_skill_special_effect(user_id, mob, skill, damage_done):
    effect_key = skill.get("effect", "")

    if not effect_key:
        return ""

    text = ""

    if effect_key == "enemy_pdef_down":
        add_enemy_effect(
            mob,
            "warrior_suppression_pdef_down",
            {
                "name": "рџ›ЎпёЏ РџСЂРёРіРЅС–С‡РµРЅРЅСЏ",
                "type": "debuff",
                "turns": 3,
                "modifiers": {
                    "pdef_percent": -30
                }
            }
        )

        text += f"рџ›ЎпёЏ {mob['name']} РїСЂРёРіРЅС–С‡РµРЅРёР№: С„С–Р·РёС‡РЅРёР№ Р·Р°С…РёСЃС‚ Р·РЅРёР¶РµРЅРѕ РЅР° 30% РЅР° 3 С…РѕРґРё.\n"

    elif effect_key == "player_shield":
        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)
        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

        if stats:
            _, _, _, _, _, level = stats
        else:
            level = 1

        absorb_amount = max(
            15,
            int(player_pdef * 2 + level * 3)
        )

        add_player_effect(
            mob,
            "knight_holy_protection_shield",
            {
                "name": "рџ§± РЎРІСЏС‚РёР№ Р·Р°С…РёСЃС‚",
                "type": "shield",
                "turns": 3,
                "absorb_left": absorb_amount,
                "modifiers": {}
            }
        )

        text += f"рџ§± РЎРІСЏС‚РёР№ Р·Р°С…РёСЃС‚ СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРёРІ С‰РёС‚ РЅР° {absorb_amount} С€РєРѕРґРё РЅР° 3 С…РѕРґРё.\n"

    elif effect_key == "enemy_pdef_trap":
        add_enemy_effect(
            mob,
            "scout_trap_pdef_down",
            {
                "name": "рџЄ¤ РџР°СЃС‚РєР°",
                "type": "debuff",
                "turns": 2,
                "modifiers": {
                    "pdef_percent": -50
                }
            }
        )

        text += f"рџЄ¤ {mob['name']} РїРѕС‚СЂР°РїРёРІ Сѓ РїР°СЃС‚РєСѓ: С„С–Р·РёС‡РЅРёР№ Р·Р°С…РёСЃС‚ Р·РЅРёР¶РµРЅРѕ РЅР° 50% РЅР° 2 С…РѕРґРё.\n"

    elif effect_key == "enemy_bleed":
        bleed_damage = max(
            2,
            int(round(max(1, damage_done) * 0.30))
        )

        add_enemy_effect(
            mob,
            "rogue_bleed",
            {
                "name": "рџ©ё РљСЂРѕРІРѕС‚РµС‡Р°",
                "icon": "рџ©ё",
                "type": "dot",
                "turns": 3,
                "damage": bleed_damage,
                "modifiers": {}
            }
        )

        text += f"рџ©ё РќР° {mob['name']} РЅР°РєР»Р°РґРµРЅРѕ РєСЂРѕРІРѕС‚РµС‡Сѓ: {bleed_damage} С€РєРѕРґРё РїСЂРѕС‚СЏРіРѕРј 3 С…РѕРґС–РІ.\n"

    elif effect_key == "enemy_poison":
        poison_damage = max(
            2,
            int(round(max(1, damage_done) * 0.30))
        )

        add_enemy_effect(
            mob,
            "scout_poison",
            {
                "name": "в пёЏ РћС‚СЂСѓС‚Р°",
                "icon": "в пёЏ",
                "type": "dot",
                "turns": 3,
                "damage": poison_damage,
                "modifiers": {}
            }
        )

        text += f"в пёЏ {mob['name']} РѕС‚СЂСѓС”РЅРёР№: {poison_damage} С€РєРѕРґРё РїСЂРѕС‚СЏРіРѕРј 3 С…РѕРґС–РІ.\n"

    elif effect_key == "player_hot":
        max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

        heal_per_turn = max(
            5,
            int(round(max_hp * 0.10))
        )

        add_player_effect(
            mob,
            "priest_healing_blessing_hot",
            {
                "name": "рџЊї Р‘Р»Р°РіРѕСЃР»РѕРІРµРЅРЅСЏ Р·С†С–Р»РµРЅРЅСЏ",
                "type": "hot",
                "turns": 4,
                "heal": heal_per_turn,
                "modifiers": {}
            }
        )

        text += f"рџЊї Р‘Р»Р°РіРѕСЃР»РѕРІРµРЅРЅСЏ Р·С†С–Р»РµРЅРЅСЏ: +{heal_per_turn} HP РїСЂРѕС‚СЏРіРѕРј 4 С…РѕРґС–РІ.\n"

    elif effect_key == "restore_mana_percent":
        mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)

        current_mp = mp_data.get("mp", 0)
        max_mp = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)

        restore_amount = max(
            1,
            int(round(max_mp * 0.25))
        )

        new_mp = min(max_mp, current_mp + restore_amount)
        restored = new_mp - current_mp

        try:
            from db import set_user_mp
            set_user_mp(user_id, new_mp)
        except Exception:
            pass

        mob["player_mp"] = new_mp
        mob["player_max_mp"] = max_mp

        text += f"рџ”® РњР°РіС–С‡РЅРёР№ РїРѕС‚С–Рє РІС–РґРЅРѕРІРёРІ {restored} MP ({new_mp}/{max_mp}).\n"

    elif effect_key == "player_cleanse_mdef_buff":
        cleared = 0

        for key in list(mob.get("player_effects", {}).keys()):
            effect = mob["player_effects"].get(key, {})

            if effect.get("negative"):
                remove_player_effect(mob, key)
                cleared += 1

        add_player_effect(
            mob,
            "priest_purify_faith_mdef",
            {
                "name": "рџ›ЎпёЏ РћС‡РёС‰РµРЅРЅСЏ РІС–СЂРё",
                "type": "buff",
                "turns": 3,
                "modifiers": {
                    "mdef_percent": 30
                }
            }
        )

        # Restore 15% max MP
        mp_data = get_user_mp(user_id)
        current_mp = mp_data.get("mp", 0)
        max_mp = mp_data.get("max_mp", 0)
        restore_amount = max(1, int(round(max_mp * 0.15)))
        new_mp = min(max_mp, current_mp + restore_amount)
        restored = new_mp - current_mp

        try:
            from db import set_user_mp
            set_user_mp(user_id, new_mp)
        except Exception:
            pass

        mob["player_mp"] = new_mp
        mob["player_max_mp"] = max_mp

        if cleared > 0:
            text += f"рџ›ЎпёЏ РћС‡РёС‰РµРЅРЅСЏ РІС–СЂРё Р·РЅСЏР»Рѕ РЅРµРіР°С‚РёРІРЅРёС… РµС„РµРєС‚С–РІ: {cleared}.\n"

        text += "рџ›ЎпёЏ РњР°РіС–С‡РЅРёР№ Р·Р°С…РёСЃС‚ РїС–РґРІРёС‰РµРЅРѕ РЅР° 30% РЅР° 3 С…РѕРґРё.\n"
        text += f"рџ›ЎпёЏ РћС‡РёС‰РµРЅРЅСЏ РІС–СЂРё РІС–РґРЅРѕРІРёР»Рѕ {restored} MP ({new_mp}/{max_mp}).\n"

    return text


def append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result):
    if mp_restore_result and mp_restore_result.get("restored"):
        text += (
            f"\nрџ”µ РњР°РЅР° РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»РµРЅР°: "
            f"{mp_restore_result['mp']}/{mp_restore_result['max_mp']}"
        )

    return text


def append_effects_to_combat_text(text, mob):
    enemy_effects_text = get_enemy_effects_text(mob)
    player_effects_text = get_player_effects_text(mob)

    if enemy_effects_text or player_effects_text:
        text += "\n\n"
        text += enemy_effects_text
        text += player_effects_text

    return text

def get_potion_cooldown_turns_by_inventory_id(inventory_id):
    item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)

    if not item:
        return 3

    (
        inv_id,
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        quantity,
        max_stack,
        durability,
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        sell_price
    ) = item

    if type_ == "potion_hp_medium":
        return 5

    if type_ == "potion_hp":
        return 3

    return 3


def build_combat_potion_kb(user_id):
    items = get_inventory_detailed(user_id)

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
    found = False

    for item in items:
        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = item

        if category == "potion" and type_ in ["potion_hp", "potion_hp_medium"]:
            found = True

            cooldown = 3

            if type_ == "potion_hp_medium":
                cooldown = 5

            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text=f"{name} x{quantity} вЂ” cooldown {cooldown} С…РѕРґ.",
                callback_data=f"combat_potion_{inv_id}"
            ))

    if not found:
        return None

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="в¬…пёЏ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ РґРѕ Р±РѕСЋ",
        callback_data="combat_back"
    ))

    return kb


def build_death_text(durability_damage):
    text = (
        "рџ’Ђ РўР Р—РђР“РРќРЈР’\n"
        "вќ¤пёЏ РџС–СЃР»СЏ РїРѕСЂР°Р·РєРё Сѓ С‚РµР±Рµ Р·Р°Р»РёС€РёР»РѕСЃСЊ 1 HP\n"
        "рџ§± РћРґСЏРіРЅРµРЅРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ РІС‚СЂР°С‚РёР»Рѕ 5 РјС–С†РЅРѕСЃС‚С–\n"
    )

    if durability_damage:
        text += "\nрџ“‰ РЎС‚Р°РЅ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ:\n"

        for item in durability_damage:
            broken_text = " вљ пёЏ Р—Р›РђРњРђРќРћ" if item["broken"] else ""
            text += f"вЂў {item['name']}: {item['old']} в†’ {item['new']}/100{broken_text}\n"

    return text


def build_victory_text(user_id, lvl, mob, reward, wear_result, contract_result, daily_result, prefix_text=""):
    exp_result = reward["exp_result"]

    victory_title = "рџЏ† Р’Р РџР•Р Р•РњРћР“Р›Р!"

    if mob.get("is_elite"):
        victory_title = "рџЏ† Р’Р РџР•Р Р•РњРћР“Р›Р Р•Р›Р†РўРќРћР“Рћ Р’РћР РћР“Рђ!"

    text = f"{victory_title}\n\n"

    text += (
        f"{mob['name']} РїРѕРІР°Р»РµРЅРёР№ РЅР° Р·РµРјР»СЋ.\n\n"
        f"рџ“€ РќР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґР°:\n"
        f"вњЁ Р”РѕСЃРІС–Рґ: +{reward['exp']} EXP"
    )

    if exp_result:
        text += f" ({exp_result['exp']}/{exp_result['exp_to_next']})"

        if exp_result["level_ups"] > 0:
            text += f"\nрџЏ† РќРѕРІРёР№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ: {exp_result['level']}!"

    text += f"\nрџ’° Р—РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ: +{reward['gold']}\n"

    if reward["loot_messages"]:
        text += "\nрџЋ’ Р—РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРёР№ Р»СѓС‚:\n"

        for loot in reward["loot_messages"]:
            text += f"вЂў {loot}\n"
    else:
        text += "\nрџЋ’ Р›СѓС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ.\n"

    if wear_result and wear_result.get("triggered"):
        text += f"\n{wear_result['message']}\n"

    if contract_result and contract_result.get("message"):
        text += f"\n{contract_result['message']}\n"

    if daily_result and daily_result.get("message"):
        text += f"\n{daily_result['message']}\n"

    mp_restore_result = restore_user_mp_to_full(user_id)
    text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)

    text += f"\nрџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР°: {reward['used_slots']}/{reward['capacity']} СЃР»РѕС‚С–РІ"

    return text



def rollback_turn_start_hot_heal_on_victory(user_id, mob):
    """
    Р’С–РґРєРѕС‡СѓС” HoT, СЏРєРёР№ СЃРїСЂР°С†СЋРІР°РІ РЅР° РїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ С…РѕРґСѓ,
    СЏРєС‰Рѕ С†РµР№ СЃР°РјРёР№ С…С–Рґ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РёРІСЃСЏ РїРµСЂРµРјРѕРіРѕСЋ.
    """

    if not mob:
        return

    hot_heal = int(mob.get("_turn_start_hot_heal_applied", 0) or 0)

    if hot_heal <= 0:
        return

    if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
        current_hp = int(mob.get("player_hp", 0) or 0)
        max_hp = int(mob.get("player_max_hp", get_max_hp(user_id)) or get_max_hp(user_id))
    else:
        current_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
        max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    new_hp = current_hp - hot_heal
    new_hp = max(1, min(max_hp, new_hp))

    mob["player_hp"] = new_hp
    mob["player_max_hp"] = max_hp
    mob["_turn_start_hot_heal_applied"] = 0

    set_current_hp(user_id, new_hp)


def finalize_combat_state_before_victory(user_id, mob):
    """
    Р¤С–РЅР°Р»С–Р·СѓС” Р±РѕР№РѕРІРёР№ СЃС‚Р°РЅ РїРµСЂРµРґ РїРµСЂРµРјРѕРіРѕСЋ.

    РџРµСЂРµРґ РѕС‡РёС‰РµРЅРЅСЏРј Р±РѕР№РѕРІРёС… РµС„РµРєС‚С–РІ РІС–РґРєРѕС‡СѓС” HoT, СЏРєРёР№ СЃРїСЂР°С†СЋРІР°РІ
    РЅР° СЃС‚Р°СЂС‚С– РїРµСЂРµРјРѕР¶РЅРѕРіРѕ С…РѕРґСѓ. РџРѕС‚С–Рј Р·Р±РµСЂС–РіР°С” РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРµ HP С– РѕС‡РёС‰Р°С”
    С‚РёРјС‡Р°СЃРѕРІС– РµС„РµРєС‚Рё Р±РѕСЋ.
    """

    if not mob:
        return

    rollback_turn_start_hot_heal_on_victory(user_id, mob)

    if "player_hp" in mob:
        try:
            player_hp = int(mob.get("player_hp", 0) or 0)
            player_max_hp = int(mob.get("player_max_hp", get_max_hp(user_id)) or get_max_hp(user_id))

            if player_max_hp <= 0:
                player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

            player_hp = max(1, min(player_max_hp, player_hp))
            set_current_hp(user_id, player_hp)

            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

        except Exception:
            pass

    mob["player_effects"] = {}
    mob["enemy_effects"] = {}
    mob["stunned_turns"] = 0
    mob["_turn_start_hot_heal_applied"] = 0

def process_victory(bot, chat_id, user_id, lvl, mob, prefix_text=""):
    """
    Р—Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРЅСЏ Р±РѕСЋ РїРµСЂРµРјРѕРіРѕСЋ.

    РџРµСЂРµРґ РІРёС…РѕРґРѕРј С–Р· Р±РѕСЋ С„С–РєСЃСѓС”РјРѕ РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРµ HP Р· Р±РѕР№РѕРІРѕРіРѕ СЃС‚Р°РЅСѓ
    С– РѕС‡РёС‰Р°С”РјРѕ С‚РёРјС‡Р°СЃРѕРІС– Р±РѕР№РѕРІС– РµС„РµРєС‚Рё.

    Р¦Рµ РІРёРїСЂР°РІР»СЏС” РєРµР№СЃ, РєРѕР»Рё Р¶СЂРµС†СЊ РЅР°РєР»Р°РІ HoT Сѓ С„С–РЅР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРјСѓ СЂР°СѓРЅРґС–,
    Р° Р·Р°Р»РёС€РєРѕРІС– С‚С–РєРё Р»С–РєСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ РЅРµРєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅРѕ РґРѕР»С–РєРѕРІСѓРІР°Р»Рё РіРµСЂРѕСЏ РїС–СЃР»СЏ РїРµСЂРµРјРѕРіРё.
    """

    finalize_combat_state_before_victory(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob
    )

    if hasattr(bot, "user_data") and user_id in bot.user_data:
        del bot.user_data[user_id]

    reward = process_victory_reward(
        user_id=user_id,
        player_level=lvl,
        mob=mob
    )

    wear_result = apply_random_durability_wear_on_victory(
        user_id=user_id,
        chance_percent=25
    )

    contract_result = process_contract_progress_on_kill(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob
    )

    daily_result = process_daily_quest_progress_on_kill(
        user_id=user_id,
        mob=mob
    )

    text = build_victory_text(
        user_id=user_id,
        lvl=lvl,
        mob=mob,
        reward=reward,
        wear_result=wear_result,
        contract_result=contract_result,
        daily_result=daily_result,
        prefix_text=prefix_text
    )

    bot.send_message(
        chat_id,
        text,
        reply_markup=main_kb()
    )

def register_combat_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ”Ћ РџРѕР»СЋРІР°РЅРЅСЏ")
    def hunt(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not stats:

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        if hp_percent <= 25:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "рџґ Р’Рё Р·Р°РЅР°РґС‚Рѕ СЃР»Р°Р±РєС– РґР»СЏ РїРѕР»СЋРІР°РЅРЅСЏ.\n\n"
                    f"вќ¤пёЏ Р—РґРѕСЂРѕРІвЂ™СЏ: {current_hp}/{max_hp} ({hp_percent:.1f}%)\n"
                    "Р’Р°С€Рµ Р·РґРѕСЂРѕРІвЂ™СЏ РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ Р°Р±Рѕ РґРѕСЂС–РІРЅСЋС” 25%.\n\n"
                    "Р’С–РґРїРѕС‡РёРЅСЊС‚Рµ Р°Р±Рѕ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°Р№С‚Рµ Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ!"

        bot.send_message(

        )
        # РџРѕС‚С–Рј РїРѕРєР°Р·СѓС”РјРѕ РїРѕРІС–РґРѕРјР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РїСЂРѕ Р±С–Р№ Р· inline РјРµРЅСЋ

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "вљ”пёЏ Р‘С–Р№ С‚СЂРёРІР°С”...")
    def combat_placeholder(message):
        # РћР±СЂРѕР±РЅРёРє РґР»СЏ С„Р°Р»СЊС€РёРІРѕС— РєРЅРѕРїРєРё вЂ” РЅС–С‡РѕРіРѕ РЅРµ СЂРѕР±РёРјРѕ, РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ РІС–РґРїРѕРІС–РґР°С”РјРѕ
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        if hasattr(bot, "user_data") and user_id in bot.user_data:
            mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "Р’РёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓР№ С–РЅР»Р°Р№РЅ РєРЅРѕРїРєРё РґР»СЏ Р±РѕСЋ!",
                reply_markup=combat_placeholder_kb()
            )
        else:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "РўРё РЅРµ РІ Р±РѕСЋ!",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "вљ”пёЏ РђС‚Р°РєСѓРІР°С‚Рё")
    def attack(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "вќ— РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РїРѕС‡РЅРё РїРѕР»СЋРІР°РЅРЅСЏ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Р‘РµР· С–РјРµРЅС–"

        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "вќ— РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        # Р’РёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС”РјРѕ Р·РґРѕСЂРѕРІ'СЏ Р· mob, СЏРєС‰Рѕ РІРѕРЅРѕ С‚Р°Рј С”, С–РЅР°РєС€Рµ Р· Р±Р°Р·Рё (РЅР° РІРёРїР°РґРѕРє СЃС‚Р°СЂРёС… СЃРµСЃС–Р№)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]

        mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(
            mob,
            attack_profile["attack_type"]
        )

        player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
            player_stat_attack=attack_profile["stat_attack"],
            mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
            dex=dex_,
            wis=wis_,
            level=lvl,
            attack_type=attack_profile["attack_type"],
            weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
            weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"]
        )

        dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
        is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
        weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)

        mob["hp"] -= dmg

        resource_attack_text = add_rage_for_player_attack(mob)

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""

            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        enemy_effect_result = process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob)
        enemy_effect_text = enemy_effect_result.get("text", "")

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = enemy_effect_text

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        mob_dmg = 0
        is_mob_crit = False
        is_dodge = False
        resource_damage_text = ""

        if mob.get("stunned_turns", 0) > 0:
            mob["stunned_turns"] -= 1

        else:

                player_dex=dex_,
                mob_dex=mob["dex"],
                sta=sta_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=mob["attack_type"]
            )

            mob_dmg = mob_attack_result["damage"]
            is_mob_crit = mob_attack_result["is_crit"]
            is_dodge = mob_attack_result["is_dodge"]

            shield_text = ""

            if not is_dodge and mob_dmg > 0:
                mob_dmg, shield_text = apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, mob_dmg)

            player_hp -= mob_dmg
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp

            resource_damage_text = add_rage_for_damage_taken(mob, mob_dmg)

            if is_dodge:
                enemy_action_text = f"рџ’Ё РЈРҐРР›! {character_name} СѓРЅРёРєРЅСѓРІ Р°С‚Р°РєРё {mob['name']}\n\n"
            elif is_mob_crit:
                enemy_action_text = f"рџ’Ґ РљР РРў {mob['name']}! {character_name} РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°РІ {mob_dmg} С€РєРѕРґРё\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
            else:
                enemy_action_text = f"рџ‘№ {mob['name']} Р·Р°РІРґР°РІ {character_name} {mob_dmg} С€РєРѕРґРё\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"

        if player_hp <= 0:
            durability_damage = damage_equipped_items_on_death(
                user_id=user_id,
                amount=5
            )

            set_current_hp(user_id, 1)
            try:
                from db import reset_hp_regen_timers_now
                reset_hp_regen_timers_now(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

            mp_restore_result = restore_user_mp_to_full(user_id)

            if user_id in bot.user_data:
                del bot.user_data[user_id]

            text = build_death_text(durability_damage)
            text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            mob["potion_cooldown"] -= 1

        text = "вљ”пёЏ Р‘Р†Р™\n\n"

        if cooldown_start_text:
            text += cooldown_start_text

            text += resource_start_text

        if resource_attack_text:
            text += resource_attack_text

        if enemy_effect_text:
