    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєРё")
    def show_skills(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "вќ— РўРё РЅРµ РІ Р±РѕСЋ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)

        text, kb = build_skill_menu_text(user_id, mob)

        if not kb:
    
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )
        
    # РЎС‚Р°СЂРёР№ РѕР±СЂРѕР±РЅРёРє С‚РµРєСЃС‚РѕРІРёС… РєРЅРѕРїРѕРє СЃРєС–Р»С–РІ (РЅРµ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ, С‚РµРїРµСЂ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС”РјРѕ inline)
    # @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: any(
    #     skill_name in m.text 
    #     for class_skills in CLASS_SKILLS_V1.values() 
    #     for skill_name in [s["name"] for s in class_skills]
    # ))
    def use_skill_text_button(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "вќ— РўРё РЅРµ РІ Р±РѕСЋ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Р‘РµР· С–РјРµРЅС–"
        class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
        class_skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
        
        # Р—РЅР°Р№С‚Рё РЅР°РІРёС‡РєСѓ Р·Р° С–Рј'СЏРј
        skill = None
        for s in class_skills:
            if s["name"] == message.text:
                skill = s
                break
        
        if not skill:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "вќЊ РќР°РІРёС‡РєСѓ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ.",
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_result = validate_skill_cooldown(mob, skill)
        if not cooldown_result["success"]:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                cooldown_result["message"],
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)
        
        pay_result = validate_and_pay_skill_cost(user_id, mob, skill)
        if not pay_result["success"]:
            class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
            skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                pay_result["message"],
                reply_markup=fight_kb(skills)
            )
            return
            
        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
        if not stats:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "вќ— РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats
        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)
        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp
        
        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]
            
        skill_attack_type = skill.get("attack_type", attack_profile["attack_type"])
        
        if skill.get("no_damage"):
            base_dmg = 0
            dmg = 0
            is_player_crit = False
            weapon_damage = 0
        else:
            if skill_attack_type == "magical":
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "magical")
                player_stat_attack = int_
            else:
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "physical")
                player_stat_attack = attack_profile["stat_attack"]
                
            player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
                player_stat_attack=player_stat_attack,
                mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
                dex=dex_,
                wis=wis_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=skill_attack_type,
                weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
                weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"]
            )
            
            base_dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
            is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
            weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)
            
            dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * float(skill.get("damage_multiplier", 1.0)))))
            
            if skill.get("scales_with_spent_rage"):
                spent_rage = mob.get("last_skill_spent_rage", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_rage / 100)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier)))
                
            if skill.get("scales_with_player_pdef"):
                player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(player_pdef * 0.85)))
                
            if skill.get("scales_with_combo"):
                spent_combo = mob.get("last_skill_spent_combo", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_combo * 0.35)
                dmg = max(1, int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier)))
                
            mob["hp"] -= dmg
            
        resource_attack_text = ""
        if not skill.get("no_damage"):
            if mob.get("player_resource_type") == "rage":
                resource_attack_text += add_rage_for_player_attack(mob)
                
        combo_gain = int(skill.get("combo_gain", 0))
        if combo_gain > 0:
            resource_attack_text += add_rogue_combo_point(mob, combo_gain)
            
        resource_attack_text += apply_extra_rage_from_skill(mob, skill)
        
        stun_text = ""
        if not skill.get("no_damage"):
            stun_text = roll_skill_stun(mob, skill)
            
        special_effect_text = apply_skill_special_effect(
            user_id=user_id,
            mob=mob,
            skill=skill,
            damage_done=dmg
        )
        
        cooldown_set_text = set_skill_cooldown(
            mob,
            skill["key"],
            skill.get("cooldown", 0)
        )
        
        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""
            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text
                
            prefix_text += f"вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєР°: {skill['name']}\n"
            if skill.get("no_damage"):
                prefix_text += "РќР°РІРёС‡РєР° Р·Р°СЃС‚РѕСЃРѕРІР°РЅР°.\n"
            else:
                prefix_text += f"РўРё Р·Р°РІРґР°РІ {dmg} С€РєРѕРґРё.\n"
                
            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return
            
        enemy_effect_result = process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob)
        enemy_effect_text = enemy_effect_result.get("text", "")
        
        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""
            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text or enemy_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text

                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text

            prefix_text += f"вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєР°: {skill['name']}\n"
            prefix_text += "Р’РѕСЂРѕРі РїРѕРІР°Р»РµРЅРёР№ РµС„РµРєС‚Р°РјРё.\n"
            
            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return
            
        mob_dmg = 0
        is_mob_crit = False
        is_dodge = False
        resource_damage_text = ""
        
        if mob.get("stunned_turns", 0) > 0:
            mob["stunned_turns"] -= 1
            enemy_action_text = f"рџ’« {mob['name']} РѕРіР»СѓС€РµРЅРёР№ С– РїСЂРѕРїСѓСЃРєР°С” С…С–Рґ.\n\n"

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("skill_locked:"))
    def skill_locked(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "вќ— Р‘С–Р№ СѓР¶Рµ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРѕ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        skill_key = call.data.split(":")[1]
        skill = get_player_skill_by_key(user_id, skill_key)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        if not skill:
    
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "вќЊ РќР°РІРёС‡РєСѓ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ.",
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        cooldown = get_skill_cooldown(mob, skill["key"])

        if cooldown <= 0:
            text, kb = build_skill_menu_text(user_id, mob)
            if kb:
                bot.send_message(
                    call.message.chat.id,
                    text,
                    reply_markup=kb
                )
            else:
        
                bot.send_message(
                    call.message.chat.id,
                    text,
                    reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
                )
            return


        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            (
                f"вЏі РќР°РІРёС‡РєР° С‰Рµ РїРµСЂРµР·Р°СЂСЏРґР¶Р°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ.\n\n"
                f"{skill['name']}\n"
                f"Р—Р°Р»РёС€РёР»РѕСЃСЊ: {cooldown} С…РѕРґ.\n\n"
                f"в„№пёЏ Р’РёРєРѕРЅР°Р№ СЂРµР°Р»СЊРЅРёР№ С…С–Рґ: Р°С‚Р°РєСѓР№ Р°Р±Рѕ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°Р№ РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅСѓ РЅР°РІРёС‡РєСѓ."
            ),
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )

                call.message.chat.id,
                "вќ— РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РїРѕС‡РЅРё РїРѕР»СЋРІР°РЅРЅСЏ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )

        # Р’РёРєР»РёРєР°С”РјРѕ РІР¶Рµ С–СЃРЅСѓСЋС‡Сѓ Р»РѕРіС–РєСѓ Р°С‚Р°РєРё

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("combat_skill_locked:"))
    def combat_skill_locked_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        skill_key = call.data.split(":")[1]
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "вќ— Р‘С–Р№ РІР¶Рµ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРѕ")
            return
            
        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        skill = get_player_skill_by_key(user_id, skill_key)
        cooldown = get_skill_cooldown(mob, skill["key"])
        
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, f"вЏі {skill['name']} С‰Рµ РїРµСЂРµР·Р°СЂСЏРґР¶Р°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ: {cooldown} С…РѕРґС–РІ")
        
    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("combat_use_skill:"))
    def combat_use_skill_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        skill_key = call.data.split(":")[1]
        
        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "вќ— Р‘С–Р№ РІР¶Рµ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРѕ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return
            
        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        init_combat_effects(mob)
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Р‘РµР· С–РјРµРЅС–"
        skill = get_player_skill_by_key(user_id, skill_key)
        class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
        
        if not skill:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "вќЊ РќР°РІРёС‡РєСѓ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ.",
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_result = validate_skill_cooldown(mob, skill)
        if not cooldown_result["success"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                cooldown_result["message"],
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return
            
        cooldown_start_text = tick_skill_cooldowns_at_player_turn(mob)
        player_effects_text = process_player_turn_start_effects(user_id, mob)
        resource_start_text = regenerate_class_resource_at_player_turn(mob)
        
        pay_result = validate_and_pay_skill_cost(user_id, mob, skill)
        if not pay_result["success"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                pay_result["message"],
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

        if not stats:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "вќ— РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

        attack_profile = get_player_attack_profile(user_id)

        player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

        # Р’РёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС”РјРѕ Р·РґРѕСЂРѕРІ'СЏ Р· mob, СЏРєС‰Рѕ РІРѕРЅРѕ С‚Р°Рј С”, С–РЅР°РєС€Рµ Р· Р±Р°Р·Рё (РЅР° РІРёРїР°РґРѕРє СЃС‚Р°СЂРёС… СЃРµСЃС–Р№)
        if "player_hp" in mob and "player_max_hp" in mob:
            player_hp = mob["player_hp"]
            player_max_hp = mob["player_max_hp"]
        else:
            player_hp = get_current_hp_raw(user_id)
            player_max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
            mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

        if "max_hp" not in mob:
            mob["max_hp"] = mob["hp"]

        skill_attack_type = skill.get("attack_type", attack_profile["attack_type"])

        if skill.get("no_damage"):
            base_dmg = 0
            dmg = 0
            is_player_crit = False
            weapon_damage = 0
        else:
            if skill_attack_type == "magical":
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "magical")
                player_stat_attack = int_
            else:
                mob_def_for_player_attack = get_effective_mob_def(mob, "physical")
                player_stat_attack = attack_profile["stat_attack"]

            player_attack_result = calculate_player_attack(
                player_stat_attack=player_stat_attack,
                mob_def=mob_def_for_player_attack,
                dex=dex_,
                wis=wis_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=skill_attack_type,
                weapon_min_damage=attack_profile["weapon_min_damage"],
                weapon_max_damage=attack_profile["weapon_max_damage"]
            )

            base_dmg = player_attack_result["damage"]
            is_player_crit = player_attack_result["is_crit"]
            weapon_damage = player_attack_result.get("weapon_damage", 0)

            dmg = max(
                1,
                int(round(base_dmg * float(skill.get("damage_multiplier", 1.0))))
            )

            if skill.get("scales_with_spent_rage"):
                spent_rage = mob.get("last_skill_spent_rage", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_rage / 100)

                dmg = max(
                    1,
                    int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier))
                )

            if skill.get("scales_with_player_pdef"):
                player_pdef, player_mdef = get_effective_player_defenses(user_id, mob)

                dmg = max(
                    1,
                    int(round(player_pdef * 0.85))
                )

            if skill.get("scales_with_combo"):
                spent_combo = mob.get("last_skill_spent_combo", 0)
                bonus_multiplier = 1.0 + (spent_combo * 0.35)

                dmg = max(
                    1,
                    int(round(base_dmg * bonus_multiplier))
                )

            mob["hp"] -= dmg

        resource_attack_text = ""

        if not skill.get("no_damage"):
            if mob.get("player_resource_type") == "rage":
                resource_attack_text += add_rage_for_player_attack(mob)

        combo_gain = int(skill.get("combo_gain", 0))

        if combo_gain > 0:
            resource_attack_text += add_rogue_combo_point(mob, combo_gain)

        resource_attack_text += apply_extra_rage_from_skill(mob, skill)

        stun_text = ""

        if not skill.get("no_damage"):
            stun_text = roll_skill_stun(mob, skill)

        special_effect_text = apply_skill_special_effect(
            user_id=user_id,
            mob=mob,
            skill=skill,
            damage_done=dmg
        )

        cooldown_set_text = set_skill_cooldown(
            mob,
            skill["key"],
            skill.get("cooldown", 0)
        )

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""

            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text

            prefix_text += f"вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєР°: {skill['name']}\n"

            if skill.get("no_damage"):
                prefix_text += "РќР°РІРёС‡РєР° Р·Р°СЃС‚РѕСЃРѕРІР°РЅР°.\n"
            else:
                prefix_text += f"РўРё Р·Р°РІРґР°РІ {dmg} С€РєРѕРґРё.\n"

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        enemy_effect_result = process_enemy_turn_start_effects(mob)
        enemy_effect_text = enemy_effect_result.get("text", "")

        if mob["hp"] <= 0:
            prefix_text = ""

            if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text or enemy_effect_text:
                prefix_text += cooldown_start_text
                prefix_text += player_effects_text
                prefix_text += resource_start_text
                prefix_text += resource_attack_text
                prefix_text += cooldown_set_text
                prefix_text += special_effect_text
                prefix_text += enemy_effect_text

            prefix_text += f"вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєР°: {skill['name']}\n"
            prefix_text += "Р’РѕСЂРѕРі РїРѕРІР°Р»РµРЅРёР№ РµС„РµРєС‚Р°РјРё.\n"

            process_victory(
                bot=bot,
                chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
                user_id=user_id,
                lvl=lvl,
                mob=mob,
                prefix_text=prefix_text
            )
            return

        mob_dmg = 0
        is_mob_crit = False
        is_dodge = False
        resource_damage_text = ""

        if mob.get("stunned_turns", 0) > 0:
            mob["stunned_turns"] -= 1
            enemy_action_text = f"рџ’« {mob['name']} РѕРіР»СѓС€РµРЅРёР№ С– РїСЂРѕРїСѓСЃРєР°С” С…С–Рґ.\n\n"
        else:
            mob_attack_result = calculate_mob_attack(
                mob_attack=mob["attack"],
                player_pdef=player_pdef,
                player_mdef=player_mdef,
                player_dex=dex_,
                mob_dex=mob["dex"],
                sta=sta_,
                level=lvl,
                attack_type=mob["attack_type"]
            )

            mob_dmg = mob_attack_result["damage"]
            is_mob_crit = mob_attack_result["is_crit"]
            is_dodge = mob_attack_result["is_dodge"]

            shield_text = ""

            if not is_dodge and mob_dmg > 0:
                mob_dmg, shield_text = apply_player_shield_absorb(mob, mob_dmg)

            player_hp -= mob_dmg
            mob["player_hp"] = player_hp

            resource_damage_text = add_rage_for_damage_taken(mob, mob_dmg)

            if is_dodge:
                enemy_action_text = f"рџ’Ё РЈРҐРР›! {character_name} СѓРЅРёРєРЅСѓРІ Р°С‚Р°РєРё {mob['name']}\n\n"
            elif is_mob_crit:
                enemy_action_text = f"рџ’Ґ РљР РРў {mob['name']}! {character_name} РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°РІ {mob_dmg} С€РєРѕРґРё\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"
            else:
                enemy_action_text = f"рџ‘№ {mob['name']} Р·Р°РІРґР°РІ {character_name} {mob_dmg} С€РєРѕРґРё\n"
                enemy_action_text += shield_text
                enemy_action_text += "\n"

        if player_hp <= 0:
            durability_damage = damage_equipped_items_on_death(
                user_id=user_id,
                amount=5
            )

            set_current_hp(user_id, 1)
            try:
                from db import reset_hp_regen_timers_now
                reset_hp_regen_timers_now(user_id)
            except Exception:
                pass

            mp_restore_result = restore_user_mp_to_full(user_id)

            if user_id in bot.user_data:
                del bot.user_data[user_id]

            text = build_death_text(durability_damage)
            text = append_mp_restore_text(text, mp_restore_result)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        set_current_hp(user_id, player_hp)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            mob["potion_cooldown"] -= 1

        text = "вњЁ РќРђР’РР§РљРђ\n\n"

        if cooldown_start_text:
            text += cooldown_start_text

        if player_effects_text:
            text += player_effects_text

        if resource_start_text:
            text += resource_start_text

        if resource_attack_text:
            text += resource_attack_text

        if cooldown_set_text:
            text += cooldown_set_text

        if special_effect_text:
            text += special_effect_text

        if enemy_effect_text:
            text += enemy_effect_text

        if resource_damage_text:
            text += resource_damage_text

        if cooldown_start_text or player_effects_text or resource_start_text or resource_attack_text or cooldown_set_text or special_effect_text or enemy_effect_text or resource_damage_text:
            text += "\n"

        text += f"{skill['name']}\n"

        if skill.get("no_damage"):
            text += "вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєР° Р·Р°СЃС‚РѕСЃРѕРІР°РЅР°.\n"
        else:
            if is_player_crit:
                text += f"рџ’Ґ РљР РРў! {character_name} Р·Р°РІРґР°РІ {mob['name']} {dmg} С€РєРѕРґРё"
            else:
                text += f"вњЁ {character_name} Р·Р°РІРґР°РІ {mob['name']} {dmg} С€РєРѕРґРё"

            if weapon_damage > 0:
                text += f" (Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ: {weapon_damage})"

            text += "\n"

        if stun_text:
            text += stun_text

        text += enemy_action_text

        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)

        text += (
            f"вќ¤пёЏ {character_name}: {player_hp}/{player_max_hp}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(player_hp, player_max_hp)}\n"
            f"{class_resource_text}\n"
            f"рџ‘№ {mob['name']}: {mob['hp']}/{mob['max_hp']}\n"
            f"{hp_bar(mob['hp'], mob['max_hp'])}"
        )

        text = append_effects_to_combat_text(text, mob)

        if mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\n\nрџ”ґ РџРѕРІРЅРёР№ С€Р»СѓРЅРѕРє: {mob['potion_cooldown']} С…РѕРґ."


        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ§Є Р—С–Р»Р»СЏ")
    def choose_potion_in_combat(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "вќ— РўРё РЅРµ РІ Р±РѕСЋ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        cooldown = mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0)

        if cooldown > 0:
    
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                f"рџ”ґ РџРѕРІРЅРёР№ С€Р»СѓРЅРѕРє: Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ РјРѕР¶РЅР° Р±СѓРґРµ РІРёРїРёС‚Рё С‡РµСЂРµР· {cooldown} С…РѕРґ.",
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        kb = build_combat_potion_kb(user_id)

        if not kb:
    
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "вќЊ РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ РЅРµРјР°С” Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ Р·РґРѕСЂРѕРІвЂ™СЏ",
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "рџ§Є РћР±РµСЂРё Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ, СЏРєРµ С…РѕС‡РµС€ РІРёРїРёС‚Рё:",
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("combat_potion_"))
    def use_selected_potion_in_combat(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        if not hasattr(bot, "user_data") or user_id not in bot.user_data:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "вќ— Р‘С–Р№ СѓР¶Рµ Р·Р°РІРµСЂС€РµРЅРѕ",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        mob = bot.user_data[user_id]
        character_name = get_character_name(user_id) or "Р‘РµР· С–РјРµРЅС–"

        cooldown = mob.get("potion_cooldown", 0)

        if cooldown > 0:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                f"рџ”ґ РџРѕРІРЅРёР№ С€Р»СѓРЅРѕРє: Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ РјРѕР¶РЅР° Р±СѓРґРµ РІРёРїРёС‚Рё С‡РµСЂРµР· {cooldown} С…РѕРґ.",
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        inventory_id = int(call.data.split("_")[2])
        cooldown_turns = get_potion_cooldown_turns_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

        potion_result = use_potion_from_inventory(user_id, inventory_id)

        if not potion_result["success"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
    

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                potion_result["message"],
                reply_markup=build_combat_inline_kb(user_id, mob)
            )
            return

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        mob["potion_cooldown"] = cooldown_turns

        player_hp = potion_result["new_hp"]
        player_max_hp = potion_result["max_hp"]

        # РћРЅРѕРІР»СЋС”РјРѕ Р·РґРѕСЂРѕРІ'СЏ РІ mob
        mob["player_hp"] = player_hp
        mob["player_max_hp"] = player_max_hp

        class_resource_text = get_class_resource_line(mob)

        text = (
            f"рџ§Є Р—Р†Р›Р›РЇ\n\n"
            f"{potion_result['message']}\n\n"

# ==============================
# вњ… COMBAT SAFE SEND RATE LIMIT V1
# ==============================

# Telegram РјРѕР¶Рµ РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚Рё 429 Too Many Requests, СЏРєС‰Рѕ Р±РѕС‚ РЅР°РґСЃРёР»Р°С” Р±Р°РіР°С‚Рѕ РїРѕРІС–РґРѕРјР»РµРЅСЊ
# Р°Р±Рѕ СЏРєС‰Рѕ СЃС‚Р°СЂС– callback-Рё РѕР±СЂРѕР±Р»СЏСЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ РїРѕРІС‚РѕСЂРЅРѕ РїС–СЃР»СЏ exception.
# Р¦РµР№ wrapper РЅРµ РґР°С” polling РїР°РґР°С‚Рё С‡РµСЂРµР· 429: С‡РµРєР°С” retry_after С– РїРѕРІС‚РѕСЂСЋС” send РѕРґРёРЅ СЂР°Р·.


def patch_combat_bot_rate_limit_safe_send(bot):
    if getattr(bot, "_rom_safe_send_patched", False):
        return

    original_send_message = bot.send_message
    bot._rom_original_send_message = original_send_message

    def safe_send_message(chat_id, text, *args, **kwargs):
        try:
            return original_send_message(chat_id, text, *args, **kwargs)
        except Exception as error:
            retry_after = None
            error_code = getattr(error, "error_code", None)
            result_json = getattr(error, "result_json", None)

            if isinstance(result_json, dict):
                parameters = result_json.get("parameters", {}) or {}
                retry_after = parameters.get("retry_after")

                if error_code is None:
                    error_code = result_json.get("error_code")

            description = str(error)

            is_rate_limit = (
                error_code == 429
                or "Too Many Requests" in description
                or "retry after" in description
            )

            if not is_rate_limit:
                raise

            if retry_after is None:
                retry_after = 3

            try:
                retry_after = int(retry_after)
            except Exception:
                retry_after = 3

            retry_after = max(1, min(60, retry_after))

            try:
                import time
                print(f"вљ пёЏ Telegram rate limit 429. Waiting {retry_after + 1}s before retry send_message.")
                time.sleep(retry_after + 1)
                return original_send_message(chat_id, text, *args, **kwargs)
            except Exception as retry_error:
                print(f"вќЊ send_message retry failed after 429: {retry_error}")
                return None

    bot.send_message = safe_send_message
    bot._rom_safe_send_patched = True

def get_unlocked_location_ids(player_level):
    unlocked = []

    for location_id, location in LOCATIONS.items():
        if player_level >= location["unlock_level"]:
            unlocked.append(location_id)

    return unlocked


def get_available_contract_mobs(player_level):
    """
    РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶Рµ РґР°С‚Рё РјРѕР±Р° Р· РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРѕС— Р»РѕРєР°С†С–С—.

    РџСЂР°РІРёР»Р°:
    - Р»РѕРєР°С†С–СЏ РјРѕР±Р° РјР°С” Р±СѓС‚Рё РІС–РґРєСЂРёС‚Р°;
    - СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ РјРѕР±Р° РІ РґС–Р°РїР°Р·РѕРЅС– player_level В± 1;
    - min_player_level РјРѕР±Р° РјР°С” Р±СѓС‚Рё <= player_level.
    """

    unlocked_locations = get_unlocked_location_ids(player_level)

    available = []

    for mob in ALL_MOBS:
        mob_level = int(mob.get("level", 1))
        min_player_level = int(mob.get("min_player_level", 1))
        location_id = mob.get("location_id", "start_path")

        if location_id not in unlocked_locations:
            continue

        if min_player_level <= player_level and player_level - 1 <= mob_level <= player_level + 1:
            available.append(mob)

    if available:
        return available

    fallback = []

    for mob in ALL_MOBS:
        min_player_level = int(mob.get("min_player_level", 1))
        location_id = mob.get("location_id", "start_path")

        if location_id not in unlocked_locations:
            continue

        if min_player_level <= player_level:
            fallback.append(mob)

    return fallback


def choose_random_contract_mob(player_level):
    available_mobs = get_available_contract_mobs(player_level)

    if not available_mobs:
        return None

    return random.choice(available_mobs)

def register_contract_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ“њ РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё")
    def show_contracts(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "рџ“њ РўРё РїС–РґС–Р№С€РѕРІ РґРѕ РґРѕС€РєРё РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚С–РІ.",
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_take")
    def take_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        status = get_contract_status(user_id)

        if not status["exists"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                status["message"],
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        if not status["unlocked"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                (
                    f"рџ”’ РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё РІС–РґРєСЂРёСЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ Р· 5 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ.\n"
                    f"рџ‘¤ РўРІС–Р№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ: {status['level']}"
                ),
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        chosen_mob = choose_random_contract_mob(status["level"])

        if not chosen_mob:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ Р·РЅР°Р№С‚Рё РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРѕРіРѕ РјРѕР±Р° РґР»СЏ РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Сѓ.",
                reply_markup=contracts_kb()
            )
            return

        target_mob_name = chosen_mob.get("name", "РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјР° С–СЃС‚РѕС‚Р°")
        target_mob_level = int(chosen_mob.get("level", status["level"]))

        result = create_daily_contract(
            user_id=user_id,
            target_mob_name=target_mob_name,
            target_mob_level=target_mob_level
        )

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_claim")
    def claim_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        result = claim_contract_reward(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "contract_abandon")
    def abandon_contract(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        result = abandon_active_contract(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=contracts_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_contracts_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

def build_daily_quest_text(user_id):

    if not status["exists"]:
        return status["message"], None

    target_count = status["target_count"]
    completed = status["completed"]
    reward_claimed = status["reward_claimed"]

    text = (
        "рџ“† Р©РѕРґРµРЅРЅРµ Р·Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ\n\n"
        "РњС–СЃС†РµРІС– Р¶РёС‚РµР»С– РїРѕС‚СЂРµР±СѓСЋС‚СЊ РґРѕРїРѕРјРѕРіРё Сѓ Р±РѕСЂРѕС‚СЊР±С– Р· РјРѕРЅСЃС‚СЂР°РјРё.\n\n"
        "рџЋЇ Р¦С–Р»СЊ:\n"
        f"Р’Р±РёС‚Рё {target_count} РјРѕРЅСЃС‚СЂС–РІ\n\n"
        "рџ“€ РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ:\n"
        f"{progress}/{target_count}\n\n"
        "рџЋЃ РќР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґР°:\n"
        "рџ”ґ РњР°Р»Рµ Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ Р·РґРѕСЂРѕРІвЂ™СЏ Г—3\n"
    )

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    if reward_claimed:
        text += "\nвњ… РќР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґСѓ Р·Р° СЃСЊРѕРіРѕРґРЅС– РІР¶Рµ РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°РЅРѕ."
        return text, kb

    if completed:
        text += "\nвњ… Р—Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ РІРёРєРѕРЅР°РЅРѕ. РњРѕР¶РЅР° Р·Р°Р±СЂР°С‚Рё РЅР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґСѓ."

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="рџЋЃ РћС‚СЂРёРјР°С‚Рё РЅР°РіРѕСЂРѕРґСѓ",
            callback_data="daily_claim_reward"
        ))

        return text, kb

    text += "\nв„№пёЏ РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ Р·Р°СЂР°С…РѕРІСѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ Р·Р° РїРµСЂРµРјРѕРіСѓ РЅР°Рґ Р±СѓРґСЊ-СЏРєРёРј РјРѕРЅСЃС‚СЂРѕРј."

    return text, kb

def register_daily_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ“† Р©РѕРґРµРЅРЅРµ Р·Р°РІРґР°РЅРЅСЏ")
    def show_daily_quest(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        text, kb = build_daily_quest_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "рџЏ›пёЏ Р’Рё Р·РЅР°С…РѕРґРёС‚РµСЃСЊ Сѓ Р Р°С‚СѓС€С–.",
            reply_markup=townhall_kb()
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "daily_claim_reward")
    def claim_daily_reward(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        result = claim_daily_quest_reward(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"],
            reply_markup=townhall_kb()
        )

        text, kb = build_daily_quest_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["give"])
    def give_item(message):
        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        parts = message.text.split()

        if len(parts) < 2:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    "вќЊ Р¤РѕСЂРјР°С‚:\n"
                    "/give item_id [quantity]\n\n"
                    "РџСЂРёРєР»Р°Рґ:\n"
                    "/give 201 5"
                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        try:
            item_id = int(parts[1])
            quantity = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) >= 3 else 1
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "вќЊ item_id С– quantity РјР°СЋС‚СЊ Р±СѓС‚Рё С‡РёСЃР»Р°РјРё.",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        if quantity < 1:
            quantity = 1

        result = add_item(user_id, item_id, quantity)

        if not result.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                result.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РІРёРґР°С‚Рё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚."),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        text = (
            f"вњ… DEV: РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РІРёРґР°РЅРѕ.\n\n"
            f"рџ“¦ {result.get('name', 'РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚')} x{result.get('added', 0)}\n"
            f"рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР°: {result.get('used_slots', 0)}/{result.get('capacity', 20)}"
        )

        if result.get("lost", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\nвљ пёЏ РќРµ РІР»С–Р·Р»Рѕ: x{result.get('lost', 0)}"

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["progress"])

        kills = progress_data["kills"]

        energy_data = get_user_energy(user_id)
        energy = energy_data["energy"]
        max_energy = energy_data["max_energy"]

        percent = 0

        if exp_to_next > 0:
            percent = (exp / exp_to_next) * 100

        text = (
            f"рџ“Љ DEV Progress\n\n"
            f"рџЏ† Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {level}\n"
            f"вњЁ EXP: {exp}/{exp_to_next} ({percent:.2f}%)\n"
            f"рџґ Р’С‚РѕРјР°: {energy}/{max_energy}\n"
            f"рџЄ™ Р—РѕР»РѕС‚Рѕ: {gold:.2f}\n"
            f"рџ‘№ Р’Р±РёС‚Рѕ РјРѕР±С–РІ: {kills}"
        )

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

        rarity_input = parts[1].lower()

                ),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        try:
            item_level = int(level_input)
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "вќЊ Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РјР°С” Р±СѓС‚Рё С‡РёСЃР»РѕРј.",
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        if item_level < 1:
            item_level = 1

        if item_level > 30:
            item_level = 30

        result = create_generated_equipment_item(

            item_level=item_level,
            rarity=rarity
        )

        if not result.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(

                result.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРёС‚Рё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚."),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        rarity_icon = {
            "common": "вљЄ",
            "uncommon": "рџџў",
            "rare": "рџ”µ",
            "epic": "рџџЈ"
        }.get(rarity, "вљЄ")

        text = (
            f"вњ… DEV: Р·РіРµРЅРµСЂРѕРІР°РЅРѕ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ.\n\n"

        if not DEV_MODE:
            return

        user_id = message.from_user.id
        parts = message.text.split()

        quantity = 1

        if len(parts) >= 2:
            try:
                quantity = int(parts[1])
            except Exception:
                quantity = 1

        if quantity < 1:
            quantity = 1

        if quantity > 10:
            quantity = 10

        seed_class_reset_sphere_item()

        result = add_item(
            user_id=user_id,
            item_id=CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID,
            quantity=quantity
        )

        if not result.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                result.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РІРёРґР°С‚Рё РЎС„РµСЂСѓ РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ С€Р»СЏС…Сѓ."),
                reply_markup=main_kb()
            )
            return

        text = (
            f"вњ… DEV: РІРёРґР°РЅРѕ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ Р·РјС–РЅРё РєР»Р°СЃСѓ.\n\n"
            f"рџ”® РЎС„РµСЂР° РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ С€Р»СЏС…Сѓ x{result.get('added', quantity)}\n"
            f"рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР°: {result.get('used_slots', 0)}/{result.get('capacity', 40)}"
        )

        if result.get("lost", 0) > 0:
            text += f"\nвљ пёЏ РќРµ РІР»С–Р·Р»Рѕ: x{result.get('lost', 0)}"

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

def guild_list_kb(user_id, page=0):
    rows = get_public_guild_list(limit=GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE + 1, offset=page * GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE)
    shown = rows[:GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE]

    kb = types.ReplyKeyboardMarkup(resize_keyboard=True)
    buttons = {}

    for guild in shown:
        member_count = guild["member_count"] if "member_count" in guild.keys() else get_guild_member_count(guild["id"])
        label = f"рџЏ° [{guild['tag']}] {guild['name']} ({member_count}/{guild['member_limit']})"
        # Telegram buttons should not be too long.
        if len(label) > 60:
            label = label[:57] + "..."
        buttons[label] = guild["id"]
        kb.add(label)

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС– РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
    if len(rows) > GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE:
        nav.append("вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС– РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
    if nav:
        kb.add(*nav)

    kb.add("рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№")

    GUILD_BROWSE_STATE[user_id] = {
        "page": page,
        "buttons": buttons,
        "selected_guild_id": None,
    }

    return kb

def validate_guild_name_for_ui(name):
    name = (name or "").strip()

    if len(name) < 3:
        return False, "вќЊ РќР°Р·РІР° РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РјР°С” РјС–СЃС‚РёС‚Рё РјС–РЅС–РјСѓРј 3 СЃРёРјРІРѕР»Рё."
    if len(name) > 32:
        return False, "вќЊ РќР°Р·РІР° РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РјР°С” Р±СѓС‚Рё РЅРµ РґРѕРІС€Р° Р·Р° 32 СЃРёРјРІРѕР»Рё."
    if get_guild_by_name_or_tag(name):
        return False, "вќЊ Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ Р· С‚Р°РєРѕСЋ РЅР°Р·РІРѕСЋ Р°Р±Рѕ Р°Р±СЂРµРІС–Р°С‚СѓСЂРѕСЋ РІР¶Рµ С–СЃРЅСѓС”."

    return True, name


def validate_guild_tag_for_ui(tag):
    tag = normalize_guild_tag_input(tag)

    if len(tag) < 2:
        return False, "вќЊ РђР±СЂРµРІС–Р°С‚СѓСЂР° РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РјР°С” РјС–СЃС‚РёС‚Рё РјС–РЅС–РјСѓРј 2 СЃРёРјРІРѕР»Рё."
    if len(tag) > 5:
        return False, "вќЊ РђР±СЂРµРІС–Р°С‚СѓСЂР° РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РјР°С” Р±СѓС‚Рё РЅРµ РґРѕРІС€Р° Р·Р° 5 СЃРёРјРІРѕР»С–РІ."

    allowed = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789РђР‘Р’Р“ТђР”Р•Р„Р–Р—РР†Р‡Р™РљР›РњРќРћРџР РЎРўРЈР¤РҐР¦Р§РЁР©Р¬Р®РЇ"
    if any(ch not in allowed for ch in tag):
        return False, "вќЊ РђР±СЂРµРІС–Р°С‚СѓСЂР° РјРѕР¶Рµ РјС–СЃС‚РёС‚Рё С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё Р»С–С‚РµСЂРё С‚Р° С†РёС„СЂРё."
    if get_guild_by_name_or_tag(tag):
        return False, "вќЊ Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ Р· С‚Р°РєРѕСЋ РЅР°Р·РІРѕСЋ Р°Р±Рѕ Р°Р±СЂРµРІС–Р°С‚СѓСЂРѕСЋ РІР¶Рµ С–СЃРЅСѓС”."

    return True, tag

def format_ua_date(value):
    value = str(value or "").strip()
    if not value:
        return "РЅРµРІС–РґРѕРјРѕ"
    try:
        date_part = value.split("T", 1)[0].split(" ", 1)[0]
        year, month, day = date_part.split("-", 2)
        return f"{day}.{month}.{year}"
    except Exception:
        return value

def build_guild_info_text(user_id):
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)

    if not guild:
        return "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    guild_name = get_guild_display_name(guild)
    member_count = get_guild_member_count(guild["id"])
    season_key = get_current_guild_season_key()

    # Try to get leader name.
    leader_name = f"user_id={guild['leader_user_id']}"
    try:
        from db import cursor
        cursor.execute("SELECT character_name FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (guild["leader_user_id"],))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if row:
            try:
                leader_name = row["character_name"] or leader_name
            except Exception:
                leader_name = row[0] or leader_name
    except Exception:
        pass

    return (
        f"в„№пёЏ Р†РЅС„РѕСЂРјР°С†С–СЏ РїСЂРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ\n\n"
        f"{guild_name}\n"
        f"Р“РѕР»РѕРІР°: {leader_name}\n"
        f"Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {guild['level']}\n"
        f"РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё: {member_count}/{guild['member_limit']}\n"
        f"РЎС‚РІРѕСЂРµРЅРѕ: {format_ua_date(guild['created_at'])}\n\n"
        f"РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРёР№ СЃРµР·РѕРЅ: {season_key}\n"
        f"РњС–СЃСЏС‡РЅРёР№ score: {guild['monthly_score']}\n"
        f"All-time score: {guild['total_score']}"
    )


def build_guild_members_text(user_id):
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)

    if not guild:
        return "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    members = get_guild_members(guild["id"])
    guild_name = get_guild_display_name(guild)

    if not members:
        return f"рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё\n\n{guild_name}\n\nРЎРїРёСЃРѕРє СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ РїРѕСЂРѕР¶РЅС–Р№."

    text = f"рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё\n\n{guild_name}\n\n"

    for index, member in enumerate(members, start=1):
        character_name = member["character_name"] or f"user_id={member['user_id']}"
        level = member["level"] or "?"
        role_label = get_guild_role_label(member["role"])
        score = member["contribution_score"] or 0
        monthly_score = member["monthly_contribution_score"] or 0
        text += (
            f"{index}. {role_label} {character_name}\n"
            f"   Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {level} | Score: {score} | РњС–СЃСЏС†СЊ: {monthly_score}\n"
        )

    return text.strip()


def build_guild_ranking_text(scope="monthly"):
    init_guild_system()

    if scope == "total":
        title = "рџЏ† Р РµР№С‚РёРЅРі РіС–Р»СЊРґС–Р№ Р·Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ"
    else:
        title = f"рџЏ† РњС–СЃСЏС‡РЅРёР№ СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРі РіС–Р»СЊРґС–Р№ ({get_current_guild_season_key()})"

    rows = get_guild_ranking(scope=scope, limit=GUILD_RANKING_LIMIT)

    if not rows:
        return f"{title}\n\nРџРѕРєРё РЅРµРјР°С” Р¶РѕРґРЅРѕС— РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    text = f"{title}\n\n"
    for index, guild in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        name = get_guild_display_name(guild)
        if scope == "total":
            score = guild["total_score"] or 0
            exp = guild["total_exp"] or 0
            resource = guild["total_resource"] or 0
        else:
            score = guild["monthly_score"] or 0
            exp = guild["monthly_exp"] or 0
            resource = guild["monthly_resource"] or 0
        text += (
            f"{index}. {name}\n"
            f"   Score: {score} | EXP: {exp} | Р РµСЃСѓСЂСЃ: {resource}\n"
        )

    return text.strip()

            "рџ“њ РЎРїРёСЃРѕРє РіС–Р»СЊРґС–Р№\n\n"
            "РџРѕРєРё РЅРµРјР°С” Р¶РѕРґРЅРѕС— РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—.\n\n"
            "РўРё РјРѕР¶РµС€ СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРёС‚Рё РїРµСЂС€Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ Сѓ Р—Р°Р»С– Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№."
        )

    text = f"рџ“њ РЎРїРёСЃРѕРє РіС–Р»СЊРґС–Р№\n\nРЎС‚РѕСЂС–РЅРєР°: {page + 1}\n\n"

    for index, guild in enumerate(shown, start=1 + page * GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE):
        member_count = guild["member_count"] if "member_count" in guild.keys() else get_guild_member_count(guild["id"])
        text += (
            f"{index}. {get_guild_display_name(guild)}\n"
            f"   Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {guild['level']} | РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё: {member_count}/{guild['member_limit']}\n"
            f"   РњС–СЃСЏС†СЊ score: {guild['monthly_score']} | All-time: {guild['total_score']}\n"
        )

    text += "\nРћР±РµСЂРё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕСЋ РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ, С‰РѕР± РїРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРЅСѓС‚Рё РґРµС‚Р°Р»С– Р°Р±Рѕ РїРѕРґР°С‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ."
    return text.strip()


def build_guild_detail_text(user_id, guild_id):
    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)
    if not guild:
        return "вќЊ Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."

    member_count = get_guild_member_count(guild_id)
    pending_text = ""

    if not get_user_guild(user_id) and has_pending_guild_application(user_id, guild_id):
        pending_text = "\n\nв„№пёЏ РўРё РІР¶Рµ РїРѕРґР°РІ Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ РІ С†СЋ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ."

    return (
        f"рџЏ° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ\n\n"
        f"{get_guild_display_name(guild)}\n"
        f"Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {guild['level']}\n"
        f"РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё: {member_count}/{guild['member_limit']}\n"
        f"РЎС‚РІРѕСЂРµРЅРѕ: {format_ua_date(guild['created_at'])}\n\n"
        f"РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРёР№ СЃРµР·РѕРЅ:\n"
        f"вЂў EXP: {guild['monthly_exp']}\n"
        f"вЂў Р РµСЃСѓСЂСЃ: {guild['monthly_resource']}\n"
        f"вЂў Score: {guild['monthly_score']}\n\n"
        f"Р—Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ:\n"
        f"вЂў EXP: {guild['total_exp']}\n"
        f"вЂў Р РµСЃСѓСЂСЃ: {guild['total_resource']}\n"
        f"вЂў Score: {guild['total_score']}"
        f"{pending_text}"
    )


def build_my_applications_text(user_id):
    apps = get_user_guild_applications(user_id)

    if not apps:
        return "рџ“Ё РњРѕС— Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё\n\nРЈ С‚РµР±Рµ РЅРµРјР°С” Р·Р°СЏРІРѕРє РґРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–Р№."

    status_labels = {
        "pending": "вЏі РѕС‡С–РєСѓС”",
        "accepted": "вњ… РїСЂРёР№РЅСЏС‚Р°",
        "rejected": "вќЊ РІС–РґС…РёР»РµРЅР°",
        "cancelled": "рџљ« СЃРєР°СЃРѕРІР°РЅР°",
    }

    text = "рџ“Ё РњРѕС— Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё\n\n"
    for index, app in enumerate(apps, start=1):
        icon = app["guild_icon"] or "рџЏ°"
        tag = app["guild_tag"] or "???"
        name = app["guild_name"] or "Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ"
        status = status_labels.get(app["status"], app["status"])
        text += f"{index}. {icon} [{tag}] {name}\n   РЎС‚Р°С‚СѓСЃ: {status}\n"

    return text.strip()

# ==============================
# SEND HELPERS
# ==============================

def open_guild_hall(bot, chat_id, user_id):
    reset_guild_browse_state(user_id)
    bot.send_message(chat_id, build_guild_hall_text(user_id), reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(user_id))


def send_guild_section(bot, message, text):
    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id))


def send_city(bot, message):
    from handlers.city import build_city_text
    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_city_text(message.from_user.id), reply_markup=city_kb())


def send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, text):
    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=guild_create_cancel_kb())


def show_guild_list(bot, message, page=0):
    text = build_guild_list_text(message.from_user.id, page)
    kb = guild_list_kb(message.from_user.id, page)
    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)


def show_guild_detail(bot, message, guild_id):
    set_selected_guild(message.from_user.id, guild_id)
    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        build_guild_detail_text(message.from_user.id, guild_id),
        reply_markup=guild_detail_kb(message.from_user.id, guild_id)
    )


# ==============================
# CREATE FLOW
# ==============================

def start_guild_creation(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    init_guild_system()

    if get_user_guild(user_id):
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ РўРё РІР¶Рµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—.", reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(user_id))
        return

    start_guild_create_state(user_id)
    send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, build_guild_create_name_prompt())


def handle_guild_creation_message(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()
    state = get_guild_create_state(user_id)

    if not state:
        return False

    if text in ["вќЊ РЎРєР°СЃСѓРІР°С‚Рё СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРµРЅРЅСЏ", "рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№", "рџ”™ РњС–СЃС‚Рѕ"]:
        reset_guild_create_state(user_id)
        if text == "рџ”™ РњС–СЃС‚Рѕ":
            send_city(bot, message)
        else:
            open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        return True

    if text == "вњЏпёЏ РџРѕС‡Р°С‚Рё Р·Р°РЅРѕРІРѕ":
        start_guild_create_state(user_id)
        send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, build_guild_create_name_prompt())
        return True

    step = state.get("step")

    if step == "name":
        ok, result = validate_guild_name_for_ui(text)
        if not ok:
            send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, result + "\n\nРЎРїСЂРѕР±СѓР№ РІРІРµСЃС‚Рё С–РЅС€Сѓ РЅР°Р·РІСѓ.")
            return True
        state["name"] = result
        state["step"] = "tag"
        send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, build_guild_create_tag_prompt(state["name"]))
        return True

    if step == "tag":
        ok, result = validate_guild_tag_for_ui(text)
        if not ok:
            send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, result + "\n\nРЎРїСЂРѕР±СѓР№ РІРІРµСЃС‚Рё С–РЅС€РёР№ TAG.")
            return True
        state["tag"] = result
        state["step"] = "icon"
        send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, build_guild_create_icon_prompt(state["name"], state["tag"]))
        return True

    if step == "icon":
        ok, result = validate_guild_icon_for_ui(text)
        if not ok:
            send_guild_create_prompt(bot, message, result + "\n\nРЎРїСЂРѕР±СѓР№ РЅР°РґС–СЃР»Р°С‚Рё РѕРґРёРЅ emoji.")
            return True
        state["icon"] = result
        state["step"] = "confirm"
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_guild_create_confirm_text(state), reply_markup=guild_create_confirm_kb())
        return True

    if step == "confirm":
        if text != "вњ… РЎС‚РІРѕСЂРёС‚Рё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ":
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "РќР°С‚РёСЃРЅРё вњ… РЎС‚РІРѕСЂРёС‚Рё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ Р°Р±Рѕ СЃРєР°СЃСѓР№ СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРµРЅРЅСЏ.", reply_markup=guild_create_confirm_kb())
            return True

        result = create_guild(user_id=user_id, name=state.get("name", ""), tag=state.get("tag", ""), icon=state.get("icon", "рџЏ°"))
        reset_guild_create_state(user_id)

        if result.get("success"):
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", "вњ… Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРµРЅРѕ."), reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(user_id))
            open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        else:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРёС‚Рё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ."), reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(user_id))
        return True

    return False


# ==============================
# LIST / APPLICATION FLOW
# ==============================

def handle_guild_list_message(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()
    state = get_guild_browse_state(user_id)

    if not state:
        return False

    if text == "в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС– РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—":
        show_guild_list(bot, message, max(0, state.get("page", 0) - 1))
        return True

    if text == "вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС– РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—":
        show_guild_list(bot, message, state.get("page", 0) + 1)
        return True

    if text == "рџ“њ РџРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРЅСѓС‚Рё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—":
        show_guild_list(bot, message, state.get("page", 0))
        return True

    if text == "рџ“Ё РџРѕРґР°С‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ":
        guild_id = state.get("selected_guild_id")
        if not guild_id:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ Р·С– СЃРїРёСЃРєСѓ.", reply_markup=guild_list_kb(user_id, state.get("page", 0)))
            return True

        result = create_guild_application(user_id=user_id, guild_id=guild_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", ""), reply_markup=guild_detail_kb(user_id, guild_id))
        show_guild_detail(bot, message, guild_id)
        return True

    buttons = state.get("buttons", {})
    if text in buttons:
        show_guild_detail(bot, message, buttons[text])
        return True

    return False


# ==============================
# HANDLERS
# ==============================

def register_guild_handlers(bot):
    init_guild_system()

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: get_guild_create_state(message.from_user.id) is not None)
    def guild_creation_state_message(message):
        handle_guild_creation_message(bot, message)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: get_guild_browse_state(message.from_user.id) is not None)
    def guild_browse_state_message(message):
        if not handle_guild_list_message(bot, message):
            # вњ… GUILD BROWSE PASS THROUGH MEMBERS V1
            if message.text == "рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё":
                reset_guild_browse_state(message.from_user.id)
                show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)
                return
            if message.text == "рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё":
                reset_guild_browse_state(message.from_user.id)
                show_guild_applications(bot, message)
                return
            if message.text == "рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№":
                reset_guild_browse_state(message.from_user.id)
                open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, message.from_user.id)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџЏ° Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№")
    def guild_hall_message(message):
        open_guild_hall(bot=bot, chat_id=message.chat.id, user_id=message.from_user.id)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№")
    def guild_back_to_hall_message(message):
        reset_guild_create_state(message.from_user.id)
        reset_guild_browse_state(message.from_user.id)
        open_guild_hall(bot=bot, chat_id=message.chat.id, user_id=message.from_user.id)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ”™ РњС–СЃС‚Рѕ")
    def guild_back_to_city_message(message):
        reset_guild_create_state(message.from_user.id)
        reset_guild_browse_state(message.from_user.id)
        send_city(bot, message)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "в„№пёЏ Р†РЅС„РѕСЂРјР°С†С–СЏ")
    def guild_info_message(message):
        send_guild_section(bot, message, build_guild_info_text(message.from_user.id))

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё")
    def guild_members_message(message):
        show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)
        # вњ… GUILD MEMBERS OLD HANDLER REPLACED V1

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџЏ† РњС–СЃСЏС‡РЅРёР№ СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРі")
    def guild_monthly_ranking_message(message):
        send_guild_section(bot, message, build_guild_ranking_text("monthly"))

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџЏ† Р РµР№С‚РёРЅРі Р·Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ")
    def guild_total_ranking_message(message):
        send_guild_section(bot, message, build_guild_ranking_text("total"))

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџЏ—пёЏ РЎС‚РІРѕСЂРёС‚Рё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ")
    def guild_create_start_message(message):
        start_guild_creation(bot, message)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ“њ РџРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРЅСѓС‚Рё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
    def guild_list_message(message):
        show_guild_list(bot, message, 0)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ“Ё РњРѕС— Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё")
    def guild_my_applications_message(message):
        send_guild_section(bot, message, build_my_applications_text(message.from_user.id))

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё")
    def guild_applications_message(message):
        show_guild_applications(bot, message)

    def guild_logs_message(message):

# Override UI icon validation: С–РєРѕРЅРєР° РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РјР°С” Р±СѓС‚Рё СѓРЅС–РєР°Р»СЊРЅР°.


def validate_guild_icon_for_ui(icon):
    icon = (icon or "").strip() or "рџЏ°"

    # Telegram emoji may be several codepoints, so only prevent very long text.
    if len(icon) > 4:
        return False, "вќЊ Р†РєРѕРЅРєР° РјР°С” Р±СѓС‚Рё РєРѕСЂРѕС‚РєРѕСЋ. РќР°Р№РєСЂР°С‰Рµ вЂ” РѕРґРёРЅ emoji."

    try:
        from db import is_guild_icon_taken
        if is_guild_icon_taken(icon):
            return False, "вќЊ РўР°РєР° С–РєРѕРЅРєР° РІР¶Рµ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ С–РЅС€РѕСЋ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С”СЋ. РћР±РµСЂРё С–РЅС€Сѓ С–РєРѕРЅРєСѓ."
    except Exception:
        pass

    return True, icon

GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE = 8


def _guild_row_get(row, key, fallback=None):
    try:
        return row[key]
    except Exception:
        return fallback


def guild_list_kb(user_id, page=0):
    rows = get_public_guild_list(
        limit=GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE + 1,
        offset=page * GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE
    )
    shown = rows[:GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE]

    kb = types.ReplyKeyboardMarkup(resize_keyboard=True)
    buttons = {}

    for guild in shown:
        guild_id = _guild_row_get(guild, "id")
        icon = _guild_row_get(guild, "icon", "рџЏ°") or "рџЏ°"
        tag = _guild_row_get(guild, "tag", "???") or "???"
        name = _guild_row_get(guild, "name", "Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ") or "Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ"
        member_limit = _guild_row_get(guild, "member_limit", 30) or 30

        try:
            member_count = guild["member_count"]
        except Exception:
            member_count = get_guild_member_count(guild_id)

        label = f"{icon} [{tag}] {name} ({member_count}/{member_limit})"

        # Telegram reply buttons should not be too long.
        if len(label) > 60:
            label = label[:57] + "..."

        buttons[label] = guild_id
        kb.add(label)

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС– РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
    if len(rows) > GUILD_LIST_PAGE_SIZE:
        nav.append("вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС– РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
    if nav:
        kb.add(*nav)

    kb.add("рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№")

    GUILD_BROWSE_STATE[user_id] = {
        "page": page,
        "buttons": buttons,
        "selected_guild_id": None,
    }

    return kb

def guild_applications_kb(user_id):

    apps = get_guild_applications(guild["id"], "pending")

    for app in apps:

        name = _app_row_get(app, "character_name") or f"user_id={_app_row_get(app, 'user_id')}"
        level = _app_row_get(app, "level") or "?"
        label = f"рџ‘¤ {name} | СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ {level}"
        if len(label) > 60:
            label = label[:57] + "..."
        buttons[label] = app_id
        kb.add(label)

    kb.add("рџ”„ РћРЅРѕРІРёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё")
    kb.add("рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№")

    GUILD_APPLICATION_REVIEW_STATE[user_id] = {
        "guild_id": guild["id"],
        "buttons": buttons,
        "selected_application_id": None,
    }

    return kb


def guild_application_detail_kb():
    kb = types.ReplyKeyboardMarkup(resize_keyboard=True)

def build_guild_applications_text(user_id):
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)

    if not guild:
        return "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    if not can_manage_guild_applications(user_id, guild["id"]):
        return "вќЊ РџРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРґР°С‚Рё С– РѕР±СЂРѕР±Р»СЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё РјРѕР¶СѓС‚СЊ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё рџ‘‘ Р“РѕР»РѕРІР° Р°Р±Рѕ рџ›Ў Р—Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРє."

    apps = get_guild_applications(guild["id"], "pending")
    guild_name = get_guild_display_name(guild)

    if not apps:
        return f"рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё РґРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—\n\n{guild_name}\n\nРђРєС‚РёРІРЅРёС… Р·Р°СЏРІРѕРє РЅРµРјР°С”."

    text = f"рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё РґРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—\n\n{guild_name}\n\n"

    for index, app in enumerate(apps, start=1):
        name = _app_row_get(app, "character_name") or f"user_id={_app_row_get(app, 'user_id')}"
        level = _app_row_get(app, "level") or "?"
        created_at = str(_app_row_get(app, "created_at", ""))[:10]
        text += f"{index}. {name}\n   Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {level} | РџРѕРґР°РЅРѕ: {created_at}\n"

    text += "\nРћР±РµСЂРё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕСЋ РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ."
    return text.strip()


def build_guild_application_detail_text(user_id, application_id):
    app = get_guild_application_by_id(application_id)

    if not app:
        return "вќЊ Р—Р°СЏРІРєСѓ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."

    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)

    if not guild or int(guild["id"]) != int(app["guild_id"]):
        return "вќЊ Р¦СЏ Р·Р°СЏРІРєР° РЅРµ РЅР°Р»РµР¶РёС‚СЊ С‚РІРѕС—Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    if not can_manage_guild_applications(user_id, guild["id"]):
        return "вќЊ РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ РЅРµРјР°С” РїСЂР°РІ РґР»СЏ РѕР±СЂРѕР±РєРё Р·Р°СЏРІРѕРє."

    name = f"user_id={app['user_id']}"
    level = "?"
    try:
        from db import cursor
        cursor.execute("SELECT character_name, level FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (app["user_id"],))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if row:
            try:
                name = row["character_name"] or name
                level = row["level"] or "?"
            except Exception:
                name = row[0] or name
                level = row[1] or "?"
    except Exception:
        pass

    return (
        "рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєР° РґРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—\n\n"
        f"Р“СЂР°РІРµС†СЊ: {name}\n"
        f"Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {level}\n"
        f"РЎС‚Р°С‚СѓСЃ: {app['status']}\n"
        f"РџРѕРґР°РЅРѕ: {str(app['created_at'])[:10]}\n\n"
        "РћР±РµСЂРё РґС–СЋ: РїСЂРёР№РЅСЏС‚Рё Р°Р±Рѕ РІС–РґС…РёР»РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ."
    )


def show_guild_applications(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = build_guild_applications_text(user_id)
    kb = guild_applications_kb(user_id)
    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)


def show_guild_application_detail(bot, message, application_id):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    state = GUILD_APPLICATION_REVIEW_STATE.setdefault(user_id, {"buttons": {}, "selected_application_id": None})
    state["selected_application_id"] = application_id

    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        build_guild_application_detail_text(user_id, application_id),
        reply_markup=guild_application_detail_kb()
    )


def handle_guild_application_review_message(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()
    state = get_guild_application_review_state(user_id)

    if not state:
        return False

    if text == "рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№":
        reset_guild_application_review_state(user_id)
        open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        return True

    if text in ["рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё", "рџ”„ РћРЅРѕРІРёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё"]:
        show_guild_applications(bot, message)
        return True

    buttons = state.get("buttons", {})
    if text in buttons:
        show_guild_application_detail(bot, message, buttons[text])
        return True

    if text in ["вњ… РџСЂРёР№РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ", "вќЊ Р’С–РґС…РёР»РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ"]:
        application_id = state.get("selected_application_id")
        if not application_id:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ Р·С– СЃРїРёСЃРєСѓ.", reply_markup=guild_applications_kb(user_id))
            return True

        if text == "вњ… РџСЂРёР№РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ":
            result = accept_guild_application(user_id, application_id)
        else:
            result = reject_guild_application(user_id, application_id)

        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", ""), reply_markup=guild_applications_kb(user_id))
        show_guild_applications(bot, message)
        return True

    return False


# Patch register_guild_handlers by wrapping the existing function.
try:
    _base_register_guild_handlers_before_application_review_v1 = register_guild_handlers
except Exception:
    _base_register_guild_handlers_before_application_review_v1 = None


def register_guild_handlers(bot):
    if _base_register_guild_handlers_before_application_review_v1 is not None:
        _base_register_guild_handlers_before_application_review_v1(bot)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: get_guild_application_review_state(message.from_user.id) is not None)
    def guild_application_review_state_message(message):
        # вњ… GUILD APPLICATION PASS THROUGH MEMBERS V1
        if message.text == "рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё":
            reset_guild_application_review_state(message.from_user.id)
            show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)
            return
        handle_guild_application_review_message(bot, message)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё")
    def guild_applications_message_v2(message):
        show_guild_applications(bot, message)

def _member_row_get(row, key, fallback=None):
    try:
        return row[key]
    except Exception:
        return fallback


def can_actor_manage_target(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if not actor_member or not target_member:
        return False

    if int(actor_member["guild_id"]) != int(target_member["guild_id"]):
        return False

    if int(actor_user_id) == int(target_user_id):
        return False

    if actor_member["role"] == "leader":
        return target_member["role"] != "leader"

    if actor_member["role"] == "officer":
        return target_member["role"] == "member"

    return False

        role_label = get_guild_role_label(_member_row_get(member, "role"))
        label = f"рџ‘¤ {name} | {role_label} | СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ {level}"

        buttons[label] = target_user_id

    kb.add("рџ”„ РћРЅРѕРІРёС‚Рё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ")
