def guild_member_detail_kb(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    kb = types.ReplyKeyboardMarkup(resize_keyboard=True)
    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if actor_member and target_member and int(actor_member["guild_id"]) == int(target_member["guild_id"]):
        if actor_member["role"] == "leader" and int(actor_user_id) != int(target_user_id):
            if target_member["role"] == "member":
                kb.add("рџ›Ў РџСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєРѕРј")
            elif target_member["role"] == "officer":
                kb.add("рџ‘¤ Р—РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР°")
            if target_member["role"] != "leader":
                kb.add("рџљЄ Р’РёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
        elif actor_member["role"] == "officer" and target_member["role"] == "member":
            kb.add("рџљЄ Р’РёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")

    kb.add("рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё")
    kb.add("рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№")
    return kb


def build_guild_member_manage_text(user_id):
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)

    if not guild:
        return "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    members = get_guild_members(guild["id"])
    guild_name = get_guild_display_name(guild)

    if not members:
        return f"рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё\n\n{guild_name}\n\nРЎРїРёСЃРѕРє СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ РїРѕСЂРѕР¶РЅС–Р№."

    text = f"рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё\n\n{guild_name}\n\n"

    for index, member in enumerate(members, start=1):
        target_user_id = _member_row_get(member, "user_id")
        name = _member_row_get(member, "character_name") or f"user_id={target_user_id}"
        level = _member_row_get(member, "level") or "?"
        role_label = get_guild_role_label(_member_row_get(member, "role"))
        score = _member_row_get(member, "contribution_score", 0) or 0
        monthly_score = _member_row_get(member, "monthly_contribution_score", 0) or 0
        text += (
            f"{index}. {role_label} {name}\n"
            f"   Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {level} | Score: {score} | РњС–СЃСЏС†СЊ: {monthly_score}\n"
        )

    text += "\nРћР±РµСЂРё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР° РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕСЋ РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ, С‰РѕР± РїРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРЅСѓС‚Рё РґС–С—."
    return text.strip()


def build_guild_member_detail_text(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if not actor_member or not target_member:
        return "вќЊ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."

    if int(actor_member["guild_id"]) != int(target_member["guild_id"]):
        return "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРє РЅРµ РЅР°Р»РµР¶РёС‚СЊ С‚РІРѕС—Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    guild = get_guild_by_id(target_member["guild_id"])
    name = f"user_id={target_user_id}"
    level = "?"

    try:
        from db import cursor
        cursor.execute("SELECT character_name, level FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (target_user_id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if row:
            try:
                name = row["character_name"] or name
                level = row["level"] or "?"
            except Exception:
                name = row[0] or name
                level = row[1] or "?"
    except Exception:
        pass

    role_label = get_guild_role_label(target_member["role"])
    joined_at = str(target_member["joined_at"] or "")[:10]

    available = []
    if actor_member["role"] == "leader" and int(actor_user_id) != int(target_user_id):
        if target_member["role"] == "member":
            available.append("вЂў рџ›Ў РџСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєРѕРј")
        elif target_member["role"] == "officer":
            available.append("вЂў рџ‘¤ Р—РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР°")
        if target_member["role"] != "leader":
            available.append("вЂў рџљЄ Р’РёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
    elif actor_member["role"] == "officer" and target_member["role"] == "member":
        available.append("вЂў рџљЄ Р’РёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")

    actions_text = "\n".join(available) if available else "РќРµРјР°С” РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёС… РґС–Р№."

    return (
        f"рџ‘¤ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРє РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—\n\n"
        f"Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ: {get_guild_display_name(guild)}\n"
        f"Р†РјКјСЏ: {name}\n"
        f"Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {level}\n"
        f"Р РѕР»СЊ: {role_label}\n"
        f"Р’СЃС‚СѓРїРёРІ: {joined_at}\n\n"
        f"Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє Р·Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ: {target_member['contribution_score']}\n"
        f"Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє Р·Р° РјС–СЃСЏС†СЊ: {target_member['monthly_contribution_score']}\n\n"
        f"Р”РѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅС– РґС–С—:\n{actions_text}"
    )


def show_guild_members_manage(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        build_guild_member_manage_text(user_id),
        reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id)
    )


def show_guild_member_detail(bot, message, target_user_id):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    state = GUILD_MEMBER_MANAGE_STATE.setdefault(user_id, {"buttons": {}, "selected_user_id": None})
    state["selected_user_id"] = target_user_id

    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        build_guild_member_detail_text(user_id, target_user_id),
        reply_markup=guild_member_detail_kb(user_id, target_user_id)
    )


def refresh_selected_member_or_list(bot, message):
    state = get_guild_member_manage_state(message.from_user.id)
    target_user_id = state.get("selected_user_id") if state else None
    if target_user_id and get_user_guild_member(target_user_id):
        show_guild_member_detail(bot, message, target_user_id)
    else:
        show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)


def handle_guild_member_manage_message(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()
    state = get_guild_member_manage_state(user_id)

    if not state:
        return False

    if text == "рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№":
        reset_guild_member_manage_state(user_id)
        open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        return True

    if text in ["рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё", "рџ”„ РћРЅРѕРІРёС‚Рё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ"]:
        show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)
        return True

    buttons = state.get("buttons", {})
    if text in buttons:
        show_guild_member_detail(bot, message, buttons[text])
        return True

    selected_user_id = state.get("selected_user_id")

    if text == "рџ›Ў РџСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєРѕРј":
        if not selected_user_id:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР°.", reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
            return True
        result = promote_guild_member_to_officer(user_id, selected_user_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", ""), reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
        refresh_selected_member_or_list(bot, message)
        return True

    if text == "рџ‘¤ Р—РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР°":
        if not selected_user_id:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР°.", reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
            return True
        result = demote_guild_officer(user_id, selected_user_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", ""), reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
        refresh_selected_member_or_list(bot, message)
        return True

    if text == "рџљЄ Р’РёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—":
        if not selected_user_id:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР°.", reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
            return True
        result = kick_guild_member(user_id, selected_user_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", ""), reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
        show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)
        return True

    return False

def register_guild_handlers(bot):
    if _base_register_guild_handlers_before_members_roles_v1 is not None:
        _base_register_guild_handlers_before_members_roles_v1(bot)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: get_guild_member_manage_state(message.from_user.id) is not None)
    def guild_member_manage_state_message(message):
        handle_guild_member_manage_message(bot, message)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё")
    def guild_members_message_v2(message):
        show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)

def _guild_format_ua_date_v2(value):
    value = str(value or "").strip()
    if not value:
        return "РЅРµРІС–РґРѕРјРѕ"
    try:
        date_part = value.split("T", 1)[0].split(" ", 1)[0]
        year, month, day = date_part.split("-", 2)
        return f"{day}.{month}.{year}"
    except Exception:
        return value


def _guild_safe_reset_other_states_for_members_v2(user_id):
    try:
        reset_guild_browse_state(user_id)
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        reset_guild_application_review_state(user_id)
    except Exception:
        pass


def _guild_has_other_officer_v2(guild_id, target_user_id=None):
    try:
        officer = get_guild_officer_member(guild_id)
        if not officer:
            return False
        if target_user_id is None:
            return True
        return int(officer["user_id"]) != int(target_user_id)
    except Exception:
        return False


# Override date display for pending applications.
def build_guild_applications_text(user_id):
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)

    if not guild:
        return "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    if not can_manage_guild_applications(user_id, guild["id"]):
        return "вќЊ РџРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРґР°С‚Рё С– РѕР±СЂРѕР±Р»СЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё РјРѕР¶СѓС‚СЊ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё рџ‘‘ Р“РѕР»РѕРІР° Р°Р±Рѕ рџ›Ў Р—Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРє."

    apps = get_guild_applications(guild["id"], "pending")
    guild_name = get_guild_display_name(guild)

    if not apps:
        return f"рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё РґРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—\n\n{guild_name}\n\nРђРєС‚РёРІРЅРёС… Р·Р°СЏРІРѕРє РЅРµРјР°С”."

    text = f"рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё РґРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—\n\n{guild_name}\n\n"

    for index, app in enumerate(apps, start=1):
        name = _app_row_get(app, "character_name") or f"user_id={_app_row_get(app, 'user_id')}"
        level = _app_row_get(app, "level") or "?"
        created_at = _guild_format_ua_date_v2(_app_row_get(app, "created_at", ""))
        text += f"{index}. {name}\n   Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {level} | РџРѕРґР°РЅРѕ: {created_at}\n"

    text += "\nРћР±РµСЂРё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ РєРЅРѕРїРєРѕСЋ РЅРёР¶С‡Рµ."
    return text.strip()

    )


# Override member detail keyboard to enforce only one officer.
def guild_member_detail_kb(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    kb = types.ReplyKeyboardMarkup(resize_keyboard=True)
    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if actor_member and target_member and int(actor_member["guild_id"]) == int(target_member["guild_id"]):
        guild_id = actor_member["guild_id"]
        has_other_officer = _guild_has_other_officer_v2(guild_id, target_user_id)

        if actor_member["role"] == "leader" and int(actor_user_id) != int(target_user_id):
            if target_member["role"] == "member" and not has_other_officer:
                kb.add("рџ›Ў РџСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєРѕРј")
            elif target_member["role"] == "officer":
                kb.add("рџ‘¤ Р—РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР°")
            if target_member["role"] != "leader":
                kb.add("рџљЄ Р’РёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
        elif actor_member["role"] == "officer" and target_member["role"] == "member":
            kb.add("рџљЄ Р’РёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")

    kb.add("рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё")
    kb.add("рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№")
    return kb

        return True

    if text in ["рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё", "рџ”„ РћРЅРѕРІРёС‚Рё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ"]:
        show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)
        return True

    buttons = state.get("buttons", {})
    if text in buttons:
        show_guild_member_detail(bot, message, buttons[text])
        return True

    selected_user_id = state.get("selected_user_id")

    if text == "рџ›Ў РџСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєРѕРј":
        if not selected_user_id:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР°.", reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
            return True
        result = promote_guild_member_to_officer(user_id, selected_user_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", ""), reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
        refresh_selected_member_or_list(bot, message)
        return True

    if text == "рџ‘¤ Р—РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР°":
        if not selected_user_id:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР°.", reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
            return True
        result = demote_guild_officer(user_id, selected_user_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", ""), reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
        refresh_selected_member_or_list(bot, message)
        return True

    if text == "рџљЄ Р’РёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—":
        if not selected_user_id:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР°.", reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
            return True
        result = kick_guild_member(user_id, selected_user_id)
        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", ""), reply_markup=guild_members_manage_kb(user_id))
        show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)
        return True

    return False

# Override show_guild_applications to clean stale pending apps before display.
def show_guild_applications(bot, message):
    try:
        cleanup_stale_guild_applications()
    except Exception:
        pass

    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = build_guild_applications_text(user_id)
    kb = guild_applications_kb(user_id)
    bot.send_message(message.chat.id, text, reply_markup=kb)


# Override detailed application review handler with exception safety.
def handle_guild_application_review_message(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()
    state = get_guild_application_review_state(user_id)

    if not state:
        return False

    if text == "рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№":
        reset_guild_application_review_state(user_id)
        open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        return True

    if text in ["рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё", "рџ”„ РћРЅРѕРІРёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё"]:
        show_guild_applications(bot, message)
        return True

    buttons = state.get("buttons", {})
    if text in buttons:
        show_guild_application_detail(bot, message, buttons[text])
        return True

    if text in ["вњ… РџСЂРёР№РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ", "вќЊ Р’С–РґС…РёР»РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ"]:
        application_id = state.get("selected_application_id")
        if not application_id:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РѕР±РµСЂРё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ Р·С– СЃРїРёСЃРєСѓ.", reply_markup=guild_applications_kb(user_id))
            return True

        try:
            if text == "вњ… РџСЂРёР№РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ":
                result = accept_guild_application(user_id, application_id)
            else:
                result = reject_guild_application(user_id, application_id)
        except Exception as error:
            result = {
                "success": False,
                "message": f"вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РѕР±СЂРѕР±РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ. РџРѕРјРёР»РєР°: {error}"
            }

        bot.send_message(message.chat.id, result.get("message", ""), reply_markup=guild_applications_kb(user_id))
        show_guild_applications(bot, message)
        return True

    return False

def _guild_progress_bar(percent, width=10):
    try:
        percent = float(percent)
    except Exception:
        percent = 0.0
    filled = int(round(width * max(0.0, min(100.0, percent)) / 100.0))
    return "в–€" * filled + "в–‘" * (width - filled)


def guild_hall_kb(user_id):
    kb = types.ReplyKeyboardMarkup(resize_keyboard=True)

    if get_user_guild(user_id):
        kb.add("в„№пёЏ Р†РЅС„РѕСЂРјР°С†С–СЏ", "рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё")
        kb.add("рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє", "рџЏ› РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
        kb.add("рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё", "рџ“њ Р–СѓСЂРЅР°Р»")
        kb.add("рџЏ† РњС–СЃСЏС‡РЅРёР№ СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРі")
        kb.add("рџЏ† Р РµР№С‚РёРЅРі Р·Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ")
        kb.add("рџ”™ РњС–СЃС‚Рѕ")
    else:
        kb.add("рџЏ—пёЏ РЎС‚РІРѕСЂРёС‚Рё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ")
        kb.add("рџ“њ РџРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРЅСѓС‚Рё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
        kb.add("рџЏ† РњС–СЃСЏС‡РЅРёР№ СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРі")
        kb.add("рџЏ† Р РµР№С‚РёРЅРі Р·Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ")
        kb.add("рџ“Ё РњРѕС— Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё")
        kb.add("рџ”™ РњС–СЃС‚Рѕ")

    return kb


def build_guild_progress_text(user_id):
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)

    if not guild:
        return "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    info = get_guild_next_level_info(guild["id"])
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)  # refresh after possible level recalc

    if not info:
        return "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°С‚Рё РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    bar = _guild_progress_bar(info["progress_percent"])

    return (
        f"рџЏ› РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—\n\n"
        f"{get_guild_display_name(guild)}\n\n"
        f"Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ: {guild['level']}\n"
        f"EXP РґРѕ РЅР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРѕРіРѕ СЂС–РІРЅСЏ:\n"
        f"{bar} {info['progress_percent']:.1f}%\n"
        f"{info['progress_exp']}/{info['needed_exp']} EXP\n\n"
        f"РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРёР№ СЃРµР·РѕРЅ:\n"
        f"вЂў EXP: {guild['monthly_exp']}\n"
        f"вЂў Р РµСЃСѓСЂСЃ: {guild['monthly_resource']}\n"
        f"вЂў Р’Р±РёРІСЃС‚РІР°: {guild['monthly_kills']}\n"
        f"вЂў РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё: {guild['monthly_contracts']}\n"
        f"вЂў Score: {guild['monthly_score']}\n\n"
        f"Р—Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ:\n"
        f"вЂў EXP: {guild['total_exp']}\n"
        f"вЂў Р РµСЃСѓСЂСЃ: {guild['total_resource']}\n"
        f"вЂў Р’Р±РёРІСЃС‚РІР°: {guild['total_kills']}\n"
        f"вЂў РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё: {guild['total_contracts']}\n"
        f"вЂў Score: {guild['total_score']}"
    )


def build_guild_contribution_text(user_id, scope="monthly"):
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)

    if not guild:
        return "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    rows = get_guild_contribution_ranking(guild["id"], scope=scope, limit=30)

    if scope == "total":
        title = "рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ Р·Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ"
    else:
        title = f"рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ Р·Р° РјС–СЃСЏС†СЊ ({get_current_guild_season_key()})"

    text = f"{title}\n\n{get_guild_display_name(guild)}\n\n"

    if not rows:
        return text + "РџРѕРєРё РЅРµРјР°С” СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ."

    for index, row in enumerate(rows, start=1):
        name = row["character_name"] or f"user_id={row['user_id']}"
        role_label = get_guild_role_label(row["role"])

        if scope == "total":
            score = row["contribution_score"] or 0
            exp = row["contribution_exp"] or 0
            resource = row["contribution_resource"] or 0
            kills = row["contribution_kills"] or 0
            contracts = row["contribution_contracts"] or 0
        else:
            score = row["monthly_contribution_score"] or 0
            exp = row["monthly_contribution_exp"] or 0
            resource = row["monthly_contribution_resource"] or 0
            kills = row["monthly_contribution_kills"] or 0
            contracts = row["monthly_contribution_contracts"] or 0

        text += (
            f"{index}. {role_label} {name}\n"
            f"   Score: {score} | EXP: {exp} | Р РµСЃСѓСЂСЃ: {resource}\n"
            f"   Р’Р±РёРІСЃС‚РІР°: {kills} | РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё: {contracts}\n"
        )

    return text.strip()


def guild_contribution_kb(user_id):
    kb = types.ReplyKeyboardMarkup(resize_keyboard=True)
    kb.add("рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє Р·Р° РјС–СЃСЏС†СЊ")
    kb.add("рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє Р·Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ")
    kb.add("рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№")
    return kb


def send_guild_contribution(bot, message, scope="monthly"):
    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        build_guild_contribution_text(message.from_user.id, scope),
        reply_markup=guild_contribution_kb(message.from_user.id)
    )


def send_guild_progress(bot, message):
    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        build_guild_progress_text(message.from_user.id),
        reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
    )

    _base_register_guild_handlers_before_progress_v1 = register_guild_handlers
except Exception:
    _base_register_guild_handlers_before_progress_v1 = None


def register_guild_handlers(bot):
    if _base_register_guild_handlers_before_progress_v1 is not None:
        _base_register_guild_handlers_before_progress_v1(bot)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџЏ› РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—")
    def guild_progress_message(message):
        send_guild_progress(bot, message)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє")
    def guild_contribution_message(message):
        send_guild_contribution(bot, message, "monthly")

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє Р·Р° РјС–СЃСЏС†СЊ")
    def guild_contribution_monthly_message(message):
        send_guild_contribution(bot, message, "monthly")

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє Р·Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ")
    def guild_contribution_total_message(message):
        send_guild_contribution(bot, message, "total")

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["guild_add_progress", "dev_guild_progress"])
    def guild_add_progress_command(message):
        parts = (message.text or "").split()

        if len(parts) < 5:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "Р¤РѕСЂРјР°С‚: /guild_add_progress EXP RESOURCE KILLS CONTRACTS\n"
                "РџСЂРёРєР»Р°Рґ: /guild_add_progress 100 5 1 0",
                reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
            )
            return

        try:
            exp = int(parts[1])
            resource = int(parts[2])
            kills = int(parts[3])
            contracts = int(parts[4])
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(message.chat.id, "вќЊ Р—РЅР°С‡РµРЅРЅСЏ РјР°СЋС‚СЊ Р±СѓС‚Рё С†С–Р»РёРјРё С‡РёСЃР»Р°РјРё.", reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id))
            return

        result = add_user_guild_progress(
            user_id=message.from_user.id,
            exp=exp,
            resource=resource,
            kills=kills,
            contracts=contracts,
            reason=f"DEV progress: +{exp} EXP, +{resource} resource, +{kills} kills, +{contracts} contracts"
        )

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result.get("message", "") + "\n\n" + build_guild_progress_text(message.from_user.id),
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )

def _guild_progress_reset_navigation_states_v1(user_id):
    for reset_func_name in [
        "reset_guild_browse_state",
        "reset_guild_application_review_state",
        "reset_guild_member_manage_state",
    ]:
        try:
            globals()[reset_func_name](user_id)
        except Exception:
            pass


def _guild_progress_handle_dev_command_v1(bot, message):
    text = (message.text or "").strip()

    if not (text.startswith("/guild_add_progress") or text.startswith("/dev_guild_progress")):
        return False

    parts = text.split()

    if len(parts) < 5:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "Р¤РѕСЂРјР°С‚: /guild_add_progress EXP RESOURCE KILLS CONTRACTS\n"
            "РџСЂРёРєР»Р°Рґ: /guild_add_progress 100 5 1 0",
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )
        return True

    try:
        exp = int(parts[1])
        resource = int(parts[2])
        kills = int(parts[3])
        contracts = int(parts[4])
    except Exception:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "вќЊ Р—РЅР°С‡РµРЅРЅСЏ РјР°СЋС‚СЊ Р±СѓС‚Рё С†С–Р»РёРјРё С‡РёСЃР»Р°РјРё.",
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )
        return True

    try:
        result = add_user_guild_progress(
            user_id=message.from_user.id,
            exp=exp,
            resource=resource,
            kills=kills,
            contracts=contracts,
            reason=f"DEV progress: +{exp} EXP, +{resource} resource, +{kills} kills, +{contracts} contracts"
        )

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result.get("message", "") + "\n\n" + build_guild_progress_text(message.from_user.id),
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )
    except Exception as error:
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            f"вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РґРѕРґР°С‚Рё РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—. РџРѕРјРёР»РєР°: {error}",
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )

    return True


def _guild_progress_handle_global_guild_buttons_v1(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()

    if _guild_progress_handle_dev_command_v1(bot, message):
        return True

    if text == "рџЏ› РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—":
        _guild_progress_reset_navigation_states_v1(user_id)
        send_guild_progress(bot, message)
        return True

    if text in ["рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє", "рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє Р·Р° РјС–СЃСЏС†СЊ"]:
        _guild_progress_reset_navigation_states_v1(user_id)
        send_guild_contribution(bot, message, "monthly")
        return True

    if text == "рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє Р·Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ":
        _guild_progress_reset_navigation_states_v1(user_id)

    if text == "рџЏ° Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№":
        _guild_progress_reset_navigation_states_v1(user_id)
        open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        return True

    if text == "рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё":
        try:
            _guild_progress_reset_navigation_states_v1(user_id)
            show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)
            return True
        except Exception:
            pass

    if text == "рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё":
        try:
            _guild_progress_reset_navigation_states_v1(user_id)
            show_guild_applications(bot, message)
            return True
        except Exception:
            pass

    if text == "рџ“њ Р–СѓСЂРЅР°Р»":
        try:
            _guild_progress_reset_navigation_states_v1(user_id)
            show_guild_logs(bot, message, 0)

try:
    from db import get_guild_logs, get_guild_logs_count
except Exception as _guild_logs_import_error:
    print(f"вљ пёЏ Guild logs import failed: {_guild_logs_import_error}")

GUILD_LOGS_PAGE_SIZE = 10
GUILD_LOGS_STATE = {}


def reset_guild_logs_state(user_id):
    GUILD_LOGS_STATE.pop(user_id, None)


def get_guild_logs_state(user_id):
    return GUILD_LOGS_STATE.get(user_id)


def _guild_log_row_get(row, key, fallback=None):
    try:
        return row[key]
    except Exception:
        return fallback


def _guild_log_format_ua_datetime(value):
    value = str(value or "").strip()
    if not value:
        return "РЅРµРІС–РґРѕРјРѕ"

    try:
        date_part, time_part = value.split("T", 1)
        year, month, day = date_part.split("-", 2)
        hour_minute = time_part[:5]
        return f"{day}.{month}.{year} {hour_minute}"
    except Exception:
        try:
            date_part = value.split(" ", 1)[0]
            year, month, day = date_part.split("-", 2)
            return f"{day}.{month}.{year}"
        except Exception:
            return value


def guild_logs_kb(user_id, page=0):
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)
    kb = types.ReplyKeyboardMarkup(resize_keyboard=True)

    if not guild:
        kb.add("рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№")
        return kb

    logs_count = get_guild_logs_count(guild["id"])
    max_page = max(0, (logs_count - 1) // GUILD_LOGS_PAGE_SIZE) if logs_count else 0
    page = max(0, min(page, max_page))

    nav = []
    if page > 0:
        nav.append("в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС– Р·Р°РїРёСЃРё")
    if page < max_page:
        nav.append("вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС– Р·Р°РїРёСЃРё")
    if nav:
        kb.add(*nav)

    kb.add("рџ”„ РћРЅРѕРІРёС‚Рё Р¶СѓСЂРЅР°Р»")
    kb.add("рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№")

    GUILD_LOGS_STATE[user_id] = {
        "guild_id": guild["id"],
        "page": page,
    }

    return kb


def build_guild_logs_text(user_id, page=0):
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)

    if not guild:
        return "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    logs_count = get_guild_logs_count(guild["id"])
    max_page = max(0, (logs_count - 1) // GUILD_LOGS_PAGE_SIZE) if logs_count else 0
    page = max(0, min(page, max_page))
    offset = page * GUILD_LOGS_PAGE_SIZE

    rows = get_guild_logs(guild["id"], limit=GUILD_LOGS_PAGE_SIZE, offset=offset)

    text = (
        f"рџ“њ Р–СѓСЂРЅР°Р» РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—\n\n"
        f"{get_guild_display_name(guild)}\n\n"
    )

    if not rows:
        return text + "РџРѕРґС–Р№ РїРѕРєРё РЅРµРјР°С”."

    text += f"РЎС‚РѕСЂС–РЅРєР°: {page + 1}/{max_page + 1}\n\n"

    for index, row in enumerate(rows, start=1 + offset):
        event_type = _guild_log_row_get(row, "event_type", "event")
        log_text = _guild_log_row_get(row, "text", "")
        created_at = _guild_log_format_ua_datetime(_guild_log_row_get(row, "created_at", ""))

        text += (
            f"{index}. {created_at}\n"
            f"   {log_text}\n"
        )

    return text.strip()


def show_guild_logs(bot, message, page=0):
    user_id = message.from_user.id

    # Clear other navigation states so journal buttons are not intercepted.
    for reset_func_name in [
        "reset_guild_browse_state",
        "reset_guild_application_review_state",
        "reset_guild_member_manage_state",
    ]:
        try:
            globals()[reset_func_name](user_id)
        except Exception:
            pass

    bot.send_message(
        message.chat.id,
        build_guild_logs_text(user_id, page),
        reply_markup=guild_logs_kb(user_id, page)
    )


def handle_guild_logs_message(bot, message):
    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()
    state = get_guild_logs_state(user_id)

    if not state:
        return False

    page = int(state.get("page", 0) or 0)

    if text == "рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№":
        reset_guild_logs_state(user_id)
        open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        return True

    if text == "рџ”„ РћРЅРѕРІРёС‚Рё Р¶СѓСЂРЅР°Р»":
        show_guild_logs(bot, message, page)
        return True

    if text == "в¬…пёЏ РџРѕРїРµСЂРµРґРЅС– Р·Р°РїРёСЃРё":
        show_guild_logs(bot, message, max(0, page - 1))
        return True

    if text == "вћЎпёЏ РќР°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅС– Р·Р°РїРёСЃРё":
        show_guild_logs(bot, message, page + 1)
        return True

    return False

def register_guild_handlers(bot):
    if _base_register_guild_handlers_before_logs_v1 is not None:
        _base_register_guild_handlers_before_logs_v1(bot)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: get_guild_logs_state(message.from_user.id) is not None)
    def guild_logs_state_message(message):
        handle_guild_logs_message(bot, message)

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "рџ“њ Р–СѓСЂРЅР°Р»")
    def guild_logs_message_v2(message):
        show_guild_logs(bot, message, 0)

# Р¦Рµ РЅРµ Р·РјС–РЅСЋС” СЃС‚Р°СЂС– Р·Р°РїРёСЃРё РІ Р‘Р”, Р°Р»Рµ РїРѕРєР°Р·СѓС” С—С… РєСЂР°СЃРёРІРѕ РІ UI.

import re as _guild_journal_re


def _guild_journal_character_name_by_user_id_v1(user_id):
    try:
        from db import cursor
        cursor.execute("SELECT character_name FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (int(user_id),))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if not row:
            return f"user_id={user_id}"
        try:
            return row["character_name"] or f"user_id={user_id}"
        except Exception:
            return row[0] or f"user_id={user_id}"
    except Exception:
        return f"user_id={user_id}"


def _guild_journal_pretty_text_v1(text):
    text = str(text or "")

    def repl(match):
        user_id = match.group(1)
        return _guild_journal_character_name_by_user_id_v1(user_id)

    return _guild_journal_re.sub(r"user_id=(\d+)", repl, text)


# Override build_guild_logs_text to format user_id in log messages as character_name.
def build_guild_logs_text(user_id, page=0):
    guild = get_user_guild(user_id)

    if not guild:
        return "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."

    logs_count = get_guild_logs_count(guild["id"])
    max_page = max(0, (logs_count - 1) // GUILD_LOGS_PAGE_SIZE) if logs_count else 0
    page = max(0, min(page, max_page))
    offset = page * GUILD_LOGS_PAGE_SIZE

    rows = get_guild_logs(guild["id"], limit=GUILD_LOGS_PAGE_SIZE, offset=offset)

    text = (
        f"рџ“њ Р–СѓСЂРЅР°Р» РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—\n\n"
        f"{get_guild_display_name(guild)}\n\n"
    )

    if not rows:
        return text + "РџРѕРґС–Р№ РїРѕРєРё РЅРµРјР°С”."

    text += f"РЎС‚РѕСЂС–РЅРєР°: {page + 1}/{max_page + 1}\n\n"

    for index, row in enumerate(rows, start=1 + offset):
        log_text = _guild_log_row_get(row, "text", "")
        log_text = _guild_journal_pretty_text_v1(log_text)
        created_at = _guild_log_format_ua_datetime(_guild_log_row_get(row, "created_at", ""))

        text += (
            f"{index}. {created_at}\n"
            f"   {log_text}\n"
        )

    return text.strip()

            message.chat.id,
            f"вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РІС–РґРєСЂРёС‚Рё РєРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё. РџРѕРјРёР»РєР°: {error}",

def _guild_progress_handle_global_guild_buttons_v1(bot, message):

    if text == "рџ“њ РљРѕРЅС‚СЂР°РєС‚Рё":
        return _guild_open_contracts_board_v1(bot, message)

    if text in ["рџ“њ Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ РќР°Р№РјР°РЅС†С–РІ", "рџ”™ Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ РќР°Р№РјР°РЅС†С–РІ"]:
        return _guild_open_mercenary_hall_v1(bot, message)

    if text in ["рџЏ™пёЏ РњС–СЃС‚Рѕ", "рџ”™ РњС–СЃС‚Рѕ"]:
        return _guild_open_city_from_stale_state_v1(bot, message)

    if _base_guild_progress_handle_global_buttons_before_contracts_v1 is not None:
        return _base_guild_progress_handle_global_buttons_before_contracts_v1(bot, message)

    return False

        ("applications", "get_guild_application_review_state"),
        ("members", "get_guild_member_manage_state"),
        ("logs", "get_guild_logs_state"),
    ]

    for label, getter_name in state_checks:
        try:
            getter = globals().get(getter_name)
            if getter and getter(user_id) is not None:
                active.append(label)
        except Exception:
            pass

    return active


def format_guild_debug_text(user_id):
    try:
        diagnostics = get_guild_diagnostics(user_id)
    except Exception as error:
        return f"рџ§Є Guild Debug\n\nвќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РѕС‚СЂРёРјР°С‚Рё diagnostics: {error}"

    active_states = get_active_guild_ui_states(user_id)
    guild = diagnostics.get("guild")
    member = diagnostics.get("member")
    next_level = diagnostics.get("next_level_info") or {}

    text = "рџ§Є Guild Debug\n\n"
    text += f"User ID: {diagnostics.get('user_id')}\n"
    text += f"Season: {diagnostics.get('season_key')}\n"
    text += f"Active UI states: {', '.join(active_states) if active_states else 'none'}\n"
    text += f"User pending applications: {diagnostics.get('user_pending_applications', 0)}\n\n"

    if not guild or not member:
        text += "Guild: none\n"
        return text.strip()

    text += f"Guild ID: {guild['id']}\n"
    text += f"Guild: {get_guild_display_name(guild)}\n"
    text += f"Role: {get_guild_role_label(member['role'])}\n"
    text += f"Members: {diagnostics.get('member_count', 0)}/{guild['member_limit']}\n"
    text += f"Officers: {diagnostics.get('officer_count', 0)}\n"
    text += f"Pending applications: {diagnostics.get('pending_applications', 0)}\n\n"

    text += f"Level: {guild['level']}\n"
    if next_level:
        text += f"Level progress: {next_level.get('progress_exp', 0)}/{next_level.get('needed_exp', 0)} EXP ({next_level.get('progress_percent', 0):.1f}%)\n"

    text += "\nMonthly:\n"
    text += f"EXP: {guild['monthly_exp']} | Resource: {guild['monthly_resource']} | Kills: {guild['monthly_kills']} | Contracts: {guild['monthly_contracts']}\n"
    text += f"Score: {guild['monthly_score']}\n"

    text += "\nTotal:\n"
    text += f"EXP: {guild['total_exp']} | Resource: {guild['total_resource']} | Kills: {guild['total_kills']} | Contracts: {guild['total_contracts']}\n"
    text += f"Score: {guild['total_score']}"

    if diagnostics.get("error"):
        text += f"\n\nError: {diagnostics.get('error')}"

    return text.strip()


def format_guild_cleanup_result_text(result):
    text = "рџ§№ Guild Cleanup\n\n"
    text += f"Status: {'вњ… OK' if result.get('ok') else 'вљ пёЏ issues'}\n"

    stale = result.get("stale_applications")
    if isinstance(stale, dict):
        text += f"Stale pending fixed: {stale.get('fixed_same_guild', 0)}\n"
        text += f"Other pending cancelled: {stale.get('cancelled_other_guild', 0)}\n"
    else:
        text += "Stale applications: n/a\n"

    text += f"Levels recalculated: {result.get('levels_recalculated')}\n"
    text += f"Icons checked: {result.get('icons_checked')}\n"

    errors = result.get("errors") or []
    if errors:
        text += "\nErrors:\n"
        for error in errors:
            text += f"- {error}\n"

    return text.strip()


def _guild_global_navigation_passthrough_v2(bot, message):
    """
    Final global pass-through for common buttons that should work even if a guild state is active.
    """

    user_id = message.from_user.id
    text = (message.text or "").strip()

    if text in ["рџЏ° Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№", "рџ”™ Р—Р°Р»Р° Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–Р№"]:
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        open_guild_hall(bot, message.chat.id, user_id)
        return True

    if text in ["рџЏ™пёЏ РњС–СЃС‚Рѕ", "рџ”™ РњС–СЃС‚Рѕ"]:
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        try:
            send_city(bot, message)
        except Exception:
            try:
                from handlers.city import build_city_text
                from keyboards import city_kb
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, build_city_text(user_id), reply_markup=city_kb())
            except Exception as error:
                bot.send_message(message.chat.id, f"вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚РёСЃСЏ РІ РјС–СЃС‚Рѕ: {error}", reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(user_id))
        return True

    if text == "рџЏ› РџСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        send_guild_progress(bot, message)
        return True

    if text in ["рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє", "рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє Р·Р° РјС–СЃСЏС†СЊ"]:
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        send_guild_contribution(bot, message, "monthly")
        return True

    if text == "рџ“Љ Р’РЅРµСЃРѕРє Р·Р° РІРµСЃСЊ С‡Р°СЃ":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        send_guild_contribution(bot, message, "total")
        return True

    if text == "рџ‘Ґ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєРё":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        show_guild_members_manage(bot, message)
        return True

    if text == "рџ“Ё Р—Р°СЏРІРєРё":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        show_guild_applications(bot, message)
        return True

    if text == "рџ“њ Р–СѓСЂРЅР°Р»":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        show_guild_logs(bot, message, 0)
        return True

    if text == "рџ“њ РџРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРЅСѓС‚Рё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—":
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(user_id)
        show_guild_list(bot, message, 0)
        return True

    return False

def register_guild_handlers(bot):
    if _base_register_guild_handlers_before_cleanup_diag_v1 is not None:
        _base_register_guild_handlers_before_cleanup_diag_v1(bot)

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["guild_debug"])
    def guild_debug_command(message):
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            format_guild_debug_text(message.from_user.id),
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["guild_fix_states", "guild_cleanup"])
    def guild_fix_states_command(message):
        reset_all_guild_ui_states(message.from_user.id)
        try:
            result = run_guild_sanity_cleanup()
        except Exception as error:
            result = {"ok": False, "errors": [str(error)]}

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            format_guild_cleanup_result_text(result),
            reply_markup=guild_hall_kb(message.from_user.id)
        )

def get_slot_label(slot_key):
    if not slot_key:
        return "РќРµРјР°С” СЃР»РѕС‚Р°"

    return EQUIPMENT_SLOTS.get(slot_key, slot_key)



def build_item_display_name(user_id, inventory_id, fallback_name):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” РЅР°Р·РІСѓ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РґР»СЏ СЃРїРёСЃРєС–РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ.

    Р”Р»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅС– РґРѕРґР°С” С‚РёРї Сѓ РґСѓР¶РєР°С…:
    Р§РѕР±РѕС‚Рё 1 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ -> Р§РѕР±РѕС‚Рё [Р›Р°С‚Рё] 1 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ

    Р”Р»СЏ Р·Р±СЂРѕС— / off-hand РќР• РґРѕРґР°С” С‚РёРї Сѓ РґСѓР¶РєР°С…,
    Р±Рѕ РЅР°Р·РІР° РІР¶Рµ Р·Р°Р·РІРёС‡Р°Р№ РјС–СЃС‚РёС‚СЊ СЃР°Рј С‚РёРї:
    РљРёРЅРґР¶Р°Р» 1 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ
    Р–РµР·Р» 1 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ
    РњР°РіС–С‡РЅРёР№ С‚Р°Р»С–СЃРјР°РЅ 1 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ
    """

    classification = get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

    if not classification:
        return fallback_name

    slot_key = classification.get("slot_key", "")
    armor_type = classification.get("armor_type", "")

    # РўРёРї Сѓ РґСѓР¶РєР°С… РїРѕРєР°Р·СѓС”РјРѕ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё РґР»СЏ Р±СЂРѕРЅС–.
    if not is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        return fallback_name

    if not armor_type:
        return fallback_name

    type_label = get_armor_type_label(armor_type)

    if not type_label:
        return fallback_name

    # РЇРєС‰Рѕ РЅР°Р·РІР° РІР¶Рµ РјС–СЃС‚РёС‚СЊ С†РµР№ С‚РёРї вЂ” РЅРµ РґСѓР±Р»СЋС”РјРѕ.
    if f"[{type_label}]" in fallback_name:
        return fallback_name

    marker = " СЂС–РІРЅСЏ"

    if marker in fallback_name:
        index = fallback_name.rfind(marker)
        before_level = fallback_name[:index]
        after_level = fallback_name[index:]

        parts = before_level.rsplit(" ", 1)

        if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit():
            return f"{parts[0]} [{type_label}] {parts[1]}{after_level}"

    return f"{fallback_name} [{type_label}]"



def build_item_allowed_classes_text(user_id, inventory_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” С‚РµРєСЃС‚, СЏРєРёРј РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚.

    РџСЂРёРєР»Р°РґРё:
    рџ‘Ґ РџС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј: рџ”® РњР°Рі, вљ•пёЏ Р–СЂРµС†СЊ
    рџ‘Ґ РџС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј: вљ”пёЏ Р›РёС†Р°СЂ
    рџ‘Ґ РџС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј: СѓСЃС–Рј РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј
    """

    classification = get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

    if not classification:
        return ""

    if classification.get("category") != "equipment":
        return ""

    slot_key = classification.get("slot_key", "")
    armor_type = classification.get("armor_type", "")
    item_subtype = classification.get("item_subtype", "")

    allowed_class_keys = []

    if is_armor_slot(slot_key):
        if not armor_type:
            return "рџ‘Ґ РџС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј: СѓСЃС–Рј РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј (СѓРЅС–РІРµСЂСЃР°Р»СЊРЅР° Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ)\n"

        for class_key, allowed_armor_type in ARMOR_ALLOWED_BY_CLASS.items():
            if allowed_armor_type == armor_type:
                allowed_class_keys.append(class_key)

    elif slot_key == "main_hand":
        if not item_subtype:
            return "рџ‘Ґ РџС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј: СѓСЃС–Рј РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј (СѓРЅС–РІРµСЂСЃР°Р»СЊРЅР° Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ)\n"

        for class_key, allowed_subtypes in MAIN_HAND_ALLOWED_BY_CLASS.items():
            if item_subtype in allowed_subtypes:
                allowed_class_keys.append(class_key)

    elif slot_key == "off_hand":
        if not item_subtype:
            return "рџ‘Ґ РџС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј: СѓСЃС–Рј РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј (СѓРЅС–РІРµСЂСЃР°Р»СЊРЅРёР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё)\n"

        for class_key, allowed_subtypes in OFF_HAND_ALLOWED_BY_CLASS.items():
            if item_subtype in allowed_subtypes:
                allowed_class_keys.append(class_key)

    else:
        # РџСЂРёРєСЂР°СЃРё С‚Р° С–РЅС€С– СЃР»РѕС‚Рё РїРѕРєРё РЅРµ РјР°СЋС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃРѕРІРёС… РѕР±РјРµР¶РµРЅСЊ.
        return "рџ‘Ґ РџС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј: СѓСЃС–Рј РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј\n"

    if not allowed_class_keys:
        return "рџ‘Ґ РџС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј: РЅРµ РІРёР·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРѕ\n"

    class_names = []

    for class_key in allowed_class_keys:
        config = CLASS_CONFIGS.get(class_key, {})
        class_names.append(config.get("name", class_key))

    return f"рџ‘Ґ РџС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃР°Рј: {', '.join(class_names)}\n"

def format_item_bonuses(b_str, b_dex, b_int, b_wis, b_sta, pdef, mdef):

    if b_str:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ’Є РЎРёР»Р° +{b_str}")

    if b_int:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ”® Р†РЅС‚РµР»РµРєС‚ +{b_int}")
    if b_wis:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ¦‰ РњСѓРґСЂС–СЃС‚СЊ +{b_wis}")
    if b_sta:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ›Ў Р’РёС‚СЂРёРІР°Р»С–СЃС‚СЊ +{b_sta}")
    if pdef:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ›Ў Р¤С–Р·. Р·Р°С…РёСЃС‚ +{pdef}")
    if mdef:
        bonuses.append(f"рџ”® РњР°Рі. Р·Р°С…РёСЃС‚ +{mdef}")

    return bonuses


def get_player_level(user_id):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if stats:
        _, _, _, _, _, player_level = stats
        return player_level

    return 1


def get_inventory_full_items(user_id):
    simple_items = get_inventory_detailed(user_id)
    result = []

    for simple_item in simple_items:
        inv_id = simple_item[0]
        full_item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inv_id)

        if full_item:
            result.append(full_item)

    return result


def get_category_items(user_id, category_key):
    items = get_inventory_full_items(user_id)

    if category_key == "all":
        return items

    filtered = []

    for item in items:
        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            slot_key,
            weapon_hands,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = item

        if category_key in SLOT_ORDER:
            if category == "equipment" and slot_key == category_key:
                filtered.append(item)

        elif category_key == "trash":
            if category == "trash":
                filtered.append(item)

        elif category_key == "potion":
            if category == "potion":
                filtered.append(item)

    return filtered


def get_category_count(user_id, category_key):
    return len(get_category_items(user_id, category_key))


def build_item_button_label(user_id, item):
    (
        inv_id,
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        quantity,
        max_stack,
        durability,
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        sell_price
    ) = item

    label = build_item_display_name(
        user_id=user_id,
        inventory_id=inv_id,
        fallback_name=name
    )

    if max_stack and max_stack > 1:
        label += f" x{quantity}"

    if category == "equipment":
        if durability is not None:
            label += f" [{durability}/100]"

        if is_inventory_item_equipped(user_id, inv_id):
            equipped_slot = find_equipped_slot_by_inventory_id(user_id, inv_id)
            label += f" вњ… {get_slot_label(equipped_slot)}"

    return label


def build_equipped_comparison_text(user_id, slot_key, current_inventory_id):
    if not slot_key:
        return ""

    equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)
    equipped_inventory_id = equipped_slots.get(slot_key)

    if not equipped_inventory_id:
        return ""

    if equipped_inventory_id == current_inventory_id:
        return ""

    equipped_item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(equipped_inventory_id)

    if not equipped_item:
        return ""

    (
        inv_id,
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        category,
        item_slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        quantity,
        max_stack,
        durability,
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        sell_price
    ) = equipped_item

    display_name = build_item_display_name(
        user_id=user_id,
        inventory_id=inv_id,
        fallback_name=name
    )

    text = "\n\nвљ–пёЏ Р—Р°СЂР°Р· РІРґСЏРіРЅРµРЅРѕ РґР»СЏ РїРѕСЂС–РІРЅСЏРЅРЅСЏ:\n"
    text += f"{display_name}\n"

    if item_slot_key == "main_hand":
        if weapon_hands == 2:
            text += "рџ‘ђ РўРёРї Р·Р±СЂРѕС—: РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР°\n"
        else:
            text += "вњ‹ РўРёРї Р·Р±СЂРѕС—: РѕРґРЅРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР°\n"

        weapon_damage_text = get_inventory_weapon_damage_display(inv_id)

        if weapon_damage_text:
            text += f"{weapon_damage_text}\n"

    if durability is not None:
        broken_text = " вљ пёЏ [Р—Р›РђРњРђРќРћ]" if durability <= 0 else ""
        text += f"рџ§± РњС–С†РЅС–СЃС‚СЊ: {durability}/100{broken_text}\n"

    bonuses = format_item_bonuses(
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef
    )

    if bonuses:
        text += "рџ“Љ Р‘РѕРЅСѓСЃРё:\n"

        for bonus in bonuses:
            text += f"вЂў {bonus}\n"
    else:
        text += "рџ“Љ Р‘РѕРЅСѓСЃРё: РЅРµРјР°С”\n"

    return text


# ==============================
# INVENTORY HOME
# ==============================

def build_inventory_home(user_id):
    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)
    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    free_slots = max(0, capacity - used_slots)

    text = (
        f"рџЋ’ Р†РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂ\n\n"
        f"рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР°: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n"
        f"вњ… Р’С–Р»СЊРЅРѕ: {free_slots}\n\n"
        f"РћР±РµСЂС–С‚СЊ СЂРѕР·РґС–Р» С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ:"
    )

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=2)

    row = []

    for category_key, label in INVENTORY_CATEGORIES:
        count = get_category_count(user_id, category_key)

        if category_key == "all":
            button_text = f"{label} ({used_slots})"
        else:
            button_text = f"{label} ({count})"

        row.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text=button_text,
            callback_data=f"invcat:{category_key}:0"
        ))

        if len(row) == 2:
            kb.add(*row)
            row = []

    if row:
        kb.add(*row)

    return text, kb


# ==============================
# CATEGORY LIST
# ==============================

def build_category_list(user_id, category_key, page=0):
    items = get_category_items(user_id, category_key)

    used_slots = get_inventory_used_slots(user_id)
    capacity = get_bag_capacity(user_id)
    free_slots = max(0, capacity - used_slots)

    category_label = dict(INVENTORY_CATEGORIES).get(category_key, category_key)

    if not items:
        text = (
            f"{category_label}\n\n"
            f"РЈ С†СЊРѕРјСѓ СЂРѕР·РґС–Р»С– РЅРµРјР°С” РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚С–РІ.\n\n"
            f"рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР°: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n"
            f"вњ… Р’С–Р»СЊРЅРѕ: {free_slots}"
        )

        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="в¬…пёЏ Р”Рѕ СЂРѕР·РґС–Р»С–РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ",
            callback_data="inv_home"
        ))

        return text, kb

    total_items = len(items)
    total_pages = max(1, (total_items + ITEMS_PER_PAGE - 1) // ITEMS_PER_PAGE)

    if page < 0:
        page = 0

    if page >= total_pages:
        page = total_pages - 1

    start = page * ITEMS_PER_PAGE
    end = start + ITEMS_PER_PAGE
    page_items = items[start:end]

    text = (
        f"{category_label}\n\n"
        f"рџЋ’ РЎСѓРјРєР°: {used_slots}/{capacity}\n"
        f"вњ… Р’С–Р»СЊРЅРѕ: {free_slots}\n"
        f"рџ“„ РЎС‚РѕСЂС–РЅРєР°: {page + 1}/{total_pages}\n\n"
    )

    if category_key in SLOT_ORDER:
        equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)
        equipped_inventory_id = equipped_slots.get(category_key)

        if equipped_inventory_id:
            equipped_item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(equipped_inventory_id)

            if equipped_item:
                equipped_display_name = build_item_display_name(
                    user_id=user_id,
                    inventory_id=equipped_inventory_id,
                    fallback_name=equipped_item[2]
                )

                text += f"вњ… Р—Р°СЂР°Р· РІРґСЏРіРЅРµРЅРѕ: {equipped_display_name}\n\n"
        else:
            text += "РЎР»РѕС‚ РїРѕСЂРѕР¶РЅС–Р№.\n\n"

    text += "РћР±РµСЂС–С‚СЊ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚:"

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    for item in page_items:
        inv_id = item[0]
        label = build_item_button_label(user_id, item)

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text=label,
            callback_data=f"item:{inv_id}:{category_key}:{page}"
        ))

    nav_buttons = []

    if page > 0:
        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="в¬…пёЏ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ",
            callback_data=f"invcat:{category_key}:{page - 1}"
        ))

    if page < total_pages - 1:
        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="вћЎпёЏ Р”Р°Р»С–",
            callback_data=f"invcat:{category_key}:{page + 1}"
        ))

    if nav_buttons:
        kb.add(*nav_buttons)

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="в¬…пёЏ Р”Рѕ СЂРѕР·РґС–Р»С–РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ",
        callback_data="inv_home"
    ))

    return text, kb

# ITEM DETAILS
# ==============================

def build_item_details(user_id, inventory_id, back_category="all", page=0):
    item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)

    if not item:
        text = "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ"

        kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="в¬…пёЏ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ",
            callback_data=f"invcat:{back_category}:{page}"
        ))

        return text, kb

    (
        inv_id,
        item_id,
        name,
        type_,
        rarity,
        category,
        slot_key,
        weapon_hands,
        quantity,
        max_stack,
        durability,
        b_str,
        b_dex,
        b_int,
        b_wis,
        b_sta,
        pdef,
        mdef,
        sell_price
    ) = item

    player_level = get_player_level(user_id)
    required_level = get_item_required_level_by_inventory_id(inv_id)
    level_ok = player_level >= required_level

    equipped = is_inventory_item_equipped(user_id, inv_id)
    equipped_slot_key = find_equipped_slot_by_inventory_id(user_id, inv_id)

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup()

    display_name = build_item_display_name(
        user_id=user_id,
        inventory_id=inv_id,
        fallback_name=name
    )

    text = f"рџ“¦ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚\n\n{display_name}\n\n"

    # ==============================
    # TRASH
    # ==============================

    if category == "trash":
        total_price = (quantity or 1) * (sell_price or 0)

        text += (
            f"рџ” РўРёРї: СЃС–СЂРёР№ Р»СѓС‚\n"
            f"рџ“¦ РљС–Р»СЊРєС–СЃС‚СЊ: {quantity}/{max_stack}\n"
            f"рџ’° Р¦С–РЅР° РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ: {sell_price:.2f} Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р° Р·Р° С€С‚.\n"
            f"рџ’° РЈСЃСЊРѕРіРѕ: {total_price:.2f} Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°\n\n"
            f"в„№пёЏ Р¦РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РїСЂРѕРґР°С‚Рё С‚РѕСЂРіРѕРІС†СЋ РІ РјС–СЃС‚С–."
        )

    # ==============================
    # POTION / SPECIAL ITEM
    # ==============================

    elif category == "potion":
        text += (
            f"рџ§Є РўРёРї: Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ / РѕСЃРѕР±Р»РёРІРёР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚\n"
            f"рџ“¦ РљС–Р»СЊРєС–СЃС‚СЊ: {quantity}/{max_stack}\n"
            f"рџ’° Р¦С–РЅР° РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶Сѓ: {sell_price:.2f} Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р° Р·Р° С€С‚.\n\n"
        )

        if type_ == "potion_hp":
            text += "вќ¤пёЏ Р•С„РµРєС‚: РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»СЋС” 50 HP\n"
        elif type_ == "potion_hp_medium":
            text += "вќ¤пёЏ Р•С„РµРєС‚: РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»СЋС” 120 HP\n"
        elif type_ == "potion_mp":
            text += "рџ”µ Р•С„РµРєС‚: РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»СЋС” 40 MP\n"
        elif type_ == "potion_mp_medium":
            text += "рџ”µ Р•С„РµРєС‚: РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»СЋС” 100 MP\n"
        elif type_ == "class_reset" or item_id == CLASS_RESET_SPHERE_ITEM_ID:
            text += (
                "рџ”® Р•С„РµРєС‚: РґРѕР·РІРѕР»СЏС” Р·РјС–РЅРёС‚Рё РєР»Р°СЃ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°.\n"
                "РџС–СЃР»СЏ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°РЅРЅСЏ РІС–РґРєСЂРёС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ РІРёР±С–СЂ РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ.\n"
            )
        else:
            text += "в„№пёЏ Р•С„РµРєС‚ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РїРѕРєРё РЅРµ РѕРїРёСЃР°РЅРёР№.\n"

        text += "\nв„№пёЏ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ Р· С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ."

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="рџ§Є Р’РёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°С‚Рё",
            callback_data=f"usepot:{inv_id}:{back_category}:{page}"
        ))

    # ==============================
    # EQUIPMENT
    # ==============================

    elif category == "equipment":
        slot_label = get_slot_label(slot_key)

        text += (
            f"рџ§° РўРёРї: СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ\n"
            f"рџЋЇ РЎР»РѕС‚: {slot_label}\n"
        )

        allowed_classes_text = build_item_allowed_classes_text(
            user_id=user_id,
            inventory_id=inv_id
        )

        if allowed_classes_text:
            text += allowed_classes_text

        level_text = "вњ…" if level_ok else "рџ”’"

        text += (
            f"рџЏ· Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°: {required_level} {level_text}\n"
            f"рџ‘¤ РўРІС–Р№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ: {player_level}\n"
        )

        if not level_ok:
            text += f"вљ пёЏ Р¦РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РјРѕР¶РЅР° Р±СѓРґРµ РІРґСЏРіРЅСѓС‚Рё Р· {required_level} СЂС–РІРЅСЏ.\n"

        if slot_key == "main_hand":
            if weapon_hands == 2:
                text += "рџ‘ђ РўРёРї Р·Р±СЂРѕС—: РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР°\n"
                text += "вљ пёЏ Р”РІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР° Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ Р±Р»РѕРєСѓС” РґСЂСѓРіСѓ СЂСѓРєСѓ.\n"
            else:
                text += "вњ‹ РўРёРї Р·Р±СЂРѕС—: РѕРґРЅРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР°\n"

            weapon_damage_text = get_inventory_weapon_damage_display(inv_id)

            if weapon_damage_text:
                text += f"{weapon_damage_text}\n"

        if durability is not None:
            broken_text = " вљ пёЏ [Р—Р›РђРњРђРќРћ]" if durability <= 0 else ""
            text += f"рџ§± РњС–С†РЅС–СЃС‚СЊ: {durability}/100{broken_text}\n"

        bonuses = format_item_bonuses(
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef
        )

        if bonuses:
            text += "\nрџ“Љ Р‘РѕРЅСѓСЃРё:\n"

            for bonus in bonuses:
                text += f"вЂў {bonus}\n"
        else:
            text += "\nрџ“Љ Р‘РѕРЅСѓСЃРё: РЅРµРјР°С”\n"

        if durability is not None and durability <= 0:
            text += "\nвљ пёЏ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ Р·Р»Р°РјР°РЅРёР№ С– РЅРµ РґР°С” Р±РѕРЅСѓСЃС–РІ РґРѕ СЂРµРјРѕРЅС‚Сѓ.\n"

        comparison_text = build_equipped_comparison_text(
            user_id=user_id,
            slot_key=slot_key,
            current_inventory_id=inv_id
        )

        if comparison_text:
            text += comparison_text

        if equipped:
            equipped_slot_label = get_slot_label(equipped_slot_key)
            text += f"\nвњ… Р—Р°СЂР°Р· РІРґСЏРіРЅРµРЅРѕ Сѓ СЃР»РѕС‚: {equipped_slot_label}"

            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text="вќЊ Р—РЅСЏС‚Рё",
                callback_data=f"unequip:{inv_id}:{back_category}:{page}"
            ))
        else:
            if level_ok:
                kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                    text=f"вњ… Р’РґСЏРіРЅСѓС‚Рё Сѓ СЃР»РѕС‚: {slot_label}",
                    callback_data=f"equip:{inv_id}:{back_category}:{page}"
                ))
            else:
                text += "\nрџ”’ РљРЅРѕРїРєР° РІРґСЏРіР°РЅРЅСЏ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅР° С‡РµСЂРµР· РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅС–Р№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ.\n"

    # ==============================
    # OTHER
    # ==============================

    else:
        text += (
            f"рџ“¦ РљР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–СЏ: {category}\n"
            f"рџ“¦ РљС–Р»СЊРєС–СЃС‚СЊ: {quantity}/{max_stack}\n"
        )

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="в¬…пёЏ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ РґРѕ СЂРѕР·РґС–Р»Сѓ",
        callback_data=f"invcat:{back_category}:{page}"
    ))

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="рџЏ  Р”Рѕ СЂРѕР·РґС–Р»С–РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ",
        callback_data="inv_home"
    ))

    return text, kb


# ==============================
# HANDLERS
# ==============================

def register_inventory_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџЋ’ Р†РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂ")
    def show_inventory(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        text, kb = build_inventory_home(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb if kb else profile_kb()
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "inv_home")
    def inventory_home_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        text, kb = build_inventory_home(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb if kb else profile_kb()
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("invcat:"))
    def inventory_category_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        parts = call.data.split(":")
        category_key = parts[1]
        page = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0

        text, kb = build_category_list(user_id, category_key, page)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("item:"))
    def item_details_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        parts = call.data.split(":")
        inventory_id = int(parts[1])
        back_category = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "all"
        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0

        text, kb = build_item_details(
            user_id=user_id,
            inventory_id=inventory_id,
            back_category=back_category,
            page=page
        )

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("equip:"))
    def equip_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        parts = call.data.split(":")
        inventory_id = int(parts[1])
        back_category = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "all"
        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0

        result = equip_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result
        )

        text, kb = build_item_details(
            user_id=user_id,
            inventory_id=inventory_id,
            back_category=back_category,
            page=page
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("unequip:"))
    def unequip_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        parts = call.data.split(":")
        inventory_id = int(parts[1])
        back_category = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "all"
        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0

        result = unequip_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result
        )

        text, kb = build_item_details(
            user_id=user_id,
            inventory_id=inventory_id,
            back_category=back_category,
            page=page
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("usepot:"))
    def use_potion_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        parts = call.data.split(":")
        inventory_id = int(parts[1])
        back_category = parts[2] if len(parts) > 2 else "potion"
        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0

        # рџ”® РЎС„РµСЂР° РЅРѕРІРѕРіРѕ С€Р»СЏС…Сѓ
        if is_class_reset_sphere_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id):
            result = use_class_reset_sphere_from_inventory(user_id, inventory_id)

            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                result["message"]
            )

            if result.get("success"):
                from handlers.start import start_class_change_flow

                start_class_change_flow(
                    bot=bot,
                    chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
                    user_id=user_id
                )
                return

            text, kb = build_category_list(user_id, back_category, page)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                text,
                reply_markup=kb
            )
            return

        # Р—РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅС– Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ
        result = use_potion_from_inventory(user_id, inventory_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            result["message"]
        )

        text, kb = build_category_list(user_id, back_category, page)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=kb
        )

try:
    if ("material", "рџЄЁ РњР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»Рё") not in INVENTORY_CATEGORIES:
        # Р’СЃС‚Р°РІР»СЏС”РјРѕ РїРµСЂРµРґ "РџРµСЂРµРіР»СЏРЅСѓС‚Рё РІСЃРµ", СЏРєС‰Рѕ РјРѕР¶Р»РёРІРѕ.
        insert_index = len(INVENTORY_CATEGORIES)
        for idx, entry in enumerate(INVENTORY_CATEGORIES):
            if entry[0] == "all":
                insert_index = idx
                break
        INVENTORY_CATEGORIES.insert(insert_index, ("material", "рџЄЁ РњР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»Рё"))
except Exception:
    pass

try:
    _base_get_category_items_before_materials_v1 = get_category_items
except Exception:
    _base_get_category_items_before_materials_v1 = None


def get_category_items(user_id, category_key):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE:
    Р”РѕРґР°С” РєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅСѓ РїС–РґС‚СЂРёРјРєСѓ РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–С— рџЄЁ РњР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»Рё.
    """

    if category_key != "material":
        if _base_get_category_items_before_materials_v1 is not None:
            return _base_get_category_items_before_materials_v1(user_id, category_key)
        return []

    items = get_inventory_full_items(user_id)
    result = []

    for item in items:
        try:
            item_id = item[1]
            category = item[5]
        except Exception:
            continue

        if category == "material" or item_id in [401, 402]:
            result.append(item)

    return result


def get_category_count(user_id, category_key):
    return len(get_category_items(user_id, category_key))

            "вЂў РІРёС‚СЂР°С‡Р°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ СЂР°Р·РѕРј С–Р· рџЄЁ РљР°РјРµРЅРµРј РџРѕСЃРёР»РµРЅРЅСЏ;\n"

        )

    return ""


def _inject_refine_material_description(text, inventory_id):
    try:
        item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)
        if not item:
            return text

        item_id = item[1]
        description = get_refine_material_description_text(item_id)

        if not description:
            return text

        if "в„№пёЏ РћРїРёСЃ:" in text:
            return text

        return text + description

    except Exception:
        return text


def build_item_details(user_id, inventory_id, back_category="all", page=0):
    if _base_build_item_details_before_refine_material_desc_v1 is None:
        return "вќЊ Р”РµС‚Р°Р»С– РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅС–.", None

    result = _base_build_item_details_before_refine_material_desc_v1(
        user_id,
        inventory_id,
        back_category,
        page
    )

    if isinstance(result, tuple):
        if len(result) >= 2:
            text = result[0]
            kb = result[1]
            text = _inject_refine_material_description(text, inventory_id)
            return text, kb

        if len(result) == 1:
            text = _inject_refine_material_description(result[0], inventory_id)
            return (text,)

    if isinstance(result, str):
        return _inject_refine_material_description(result, inventory_id)

    return result

def get_player_level_from_stats(user_id):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return 1

    _, _, _, _, _, level = stats
    return level or 1


def build_world_map_text(user_id):
    player_level = get_player_level_from_stats(user_id)
    current_location_id = get_current_location(user_id)
    current_location = get_location(current_location_id)

    text = (
        "рџ—єпёЏ РњР°РїР° СЃРІС–С‚Сѓ\n\n"
        f"рџ“Ќ РўРё Р·Р°СЂР°Р· Р·РЅР°С…РѕРґРёС€СЃСЏ:\n"
        f"{current_location['name']}\n\n"
        f"рџ‘¤ РўРІС–Р№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ: {player_level}\n\n"
        "Р”РѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅС– Р»РѕРєР°С†С–С—:\n"
    )

    for location_id in LOCATION_ORDER:
        location = LOCATIONS[location_id]

        unlocked = is_location_unlocked(location_id, player_level)
        current_marker = " вњ…" if location_id == current_location_id else ""

        if unlocked:
            text += (
                f"\nвЂў {location['name']} вЂ” СЂС–РІРЅС– "
                f"{location['level_min']}вЂ“{location['level_max']}{current_marker}\n"
            )
        else:
            text += (
                f"\nвЂў рџ”’ {location['name']} вЂ” РІС–РґРєСЂРёС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ Р· "
                f"{location['unlock_level']} СЂС–РІРЅСЏ\n"
            )

    text += (
        "\nрџЏ™пёЏ РњС–СЃС‚Рѕ вЂ” РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚РёСЃСЏ РґРѕ С‚РѕСЂРіРѕРІС†СЏ С‚Р° СЃРµСЂРІС–СЃС–РІ\n"
        "рџ”™ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ вЂ” РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚РёСЃСЏ РґРѕ С‚Р°Р±РѕСЂСѓ"
    )

    return text


def build_location_info_text(location_id, player_level):
    location = get_location(location_id)
    mobs = get_mobs_for_location(location_id)

    text = (
        f"{location['name']}\n\n"
        f"рџЏ· Р С–РІРЅС– Р·РѕРЅРё: {location['level_min']}вЂ“{location['level_max']}\n\n"
        f"рџ“– {location['description']}\n\n"
        f"рџ‘№ РњРѕР±Рё С†С–С”С— Р·РѕРЅРё:\n"
    )

    for mob in mobs:
        attack_icon = "вљ”пёЏ" if mob.get("attack_type") == "physical" else "рџ”®"

        text += (
            f"вЂў {attack_icon} {mob['name']} вЂ” "
            f"СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ {mob['level']}\n"
        )

    text += (
        f"\nрџ‘‘ Р‘РѕСЃ Р·РѕРЅРё:\n"
        f"{location.get('boss', 'РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРѕ')}\n"
    )

    if player_level < location["unlock_level"]:
        text += (
            f"\nрџ”’ Р›РѕРєР°С†С–СЏ РІС–РґРєСЂРёС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ Р· "
            f"{location['unlock_level']} СЂС–РІРЅСЏ."
        )

    return text

def register_map_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ—єпёЏ РњР°РїР°")
    def show_map(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        text = build_world_map_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=map_kb()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ”™ РњР°РїР°")
    def show_map_from_city(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        text = build_world_map_text(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            text,
            reply_markup=map_kb()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџЊї РџРѕС‡Р°С‚РѕРє РЁР»СЏС…Сѓ")
    def travel_start_path(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        player_level = get_player_level_from_stats(user_id)
        location_id = "start_path"

        if not is_location_unlocked(location_id, player_level):
            location = get_location(location_id)

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    f"рџ”’ {location['name']} РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅР°.\n"
                    f"РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРёР№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ: {location['unlock_level']}"
                ),
                reply_markup=map_kb()
            )
            return

        set_current_location(user_id, location_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_location_info_text(location_id, player_level),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџЊІ РўРµРјРЅРёР№ Р‘С–СЂ")
    def travel_dark_forest(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id
        player_level = get_player_level_from_stats(user_id)
        location_id = "dark_forest"

        if not is_location_unlocked(location_id, player_level):
            location = get_location(location_id)

            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                (
                    f"рџ”’ {location['name']} РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅР°.\n\n"
                    f"РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРёР№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ: {location['unlock_level']}\n"
                    f"рџ‘¤ РўРІС–Р№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ: {player_level}"
                ),
                reply_markup=map_kb()
            )
            return

        set_current_location(user_id, location_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_location_info_text(location_id, player_level),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ”™ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ")
    def back_to_main_from_map(message):
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "рџЏ•пёЏ РўРё РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅСѓРІСЃСЏ РґРѕ С‚Р°Р±РѕСЂСѓ.",
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

def profile_inline_kb(active_tab="character"):
    """
    Inline-РЅР°РІС–РіР°С†С–СЏ РјС–Р¶ РІРєР»Р°РґРєР°РјРё РїСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЋ.

    active_tab:
    - character
    - stats
    - equipment
    - skills

    РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅР° РІРєР»Р°РґРєР° РќР• РїРѕРєР°Р·СѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ СЏРє РєРЅРѕРїРєР°.
    """

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=2)

    buttons = []

    if active_tab != "character":
        buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="рџ‘¤ РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶",
            callback_data="profile_character"
        ))

    if active_tab != "stats":
        buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="рџ“Љ РџР°СЂР°РјРµС‚СЂРё",
            callback_data="profile_stats"
        ))

    if active_tab != "equipment":
        buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="рџ§° Р•РєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ",
            callback_data="profile_equipment"
        ))

    if active_tab != "skills":
        buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєРё",
            callback_data="profile_skills"
        ))

    # Р РѕР·РїРѕРґС–Р» РєРЅРѕРїРѕРє РїРѕ СЂСЏРґРєР°С…
    if len(buttons) == 1:
        kb.add(buttons[0])
    elif len(buttons) == 2:
        kb.add(buttons[0], buttons[1])
    elif len(buttons) == 3:
        kb.add(buttons[0], buttons[1])
        kb.add(buttons[2])
    elif len(buttons) == 4:
        kb.add(buttons[0], buttons[1])
        kb.add(buttons[2], buttons[3])

    return kb

def format_equipment_bonuses(b_str, b_dex, b_int, b_wis, b_sta, pdef, mdef):

    if mdef:
