def build_character_text(user_id):
    process_passive_regeneration(user_id)
    reset_daily_hunts_if_needed(user_id)
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)

    if not stats:
        return "вќ— РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ. РќР°С‚РёСЃРЅРё /start."

    str_, dex_, int_, wis_, sta_, lvl = stats

    current_hp = get_current_hp(user_id)
    max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    energy_data = get_user_energy(user_id)
    energy = energy_data["energy"]
    max_energy = energy_data["max_energy"]

    progress = get_user_progress(user_id)

    if progress:
        exp = progress["exp"]
        exp_to_next = progress["exp_to_next"]
        gold = progress["gold"]
        kills = progress["kills"]
        daily_hunts = progress["daily_hunts"]
    else:
        exp = 0
        exp_to_next = 0
        gold = 0
        kills = 0
        daily_hunts = 0

    exp_percent = 0

    if exp_to_next > 0:
        exp_percent = (exp / exp_to_next) * 100

    profile_summary = get_character_profile_summary(user_id)
    character_name = profile_summary.get("name") or "Р‘РµР· С–РјРµРЅС–"
    class_name = profile_summary.get("class_name") or "РќРµ РѕР±СЂР°РЅРѕ"

    text = (
        f"рџ‘¤ РџРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶\n\n"
        f"рџ“ќ Р†РјвЂ™СЏ: {character_name}\n"
        f"{get_user_guild_profile_line(user_id)}"

def build_equipment_text(user_id):
    from db import SLOT_ORDER, EQUIPMENT_SLOTS

    equipped_slots = get_all_equipped_slots(user_id)

    text = (
        f"рџ§° Р•РєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°\n\n"
        f"РЎС‚Р°РЅ Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅРёС… СЃР»РѕС‚С–РІ:\n\n"
    )

    for slot_key in SLOT_ORDER:
        slot_label = EQUIPMENT_SLOTS.get(slot_key, slot_key)
        inventory_id = equipped_slots.get(slot_key)

        if not inventory_id:
            text += f"{slot_label}: РїРѕСЂРѕР¶РЅСЊРѕ\n\n"
            continue

        item = get_item_by_inventory_id_full(inventory_id)

        if not item:
            text += f"{slot_label}: РїРѕРјРёР»РєР° РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°\n\n"
            continue

        (
            inv_id,
            item_id,
            name,
            type_,
            rarity,
            category,
            item_slot_key,
            weapon_hands,
            quantity,
            max_stack,
            durability,
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef,
            sell_price
        ) = item

        text += f"{slot_label}: {name}\n"

        if durability is not None:
            broken_text = " вљ пёЏ [Р—Р›РђРњРђРќРћ]" if durability <= 0 else ""
            text += f"рџ§± РњС–С†РЅС–СЃС‚СЊ: {durability}/100{broken_text}\n"

        if item_slot_key == "main_hand":
            if weapon_hands == 2:
                text += "рџ‘ђ РўРёРї Р·Р±СЂРѕС—: РґРІРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР°\n"
            else:
                text += "вњ‹ РўРёРї Р·Р±СЂРѕС—: РѕРґРЅРѕСЂСѓС‡РЅР°\n"

            weapon_damage_text = get_inventory_weapon_damage_display(inv_id)

            if weapon_damage_text:
                text += f"{weapon_damage_text}\n"

        bonuses = format_equipment_bonuses(
            b_str,
            b_dex,
            b_int,
            b_wis,
            b_sta,
            pdef,
            mdef
        )

        if bonuses:
            text += "рџ“Љ Р‘РѕРЅСѓСЃРё:\n"

            for bonus in bonuses:
                text += f"вЂў {bonus}\n"
        else:
            text += "рџ“Љ Р‘РѕРЅСѓСЃРё: РЅРµРјР°С”\n"

        text += "\n"

    return text


def build_skills_text(user_id):
    class_key = get_character_class(user_id)
    skills = CLASS_SKILLS_V1.get(class_key, [])
    profile_summary = get_character_profile_summary(user_id)
    class_name = profile_summary.get("class_name", "РќРµ РѕР±СЂР°РЅРѕ")
    character_name = profile_summary.get("name") or "Р‘РµР· С–РјРµРЅС–"

    text = f"вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєРё РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°\n\n"
    text += f"рџ“ќ Р†РјвЂ™СЏ: {character_name}\n"
    text += f"рџ§­ РљР»Р°СЃ: {class_name}\n\n"

    if not skills:
        text += "РќРµРјР°С” РґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёС… РЅР°РІРёС‡РѕРє"
    else:
        for i, skill in enumerate(skills):
            text += f"{i+1}. {skill['name']}\n"
            text += f"{skill['description']}\n"
            if skill.get("cost"):
                if skill["cost_type"] == "rage":
                    text += f"рџ’Ґ Р’Р°СЂС‚С–СЃС‚СЊ: {skill['cost']} Р›СЋС‚С–\n"
                elif skill["cost_type"] == "combat_energy" or skill["cost_type"] == "combat_energy_combo":
                    text += f"рџ’Ґ Р’Р°СЂС‚С–СЃС‚СЊ: {skill['cost']} Р•РЅРµСЂРіС–С—\n"
                elif skill["cost_type"] == "mana":
                    text += f"рџ’§ Р’Р°СЂС‚С–СЃС‚СЊ: {skill['cost']} РњР°РЅРё\n"
            if skill.get("cooldown", 0) > 0:
                text += f"вЏі РџРµСЂРµР·Р°СЂСЏРґРєР°: {skill['cooldown']} С…РѕРґС–РІ\n"
            text += "\n"

    return text

def register_profile_handlers(bot):

    # ==============================
    # PROFILE ROOT
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ‘¤ РџСЂРѕС„С–Р»СЊ")
    def profile(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "рџ‘¤ Р РѕР·РґС–Р» РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р° РІС–РґРєСЂРёС‚Рѕ",
            reply_markup=profile_kb()
        )

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_character_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=profile_inline_kb(active_tab="character")
        )

    # ==============================
    # TEXT BUTTONS
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ“Љ РџР°СЂР°РјРµС‚СЂРё")
    def stats(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_stats_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=profile_inline_kb(active_tab="stats")
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ§° Р•РєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ")
    def equipment(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_equipment_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=profile_inline_kb(active_tab="equipment")
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "вњЁ РќР°РІРёС‡РєРё")
    def skills(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_skills_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=profile_inline_kb(active_tab="skills")
        )

    # ==============================
    # INLINE CALLBACKS
    # ==============================

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "profile_character")
    def profile_character_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_character_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=profile_inline_kb(active_tab="character")
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "profile_stats")
    def profile_stats_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_stats_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=profile_inline_kb(active_tab="stats")
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "profile_equipment")
    def profile_equipment_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_equipment_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=profile_inline_kb(active_tab="equipment")
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "profile_skills")
    def profile_skills_callback(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_skills_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=profile_inline_kb(active_tab="skills")
        )

    # ==============================
    # BACK
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.text == "рџ”™ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ")
    def back_from_profile(message):
        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            "рџЏ•пёЏ РџРѕРІРµСЂРЅРµРЅРЅСЏ РґРѕ С‚Р°Р±РѕСЂСѓ.",
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

def format_percent(value):
    try:
        value = float(value)
    except Exception:
        value = 0.0

    if value.is_integer():
        return str(int(value))

    return f"{value:.2f}".rstrip("0").rstrip(".")

def get_refinable_inventory_items(user_id):
    result = []
    items = get_inventory_detailed(user_id)

    for item in items:
        try:
            inventory_id = item[0]
        except Exception:
            continue

        info = get_inventory_item_refine_info(inventory_id)
        check = can_refine_item(info)

        if not check.get("refine_kind"):
            continue

        current_level = int(info.get("refine_level", 0) or 0)
        max_level = int(check.get("max_level", 0) or 0)

        if max_level <= 0:
            continue

        name = get_inventory_refined_display_name(
            inventory_id,
            info.get("name", "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")
        )

        result.append({
            "inventory_id": inventory_id,
            "name": name,
            "refine_kind": check.get("refine_kind", ""),
            "current_level": current_level,
            "max_level": max_level,
            "can_refine": bool(check.get("success")),
        })

    return result

# KEYBOARDS
# ==============================

def build_refine_items_kb(user_id, page=0):
    items = get_refinable_inventory_items(user_id)
    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    if not items:
        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="рџ”™ Р—Р°РєСЂРёС‚Рё",
            callback_data="refine_close"
        ))
        return kb

    total_pages = max(1, (len(items) + REFINE_ITEMS_PER_PAGE - 1) // REFINE_ITEMS_PER_PAGE)
    page = max(0, min(page, total_pages - 1))

    start = page * REFINE_ITEMS_PER_PAGE
    end = start + REFINE_ITEMS_PER_PAGE

    for item in items[start:end]:
        prefix = "вљ”пёЏ" if item["refine_kind"] == "weapon" else "рџ›ЎпёЏ"
        status = f"+{item['current_level']}/{item['max_level']}"

        kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text=f"{prefix} {item['name']} ({status})",
            callback_data=f"refine_item:{item['inventory_id']}:{page}"
        ))

    nav_buttons = []

    if page > 0:
        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="в¬…пёЏ РќР°Р·Р°Рґ",
            callback_data=f"refine_page:{page - 1}"
        ))

    if page < total_pages - 1:
        nav_buttons.append(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
            text="вћЎпёЏ Р”Р°Р»С–",
            callback_data=f"refine_page:{page + 1}"
        ))

    if nav_buttons:
        kb.row(*nav_buttons)

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="вќЊ Р—Р°РєСЂРёС‚Рё",
        callback_data="refine_close"
    ))

    return kb


def build_refine_effect_text(info, check):
    refine_kind = check.get("refine_kind", "")
    current_level = int(info.get("refine_level", 0) or 0)
    max_level = int(check.get("max_level", 0) or 0)

    if refine_kind == "weapon":
        current_effect = get_weapon_refine_damage_multiplier(current_level)
        next_effect = get_weapon_refine_damage_multiplier(min(current_level + 1, max_level))

        text = (
            "вљ”пёЏ Р•С„РµРєС‚ Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєРё Р·Р±СЂРѕС—:\n"
            f"вЂў РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРёР№ РјРЅРѕР¶РЅРёРє С€РєРѕРґРё: Г—{current_effect:.2f}\n"
        )

        if current_level < max_level:
            text += f"вЂў РџС–СЃР»СЏ СѓСЃРїС–С…Сѓ: Г—{next_effect:.2f}\n"

        return text

    if refine_kind == "armor":
        rarity = info.get("rarity", "common")
        current_effect = get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent(current_level, rarity)
        next_effect = get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent(min(current_level + 1, max_level), rarity)

        text = (
            "рџ›ЎпёЏ Р•С„РµРєС‚ Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєРё Р±СЂРѕРЅС–:\n"
            f"вЂў РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРёР№ Р±РѕРЅСѓСЃ HP: +{format_percent(current_effect)}%\n"
        )

        if current_level < max_level:
            text += f"вЂў РџС–СЃР»СЏ СѓСЃРїС–С…Сѓ: +{format_percent(next_effect)}% HP\n"

        return text

    return ""


def build_refine_risk_text(info, check):
    refine_kind = check.get("refine_kind", "")
    current_level = int(info.get("refine_level", 0) or 0)
    max_level = int(check.get("max_level", 0) or 0)

    if current_level >= max_level:
        return "вњ… РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ СѓР¶Рµ РјР°С” РјР°РєСЃРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅРёР№ СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєРё.\n"

    chance = get_refine_success_chance(refine_kind, current_level)
    failure_level = get_refine_failure_level(refine_kind, current_level)

    text = f"рџЋІ РЁР°РЅСЃ СѓСЃРїС–С…Сѓ: {chance}%\n"

    if failure_level < current_level:
        text += f"вќЊ РџСЂРё РЅРµРІРґР°С‡С–: +{current_level} в†’ +{failure_level}\n"
    else:
        text += f"вќЊ РџСЂРё РЅРµРІРґР°С‡С–: +{current_level} Р±РµР· Р·РјС–РЅ\n"

    return text


def build_refine_item_text(user_id, inventory_id):
    info = get_inventory_item_refine_info(inventory_id)

    if not info:
        return "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."

    check = can_refine_item(info)
    resources = get_refine_resource_counts(user_id)

    name = get_inventory_refined_display_name(
        inventory_id,
        info.get("name", "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")
    )

    refine_kind = check.get("refine_kind", "")
    current_level = int(info.get("refine_level", 0) or 0)
    max_level = int(check.get("max_level", 0) or 0)

    if refine_kind == "weapon":
        kind_text = "вљ”пёЏ Р—Р±СЂРѕСЏ"
    elif refine_kind == "armor":
        kind_text = "рџ›ЎпёЏ Р‘СЂРѕРЅСЏ"
    else:
        kind_text = "вќ“ РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ С‚РёРї"

    text = (
        f"вњЁ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР° РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р°\n\n"
        f"рџ“¦ {name}\n"
        f"РўРёРї: {kind_text}\n"
        f"РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅР° Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР°: +{current_level}/{max_level}\n\n"
        f"{build_refine_effect_text(info, check)}\n"
        f"{build_refine_risk_text(info, check)}\n"
        f"РњР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»Рё:\n"
        f"вЂў рџЄЁ РљР°РјС–РЅСЊ РџРѕСЃРёР»РµРЅРЅСЏ: {resources.get('stone', 0)}\n"
        f"вЂў рџ’Ћ Р СѓРЅР° РЈСЃРїС–С…Сѓ: {resources.get('success_rune', 0)}"
    )

    return text


def build_refine_item_kb(user_id, inventory_id, page=0):
    info = get_inventory_item_refine_info(inventory_id)
    check = can_refine_item(info)
    resources = get_refine_resource_counts(user_id)

    kb = types.InlineKeyboardMarkup(row_width=1)

    if check.get("success"):
        if resources.get("stone", 0) > 0:
            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text="вњЁ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РёС‚Рё Р·Р° рџЄЁ РљР°РјС–РЅСЊ",
                callback_data=f"refine_do:{inventory_id}:0:{page}"
            ))
        else:
            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text="вќЊ РќРµРјР°С” рџЄЁ РљР°РјРµРЅСЏ РџРѕСЃРёР»РµРЅРЅСЏ",
                callback_data="refine_noop"
            ))

        if resources.get("stone", 0) > 0 and resources.get("success_rune", 0) > 0:
            kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
                text="рџ’Ћ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РёС‚Рё Р· Р СѓРЅРѕСЋ РЈСЃРїС–С…Сѓ",
                callback_data=f"refine_do:{inventory_id}:1:{page}"
            ))

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="рџ”™ Р”Рѕ СЃРїРёСЃРєСѓ",
        callback_data=f"refine_page:{page}"
    ))

    kb.add(types.InlineKeyboardButton(
        text="вќЊ Р—Р°РєСЂРёС‚Рё",
        callback_data="refine_close"
    ))

    return kb

def build_refine_attempt_result_text(user_id, inventory_id, before_info, after_info, result, use_success_rune):
    before_level = int((before_info or {}).get("refine_level", 0) or 0)
    after_level = int((after_info or {}).get("refine_level", 0) or 0)

    before_name = get_inventory_refined_display_name(
        inventory_id,
        (before_info or {}).get("name", "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")
    )

    after_name = get_inventory_refined_display_name(
        inventory_id,
        (after_info or before_info or {}).get("name", "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")
    )

    if not result.get("success"):
        return (
            f"вќЊ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР° РЅРµ РІРёРєРѕРЅР°РЅР°.\n\n"
            f"рџ“¦ {before_name}\n"
            f"в„№пёЏ {result.get('message', 'РЎРїСЂРѕР±Р° РЅРµРјРѕР¶Р»РёРІР°.')}"
        )

    lines = []

    if use_success_rune:
        lines.append("рџ’Ћ Р СѓРЅР° РЈСЃРїС–С…Сѓ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°РЅР°.")
        lines.append("рџЋЇ РЁР°РЅСЃ СѓСЃРїС–С…Сѓ Р±СѓРІ 100%.")

    if after_level > before_level:
        lines.append("вњ… Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР° СѓСЃРїС–С€РЅР°!")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"рџ“¦ {after_name}")
        lines.append(f"вњЁ Р‘СѓР»Рѕ: +{before_level}")
        lines.append(f"вњЁ РЎС‚Р°Р»Рѕ: +{after_level}")

        refine_kind = result.get("refine_kind") or can_refine_item(after_info).get("refine_kind", "")

        if refine_kind == "weapon":
            lines.append("вљ”пёЏ РЁРєРѕРґР° Р·Р±С–Р»СЊС€РµРЅР°.")
        elif refine_kind == "armor":
            lines.append("рџ›ЎпёЏ Р‘РѕРЅСѓСЃ РґРѕ РјР°РєСЃРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРіРѕ HP Р·Р±С–Р»СЊС€РµРЅРѕ.")

        lines.append("рџЄЁ РљР°РјС–РЅСЊ РџРѕСЃРёР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РІРёС‚СЂР°С‡РµРЅРѕ.")

    elif after_level < before_level:
        lines.append("вќЊ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР° РЅРµ РІРґР°Р»Р°СЃСЏ.")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"рџ“¦ {after_name}")
        lines.append(f"рџ“‰ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР° Р·РЅРёР¶РµРЅР°: +{before_level} в†’ +{after_level}")
        lines.append("рџЄЁ РљР°РјС–РЅСЊ РџРѕСЃРёР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РІРёС‚СЂР°С‡РµРЅРѕ.")

    else:
        lines.append("вќЊ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР° РЅРµ РІРґР°Р»Р°СЃСЏ.")
        lines.append("")
        lines.append(f"рџ“¦ {after_name}")
        lines.append("вњЁ Р С–РІРµРЅСЊ Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєРё РЅРµ Р·РјС–РЅРёРІСЃСЏ.")
        lines.append("рџЄЁ РљР°РјС–РЅСЊ РџРѕСЃРёР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РІРёС‚СЂР°С‡РµРЅРѕ.")

    return "\n".join(lines)


# ==============================
# SEND / OPEN
# ==============================

def _send_or_edit(bot, chat_id, text, reply_markup=None, message_id=None):
    if message_id:
        try:
            bot.edit_message_text(
                chat_id=chat_id,
                message_id=message_id,
                text=text,
                reply_markup=reply_markup
            )
            return
        except Exception:
            pass

    bot.send_message(
        chat_id,
        text,
        reply_markup=reply_markup
    )


def open_refine_menu(bot, chat_id, user_id, message_id=None, page=0):
    _send_or_edit(
        bot=bot,
        chat_id=chat_id,
        message_id=message_id,
        text=build_refine_main_text(user_id),
        reply_markup=build_refine_items_kb(user_id, page)
    )

def register_refine_handlers(bot):

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["refine", "zatocka", "refine_test"])
    def refine_command(message):
        open_refine_menu(
            bot=bot,
            chat_id=message.chat.id,
            user_id=message.from_user.id
        )

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda message: message.text == "вњЁ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР°")
    def refine_text_button(message):
        open_refine_menu(
            bot=bot,
            chat_id=message.chat.id,
            user_id=message.from_user.id
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "refine_menu")
    def refine_menu_callback(call):
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        open_refine_menu(
            bot=bot,
            chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
            user_id=call.from_user.id,
            message_id=call.message.message_id
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("refine_page:"))
    def refine_page_callback(call):
        page = int(call.data.split(":")[1])
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        open_refine_menu(
            bot=bot,
            chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
            user_id=call.from_user.id,
            message_id=call.message.message_id,
            page=page
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("refine_item:"))
    def refine_item_callback(call):
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        inventory_id = int(parts[1])
        page = int(parts[2]) if len(parts) > 2 else 0

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        _send_or_edit(
            bot=bot,
            chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
            message_id=call.message.message_id,
            text=build_refine_item_text(call.from_user.id, inventory_id),
            reply_markup=build_refine_item_kb(call.from_user.id, inventory_id, page)
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("refine_do:"))
    def refine_do_callback(call):
        parts = call.data.split(":")
        inventory_id = int(parts[1])
        use_success_rune = parts[2] == "1"
        page = int(parts[3]) if len(parts) > 3 else 0

        before_info = get_inventory_item_refine_info(inventory_id)

        result = perform_refine_attempt(
            user_id=call.from_user.id,
            inventory_id=inventory_id,
            use_success_rune=use_success_rune
        )

        after_info = get_inventory_item_refine_info(inventory_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        result_text = build_refine_attempt_result_text(
            user_id=call.from_user.id,
            inventory_id=inventory_id,
            before_info=before_info,
            after_info=after_info,
            result=result,
            use_success_rune=use_success_rune
        )

        item_text = build_refine_item_text(call.from_user.id, inventory_id)

        _send_or_edit(
            bot=bot,
            chat_id=call.message.chat.id,
            message_id=call.message.message_id,
            text=f"{result_text}\n\n{item_text}",
            reply_markup=build_refine_item_kb(call.from_user.id, inventory_id, page)
        )

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "refine_noop")
    def refine_noop_callback(call):
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id, "РќРµРґРѕСЃС‚Р°С‚РЅСЊРѕ РјР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»С–РІ.")

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data == "refine_close")
    def refine_close_callback(call):
        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)
        try:
            bot.delete_message(call.message.chat.id, call.message.message_id)
        except Exception:
            bot.send_message(call.message.chat.id, "вњ… РњРµРЅСЋ Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєРё Р·Р°РєСЂРёС‚Рѕ.")

def build_class_change_unequip_text_local(unequip_result):
    """
    Р›РѕРєР°Р»СЊРЅР° РІРµСЂСЃС–СЏ РїРѕРІС–РґРѕРјР»РµРЅРЅСЏ РїС–СЃР»СЏ Р·РјС–РЅРё РєР»Р°СЃСѓ.
    РќРµ Р·Р°Р»РµР¶РёС‚СЊ РІС–Рґ build_class_change_unequip_text Р· db.py.

    Р¤РѕСЂРјР°С‚:
    вљ пёЏ РќРµСЃСѓРјС–СЃРЅРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ Р·РЅСЏС‚Рѕ:
    вЂў РћР±Р»Р°РґСѓРЅРѕРє [РЁРєС–СЂР°] 3 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ вЂ” Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ
    вЂў РљРёРЅРґР¶Р°Р» 3 СЂС–РІРЅСЏ вЂ” Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ
    """

    def add_armor_type_to_name(name, inventory_id):
        if not inventory_id:
            return name

        try:
            from db import (
                get_item_classification_by_inventory_id,
                is_armor_slot,
                get_armor_type_label
            )

            classification = get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

            if not classification:
                return name

            slot_key = classification.get("slot_key", "")
            armor_type = classification.get("armor_type", "")

            if not is_armor_slot(slot_key):
                return name

            if not armor_type:
                return name

            armor_label = get_armor_type_label(armor_type)

            if not armor_label:
                return name

            if f"[{armor_label}]" in name:
                return name

            marker = " СЂС–РІРЅСЏ"

            if marker in name:
                index = name.rfind(marker)
                before_level = name[:index]
                after_level = name[index:]

                parts = before_level.rsplit(" ", 1)

                if len(parts) == 2 and parts[1].isdigit():
                    return f"{parts[0]} [{armor_label}] {parts[1]}{after_level}"

            return f"{name} [{armor_label}]"

        except Exception:
            return name

    def infer_reason(item):
        reason = item.get("reason", "") or ""
        reason_lower = reason.lower()

        if "С‚РёРї Р±СЂРѕРЅС–" in reason_lower or "Р±СЂРѕРЅ" in reason_lower:
            return "Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if "Р·Р±СЂРѕ" in reason_lower or "main_hand" in reason_lower:
            return "Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if "РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё" in reason_lower or "РґСЂСѓРіСѓ СЂСѓРєСѓ" in reason_lower:
            return "РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РґР»СЏ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        slot_key = item.get("slot_key", "")

        if slot_key in [
            "helmet",
            "shoulders",
            "chest",
            "gloves",
            "legs",
            "boots"
        ]:
            return "Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if slot_key == "main_hand":
            return "Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        if slot_key == "off_hand":
            return "РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РґР»СЏ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

        inventory_id = item.get("inventory_id")

        if inventory_id:
            try:
                from db import (
                    get_item_classification_by_inventory_id,
                    is_armor_slot
                )

                classification = get_item_classification_by_inventory_id(inventory_id)

                if classification:
                    real_slot_key = classification.get("slot_key", "")

                    if is_armor_slot(real_slot_key):
                        return "Р±СЂРѕРЅСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

                    if real_slot_key == "main_hand":
                        return "Р·Р±СЂРѕСЏ РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

                    if real_slot_key == "off_hand":
                        return "РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РґР»СЏ РґСЂСѓРіРѕС— СЂСѓРєРё РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

            except Exception:
                pass

        return "РЅРµ РїС–РґС…РѕРґРёС‚СЊ РЅРѕРІРѕРјСѓ РєР»Р°СЃСѓ"

    if not unequip_result:
        return ""

    removed_items = unequip_result.get("removed_items", [])

    if not removed_items:
        return "\n\nвњ… РЈСЃРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ СЃСѓРјС–СЃРЅРµ Р· РЅРѕРІРёРј РєР»Р°СЃРѕРј."

    text = "\n\nвљ пёЏ РќРµСЃСѓРјС–СЃРЅРµ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ Р·РЅСЏС‚Рѕ:\n"

    for item in removed_items:
        name = item.get("name", "РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРёР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")
        inventory_id = item.get("inventory_id")

        display_name = add_armor_type_to_name(
            name=name,
            inventory_id=inventory_id
        )

        reason = infer_reason(item)

        text += f"вЂў {display_name} вЂ” {reason}\n"

    text += "\nРџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Рё РїРѕРІРµСЂРЅСѓС‚Рѕ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂ."

    return text

def continue_registration_or_main(bot, chat_id, user_id):
    init_character_class_system()
    create_user(user_id)
    process_passive_regeneration(user_id)

    if needs_character_name(user_id):
        PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME.add(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            chat_id,
            build_name_request_text()
        )
        return

    if needs_character_class(user_id):
        bot.send_message(
            chat_id,
            build_class_selection_text(user_id, mode="register"),
            reply_markup=build_class_selection_kb(mode="register")
        )
        return

    bot.send_message(
        chat_id,
        build_main_menu_text(user_id),
        reply_markup=main_kb()
    )


def start_class_change_flow(bot, chat_id, user_id):
    init_character_class_system()

    if not has_class_change_available(user_id):
        bot.send_message(
            chat_id,
            "вќЊ Р—РјС–РЅР° РєР»Р°СЃСѓ Р·Р°СЂР°Р· РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅР°."
        )
        return

    bot.send_message(
        chat_id,
        build_class_selection_text(user_id, mode="change"),
        reply_markup=build_class_selection_kb(mode="change")
    )

def register_start_handlers(bot):

    # ==============================
    # /start
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(commands=["start"])
    def start(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        continue_registration_or_main(
            bot=bot,
            chat_id=message.chat.id,
            user_id=user_id
        )

    # ==============================
    # CHARACTER NAME INPUT
    # ==============================

    @bot.message_handler(func=lambda m: m.from_user.id in PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME)
    def receive_character_name(message):
        user_id = message.from_user.id

        if message.text and message.text.startswith("/"):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                "в„№пёЏ РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ РІРІРµРґРё С–РјвЂ™СЏ РїРµСЂСЃРѕРЅР°Р¶Р°."
            )
            return

        result = set_character_name(user_id, message.text)

        if not result["success"]:
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                result["message"]
            )
            return

        PENDING_CHARACTER_NAME.discard(user_id)

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            result["message"]
        )

        if needs_character_class(user_id):
            bot.send_message(
                message.chat.id,
                build_class_selection_text(user_id, mode="register"),
                reply_markup=build_class_selection_kb(mode="register")
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(
            message.chat.id,
            build_main_menu_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # INITIAL CLASS SELECTION
    # ==============================

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("select_class:"))
    def select_class(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        class_key = call.data.split(":")[1]

        result = set_character_class(user_id, class_key)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        if not result["success"]:
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                result["message"]
            )
            return

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            (
                f"{result['message']}\n\n"
                f"РўРІС–Р№ С€Р»СЏС… РїРѕС‡РёРЅР°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ."
            )
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_main_menu_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

    # ==============================
    # CLASS CHANGE BY SPHERE
    # ==============================

    @bot.callback_query_handler(func=lambda call: call.data.startswith("change_class:"))
    def change_class(call):
        user_id = call.from_user.id
        class_key = call.data.split(":")[1]

        if not has_class_change_available(user_id):
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                "вќЊ Р—РјС–РЅР° РєР»Р°СЃСѓ РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅР°."
            )
            return

        old_class = get_character_class_display(user_id)

        result = set_character_class(user_id, class_key)

        if not result["success"]:
            bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                result["message"]
            )
            return

        consume_result = consume_class_change_available(user_id)

        bot.answer_callback_query(call.id)

        if not consume_result["success"]:
            bot.send_message(
                call.message.chat.id,
                consume_result["message"]
            )
            return

        unequip_result = unequip_incompatible_items_after_class_change(user_id)
        unequip_text = build_class_change_unequip_text_local(unequip_result)

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            (
                f"рџ”® РљР»Р°СЃ Р·РјС–РЅРµРЅРѕ.\n\n"
                f"Р‘СѓР»Рѕ: {old_class}\n"
                f"РЎС‚Р°Р»Рѕ: {result['class_name']}"
                f"{unequip_text}"
            )
        )

        bot.send_message(
            call.message.chat.id,
            build_main_menu_text(user_id),
            reply_markup=main_kb()
        )

# ROM migrations

This directory contains database migrations for future schema changes.

## Naming

Use numeric prefixes:

```text
001_base.py
002_equipment.py
003_classes.py
004_refine.py
005_guilds.py
006_auction.py
007_next_feature.py
```

## Migration format

Each migration file should define one function:

```python
def up(conn):
    conn.execute("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN example TEXT DEFAULT ''")
```

or:

```python
def migrate(conn):
    conn.execute("ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN example TEXT DEFAULT ''")
```

The runner commits after each successful migration and records it in `schema_migrations`.

## Rule

Future DB schema changes should go here instead of being scattered across `db.py` or handlers.



============================================================
FILE: migrations\runner.py
============================================================

"""
ROM migrations foundation.

Refactor 9.0.11.

Purpose:
- Provide a safe migration runner for future DB schema changes.
- Track applied migrations in schema_migrations table.
- Keep existing init_db() behavior unchanged for now.

Migration file format:
    migrations/001_example.py

Each migration may expose either:
    def up(conn): ...

or:
    def migrate(conn): ...

The function receives sqlite3 connection and should use conn.execute(...).
The runner commits after each successful migration and records it.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import importlib.util
import sqlite3
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Callable, Iterable

MIGRATIONS_TABLE = "schema_migrations"


def get_project_root() -> Path:
    return Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]


def ensure_migrations_table(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> None:
    conn.execute(
        f"""
        CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS {MIGRATIONS_TABLE} (
            id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
            migration_name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,
            applied_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
        )
        """
    )
    conn.commit()


def get_applied_migrations(conn: sqlite3.Connection) -> set[str]:
    ensure_migrations_table(conn)
    rows = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT migration_name FROM {MIGRATIONS_TABLE} ORDER BY migration_name"
    ).fetchall()
    return {row[0] for row in rows}


def discover_migration_files(migrations_dir: Path | None = None) -> list[Path]:
    if migrations_dir is None:
        migrations_dir = get_project_root() / "migrations"

    if not migrations_dir.exists():
        migrations_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)

    files = []
    for path in migrations_dir.glob("*.py"):
        if path.name.startswith("__"):
            continue
        if path.name in {"runner.py", "README.md"}:
            continue
        files.append(path)

    return sorted(files, key=lambda p: p.name)


def load_migration_callable(path: Path) -> Callable[[sqlite3.Connection], None]:
    module_name = f"rom_migration_{path.stem}"
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(module_name, path)

    if spec is None or spec.loader is None:
        raise RuntimeError(f"Cannot load migration: {path}")

    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)

    if hasattr(module, "up"):
        return getattr(module, "up")

    if hasattr(module, "migrate"):
        return getattr(module, "migrate")

    raise RuntimeError(f"Migration {path.name} must define up(conn) or migrate(conn)")


def mark_migration_applied(conn: sqlite3.Connection, migration_name: str) -> None:
    conn.execute(
        f"INSERT OR IGNORE INTO {MIGRATIONS_TABLE} (migration_name) VALUES (?)",
        (migration_name,),
    )
    conn.commit()


def run_pending_migrations(conn: sqlite3.Connection, migrations_dir: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    """Run pending migrations. Returns a diagnostics dict."""

    ensure_migrations_table(conn)
    applied = get_applied_migrations(conn)
    files = discover_migration_files(migrations_dir)

    result = {
        "success": True,
        "applied": [],
        "skipped": [],
        "failed": None,
        "total_files": len(files),
    }

    for path in files:
        migration_name = path.name

        if migration_name in applied:
            result["skipped"].append(migration_name)
            continue

        try:
            migration_func = load_migration_callable(path)
            migration_func(conn)
            conn.commit()
            mark_migration_applied(conn, migration_name)
            result["applied"].append(migration_name)
        except Exception as error:
            conn.rollback()
            result["success"] = False
            result["failed"] = {
                "migration": migration_name,
                "error": str(error),
            }
            raise

    return result


def get_migration_status(conn: sqlite3.Connection, migrations_dir: Path | None = None) -> dict:
    ensure_migrations_table(conn)
    applied = get_applied_migrations(conn)
    files = discover_migration_files(migrations_dir)

    known = [path.name for path in files]
    pending = [name for name in known if name not in applied]

    return {
        "known": known,
        "applied": sorted(applied),
        "pending": pending,
        "applied_count": len(applied),
        "pending_count": len(pending),
    }

from datetime import datetime, timedelta

from db import conn, cursor

AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE = "ACTIVE"
AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED = "SOLD_UNCLAIMED"
AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_CLAIMED = "SOLD_CLAIMED"
AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED = "EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED"
AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_CLAIMED = "EXPIRED_CLAIMED"
AUCTION_STATUS_DELETED = "DELETED"

AUCTION_ACTIVE_DAYS = 7
AUCTION_CLAIM_DAYS = 30
AUCTION_MAX_ACTIVE_LOTS_PER_USER = 20

AUCTION_MIN_PRICE = Decimal("1.0")
AUCTION_MAX_PRICE = Decimal("999999.0")
AUCTION_PRICE_QUANT = Decimal("0.01")

AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT = "equipment"
AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION = "potion"
AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL = "material"

AUCTION_ALLOWED_CATEGORIES = {
    AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
    AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION,
    AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL,
}

AUCTION_HISTORY_LISTED = "LISTED"
AUCTION_HISTORY_SOLD = "SOLD"
AUCTION_HISTORY_CANCELLED = "CANCELLED"
AUCTION_HISTORY_EXPIRED = "EXPIRED"
AUCTION_HISTORY_ITEM_CLAIMED = "ITEM_CLAIMED"
AUCTION_HISTORY_GOLD_CLAIMED = "GOLD_CLAIMED"
AUCTION_HISTORY_DELETED = "DELETED"

def now_iso():
    return datetime.now().isoformat()


def iso_after_days(days):
    return (datetime.now() + timedelta(days=int(days))).isoformat()


def decimal_to_price_text(value):
    """
    Normalize user/input price to DB-safe text.

    The auction house uses Decimal, and stores price as TEXT to avoid binary float issues.
    """

    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
        price = value
    else:
        try:
            price = Decimal(str(value).strip().replace(",", "."))
        except (InvalidOperation, ValueError, AttributeError):
            raise ValueError("РќРµРєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅР° С†С–РЅР°.")

    price = price.quantize(AUCTION_PRICE_QUANT, rounding=ROUND_DOWN)

    if price < AUCTION_MIN_PRICE:
        raise ValueError(f"РњС–РЅС–РјР°Р»СЊРЅР° С†С–РЅР°: {AUCTION_MIN_PRICE} Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°.")

    if price > AUCTION_MAX_PRICE:
        raise ValueError(f"РњР°РєСЃРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅР° С†С–РЅР°: {AUCTION_MAX_PRICE} Р·РѕР»РѕС‚Р°.")

    # Keep a simple human-readable decimal string.
    return format(price, "f")


def validate_auction_price(value):
    try:
        return {
            "success": True,
            "price": decimal_to_price_text(value),
        }
    except ValueError as error:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": f"вќЊ {error}",
        }


def auction_price_to_decimal(value):
    return Decimal(str(value or "0").strip().replace(",", "."))


def normalize_auction_category(category):
    category = str(category or "").strip().lower()

    aliases = {
        "вљ”пёЏ СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ": AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
        "СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ": AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
        "equipment": AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
        "gear": AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
        "рџ§Є Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ": AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION,
        "Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ": AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION,
        "potion": AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION,
        "potions": AUCTION_CATEGORY_POTION,
        "рџЄЁ РјР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»Рё": AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL,
        "РјР°С‚РµСЂС–Р°Р»Рё": AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL,
        "material": AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL,
        "materials": AUCTION_CATEGORY_MATERIAL,
    }

    category = aliases.get(category, category)

    if category not in AUCTION_ALLOWED_CATEGORIES:
        raise ValueError("РќРµРєРѕСЂРµРєС‚РЅР° РєР°С‚РµРіРѕСЂС–СЏ РўРѕСЂРіРѕРІРѕРіРѕ Р”РѕРјСѓ.")

    return category


def safe_json_dumps(value):
    return json.dumps(value or {}, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True)


def safe_json_loads(value):
    try:
        return json.loads(value or "{}")
    except Exception:
        return {}

def init_auction_house():
    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auction_lots (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,

        seller_user_id INTEGER NOT NULL,
        buyer_user_id INTEGER,

        item_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        item_source TEXT DEFAULT '',
        item_ref_id INTEGER,
        item_snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,

        item_name TEXT NOT NULL,
        item_name_norm TEXT NOT NULL,
        category TEXT NOT NULL,
        rarity TEXT DEFAULT '',
        level INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        enhancement_level INTEGER DEFAULT 0,
        durability_current INTEGER,
        durability_max INTEGER,
        quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 1,

        price TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ACTIVE',

        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        expires_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        sold_at TEXT,
        claimed_at TEXT,
        delete_after TEXT,
        updated_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS auction_history (
        id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT,
        lot_id INTEGER,
        event_type TEXT NOT NULL,
        actor_user_id INTEGER,
        seller_user_id INTEGER,
        buyer_user_id INTEGER,
        item_name TEXT,
        category TEXT,
        quantity INTEGER DEFAULT 1,
        price TEXT,
        status_before TEXT,
        status_after TEXT,
        details_json TEXT DEFAULT '{}',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auction_lots_status_created
    ON auction_lots(status, created_at)
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auction_lots_seller_status
    ON auction_lots(seller_user_id, status)
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auction_lots_buyer_status
    ON auction_lots(buyer_user_id, status)
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auction_lots_category_status
    ON auction_lots(category, status)
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auction_lots_name_norm
    ON auction_lots(item_name_norm)
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auction_history_lot
    ON auction_history(lot_id)
    """)

    cursor.execute("""
    CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_auction_history_actor
    ON auction_history(actor_user_id, created_at)
    """)

    conn.commit()

def add_auction_history(
    lot_id=None,
    event_type=AUCTION_HISTORY_LISTED,
    actor_user_id=None,
    seller_user_id=None,
    buyer_user_id=None,
    item_name="",
    category="",
    quantity=1,
    price="",
    status_before=None,
    status_after=None,
    details=None,
):
    init_auction_house()

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO auction_history (
        lot_id,
        event_type,
        actor_user_id,
        seller_user_id,
        buyer_user_id,
        item_name,
        category,
        quantity,
        price,
        status_before,
        status_after,
        details_json,
        created_at
    ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        lot_id,
        event_type,
        actor_user_id,
        seller_user_id,
        buyer_user_id,
        item_name,
        category,
        int(quantity or 1),
        str(price or ""),
        status_before,
        status_after,
        safe_json_dumps(details or {}),
        now_iso(),
    ))

    conn.commit()

def get_auction_lot_by_id(lot_id):
    init_auction_house()
    cursor.execute("SELECT * FROM auction_lots WHERE id=?", (lot_id,))
    return cursor.fetchone()


def get_user_active_auction_count(user_id):
    init_auction_house()
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM auction_lots
    WHERE seller_user_id=? AND status=?
    """, (
        user_id,
        AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
    ))
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    try:
        return int(row["cnt"] or 0)
    except Exception:
        return int(row[0] or 0) if row else 0


def can_user_create_auction_lot(user_id):
    active_count = get_user_active_auction_count(user_id)

    if active_count >= AUCTION_MAX_ACTIVE_LOTS_PER_USER:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": f"вќЊ Р”РѕСЃСЏРіРЅСѓС‚Рѕ Р»С–РјС–С‚ Р°РєС‚РёРІРЅРёС… Р»РѕС‚С–РІ: {AUCTION_MAX_ACTIVE_LOTS_PER_USER}.",
            "active_count": active_count,
        }

    return {
        "success": True,
        "active_count": active_count,
        "limit": AUCTION_MAX_ACTIVE_LOTS_PER_USER,
    }


def get_auction_lots(
    status=AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
    category=None,
    search_text=None,
    limit=10,
    offset=0,
    sort="new",
):
    init_auction_house()

    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        limit = 10
    try:
        offset = int(offset)
    except Exception:
        offset = 0

    limit = max(1, min(50, limit))
    offset = max(0, offset)

    where = ["status=?"]
    params = [status]

    if category:
        where.append("category=?")
        params.append(normalize_auction_category(category))

    if search_text:
        where.append("item_name_norm LIKE ?")
        params.append(f"%{str(search_text).strip().lower()}%")

    order_by = "created_at DESC"
    if sort == "old":
        order_by = "created_at ASC"
    elif sort == "price_asc":
        order_by = "CAST(price AS REAL) ASC, created_at DESC"
    elif sort == "price_desc":
        order_by = "CAST(price AS REAL) DESC, created_at DESC"
    elif sort == "rarity":
        order_by = "rarity DESC, created_at DESC"

    sql = f"""
    SELECT *
    FROM auction_lots
    WHERE {' AND '.join(where)}
    ORDER BY {order_by}
    LIMIT ? OFFSET ?
    """
    params.extend([limit, offset])

    cursor.execute(sql, tuple(params))
    return cursor.fetchall()

def create_auction_lot_record(
    seller_user_id,
    item_type,
    item_snapshot,
    item_name,
    category,
    price,
    quantity=1,
    item_source="",
    item_ref_id=None,
    rarity="",
    level=0,
    enhancement_level=0,
    durability_current=None,
    durability_max=None,
):
    """
    Creates only the auction lot record.

    IMPORTANT:
    This helper does not remove or lock the item from inventory yet.
    Item movement/locking will be implemented in later patches.
    """

    init_auction_house()

    can_create = can_user_create_auction_lot(seller_user_id)
    if not can_create.get("success"):
        return can_create

    price_result = validate_auction_price(price)
    if not price_result.get("success"):
        return price_result

    category = normalize_auction_category(category)

    try:
        quantity = int(quantity or 1)
    except Exception:
        quantity = 1

    if quantity <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РљС–Р»СЊРєС–СЃС‚СЊ РјР°С” Р±СѓС‚Рё Р±С–Р»СЊС€РѕСЋ Р·Р° 0.",
        }

    item_name = str(item_name or "").strip()
    if not item_name:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќР°Р·РІР° РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Р° РЅРµ РјРѕР¶Рµ Р±СѓС‚Рё РїРѕСЂРѕР¶РЅСЊРѕСЋ.",
        }

    now = now_iso()
    expires_at = iso_after_days(AUCTION_ACTIVE_DAYS)

    cursor.execute("""
    INSERT INTO auction_lots (
        seller_user_id,
        buyer_user_id,
        item_type,
        item_source,
        item_ref_id,
        item_snapshot_json,
        item_name,
        item_name_norm,
        category,
        rarity,
        level,
        enhancement_level,
        durability_current,
        durability_max,
        quantity,
        price,
        status,
        created_at,
        expires_at,
        updated_at
    ) VALUES (?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        seller_user_id,
        str(item_type or ""),
        str(item_source or ""),
        item_ref_id,
        safe_json_dumps(item_snapshot or {}),
        item_name,
        item_name.lower(),
        category,
        str(rarity or ""),
        int(level or 0),
        int(enhancement_level or 0),
        durability_current,
        durability_max,
        quantity,
        price_result["price"],
        AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        now,
        expires_at,
        now,
    ))

    lot_id = cursor.lastrowid
    conn.commit()

    add_auction_history(
        lot_id=lot_id,
        event_type=AUCTION_HISTORY_LISTED,
        actor_user_id=seller_user_id,
        seller_user_id=seller_user_id,
        item_name=item_name,
        category=category,
        quantity=quantity,
        price=price_result["price"],
        status_before=None,
        status_after=AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        details={"item_type": item_type, "item_source": item_source, "item_ref_id": item_ref_id},
    )

    return {
        "success": True,
        "lot_id": lot_id,
        "message": "вњ… Р›РѕС‚ СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРµРЅРѕ.",
    }


def mark_auction_lot_status(lot_id, status_after, actor_user_id=None, event_type=None, details=None):
    init_auction_house()

    lot = get_auction_lot_by_id(lot_id)
    if not lot:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р›РѕС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ.",
        }

    status_before = lot["status"]
    now = now_iso()

    delete_after = lot["delete_after"]
    claimed_at = lot["claimed_at"]

    if status_after in [AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED, AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED]:
        delete_after = iso_after_days(AUCTION_CLAIM_DAYS)

    if status_after in [AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_CLAIMED, AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_CLAIMED]:
        claimed_at = now

    cursor.execute("""
    UPDATE auction_lots
    SET status=?,
        claimed_at=?,
        delete_after=?,
        updated_at=?
    WHERE id=?
    """, (
        status_after,
        claimed_at,
        delete_after,
        now,
        lot_id,
    ))
    conn.commit()

    add_auction_history(
        lot_id=lot_id,
        event_type=event_type or status_after,
        actor_user_id=actor_user_id,
        seller_user_id=lot["seller_user_id"],
        buyer_user_id=lot["buyer_user_id"],
        item_name=lot["item_name"],
        category=lot["category"],
        quantity=lot["quantity"],
        price=lot["price"],
        status_before=status_before,
        status_after=status_after,
        details=details or {},
    )

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": "вњ… РЎС‚Р°С‚СѓСЃ Р»РѕС‚Р° РѕРЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРѕ.",
    }


def update_expired_auction_lots():
    """
    Expiration cleanup:
    - ACTIVE after 7 days -> EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED
    - EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED after 30 days -> DELETED
    - SOLD_UNCLAIMED after 30 days -> DELETED

    No automatic item/gold return is performed here.
    """

    init_auction_house()
    now = now_iso()

    expired_count = 0
    deleted_count = 0

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT *
    FROM auction_lots
    WHERE status=? AND expires_at<=?
    """, (
        AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        now,
    ))
    active_rows = cursor.fetchall()

    for lot in active_rows:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE auction_lots
        SET status=?,
            delete_after=?,
            updated_at=?
        WHERE id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED,
            iso_after_days(AUCTION_CLAIM_DAYS),
            now,
            lot["id"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        ))

        if cursor.rowcount:
            expired_count += 1
            add_auction_history(
                lot_id=lot["id"],
                event_type=AUCTION_HISTORY_EXPIRED,
                seller_user_id=lot["seller_user_id"],
                buyer_user_id=lot["buyer_user_id"],
                item_name=lot["item_name"],
                category=lot["category"],
                quantity=lot["quantity"],
                price=lot["price"],
                status_before=AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
                status_after=AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED,
            )

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT *
    FROM auction_lots
    WHERE status IN (?, ?) AND delete_after IS NOT NULL AND delete_after<=?
    """, (
        AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED,
        AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED,
        now,
    ))
    delete_rows = cursor.fetchall()

    for lot in delete_rows:
        before = lot["status"]
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE auction_lots
        SET status=?, updated_at=?
        WHERE id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            AUCTION_STATUS_DELETED,
            now,
            lot["id"],
            before,
        ))

        if cursor.rowcount:
            deleted_count += 1
            add_auction_history(
                lot_id=lot["id"],
                event_type=AUCTION_HISTORY_DELETED,
                seller_user_id=lot["seller_user_id"],
                buyer_user_id=lot["buyer_user_id"],
                item_name=lot["item_name"],
                category=lot["category"],
                quantity=lot["quantity"],
                price=lot["price"],
                status_before=before,
                status_after=AUCTION_STATUS_DELETED,
            )

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "success": True,
        "expired": expired_count,
        "deleted": deleted_count,
    }


def get_auction_house_stats():
    init_auction_house()

    result = {}
    statuses = [
        AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
        AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_UNCLAIMED,
        AUCTION_STATUS_SOLD_CLAIMED,
        AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_UNCLAIMED,
        AUCTION_STATUS_EXPIRED_CLAIMED,
        AUCTION_STATUS_DELETED,
    ]

    for status in statuses:
        cursor.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM auction_lots WHERE status=?", (status,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        try:
            result[status] = int(row["cnt"] or 0)
        except Exception:
            result[status] = int(row[0] or 0) if row else 0

    return result

AUCTION_EQUIPMENT_PAGE_SIZE = 8


def _auction_row_to_dict(row):
    if row is None:
        return None

    try:
        return dict(row)
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        keys = row.keys()
        return {key: row[key] for key in keys}
    except Exception:
        return {}


def _auction_table_columns(table_name):
    cursor.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table_name})")
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    columns = []

    for row in rows:
        try:
            columns.append(row["name"])
        except Exception:
            columns.append(row[1])

    return columns


def _auction_has_table(table_name):
    cursor.execute(
        "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name=?",
        (table_name,)
    )
    return cursor.fetchone() is not None


def _auction_get_inventory_row(inventory_id, user_id=None):
    init_auction_house()

    inventory_id = int(inventory_id)

    sql = """
    SELECT
        inv.id AS inventory_id,
        inv.user_id AS inventory_user_id,
        inv.item_id AS inventory_item_id,
        inv.quantity AS inventory_quantity,
        inv.refine_level AS inventory_refine_level,
        inv.*,
        it.id AS item_id,
        it.name AS item_name,
        it.type AS item_type,
        it.category AS item_category,
        it.slot_key AS item_slot_key,
        it.rarity AS item_rarity,
        it.level AS item_level,
        it.*
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN items it ON inv.item_id = it.id
    WHERE inv.id=?
    """
    params = [inventory_id]

    if user_id is not None:
        sql += " AND inv.user_id=?"
        params.append(user_id)

    cursor.execute(sql, tuple(params))
    return cursor.fetchone()


def _auction_get_int(row_dict, *keys, default=0):
    for key in keys:
        if key in row_dict and row_dict.get(key) is not None:
            try:
                return int(row_dict.get(key))
            except Exception:
                pass
    return int(default)


def _auction_get_str(row_dict, *keys, default=""):
    for key in keys:
        value = row_dict.get(key)
        if value is not None:
            value = str(value)
            if value:
                return value
    return default


def _auction_get_durability(row_dict):
    current = None
    maximum = None

    current_keys = [
        "durability",
        "current_durability",
        "durability_current",
        "inventory_durability",
        "item_durability",
    ]
    max_keys = [
        "max_durability",
        "durability_max",
        "inventory_max_durability",
        "item_max_durability",
    ]

    for key in current_keys:
        if key in row_dict and row_dict.get(key) is not None:
            try:
                current = int(row_dict.get(key))
                break
            except Exception:
                pass

    for key in max_keys:
        if key in row_dict and row_dict.get(key) is not None:
            try:
                maximum = int(row_dict.get(key))
                break
            except Exception:
                pass

    if current is None:
        current = 100

    if maximum is None:
        maximum = 100

    return current, maximum


def _auction_format_refined_name(name, refine_level):
    try:
        refine_level = int(refine_level or 0)
    except Exception:
        refine_level = 0

    if refine_level <= 0:
        return name

    marker = f"[+{refine_level}]"

    if marker in name:
        return name

    level_marker = " СЂС–РІРЅСЏ"

    if level_marker in name:
        index = name.rfind(level_marker)
        level_end = index + len(level_marker)
        return f"{name[:level_end]} {marker}{name[level_end:]}"

    return f"{name} {marker}"


def _auction_is_inventory_equipped(user_id, inventory_id):
    if not _auction_has_table("equipment_slots"):
        return False

    columns = _auction_table_columns("equipment_slots")

    if "inventory_id" in columns:
        cursor.execute(
            "SELECT 1 FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=? AND inventory_id=? LIMIT 1",
            (user_id, inventory_id)
        )
        return cursor.fetchone() is not None

    # Fallback for wide slot columns if project uses that schema.
    possible_slot_columns = [
        "main_hand", "off_hand", "helmet", "shoulders", "chest", "gloves",
        "legs", "boots", "necklace", "ring",
    ]

    existing = [col for col in possible_slot_columns if col in columns]

    for col in existing:
        cursor.execute(
            f"SELECT 1 FROM equipment_slots WHERE user_id=? AND {col}=? LIMIT 1",
            (user_id, inventory_id)
        )
        if cursor.fetchone() is not None:
            return True

    return False


def _auction_is_equipment_row(row_dict):
    slot_key = _auction_get_str(row_dict, "item_slot_key", "slot_key", default="")
    item_type = _auction_get_str(row_dict, "item_type", "type", default="").lower()
    item_category = _auction_get_str(row_dict, "item_category", "category", default="").lower()

    if slot_key:
        return True

    if item_type in [
        "weapon", "main_hand", "off_hand", "helmet", "shoulders", "chest",
        "gloves", "legs", "boots", "necklace", "ring",
    ]:
        return True

    if item_category == "equipment":
        return True

    return False


def get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id):
    """
    Builds a full enough snapshot of an inventory item for Auction House listing.
    Does not mutate inventory.
    """

    row = _auction_get_inventory_row(inventory_id=inventory_id, user_id=user_id)

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂС–.",
        }

    data = _auction_row_to_dict(row)

    item_id = _auction_get_int(data, "item_id", "inventory_item_id")
    quantity = _auction_get_int(data, "inventory_quantity", "quantity", default=1)
    refine_level = _auction_get_int(data, "inventory_refine_level", "refine_level", default=0)
    raw_name = _auction_get_str(data, "item_name", "name", default="РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚")
    display_name = _auction_format_refined_name(raw_name, refine_level)

    durability_current, durability_max = _auction_get_durability(data)

    rarity = _auction_get_str(data, "item_rarity", "rarity", default="")
    level = _auction_get_int(data, "item_level", "level", default=0)
    slot_key = _auction_get_str(data, "item_slot_key", "slot_key", default="")
    item_type = _auction_get_str(data, "item_type", "type", default="")
    item_category = _auction_get_str(data, "item_category", "category", default="")

    snapshot = {
        "inventory_id": int(inventory_id),
        "item_id": item_id,
        "quantity": quantity,
        "refine_level": refine_level,
        "name": display_name,
        "raw_name": raw_name,
        "rarity": rarity,
        "level": level,
        "slot_key": slot_key,
        "item_type": item_type,
        "item_category": item_category,
        "durability_current": durability_current,
        "durability_max": durability_max,
        "row": data,
    }

    return {
        "success": True,
        "snapshot": snapshot,
    }


def validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id):
    snapshot_result = get_inventory_item_snapshot_for_auction(user_id, inventory_id)

    if not snapshot_result.get("success"):
        return snapshot_result

    snapshot = snapshot_result["snapshot"]

    if not _auction_is_equipment_row(snapshot["row"]):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќР° С†СЊРѕРјСѓ РµС‚Р°РїС– РјРѕР¶РЅР° РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»СЏС‚Рё С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё СЃРїРѕСЂСЏРґР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ.",
        }

    if _auction_is_inventory_equipped(user_id, inventory_id):
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р•РєС–РїС–СЂРѕРІР°РЅРёР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚Рё РЅР° РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶.",
        }

    if int(snapshot.get("durability_current", 100) or 0) <= 0:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вљ пёЏ РќРµРјРѕР¶Р»РёРІРѕ РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІРёС‚Рё Р·Р»Р°РјР°РЅРёР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚.",
        }

    return {
        "success": True,
        "snapshot": snapshot,
    }


def get_user_sellable_equipment_for_auction(user_id, limit=50, offset=0):
    init_auction_house()

    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        limit = 50
    try:
        offset = int(offset)
    except Exception:
        offset = 0

    # Fetch a wider slice and filter in Python because schemas vary across project patches.
    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT inv.id AS inventory_id
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN items it ON inv.item_id = it.id
    WHERE inv.user_id=?
    ORDER BY inv.id DESC
    LIMIT 200
    """, (user_id,))

    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    result = []

    for row in rows:
        try:
            inventory_id = row["inventory_id"]
        except Exception:
            inventory_id = row[0]

        check = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)

        if check.get("success"):
            snapshot = check["snapshot"]
            result.append({
                "inventory_id": inventory_id,
                "name": snapshot["name"],
                "quantity": snapshot["quantity"],
                "rarity": snapshot["rarity"],
                "level": snapshot["level"],
                "refine_level": snapshot["refine_level"],
                "durability_current": snapshot["durability_current"],
                "durability_max": snapshot["durability_max"],
                "slot_key": snapshot["slot_key"],
            })

    return result[offset:offset + limit]


def create_equipment_auction_lot(user_id, inventory_id, price):
    """
    Creates an ACTIVE auction lot from a single equipment inventory item and removes it from inventory.

    This is the first real item-listing implementation for Auction House 8.0.3.
    Stackable items/materials are intentionally handled later.
    """

    init_auction_house()

    check = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)

    if not check.get("success"):
        return check

    can_create = can_user_create_auction_lot(user_id)
    if not can_create.get("success"):
        return can_create

    price_result = validate_auction_price(price)
    if not price_result.get("success"):
        return price_result

    snapshot = check["snapshot"]
    now = now_iso()
    expires_at = iso_after_days(AUCTION_ACTIVE_DAYS)

    try:
        conn.execute("BEGIN IMMEDIATE")

        # Re-check ownership and active status inside transaction.
        check_inside = validate_inventory_item_for_auction_equipment(user_id, inventory_id)
        if not check_inside.get("success"):
            conn.rollback()
            return check_inside

        snapshot = check_inside["snapshot"]

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_lots (
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_type,
            item_source,
            item_ref_id,
            item_snapshot_json,
            item_name,
            item_name_norm,
            category,
            rarity,
            level,
            enhancement_level,
            durability_current,
            durability_max,
            quantity,
            price,
            status,
            created_at,
            expires_at,
            updated_at
        ) VALUES (?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            user_id,
            snapshot.get("item_type") or "equipment",
            "inventory",
            int(inventory_id),
            safe_json_dumps(snapshot),
            snapshot["name"],
            snapshot["name"].lower(),
            AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
            snapshot.get("rarity", ""),
            int(snapshot.get("level", 0) or 0),
            int(snapshot.get("refine_level", 0) or 0),
            snapshot.get("durability_current"),
            snapshot.get("durability_max"),
            1,
            price_result["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            now,
            expires_at,
            now,
        ))

        lot_id = cursor.lastrowid

        cursor.execute(
            "DELETE FROM inventory WHERE id=? AND user_id=?",
            (inventory_id, user_id)
        )

        if cursor.rowcount != 1:
            conn.rollback()
            return {
                "success": False,
                "message": "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РїРµСЂРµРЅРµСЃС‚Рё РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ Р· С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂСЏ.",
            }

        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO auction_history (
            lot_id,
            event_type,
            actor_user_id,
            seller_user_id,
            buyer_user_id,
            item_name,
            category,
            quantity,
            price,
            status_before,
            status_after,
            details_json,
            created_at
        ) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?, ?, NULL, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            lot_id,
            AUCTION_HISTORY_LISTED,
            user_id,
            user_id,
            snapshot["name"],
            AUCTION_CATEGORY_EQUIPMENT,
            1,
            price_result["price"],
            AUCTION_STATUS_ACTIVE,
            safe_json_dumps({"inventory_id": inventory_id, "item_id": snapshot.get("item_id")}),
            now,
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "success": True,
            "lot_id": lot_id,
            "item_name": snapshot["name"],
            "price": price_result["price"],
            "expires_at": expires_at,
            "message": "вњ… Р›РѕС‚ РІРёСЃС‚Р°РІР»РµРЅРѕ РЅР° РїСЂРѕРґР°Р¶.",
        }

    except Exception as error:
        try:
            conn.rollback()
        except Exception:
            pass

        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": f"вќЊ РџРѕРјРёР»РєР° СЃС‚РІРѕСЂРµРЅРЅСЏ Р»РѕС‚Р°: {error}",
        }

# вњ… AUCTION HOUSE ITEM SCHEMA SAFE SNAPSHOT V1

def _auction_sql_literal(value):
    return "'" + str(value).replace("'", "''") + "'"


def _auction_select_existing_expr(alias, columns, preferred_names, output_alias, default_value=""):
    """
    Builds a safe SELECT expression for schemas where item columns may have different names.

    Example:
    - if items has item_level -> it.item_level AS item_level
    - if items has level      -> it.level AS item_level
    - otherwise              -> 0 AS item_level
    """

    for column_name in preferred_names:
        if column_name in columns:
            return f"{alias}.{column_name} AS {output_alias}"

    if isinstance(default_value, int):
        return f"{int(default_value)} AS {output_alias}"

    return f"{_auction_sql_literal(default_value)} AS {output_alias}"


def _auction_get_inventory_row(inventory_id, user_id=None):
    """
    Schema-safe inventory + item loader.

    Older 8.0.3 code expected items.level, but this project stores item level under
    another column name in the current DB. This loader checks actual table columns
    and only selects columns that really exist.
    """

    init_auction_house()

    inventory_id = int(inventory_id)

    inv_cols = _auction_table_columns("inventory")
    item_cols = _auction_table_columns("items")

    select_parts = []

    # Stable aliases used by auction snapshot code.
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("inv", inv_cols, ["id"], "inventory_id", 0))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("inv", inv_cols, ["user_id"], "inventory_user_id", 0))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("inv", inv_cols, ["item_id"], "inventory_item_id", 0))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("inv", inv_cols, ["quantity"], "inventory_quantity", 1))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("inv", inv_cols, ["refine_level"], "inventory_refine_level", 0))

    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["id"], "item_id", 0))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["name"], "item_name", "РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚"))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["type", "item_type"], "item_type", ""))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["category", "item_category"], "item_category", ""))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["slot_key", "slot", "equipment_slot"], "item_slot_key", ""))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["rarity", "item_rarity"], "item_rarity", ""))
    select_parts.append(_auction_select_existing_expr("it", item_cols, ["level", "item_level", "required_level", "min_level"], "item_level", 0))

    # Preserve full row details with prefixed aliases to avoid duplicate-column collisions.
    for column_name in inv_cols:
        select_parts.append(f"inv.{column_name} AS inv_{column_name}")

    for column_name in item_cols:
        select_parts.append(f"it.{column_name} AS item_{column_name}")

    sql = f"""
    SELECT
        {', '.join(select_parts)}
    FROM inventory inv
    JOIN items it ON inv.item_id = it.id
    WHERE inv.id=?
    """

    params = [inventory_id]

    if user_id is not None:
        sql += " AND inv.user_id=?"
        params.append(user_id)

    cursor.execute(sql, tuple(params))
    return cursor.fetchone()
