# 7.0.6
# РљРµСЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР°РјРё РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—:
# - РїСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР°
# - Р·РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР°
# - РІРёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР°


def get_guild_member(guild_id, user_id):
    init_guild_system()
    cursor.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM guild_members WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=?",
        (guild_id, user_id)
    )
    return cursor.fetchone()


def get_character_name_by_user_id(user_id):
    try:
        cursor.execute("SELECT character_name FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
        row = cursor.fetchone()
        if not row:
            return f"user_id={user_id}"
        try:
            return row["character_name"] or f"user_id={user_id}"
        except Exception:
            return row[0] or f"user_id={user_id}"
    except Exception:
        return f"user_id={user_id}"


def is_guild_leader(user_id, guild_id):
    member = get_guild_member(guild_id, user_id)
    return bool(member and member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_LEADER)


def is_guild_officer(user_id, guild_id):
    member = get_guild_member(guild_id, user_id)
    return bool(member and member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER)


def promote_guild_member_to_officer(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    """
    РџСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡РёС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР°.
    Р”РѕР·РІРѕР»РµРЅРѕ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё РіРѕР»РѕРІС– РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—.
    """

    init_guild_system()
    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if not actor_member:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

    if not target_member or int(target_member["guild_id"]) != int(actor_member["guild_id"]):
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С” Сѓ С‚РІРѕС—Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

    guild_id = actor_member["guild_id"]

    if actor_member["role"] != GUILD_ROLE_LEADER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РџСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡Р°С‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєС–РІ РјРѕР¶Рµ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё рџ‘‘ Р“РѕР»РѕРІР° РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

    if target_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_LEADER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р“РѕР»РѕРІР° РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РІР¶Рµ РјР°С” РЅР°Р№РІРёС‰Сѓ СЂРѕР»СЊ."}

    if target_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "в„№пёЏ Р¦РµР№ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ СѓР¶Рµ С” рџ›Ў Р—Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєРѕРј."}

    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE guild_members SET role=? WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=?",
        (GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER, guild_id, target_user_id)
    )
    conn.commit()

    target_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(target_user_id)
    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="member_promoted",
        text=f"{target_name} РїСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРёР№ рџ›Ў Р—Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєРѕРј."
    )

    return {"success": True, "message": f"вњ… {target_name} С‚РµРїРµСЂ рџ›Ў Р—Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРє РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}


def demote_guild_officer(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    """
    Р—РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР° РґРѕ СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР°.
    Р”РѕР·РІРѕР»РµРЅРѕ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё РіРѕР»РѕРІС– РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—.
    """

    init_guild_system()
    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if not actor_member:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

    if not target_member or int(target_member["guild_id"]) != int(actor_member["guild_id"]):
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С” Сѓ С‚РІРѕС—Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

    guild_id = actor_member["guild_id"]

    if actor_member["role"] != GUILD_ROLE_LEADER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р—РЅС–РјР°С‚Рё Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєС–РІ РјРѕР¶Рµ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё рџ‘‘ Р“РѕР»РѕРІР° РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

    if target_member["role"] != GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ РЅРµ С” Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєРѕРј."}

    cursor.execute(
        "UPDATE guild_members SET role=? WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=?",
        (GUILD_ROLE_MEMBER, guild_id, target_user_id)
    )
    conn.commit()

    target_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(target_user_id)
    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="member_demoted",
        text=f"{target_name} Р±С–Р»СЊС€Рµ РЅРµ С” рџ›Ў Р—Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєРѕРј."
    )

    return {"success": True, "message": f"вњ… {target_name} С‚РµРїРµСЂ рџ‘¤ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРє РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}


def kick_guild_member(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    """
    Р’РёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєР° Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—.

    РџСЂР°РІРёР»Р°:
    - Р“РѕР»РѕРІР° РјРѕР¶Рµ РІРёРєР»СЋС‡Р°С‚Рё СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ С– Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєС–РІ, Р°Р»Рµ РЅРµ СЃРµР±Рµ.
    - Р—Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРє РјРѕР¶Рµ РІРёРєР»СЋС‡Р°С‚Рё С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё Р·РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅРёС… СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ.
    - РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРє РЅРµ РјРѕР¶Рµ РІРёРєР»СЋС‡Р°С‚Рё РЅС–РєРѕРіРѕ.
    - Р“РѕР»РѕРІСѓ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РІРёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё.
    """

    init_guild_system()
    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if not actor_member:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

    if not target_member or int(target_member["guild_id"]) != int(actor_member["guild_id"]):
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С” Сѓ С‚РІРѕС—Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

    guild_id = actor_member["guild_id"]

    if int(actor_user_id) == int(target_user_id):
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РќРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РІРёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё СЃР°РјРѕРіРѕ СЃРµР±Рµ."}

    if target_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_LEADER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р“РѕР»РѕРІСѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РІРёРєР»СЋС‡РёС‚Рё."}

    if actor_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_MEMBER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РЈС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРє РЅРµ РјРѕР¶Рµ РІРёРєР»СЋС‡Р°С‚Рё С–РЅС€РёС… СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ."}

    if actor_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER and target_member["role"] != GUILD_ROLE_MEMBER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р—Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРє РјРѕР¶Рµ РІРёРєР»СЋС‡Р°С‚Рё С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё Р·РІРёС‡Р°Р№РЅРёС… СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ."}

    cursor.execute(
        "DELETE FROM guild_members WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=?",
        (guild_id, target_user_id)
    )
    conn.commit()

    target_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(target_user_id)
    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="member_kicked",
        text=f"{target_name} РІРёРєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРёР№ Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."
    )

    return {"success": True, "message": f"вњ… {target_name} РІРёРєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРёР№ Р· РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

def get_guild_officer_count(guild_id):
    init_guild_system()
    cursor.execute(
        "SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM guild_members WHERE guild_id=? AND role=?",
        (guild_id, GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER)
    )
    row = cursor.fetchone()
    try:
        return int(row["cnt"] or 0)
    except Exception:
        return int(row[0] or 0) if row else 0


def get_guild_officer_member(guild_id):
    init_guild_system()
    cursor.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM guild_members WHERE guild_id=? AND role=? LIMIT 1",
        (guild_id, GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER)
    )
    return cursor.fetchone()


try:
    _base_promote_guild_member_to_officer_before_single_officer_v1 = promote_guild_member_to_officer
except Exception:
    _base_promote_guild_member_to_officer_before_single_officer_v1 = None


def promote_guild_member_to_officer(actor_user_id, target_user_id):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE:
    РџСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡Р°С” Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР°, Р°Р»Рµ С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё СЏРєС‰Рѕ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— С‰Рµ РЅРµРјР°С” С–РЅС€РѕРіРѕ Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР°.
    """

    actor_member = get_user_guild_member(actor_user_id)
    target_member = get_user_guild_member(target_user_id)

    if not actor_member:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РўРё РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С”С€ Сѓ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

    if not target_member or int(target_member["guild_id"]) != int(actor_member["guild_id"]):
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ РЅРµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С” Сѓ С‚РІРѕС—Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}

    guild_id = actor_member["guild_id"]

    if target_member["role"] == GUILD_ROLE_OFFICER:
        return {"success": False, "message": "в„№пёЏ Р¦РµР№ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ СѓР¶Рµ С” рџ›Ў Р—Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєРѕРј."}

    officer = get_guild_officer_member(guild_id)

    if officer:
        officer_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(officer["user_id"])
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": f"вќЊ РЈ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РІР¶Рµ С” рџ›Ў Р—Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРє: {officer_name}. РЎРїРѕС‡Р°С‚РєСѓ Р·РЅС–РјРё Р№РѕРіРѕ Р· РїРѕСЃР°РґРё."
        }

    if _base_promote_guild_member_to_officer_before_single_officer_v1 is None:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р¤СѓРЅРєС†С–СЏ РїСЂРёР·РЅР°С‡РµРЅРЅСЏ Р·Р°СЃС‚СѓРїРЅРёРєР° РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅР°."}

    return _base_promote_guild_member_to_officer_before_single_officer_v1(actor_user_id, target_user_id)


# ==============================
# вњ… GUILD ACCEPT APPLICATION IDEMPOTENT FIX V1

# 7.0.6b
# Fix РїСЂРѕР±Р»РµРјРё:
# - РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ СѓР¶Рµ РґРѕРґР°РІСЃСЏ РІ guild_members;
# - Р·Р°СЏРІРєР° Р»РёС€РёР»Р°СЃСЊ pending;
# - РїРѕРІС‚РѕСЂРЅРµ РЅР°С‚РёСЃРєР°РЅРЅСЏ вњ… РџСЂРёР№РЅСЏС‚Рё Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ РїР°РґР°Р»Рѕ С‡РµСЂРµР· UNIQUE constraint
#   guild_applications(guild_id, user_id, status).
#
# Р С–С€РµРЅРЅСЏ:
# - РїСЂРёР№РЅСЏС‚С‚СЏ Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё СЃС‚Р°Р»Рѕ idempotent;
# - СЏРєС‰Рѕ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ СѓР¶Рµ РІ С†С–Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—, pending-Р·Р°СЏРІРєР° РїСЂРѕСЃС‚Рѕ РїРѕР·РЅР°С‡Р°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ accepted/removes duplicate safely;
# - СЏРєС‰Рѕ already С” accepted-Р·Р°СЏРІРєР° Р· С‚Р°РєРёРј UNIQUE РєР»СЋС‡РµРј, pending-Р·Р°СЏРІРєР° РІРёРґР°Р»СЏС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ;
# - СЃС‚Р°СЂС– pending-Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё РіСЂР°РІС†СЏ РІ С–РЅС€С– РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— СЃРєР°СЃРѕРІСѓСЋС‚СЊСЃСЏ.


def _guild_safe_set_application_status(application_id, status, processed_by=None):
    """
    Р‘РµР·РїРµС‡РЅРѕ Р·РјС–РЅСЋС” СЃС‚Р°С‚СѓСЃ Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё Р· СѓСЂР°С…СѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏРј UNIQUE(guild_id, user_id, status).

    РЇРєС‰Рѕ Р·Р°РїРёСЃ С–Р· С‚Р°РєРёРј status СѓР¶Рµ С–СЃРЅСѓС”, РїРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅР° Р·Р°СЏРІРєР° РІРёРґР°Р»СЏС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ,
    С‰РѕР± РЅРµ Р»Р°РјР°С‚Рё Р‘Р” С– РЅРµ Р·Р°Р»РёС€Р°С‚Рё pending-РґСѓР±Р»С–РєР°С‚.
    """

    app = get_guild_application_by_id(application_id)
    if not app:
        return False

    now = now_iso()

    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE guild_applications
        SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
        WHERE id=?
        """, (
            status,
            now,
            processed_by,
            application_id,
        ))
        conn.commit()
        return True
    except Exception as error:
        if "UNIQUE constraint failed" not in str(error):
            raise

        # Р„ С–РЅС€Р° Р·Р°СЏРІРєР° Р· С‚Р°РєРёРј СЃР°РјРёРј guild_id/user_id/status.
        # РџРѕС‚РѕС‡РЅРёР№ pending-Р·Р°РїРёСЃ Р±С–Р»СЊС€Рµ РЅРµ РїРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РµРЅ.
        cursor.execute("DELETE FROM guild_applications WHERE id=?", (application_id,))
        conn.commit()
        return True


def _guild_cancel_other_pending_applications(user_id, except_application_id=None, processed_by=None):
    now = now_iso()

    if except_application_id is None:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE guild_applications
        SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND status=?
        """, (
            GUILD_APPLICATION_CANCELLED,
            now,
            processed_by,
            user_id,
            GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
        ))
    else:
        cursor.execute("""
        UPDATE guild_applications
        SET status=?, processed_at=?, processed_by=?
        WHERE user_id=? AND status=? AND id != ?
        """, (
            GUILD_APPLICATION_CANCELLED,
            now,
            processed_by,
            user_id,
            GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
            except_application_id,
        ))

    conn.commit()


# FINAL OVERRIDE for 7.0.5 accept_guild_application.
def accept_guild_application(actor_user_id, application_id):
    init_guild_system()

    app = get_guild_application_by_id(application_id)

    if not app:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р—Р°СЏРІРєСѓ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."}

    guild_id = app["guild_id"]
    applicant_user_id = app["user_id"]

    if app["status"] != GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р¦СЏ Р·Р°СЏРІРєР° РІР¶Рµ РЅРµ РѕС‡С–РєСѓС” СЂРѕР·РіР»СЏРґСѓ."}

    if not can_manage_guild_applications(actor_user_id, guild_id):
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РЈ С‚РµР±Рµ РЅРµРјР°С” РїСЂР°РІ РґР»СЏ РѕР±СЂРѕР±РєРё Р·Р°СЏРІРѕРє."}

    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)
    if not guild:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."}

    applicant_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(applicant_user_id)
    existing_member = get_user_guild_member(applicant_user_id)

    # Idempotent recovery: РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ СѓР¶Рµ РІ С†С–Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—, Р°Р»Рµ pending-Р·Р°СЏРІРєР° РІРёСЃРёС‚СЊ.
    if existing_member and int(existing_member["guild_id"]) == int(guild_id):
        _guild_safe_set_application_status(
            application_id,
            GUILD_APPLICATION_ACCEPTED,
            processed_by=actor_user_id,
        )
        _guild_cancel_other_pending_applications(
            applicant_user_id,
            except_application_id=application_id,
            processed_by=actor_user_id,
        )
        return {
            "success": True,
            "message": f"вњ… {applicant_name} СѓР¶Рµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С” РІ С†С–Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—. Р—Р°СЏРІРєСѓ РѕС‡РёС‰РµРЅРѕ."
        }

    # РЇРєС‰Рѕ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ СѓР¶Рµ РІ С–РЅС€С–Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— вЂ” pending-Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ С‚СЂРµР±Р° РїСЂРёР±СЂР°С‚Рё Р±РµР· РїР°РґС–РЅРЅСЏ.
    if existing_member and int(existing_member["guild_id"]) != int(guild_id):
        _guild_safe_set_application_status(
            application_id,
            GUILD_APPLICATION_REJECTED,
            processed_by=actor_user_id,
        )
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р“СЂР°РІРµС†СЊ СѓР¶Рµ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°С” РІ С–РЅС€С–Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—. Р—Р°СЏРІРєСѓ РІС–РґС…РёР»РµРЅРѕ."}

    member_count = get_guild_member_count(guild_id)
    member_limit = int(guild["member_limit"] or DEFAULT_GUILD_MEMBER_LIMIT)

    if member_count >= member_limit:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РЈ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РЅРµРјР°С” РІС–Р»СЊРЅРёС… РјС–СЃС†СЊ."}

    now = now_iso()

    try:
        cursor.execute("""
        INSERT INTO guild_members (guild_id, user_id, role, joined_at)
        VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
        """, (
            guild_id,
            applicant_user_id,
            GUILD_ROLE_MEMBER,
            now,
        ))
        conn.commit()
    except Exception as error:
        # РЇРєС‰Рѕ РїР°СЂР°Р»РµР»СЊРЅРѕ/СЂР°РЅС–С€Рµ РіСЂР°РІРµС†СЊ СѓР¶Рµ Р±СѓРІ РґРѕРґР°РЅРёР№ вЂ” РїРµСЂРµРІРѕРґРёРјРѕ РІ idempotent branch.
        if "UNIQUE constraint failed" not in str(error):
            raise

    _guild_safe_set_application_status(
        application_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_ACCEPTED,
        processed_by=actor_user_id,
    )

    _guild_cancel_other_pending_applications(
        applicant_user_id,
        except_application_id=application_id,
        processed_by=actor_user_id,
    )

    try:
        add_guild_log(
            guild_id=guild_id,
            event_type="application_accepted",
            text=f"{applicant_name} РІСЃС‚СѓРїРёРІ РґРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."
        )
    except Exception:
        pass

    return {"success": True, "message": f"вњ… {applicant_name} РїСЂРёР№РЅСЏС‚Рѕ РґРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—."}


def cleanup_stale_guild_applications():
    """
    Р§РёСЃС‚РёС‚СЊ СЃС‚Р°СЂС– pending-Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё РІС–Рґ РіСЂР°РІС†С–РІ, СЏРєС– РІР¶Рµ С” РІ С‚С–Р№ СЃР°РјС–Р№ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—.
    РўР°РєРѕР¶ РїСЂРёР±РёСЂР°С” pending-Р·Р°СЏРІРєРё РІ С–РЅС€С– РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РґР»СЏ РіСЂР°РІС†С–РІ, СЏРєС– РІР¶Рµ РґРµСЃСЊ РїРµСЂРµР±СѓРІР°СЋС‚СЊ.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    fixed_same_guild = 0
    cancelled_other_guild = 0

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT ga.id, ga.guild_id, ga.user_id, gm.guild_id AS member_guild_id
    FROM guild_applications ga
    JOIN guild_members gm ON gm.user_id = ga.user_id
    WHERE ga.status=?
    """, (GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,))

    rows = cursor.fetchall()

    for row in rows:
        app_id = row["id"]
        app_guild_id = row["guild_id"]
        member_guild_id = row["member_guild_id"]

        if int(app_guild_id) == int(member_guild_id):
            _guild_safe_set_application_status(app_id, GUILD_APPLICATION_ACCEPTED, processed_by=None)
            fixed_same_guild += 1
        else:
            _guild_safe_set_application_status(app_id, GUILD_APPLICATION_CANCELLED, processed_by=None)
            cancelled_other_guild += 1

    return {
        "fixed_same_guild": fixed_same_guild,
        "cancelled_other_guild": cancelled_other_guild,
    }


# ==============================
# вњ… GUILD PROGRESS CONTRIBUTIONS CORE V1
# ==============================

# 7.0.7
# Guild EXP / Resource / РІРЅРµСЃРѕРє СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ.
# РќР° С†СЊРѕРјСѓ РµС‚Р°РїС– РґРѕРґР°С”РјРѕ:
# - СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РІС–Рґ Р·Р°РіР°Р»СЊРЅРѕРіРѕ EXP;
# - СЂРµР№С‚РёРЅРі РІРЅРµСЃРєСѓ СѓС‡Р°СЃРЅРёРєС–РІ;
# - helper-Рё РґР»СЏ РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃСѓ;
# - add_guild_progress() Р»РёС€Р°С”С‚СЊСЃСЏ С†РµРЅС‚СЂР°Р»СЊРЅРѕСЋ С‚РѕС‡РєРѕСЋ РЅР°СЂР°С…СѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ.

GUILD_LEVEL_EXP_BASE = 1000


def get_guild_exp_required_for_level(level):
    """
    РЎРєС–Р»СЊРєРё total EXP РїРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ РґР»СЏ РєРѕРЅРєСЂРµС‚РЅРѕРіРѕ СЂС–РІРЅСЏ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—.

    Level 1: 0
    Level 2: 1000
    Level 3: 3000
    Level 4: 6000

    Р¤РѕСЂРјСѓР»Р° РЅР°РєРѕРїРёС‡СѓРІР°Р»СЊРЅР°: sum(base * n) РґР»СЏ n=1..level-1.
    """

    try:
        level = int(level)
    except Exception:
        level = 1

    level = max(1, level)

    if level <= 1:
        return 0

    return int(GUILD_LEVEL_EXP_BASE * ((level - 1) * level / 2))


def calculate_guild_level_from_exp(total_exp):
    try:
        total_exp = int(total_exp or 0)
    except Exception:
        total_exp = 0

    level = 1

    while total_exp >= get_guild_exp_required_for_level(level + 1):
        level += 1

    return level


def get_guild_next_level_info(guild_id):
    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)

    if not guild:
        return None

    total_exp = int(guild["total_exp"] or 0)
    level = int(guild["level"] or 1)
    calculated_level = calculate_guild_level_from_exp(total_exp)

    if calculated_level > level:
        level = calculated_level

    current_level_exp = get_guild_exp_required_for_level(level)
    next_level_exp = get_guild_exp_required_for_level(level + 1)
    progress_exp = max(0, total_exp - current_level_exp)
    needed_exp = max(1, next_level_exp - current_level_exp)
    progress_percent = min(100.0, max(0.0, progress_exp / needed_exp * 100))

    return {
        "level": level,
        "total_exp": total_exp,
        "current_level_exp": current_level_exp,
        "next_level_exp": next_level_exp,
        "progress_exp": progress_exp,
        "needed_exp": needed_exp,
        "progress_percent": progress_percent,
    }


def recalculate_guild_level(guild_id):
    guild = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)

    if not guild:
        return None

    old_level = int(guild["level"] or 1)
    total_exp = int(guild["total_exp"] or 0)
    new_level = calculate_guild_level_from_exp(total_exp)

    if new_level != old_level:
        cursor.execute(
            "UPDATE guilds SET level=?, updated_at=? WHERE id=?",
            (new_level, now_iso(), guild_id)
        )
        conn.commit()

        if new_level > old_level:
            try:
                add_guild_log(
                    guild_id=guild_id,
                    event_type="guild_level_up",
                    text=f"Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЏ РїС–РґРЅСЏР»Р°СЃСЊ РґРѕ СЂС–РІРЅСЏ {new_level}."
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

    return new_level

def add_guild_progress(guild_id, exp=0, resource=0, kills=0, contracts=0, user_id=None, reason=""):
    """
    FINAL OVERRIDE:
    Р”РѕРґР°С” РїСЂРѕРіСЂРµСЃ С‡РµСЂРµР· Р±Р°Р·РѕРІСѓ С„СѓРЅРєС†С–СЋ 7.0.1 С– РїС–СЃР»СЏ С†СЊРѕРіРѕ РїРµСЂРµСЂР°С…РѕРІСѓС” СЂС–РІРµРЅСЊ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С—.
    """

    if _base_add_guild_progress_before_contributions_v1 is None:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р‘Р°Р·РѕРІР° С„СѓРЅРєС†С–СЏ add_guild_progress РЅРµРґРѕСЃС‚СѓРїРЅР°."
        }

    result = _base_add_guild_progress_before_contributions_v1(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        exp=exp,
        resource=resource,
        kills=kills,
        contracts=contracts,
        user_id=user_id,
        reason=reason,
    )

    try:
        result["guild_level"] = recalculate_guild_level(guild_id)
        result["next_level_info"] = get_guild_next_level_info(guild_id)
    except Exception:
        pass

    return result

def get_guild_contribution_ranking(guild_id, scope="monthly", limit=30):
    init_guild_system()
    ensure_guild_monthly_season(guild_id)

    try:
        limit = int(limit)
    except Exception:
        limit = 30

    limit = max(1, min(100, limit))

    if scope == "total":
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT gm.*,
               users.character_name,
               users.level
        FROM guild_members gm
        LEFT JOIN users ON users.user_id = gm.user_id
        WHERE gm.guild_id=?
        ORDER BY gm.contribution_score DESC,
                 gm.contribution_exp DESC,
                 gm.joined_at ASC
        LIMIT ?
        """, (guild_id, limit))
    else:
        cursor.execute("""
        SELECT gm.*,
               users.character_name,
               users.level
        FROM guild_members gm
        LEFT JOIN users ON users.user_id = gm.user_id
        WHERE gm.guild_id=?
        ORDER BY gm.monthly_contribution_score DESC,
                 gm.monthly_contribution_exp DESC,
                 gm.joined_at ASC
        LIMIT ?
        """, (guild_id, limit))

    return cursor.fetchall()


def cleanup_recalculate_all_guild_levels():
    init_guild_system()
    cursor.execute("SELECT id FROM guilds")
    rows = cursor.fetchall()
    updated = 0

    for row in rows:
        try:
            guild_id = row["id"]
        except Exception:
            guild_id = row[0]
        old = get_guild_by_id(guild_id)["level"]
        new = recalculate_guild_level(guild_id)
        if new != old:
            updated += 1

    return updated

            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р“С–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."
        }

    cursor.execute("""
    SELECT * FROM guild_applications
    WHERE guild_id=? AND user_id=? AND status=?
    """, (
        guild_id,
        user_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
    ))

    if cursor.fetchone():
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "в„№пёЏ РўРё РІР¶Рµ РїРѕРґР°РІ Р·Р°СЏРІРєСѓ РІ С†СЋ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–СЋ."
        }

    cursor.execute("""

    VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?)
    """, (
        guild_id,
        user_id,
        GUILD_APPLICATION_PENDING,
        now_iso(),
    ))

    conn.commit()

    applicant_name = get_character_name_by_user_id(user_id)

    add_guild_log(
        guild_id=guild_id,
        event_type="application_created",
        text=f"РќРѕРІР° Р·Р°СЏРІРєР° РґРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РІС–Рґ {applicant_name}."
    )

        "message": "вњ… Р—Р°СЏРІРєСѓ РґРѕ РіС–Р»СЊРґС–С— РїРѕРґР°РЅРѕ."
    }

def get_guild_diagnostics(user_id):
    """
    Technical diagnostics for /guild_debug.
    Safe read-only helper.
    """

    init_guild_system()

    diagnostics = {
        "user_id": user_id,
        "season_key": get_current_guild_season_key(),
        "has_guild": False,
        "guild": None,
        "member": None,
        "member_count": 0,
        "pending_applications": 0,
        "user_pending_applications": 0,
        "officer_count": 0,
        "next_level_info": None,
    }

    try:
        member = get_user_guild_member(user_id)
        diagnostics["member"] = member
        diagnostics["user_pending_applications"] = get_user_pending_applications_count(user_id)

        if not member:
            return diagnostics

        guild = get_guild_by_id(member["guild_id"])
        diagnostics["guild"] = guild
        diagnostics["has_guild"] = bool(guild)

        if guild:
            ensure_guild_monthly_season(guild["id"])
            diagnostics["member_count"] = get_guild_member_count(guild["id"])
            diagnostics["pending_applications"] = get_guild_pending_applications_count(guild["id"])

            try:
                diagnostics["officer_count"] = get_guild_officer_count(guild["id"])
            except Exception:
                diagnostics["officer_count"] = 0

            try:
                diagnostics["next_level_info"] = get_guild_next_level_info(guild["id"])
            except Exception:
                diagnostics["next_level_info"] = None

    except Exception as error:
        diagnostics["error"] = str(error)

    return diagnostics


def run_guild_sanity_cleanup():
    """
    Conservative cleanup used by /guild_fix_states and startup-compatible calls:
    - stale pending applications for players already in guilds;
    - guild levels recalculation;
    - duplicate icon/index checks if available.
    """

    result = {
        "stale_applications": None,
        "levels_recalculated": None,
        "icons_checked": False,
        "ok": True,
        "errors": [],
    }

    try:
        try:
            result["stale_applications"] = cleanup_stale_guild_applications()
        except Exception as error:
            result["errors"].append(f"cleanup_stale_guild_applications: {error}")

        try:
            result["levels_recalculated"] = cleanup_recalculate_all_guild_levels()
        except Exception as error:
            result["errors"].append(f"cleanup_recalculate_all_guild_levels: {error}")

        try:
            ensure_unique_guild_icon_index()
            result["icons_checked"] = True
        except Exception as error:
            result["errors"].append(f"ensure_unique_guild_icon_index: {error}")

    except Exception as error:
        result["ok"] = False
        result["errors"].append(str(error))

    if result["errors"]:
        result["ok"] = False

    return result

import time

from datetime import datetime, timedelta


# ==============================

DB_PATH = "game.db"

NOTIFICATION_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS = 60

ENERGY_MAX = 40
ENERGY_REGEN_MINUTES = 5

HP_REGEN_PERCENT = 0.10
HP_REGEN_MINUTES = 1


# ==============================

def create_worker_connection():
    """
    РћРєСЂРµРјРµ SQLite-РїС–РґРєР»СЋС‡РµРЅРЅСЏ РґР»СЏ notification worker.
    РќРµ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС” РіР»РѕР±Р°Р»СЊРЅРёР№ conn/cursor Р· db.py.
    """

    conn = sqlite3.connect(
        DB_PATH,
        check_same_thread=False,
        timeout=30
    )

    try:
        conn.execute("PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL")
        conn.execute("PRAGMA busy_timeout=30000")
    except Exception:
        pass

    return conn

# вњ… ENERGY HELPERS
# ==============================

def init_energy_columns(conn):
    migrations = [
        ("users", "energy", "INTEGER DEFAULT 0"),
        ("users", "last_energy_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "energy_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET energy = ?
    WHERE energy IS NULL OR energy < 0
    """, (0,))

    # Р’РёРґР°Р»РµРЅРѕ РЅРµР±РµР·РїРµС‡РЅРµ РѕР±РЅСѓР»РµРЅРЅСЏ - С†Рµ СЃРїСЂРёС‡РёРЅСЏР»Рѕ РїРѕРјРёР»РєРё РїСЂРё СЂРµРіРµРЅРµСЂР°С†С–С— energ


def apply_energy_regen(conn, user_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” Р°РєС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅСѓ Р’С‚РѕРјСѓ Р· СѓСЂР°С…СѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏРј Р·РЅРёР¶РµРЅРЅСЏ (СЂРµРіРµРЅР°С†С–С—).
    """

    init_energy_columns(conn)

    row = conn.execute("""
    SELECT energy, last_energy_update
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,)).fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "energy": 0,
            "max_energy": ENERGY_MAX
        }

    energy, last_update = row

    if energy is None:
        energy = 0

    now = datetime.now()

    if not last_update:
        last_update_dt = now
    else:
        try:
            last_update_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(last_update)
        except Exception:
            last_update_dt = now

    if energy > 0:
        diff_seconds = (now - last_update_dt).total_seconds()
        regen_units = int(diff_seconds // (ENERGY_REGEN_MINUTES * 60))

        if regen_units > 0:
            energy = max(0, energy - regen_units)
            last_update_dt = last_update_dt + timedelta(
                minutes=regen_units * ENERGY_REGEN_MINUTES
            )

            conn.execute("""
            UPDATE users
            SET energy=?,
                last_energy_update=?
            WHERE user_id=?
            """, (
                energy,
                last_update_dt.isoformat(),
                user_id
            ))

            conn.commit()

    # РљРѕР»Рё energy == 0, РЅРµ РїРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅРѕ РѕРЅРѕРІР»СЋРІР°С‚Рё С‚Р°Р№РјРµСЂ (РІС–РЅ РІР¶Рµ РЅР° 0)

    return {
        "energy": energy,
        "max_energy": ENERGY_MAX
    }


def get_users_for_energy_full_notification_worker(conn):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” user_id РіСЂР°РІС†С–РІ, Сѓ СЏРєРёС… Р’С‚РѕРјР° СЃС‚Р°Р»Р° 0 (РїРѕРІРЅС–СЃС‚СЋ РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРѕ),
    Р°Р»Рµ РїРѕРІС–РґРѕРјР»РµРЅРЅСЏ С‰Рµ РЅРµ РЅР°РґСЃРёР»Р°Р»РѕСЃСЏ.
    """

    init_energy_columns(conn)

    rows = conn.execute("""
    SELECT user_id
    FROM users
    """).fetchall()

    notify_users = []

    for row in rows:
        user_id = row[0]

        energy_data = apply_energy_regen(conn, user_id)
        energy = energy_data["energy"]
        max_energy = energy_data["max_energy"]

        notified_row = conn.execute("""
        SELECT energy_full_notified
        FROM users
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (user_id,)).fetchone()

        notified = notified_row[0] if notified_row else 0

        if energy <= 0 and not notified:
            notify_users.append(user_id)

            conn.execute("""
            UPDATE users
            SET energy_full_notified=1
            WHERE user_id=?
            """, (user_id,))

        elif energy > 0 and notified:
            conn.execute("""
            UPDATE users
            SET energy_full_notified=0
            WHERE user_id=?
            """, (user_id,))

    conn.commit()

    return notify_users

def init_hp_columns(conn):
    migrations = [
        ("users", "last_hp_regen_update", "TEXT DEFAULT ''"),
        ("users", "hp_full_notified", "INTEGER DEFAULT 1"),
    ]

    for table, column, column_type in migrations:
        try:
            conn.execute(f"ALTER TABLE {table} ADD COLUMN {column} {column_type}")
        except Exception:
            pass

    conn.commit()


def get_equipped_stat_bonus(conn, user_id, stat_column):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” СЃСѓРјР°СЂРЅРёР№ Р±РѕРЅСѓСЃ РµРєС–РїС–СЂСѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏ РґР»СЏ РєРѕРЅРєСЂРµС‚РЅРѕС— С…Р°СЂР°РєС‚РµСЂРёСЃС‚РёРєРё.
    Р’СЂР°С…РѕРІСѓС” С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё РІРґСЏРіРЅРµРЅС– РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚Рё Р· durability > 0.
    """

    try:
        rows = conn.execute(f"""
        SELECT items.{stat_column}, inventory.durability
        FROM equipment_slots
        JOIN inventory ON equipment_slots.inventory_id = inventory.id
        JOIN items ON inventory.item_id = items.id
        WHERE equipment_slots.user_id=?
          AND equipment_slots.inventory_id IS NOT NULL
        """, (user_id,)).fetchall()
    except Exception:
        return 0

    total = 0

    for bonus, durability in rows:
        if durability is not None and durability <= 0:
            continue

        total += bonus or 0

    return total


def get_worker_max_hp(conn, user_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІС‚РѕСЂСЋС” Р»РѕРіС–РєСѓ get_max_hp Р· db.py:
    max_hp = 100 + level * 20 + total_sta * 5
    """

    row = conn.execute("""
    SELECT level, sta
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,)).fetchone()

    if not row:
        return 100

    level, base_sta = row

    level = level or 1
    base_sta = base_sta or 10

    item_sta = get_equipped_stat_bonus(conn, user_id, "bonus_sta")

    total_sta = base_sta + item_sta

    return 100 + (level * 20) + (total_sta * 5)


def apply_hp_regen(conn, user_id):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” Р°РєС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅРµ HP Р· СѓСЂР°С…СѓРІР°РЅРЅСЏРј РїР°СЃРёРІРЅРѕС— СЂРµРіРµРЅРµСЂР°С†С–С—.
    """

    init_hp_columns(conn)

    row = conn.execute("""
    SELECT hp, last_hp_regen_update
    FROM users
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (user_id,)).fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "hp": 0,
            "max_hp": 100
        }

    hp, last_update = row
    max_hp = get_worker_max_hp(conn, user_id)

    if hp is None:
        hp = max_hp

    now = datetime.now()

    if not last_update:
        last_update_dt = now

        conn.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET last_hp_regen_update=?
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (
            last_update_dt.isoformat(),
            user_id
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "hp": hp,
            "max_hp": max_hp
        }

    try:
        last_update_dt = datetime.fromisoformat(last_update)
    except Exception:
        last_update_dt = now

    if hp >= max_hp:
        hp = max_hp

        conn.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET hp=?,
            last_hp_regen_update=?,
            hp_full_notified=1
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (
            max_hp,
            now.isoformat(),
            user_id
        ))

        conn.commit()

        return {
            "hp": max_hp,
            "max_hp": max_hp
        }

    diff_seconds = (now - last_update_dt).total_seconds()
    regen_ticks = int(diff_seconds // (HP_REGEN_MINUTES * 60))

    if regen_ticks <= 0:
        return {
            "hp": hp,
            "max_hp": max_hp
        }

    heal_per_tick = max(1, int(max_hp * HP_REGEN_PERCENT))
    total_heal = heal_per_tick * regen_ticks

    new_hp = min(max_hp, hp + total_heal)

    new_update_dt = last_update_dt + timedelta(
        minutes=regen_ticks * HP_REGEN_MINUTES
    )

    hp_full_notified = 0 if new_hp >= max_hp else 0

    conn.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET hp=?,
        last_hp_regen_update=?,
        hp_full_notified=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_hp,
        new_update_dt.isoformat(),
        hp_full_notified,
        user_id
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "hp": new_hp,
        "max_hp": max_hp
    }


def get_users_for_hp_full_notification_worker(conn):
    """
    РџРѕРІРµСЂС‚Р°С” user_id РіСЂР°РІС†С–РІ, Сѓ СЏРєРёС… HP СЃС‚Р°Р»Рѕ РїРѕРІРЅРёРј,
    Р°Р»Рµ РїРѕРІС–РґРѕРјР»РµРЅРЅСЏ С‰Рµ РЅРµ РЅР°РґСЃРёР»Р°Р»РѕСЃСЏ.
    """

    init_hp_columns(conn)

    rows = conn.execute("""
    SELECT user_id
    FROM users
    """).fetchall()

    notify_users = []

    for row in rows:
        user_id = row[0]

        hp_data = apply_hp_regen(conn, user_id)
        hp = hp_data["hp"]
        max_hp = hp_data["max_hp"]

        notified_row = conn.execute("""
        SELECT hp_full_notified
        FROM users
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (user_id,)).fetchone()

        notified = notified_row[0] if notified_row else 1

        if hp >= max_hp and not notified:
            notify_users.append(user_id)

            conn.execute("""
            UPDATE users
            SET hp_full_notified=1
            WHERE user_id=?
            """, (user_id,))

        elif hp < max_hp and notified:
            conn.execute("""
            UPDATE users
            SET hp_full_notified=0
            WHERE user_id=?
            """, (user_id,))

    conn.commit()

    return notify_users

def notification_worker(bot_instance):
    conn = create_worker_connection()

    print("вњ… NOTIFICATION WORKER DB CONNECTION READY")

    while True:
        try:
            notify_energy_full(bot_instance, conn)
            notify_hp_restored(bot_instance, conn)

            # РњР°Р№Р±СѓС‚РЅС– РїРѕРІС–РґРѕРјР»РµРЅРЅСЏ:
            # notify_daily_contracts_reset(bot_instance, conn)
            # notify_craft_or_repair_ready(bot_instance, conn)

        except Exception as error:
            print(f"вљ пёЏ NOTIFICATION WORKER ERROR: {error}")

            try:
                conn.close()
            except Exception:
                pass

            try:
                conn = create_worker_connection()
                print("вњ… NOTIFICATION WORKER DB CONNECTION RECREATED")
            except Exception as reconnect_error:
                print(f"вќЊ NOTIFICATION WORKER DB RECONNECT ERROR: {reconnect_error}")

        time.sleep(NOTIFICATION_CHECK_INTERVAL_SECONDS)


def start_notification_worker(bot_instance):
    thread = threading.Thread(
        target=notification_worker,
        args=(bot_instance,),
        daemon=True
    )

    thread.start()

    print("вњ… NOTIFICATION WORKER STARTED")


# ==============================
# вњ… ROM 9.0.2d NOTIFICATION HP DYNAMIC MAX FIX V1
# ==============================

# Fix reason:
# Notification worker had its own get_worker_max_hp() formula and did not include
# refine armor HP bonus. Because of that it could treat 365/365 as full HP while
# the real dynamic max HP from +6 armor was 380.
#
# This override keeps notifications worker self-contained and uses the worker DB
# connection instead of importing db.py in the worker thread.

try:
    _notifications_base_get_worker_max_hp_before_dynamic_refine_v1 = get_worker_max_hp
except NameError:
    _notifications_base_get_worker_max_hp_before_dynamic_refine_v1 = None

try:
    _notifications_base_apply_hp_regen_before_dynamic_refine_v1 = apply_hp_regen
except NameError:
    _notifications_base_apply_hp_regen_before_dynamic_refine_v1 = None


WORKER_ARMOR_HP_BONUS_PER_REFINE_LEVEL_V1 = 4.0 / 6.0
WORKER_ARMOR_SLOTS_FOR_HP_REFINE_V1 = {
    "helmet",
    "shoulders",
    "chest",
    "gloves",
    "legs",
    "boots",
}


def _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, table_name):
    try:
        rows = conn.execute(f"PRAGMA table_info({table_name})").fetchall()
        return {row[1] for row in rows}
    except Exception:
        return set()


def _worker_iso_to_dt_v1(value):
    if not value:
        return None

    text = str(value).strip()

    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace("Z", ""))
    except Exception:
        pass

    try:
        return datetime.fromisoformat(text.replace("T", " ").split(".")[0])
    except Exception:
        return None


def get_worker_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent_v1(conn, user_id):
    """
    Calculates HP bonus from currently equipped refined armor for notification worker.

    Current known rule from refine 6.0:
    - armor +6 gives +4% max HP;
    - therefore 1 refine level ~= 0.6667% max HP.

    This mirrors the gameplay intent well enough for notification/full-HP checks.
    """

    try:
        equipment_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "equipment_slots")
        inventory_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "inventory")
        item_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "items")

        if not {"user_id", "slot_key", "inventory_id"}.issubset(equipment_cols):
            return 0.0

        if "refine_level" not in inventory_cols:
            return 0.0

        if "slot_key" not in item_cols:
            return 0.0

        rows = conn.execute("""
        SELECT
            es.slot_key AS equipped_slot,
            COALESCE(inv.refine_level, 0) AS refine_level,
            items.slot_key AS item_slot,
            items.category AS category
        FROM equipment_slots es
        JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id = es.inventory_id
        JOIN items ON items.id = inv.item_id
        WHERE es.user_id=?
          AND es.inventory_id IS NOT NULL
        """, (user_id,)).fetchall()

        total_percent = 0.0

        for row in rows:
            equipped_slot = row[0]
            refine_level = int(row[1] or 0)
            item_slot = row[2]

            slot = equipped_slot or item_slot

            if refine_level <= 0:
                continue

            if slot not in WORKER_ARMOR_SLOTS_FOR_HP_REFINE_V1:
                continue

            total_percent += refine_level * WORKER_ARMOR_HP_BONUS_PER_REFINE_LEVEL_V1

        return max(0.0, total_percent)

    except Exception:
        return 0.0


def get_worker_max_hp(conn, user_id):
    """
    Dynamic max HP for notification worker.

    Uses the existing worker base formula, then applies refine armor HP bonus.
    Also syncs users.max_hp so DB snapshots match profile logic.
    """

    if _notifications_base_get_worker_max_hp_before_dynamic_refine_v1:
        try:
            base_hp = int(_notifications_base_get_worker_max_hp_before_dynamic_refine_v1(conn, user_id) or 1)
        except Exception:
            base_hp = 100
    else:
        base_hp = 100

    bonus_percent = get_worker_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent_v1(conn, user_id)
    dynamic_max_hp = int(round(base_hp * (1 + bonus_percent / 100.0)))
    dynamic_max_hp = max(1, dynamic_max_hp)

    try:
        user_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "users")
        if "max_hp" in user_cols:
            conn.execute(
                "UPDATE users SET max_hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                (dynamic_max_hp, user_id),
            )
            conn.commit()
    except Exception:
        pass

    return dynamic_max_hp


def apply_hp_regen(conn, user_id):
    """
    HP regen that respects dynamic max HP from refined armor.

    Important behavior:
    - equipping refined armor increases max HP but does not heal instantly;
    - passive regen heals toward the dynamic max;
    - full HP notification only fires at dynamic max, not stale stored max_hp.
    """

    init_hp_columns(conn)

    user_cols = _worker_table_columns_v1(conn, "users")
    has_max_hp = "max_hp" in user_cols

    select_cols = ["hp", "last_hp_regen_update"]
    if has_max_hp:
        select_cols.insert(1, "max_hp")

    row = conn.execute(
        f"SELECT {', '.join(select_cols)} FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
        (user_id,)
    ).fetchone()

    if not row:
        return {
            "hp": 0,
            "max_hp": 100,
        }

    if has_max_hp:
        hp = row[0]
        stored_max_hp = row[1]
        last_update = row[2]
    else:
        hp = row[0]
        stored_max_hp = None
        last_update = row[1]

    max_hp = get_worker_max_hp(conn, user_id)

    if hp is None:
        hp = max_hp

    hp = int(hp or 0)

    now = datetime.now()

    last_update_dt = _worker_iso_to_dt_v1(last_update)

    if last_update_dt is None:
        conn.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET last_hp_regen_update=?
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (
            now.isoformat(),
            user_id,
        ))
        conn.commit()

        return {
            "hp": min(hp, max_hp),
            "max_hp": max_hp,
        }

    # Clamp overheal / stale HP down to dynamic max.
    if hp >= max_hp:
        hp = max_hp

        conn.execute("""
        UPDATE users
        SET hp=?,
            last_hp_regen_update=?,
            hp_full_notified=1
        WHERE user_id=?
        """, (
            max_hp,
            now.isoformat(),
            user_id,
        ))
        conn.commit()

        return {
            "hp": max_hp,
            "max_hp": max_hp,
        }

    diff_seconds = (now - last_update_dt).total_seconds()

    if diff_seconds < 0:
        diff_seconds = 0

    regen_ticks = int(diff_seconds // (HP_REGEN_MINUTES * 60))

    if regen_ticks <= 0:
        # Below dynamic max but not enough time has passed. Do not mark full.
        if has_max_hp and stored_max_hp != max_hp:
            try:
                conn.execute(
                    "UPDATE users SET max_hp=?, hp_full_notified=0 WHERE user_id=?",
                    (max_hp, user_id),
                )
                conn.commit()
            except Exception:
                pass

        return {
            "hp": hp,
            "max_hp": max_hp,
        }

    heal_per_tick = max(1, int(max_hp * HP_REGEN_PERCENT))
    total_heal = heal_per_tick * regen_ticks
    new_hp = min(max_hp, hp + total_heal)

    new_update_dt = last_update_dt + timedelta(
        minutes=regen_ticks * HP_REGEN_MINUTES
    )

    # If HP became full, keep hp_full_notified=0 so get_users_for_hp_full_notification_worker()
    # can send one notification and then mark it as notified.
    hp_full_notified = 0

    conn.execute("""
    UPDATE users
    SET hp=?,
        max_hp=?,
        last_hp_regen_update=?,
        hp_full_notified=?
    WHERE user_id=?
    """, (
        new_hp,
        max_hp,
        new_update_dt.isoformat(),
        hp_full_notified,
        user_id,
    ))

    conn.commit()

    return {
        "hp": new_hp,
        "max_hp": max_hp,
    }

# вњ… ROM 9.0.2 PLAYER SYSTEM V1
"""
ROM Player System v1.

Goal of 9.0.2:
- create a dedicated player/progression/stat domain module;
- move public player/stats/gold/exp/API ownership behind systems.player_system;
- keep db.py as compatibility facade for existing handlers;
- preserve current behavior by delegating to legacy db.py implementations where available.

This stage is conservative and intentionally does not delete old db.py code.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Callable, Optional


def _db_module():
    import db
    return db


def _legacy_function(name: str) -> Optional[Callable[..., Any]]:
    db = _db_module()
    return getattr(db, f"_legacy_{name}_before_player_system_v1", None)


def _fetchone(sql: str, params: tuple = ()):  # sqlite3.Row or tuple depending on project state
    db = _db_module()
    db.cursor.execute(sql, params)
    return db.cursor.fetchone()


def _execute_commit(sql: str, params: tuple = ()):
    db = _db_module()
    db.cursor.execute(sql, params)
    db.conn.commit()


def _row_get(row, key: str, index: int = 0, default=None):
    if row is None:
        return default
    try:
        return row[key]
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        return row[index]
    except Exception:
        return default


def get_player_stats(user_id: int):
    legacy = _legacy_function("get_player_stats")
    if legacy:
        return legacy(user_id)

    row = _fetchone(
        """
        SELECT str, dex, int, wis, sta, level
        FROM users
        WHERE user_id=?
        """,
        (user_id,),
    )

    if not row:
        return None

    return (
        int(_row_get(row, "str", 0, 10) or 10),
        int(_row_get(row, "dex", 1, 10) or 10),
        int(_row_get(row, "int", 2, 10) or 10),
        int(_row_get(row, "wis", 3, 10) or 10),
        int(_row_get(row, "sta", 4, 10) or 10),
        int(_row_get(row, "level", 5, 1) or 1),
    )


def get_player_level(user_id: int):
    legacy = _legacy_function("get_player_level")
    if legacy:
        return legacy(user_id)

    row = _fetchone("SELECT level FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
    return int(_row_get(row, "level", 0, 1) or 1)


def get_wallet(user_id: int):
    legacy = _legacy_function("get_wallet")
    if legacy:
        return legacy(user_id)

    row = _fetchone("SELECT gold FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
    return float(_row_get(row, "gold", 0, 0) or 0)


def add_gold(user_id: int, amount):
    legacy = _legacy_function("add_gold")
    if legacy:
        return legacy(user_id, amount)

    current = get_wallet(user_id)
    new_value = current + float(amount)
    _execute_commit("UPDATE users SET gold=? WHERE user_id=?", (new_value, user_id))
    return new_value


def add_exp(user_id: int, amount):
    legacy = _legacy_function("add_exp")
    if legacy:
        return legacy(user_id, amount)

    row = _fetchone("SELECT exp FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
    current = int(_row_get(row, "exp", 0, 0) or 0)
    new_value = current + int(amount)
    _execute_commit("UPDATE users SET exp=? WHERE user_id=?", (new_value, user_id))
    return {"exp": new_value, "level": get_player_level(user_id), "level_ups": 0}

def add_kill(user_id: int, amount: int = 1):
    """
    Compatibility fix.

    РЈ СЃС‚Р°СЂРѕРјСѓ db.py Р°РєС‚СѓР°Р»СЊРЅР° legacy-С„СѓРЅРєС†С–СЏ add_kill() РјР°С” СЃРёРіРЅР°С‚СѓСЂСѓ:
        add_kill(user_id)

    Рђ facade 9.0.2 РІРёРєР»РёРєР°РІ legacy СЏРє:
        legacy(user_id, amount)

    Р§РµСЂРµР· С†Рµ РїС–СЃР»СЏ Р±РѕСЋ РІРёРЅРёРєР°Р»Рѕ:
        TypeError: add_kill() takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given

    РџСЂР°РІРёР»СЊРЅР° СЃСѓРјС–СЃРЅР° Р»РѕРіС–РєР°:
    - СЏРєС‰Рѕ amount == 1, РїСЂРѕР±СѓС”РјРѕ СЃС‚Р°СЂРёР№ legacy(user_id);
    - СЏРєС‰Рѕ amount > 1 С– legacy РїС–РґС‚СЂРёРјСѓС” С‚С–Р»СЊРєРё 1 Р°СЂРіСѓРјРµРЅС‚, РІРёРєР»РёРєР°С”РјРѕ legacy(user_id) РєС–Р»СЊРєР° СЂР°Р·С–РІ;
    - СЏРєС‰Рѕ legacy РІС–РґСЃСѓС‚РЅС–Р№, РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚РѕРІСѓС”РјРѕ fallback UPDATE.
    """

    legacy = _legacy_function("add_kill")

    if legacy:
        try:
            return legacy(user_id, amount)
        except TypeError:
            safe_amount = max(1, int(amount or 1))
            result = None
            for _ in range(safe_amount):
                result = legacy(user_id)
            return result

    try:
        safe_amount = max(1, int(amount or 1))
        _execute_commit(
            "UPDATE users SET kills=COALESCE(kills, 0)+? WHERE user_id=?",
            (safe_amount, user_id),
        )
        return True
    except Exception:
        return False

def sync_user_max_hp(user_id: int, heal_to_full: bool = False):
    """
    Synchronize stored users.max_hp with the real dynamic get_max_hp(user_id).

    Important gameplay rule:
    - Equipping +HP armor raises max HP but does NOT heal missing HP automatically.
    - Removing +HP armor lowers max HP and clamps current HP if it is above new max.

    This fixes stale max_hp in DB, which may cause notification worker to say
    "full HP" using stored max_hp while dynamic max HP from refined armor is higher.
    """

    db = _db_module()
    dynamic_max_hp = int(get_max_hp(user_id) or 1)

    try:
        row = _fetchone("SELECT hp, max_hp FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
    except Exception:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "max_hp": dynamic_max_hp,
            "hp": dynamic_max_hp if heal_to_full else 0,
            "changed": False,
        }

    if not row:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "max_hp": dynamic_max_hp,
            "hp": 0,
            "changed": False,
        }

    current_hp = int(_row_get(row, "hp", 0, dynamic_max_hp) or 0)
    stored_max_hp = int(_row_get(row, "max_hp", 1, dynamic_max_hp) or dynamic_max_hp)

    if heal_to_full:
        new_hp = dynamic_max_hp
    else:
        new_hp = min(current_hp, dynamic_max_hp)

    changed = (stored_max_hp != dynamic_max_hp) or (current_hp != new_hp)

    if changed:
        try:
            _execute_commit(
                "UPDATE users SET hp=?, max_hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                (new_hp, dynamic_max_hp, user_id),
            )
        except Exception:
            # If max_hp column is absent in some older DB, still try to clamp hp.
            try:
                _execute_commit(
                    "UPDATE users SET hp=? WHERE user_id=?",
                    (new_hp, user_id),
                )
            except Exception:
                pass

    return {
        "success": True,
        "hp": new_hp,
        "max_hp": dynamic_max_hp,
        "old_hp": current_hp,
        "old_max_hp": stored_max_hp,
        "changed": changed,
    }


def get_current_hp_raw(user_id: int):
    sync = sync_user_max_hp(user_id, heal_to_full=False)

    if sync.get("success"):
        return int(sync.get("hp", 0) or 0)

    if _player_system_base_get_current_hp_raw_before_hp_sync_v1:
        return _player_system_base_get_current_hp_raw_before_hp_sync_v1(user_id)

    row = _fetchone("SELECT hp FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (user_id,))
    return int(_row_get(row, "hp", 0, get_max_hp(user_id)) or get_max_hp(user_id))


def get_current_hp(user_id: int):
    sync = sync_user_max_hp(user_id, heal_to_full=False)

    if sync.get("success"):
        return int(sync.get("hp", 0) or 0)

    if _player_system_base_get_current_hp_before_hp_sync_v1:
        return _player_system_base_get_current_hp_before_hp_sync_v1(user_id)

    return get_current_hp_raw(user_id)


def set_current_hp(user_id: int, hp: int):
    sync = sync_user_max_hp(user_id, heal_to_full=False)
    max_hp = int(sync.get("max_hp", get_max_hp(user_id)) or get_max_hp(user_id))
    safe_hp = max(0, min(int(hp), max_hp))

    try:
        _execute_commit("UPDATE users SET hp=?, max_hp=? WHERE user_id=?", (safe_hp, max_hp, user_id))
        return safe_hp
    except Exception:
        if _player_system_base_set_current_hp_before_hp_sync_v1:
            return _player_system_base_set_current_hp_before_hp_sync_v1(user_id, safe_hp)
        return safe_hp

def _player_direct_db():
    import db
    return db

def _player_direct_fetchone(sql, params=()):
    db = _player_direct_db()
    db.cursor.execute(sql, params)
    return db.cursor.fetchone()

def _player_direct_value(row, key, index=0, default=None):
    if row is None:
        return default
    try:
        return row[key]
    except Exception:
        pass
    try:
        return row[index]
    except Exception:
        return default

def get_player_level(user_id: int):
    row = _player_direct_fetchone("SELECT level FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (int(user_id),))
    try:
        return int(_player_direct_value(row, "level", 0, 1) or 1)
    except Exception:
        return 1

def get_wallet(user_id: int):
    row = _player_direct_fetchone("SELECT gold FROM users WHERE user_id=?", (int(user_id),))
    try:
        return float(_player_direct_value(row, "gold", 0, 0.0) or 0.0)
    except Exception:
        return 0.0

def add_gold(user_id: int, amount):
    db = _player_direct_db()
    try:
        amount = float(amount)
    except Exception:
        amount = 0.0
    db.cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET gold=COALESCE(gold,0)+? WHERE user_id=?", (amount, int(user_id)))
    db.conn.commit()
    return None

def add_kill(user_id: int, amount: int = 1):
    db = _player_direct_db()
    try:
        amount = max(0, int(amount))
    except Exception:
        amount = 1
    if amount:
        db.cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET kills=COALESCE(kills,0)+? WHERE user_id=?", (amount, int(user_id)))
        db.conn.commit()
    return None

def get_current_hp_raw(user_id: int):
    sync = sync_user_max_hp(int(user_id), heal_to_full=False)
    try:
        return int(sync.get("hp", 0) or 0)
    except Exception:
        return 0

def get_current_hp(user_id: int):
    return get_current_hp_raw(int(user_id))

def set_current_hp(user_id: int, hp: int):
    db = _player_direct_db()
    sync = sync_user_max_hp(int(user_id), heal_to_full=False)
    try:
        max_hp = int(sync.get("max_hp", get_max_hp(user_id)) or get_max_hp(user_id))
    except Exception:
        max_hp = int(get_max_hp(user_id) or 1)
    try:
        safe_hp = max(0, min(int(hp), max_hp))
    except Exception:
        safe_hp = 0
    db.cursor.execute("UPDATE users SET hp=? WHERE user_id=?", (safe_hp, int(user_id)))
    db.conn.commit()
    reset = getattr(db, "reset_hp_regen_timers_now", None)
    if callable(reset):
        reset(int(user_id))
    return safe_hp

_ARMOR_SLOTS_9_0_12G = {"helmet", "shoulders", "chest", "gloves", "legs", "boots"}


def _player_combat_db_9_0_12g():
    import db as _db_module
    return _db_module


def _player_base_row_9_0_12g(user_id):
    db = _player_combat_db_9_0_12g()
    return db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT COALESCE(str,0), COALESCE(dex,0), COALESCE(intelligence,0), "
        "COALESCE(wis,0), COALESCE(sta,0), COALESCE(level,1) "
        "FROM users WHERE user_id=?",
        (int(user_id),),
    ).fetchone()


def get_player_stats(user_id: int):
    """Return (STR, DEX, INT, WIS, STA, level), including active equipment."""
    row = _player_base_row_9_0_12g(user_id)
    if not row:
        return None
    base_str, base_dex, base_int, base_wis, base_sta, level = row
    db = _player_combat_db_9_0_12g()
    bonuses = db.get_item_bonuses(int(user_id))
    try:
        item_str, item_dex, item_int, item_wis, item_sta = bonuses
    except Exception:
        item_str = item_dex = item_int = item_wis = item_sta = 0
    return (
        int(base_str or 0) + int(item_str or 0),
        int(base_dex or 0) + int(item_dex or 0),
        int(base_int or 0) + int(item_int or 0),
        int(base_wis or 0) + int(item_wis or 0),
        int(base_sta or 0) + int(item_sta or 0),
        max(1, int(level or 1)),
    )


def get_attack(user_id: int):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
    return int(stats[0]) if stats else 0


def get_magic_attack(user_id: int):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
    return int(stats[2]) if stats else 0


def _armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent_9_0_12g(user_id):
    db = _player_combat_db_9_0_12g()
    rows = db.conn.execute(
        "SELECT it.slot_key, it.rarity, COALESCE(inv.refine_level,0), "
        "COALESCE(inv.durability,100) "
        "FROM equipment_slots es "
        "JOIN inventory inv ON inv.id=es.inventory_id AND inv.user_id=es.user_id "
        "JOIN items it ON it.id=inv.item_id "
        "WHERE es.user_id=?",
        (int(user_id),),
    ).fetchall()
    total = 0.0
    try:
        from systems.refine_system import get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent
    except Exception:
        return 0.0
    for slot_key, rarity, refine_level, durability in rows:
        if slot_key not in _ARMOR_SLOTS_9_0_12G:
            continue
        if int(durability or 0) <= 0:
            continue
        total += float(get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent(refine_level, rarity) or 0.0)
    return round(total, 4)


def get_max_hp(user_id: int):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
    if not stats:
        return 100
    _str, _dex, _int, _wis, total_sta, level = stats
    base_hp = 100 + int(level) * 20 + int(total_sta) * 5
    refine_percent = _armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent_9_0_12g(user_id)
    return max(1, int(round(base_hp * (1.0 + refine_percent / 100.0))))


def get_physical_defense(user_id: int):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
    if not stats:
        return 0
    db = _player_combat_db_9_0_12g()
    item_pdef, _item_mdef = db.get_equipped_item_defenses(int(user_id))
    return int(int(item_pdef or 0) + int(stats[4]) * 0.2)


def get_magic_defense(user_id: int):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
    if not stats:
        return 0
    db = _player_combat_db_9_0_12g()
    _item_pdef, item_mdef = db.get_equipped_item_defenses(int(user_id))
    return int(int(item_mdef or 0) + int(stats[3]))


def get_physical_crit_chance_display(user_id: int):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
    if not stats:
        return 5.0
    chance = 5.0 + ((float(stats[1]) - 10.0) / max(1, int(stats[5]))) * 0.5
    return max(1.0, min(35.0, chance))


def get_magical_crit_chance_display(user_id: int):
    stats = get_player_stats(user_id)
    if not stats:
        return 5.0
    chance = 5.0 + ((float(stats[3]) - 10.0) / max(1, int(stats[5]))) * 0.5
    return max(1.0, min(35.0, chance))


def get_base_dodge_chance_display(user_id: int):
    return 5.0

def get_potion_description(item_id):
    potion = POTIONS.get(item_id)

    if not potion:
        return "РќРµРІС–РґРѕРјРµ Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ"

    if potion["type"] == "hp":
        effect = f"РІС–РґРЅРѕРІР»СЋС” {potion['restore']} HP"

def use_potion_from_inventory(user_id, inventory_id):
    entry = get_inventory_entry(user_id, inventory_id)

    if not entry:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ РІ С–РЅРІРµРЅС‚Р°СЂС–"
        }

    inv_id, item_id, name, item_type, category, quantity = entry

    if category != "potion":
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р¦Рµ РЅРµ Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ"
        }

    potion = POTIONS.get(item_id)

    if not potion:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ Р¦Рµ Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ С‰Рµ РЅРµ РїС–РґС‚СЂРёРјСѓС”С‚СЊСЃСЏ"
        }

    if potion["type"] == "mp":
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "рџ”µ РњР°РЅР° С‰Рµ РЅРµ СЂРµР°Р»С–Р·РѕРІР°РЅР°. Р¦Рµ Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ РїРѕРєРё РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР° РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°С‚Рё."
        }

    current_hp = get_current_hp(user_id)
    max_hp = get_max_hp(user_id)

    if current_hp >= max_hp:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќ¤пёЏ Р—РґРѕСЂРѕРІвЂ™СЏ РІР¶Рµ РїРѕРІРЅРµ"
        }

    healed_amount = potion["restore"]
    new_hp = min(max_hp, current_hp + healed_amount)
    real_heal = new_hp - current_hp

    consumed = consume_inventory_item(user_id, inventory_id, 1)

    if not consumed:
        return {
            "success": False,
            "message": "вќЊ РќРµ РІРґР°Р»РѕСЃСЏ РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°С‚Рё Р·С–Р»Р»СЏ"
        }

    set_current_hp(user_id, new_hp)

    return {
        "success": True,
        "message": (
            f"{potion['name']} РІРёРєРѕСЂРёСЃС‚Р°РЅРѕ.\n"
            f"вќ¤пёЏ Р’С–РґРЅРѕРІР»РµРЅРѕ: +{real_heal} HP\n"
            f"вќ¤пёЏ Р—РґРѕСЂРѕРІвЂ™СЏ: {new_hp}/{max_hp}"
        ),
        "heal": real_heal,
        "new_hp": new_hp,
        "max_hp": max_hp
    }

"""
Rune Magic RPG - Refine System Core v1
6.0.1: core refine logic without Telegram UI.
"""

import random

REFINE_STONE_ITEM_ID = 401
SUCCESS_RUNE_ITEM_ID = 402
WEAPON_MAX_REFINE_LEVEL = 10
ARMOR_MAX_REFINE_LEVEL = 6

WEAPON_REFINE_SUCCESS_CHANCES = {0: 100, 1: 100, 2: 100, 3: 80, 4: 70, 5: 60, 6: 50, 7: 40, 8: 30, 9: 20}
ARMOR_REFINE_SUCCESS_CHANCES = {0: 100, 1: 100, 2: 70, 3: 50, 4: 30, 5: 20}
WEAPON_REFINE_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIERS = {0: 1.00, 1: 1.05, 2: 1.10, 3: 1.15, 4: 1.22, 5: 1.30, 6: 1.40, 7: 1.52, 8: 1.66, 9: 1.82, 10: 2.00}
ARMOR_REFINE_BASE_HP_BONUS_PERCENT = {0: 0.0, 1: 0.5, 2: 1.0, 3: 1.5, 4: 2.0, 5: 3.0, 6: 4.0}
ARMOR_REFINE_RARITY_HP_MULTIPLIERS = {"common": 1.0, "uncommon": 1.1, "rare": 1.2, "epic": 1.3}
ARMOR_SLOT_KEYS = {"helmet", "shoulders", "chest", "gloves", "legs", "boots"}


def normalize_refine_level(level):
    try:
        level = int(level)
    except Exception:
        level = 0
    return max(0, level)


def get_item_refine_kind(item_info):
    if not item_info:
        return ""
    category = item_info.get("category", "")
    slot_key = item_info.get("slot_key", "")
    type_ = item_info.get("type", "")
    if category != "equipment":
        return ""
    if slot_key == "main_hand" or type_ == "weapon":
        return "weapon"
    if slot_key in ARMOR_SLOT_KEYS:
        return "armor"
    return ""


def get_refine_max_level(refine_kind):
    if refine_kind == "weapon":
        return WEAPON_MAX_REFINE_LEVEL
    if refine_kind == "armor":
        return ARMOR_MAX_REFINE_LEVEL
    return 0


def get_refine_success_chance(refine_kind, current_level):
    current_level = normalize_refine_level(current_level)
    if refine_kind == "weapon":
        return WEAPON_REFINE_SUCCESS_CHANCES.get(current_level, 0)
    if refine_kind == "armor":
        return ARMOR_REFINE_SUCCESS_CHANCES.get(current_level, 0)
    return 0


def get_refine_failure_level(refine_kind, current_level):
    current_level = normalize_refine_level(current_level)
    if refine_kind == "weapon":
        return current_level if current_level <= 3 else max(0, current_level - 1)
    if refine_kind == "armor":
        return current_level if current_level <= 2 else max(0, current_level - 1)
    return current_level


def get_weapon_refine_damage_multiplier(refine_level):
    refine_level = min(normalize_refine_level(refine_level), WEAPON_MAX_REFINE_LEVEL)
    return WEAPON_REFINE_DAMAGE_MULTIPLIERS.get(refine_level, 1.00)


def apply_weapon_refine_to_damage(min_damage, max_damage, refine_level):
    multiplier = get_weapon_refine_damage_multiplier(refine_level)
    return int(round(int(min_damage or 0) * multiplier)), int(round(int(max_damage or 0) * multiplier))


def get_armor_refine_hp_bonus_percent(refine_level, rarity):
    refine_level = min(normalize_refine_level(refine_level), ARMOR_MAX_REFINE_LEVEL)
    rarity = (rarity or "common").strip().lower()
    base_bonus = ARMOR_REFINE_BASE_HP_BONUS_PERCENT.get(refine_level, 0.0)
    rarity_multiplier = ARMOR_REFINE_RARITY_HP_MULTIPLIERS.get(rarity, 1.0)
    return round(base_bonus * rarity_multiplier, 2)


def get_refine_display_suffix(refine_level):
    refine_level = normalize_refine_level(refine_level)
    return "" if refine_level <= 0 else f" [+{refine_level}]"


def can_refine_item(item_info):
    refine_kind = get_item_refine_kind(item_info)
    if not refine_kind:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р¦РµР№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ РјРѕР¶РЅР° Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РёС‚Рё.", "refine_kind": ""}
    current_level = normalize_refine_level(item_info.get("refine_level", 0))
    max_level = get_refine_max_level(refine_kind)
    if current_level >= max_level:
        return {"success": False, "message": f"вњ… РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ СѓР¶Рµ РјР°С” РјР°РєСЃРёРјР°Р»СЊРЅСѓ Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РєСѓ +{max_level}.", "refine_kind": refine_kind}
    return {"success": True, "message": "вњ… РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РјРѕР¶РЅР° Р·Р°С‚РѕС‡РёС‚Рё.", "refine_kind": refine_kind, "current_level": current_level, "max_level": max_level}


def roll_refine_success(refine_kind, current_level, use_success_rune=False):
    if use_success_rune:
        return {"success": True, "chance": 100, "roll": None}
    chance = get_refine_success_chance(refine_kind, current_level)
    roll = random.randint(1, 100)
    return {"success": roll <= chance, "chance": chance, "roll": roll}


def perform_refine_attempt(user_id, inventory_id, use_success_rune=False):
    from db import init_refine_system, get_inventory_item_refine_info, count_user_item, consume_user_item_by_item_id, set_inventory_refine_level
    init_refine_system()
    item_info = get_inventory_item_refine_info(inventory_id)
    if not item_info:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РџСЂРµРґРјРµС‚ РЅРµ Р·РЅР°Р№РґРµРЅРѕ."}
    if int(item_info.get("user_id", 0)) != int(user_id):
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ Р¦Рµ РЅРµ С‚РІС–Р№ РїСЂРµРґРјРµС‚."}
    refine_check = can_refine_item(item_info)
    if not refine_check.get("success"):
        return refine_check
    if count_user_item(user_id, REFINE_STONE_ITEM_ID) <= 0:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РµРЅ рџЄЁ РљР°РјС–РЅСЊ РџРѕСЃРёР»РµРЅРЅСЏ."}
    if use_success_rune and count_user_item(user_id, SUCCESS_RUNE_ITEM_ID) <= 0:
        return {"success": False, "message": "вќЊ РџРѕС‚СЂС–Р±РЅР° рџ’Ћ Р СѓРЅР° РЈСЃРїС–С…Сѓ."}
    consume_user_item_by_item_id(user_id, REFINE_STONE_ITEM_ID, 1)
    if use_success_rune:
        consume_user_item_by_item_id(user_id, SUCCESS_RUNE_ITEM_ID, 1)
    refine_kind = refine_check["refine_kind"]
    current_level = refine_check["current_level"]
    roll_result = roll_refine_success(refine_kind, current_level, use_success_rune)
    if roll_result["success"]:
        new_level = current_level + 1
        set_inventory_refine_level(inventory_id, new_level)
        return {"success": True, "refine_success": True, "refine_kind": refine_kind, "old_level": current_level, "new_level": new_level, "chance": roll_result["chance"], "roll": roll_result["roll"], "used_success_rune": bool(use_success_rune), "message": f"вњ… Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР° СѓСЃРїС–С€РЅР°: +{current_level} в†’ +{new_level}"}
    new_level = get_refine_failure_level(refine_kind, current_level)
    set_inventory_refine_level(inventory_id, new_level)
    if new_level < current_level:
        message = f"вќЊ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР° РЅРµ РІРґР°Р»Р°СЃСЏ: +{current_level} в†’ +{new_level}"
    else:
        message = f"вќЊ Р—Р°С‚РѕС‡РєР° РЅРµ РІРґР°Р»Р°СЃСЏ: +{current_level} Р±РµР· Р·РјС–РЅ"
    return {"success": True, "refine_success": False, "refine_kind": refine_kind, "old_level": current_level, "new_level": new_level, "chance": roll_result["chance"], "roll": roll_result["roll"], "used_success_rune": bool(use_success_rune), "message": message}
